वाष्प: वाष्प वाष्प (also written वास्प), अस्, अम्, m. n. (perhaps connected with वार्; according to Uṇādi-s. III. 28. fr. rt. वाध्, the final being changed to ष्; cf. अश्रु), vapour, hot vapour, steam, mist; an incipient tear, water swimming in the eye, a tear, tears; iron; a kind of pot-herb, = वाष्पिका; (अस्), m., N. of one of the five pupils of Śākya-muni; (ई), f. a drug (commonly हिङ्गु-पत्त्री); [cf. Lat. vappa, perhaps vapor.] —वाष्प-कण्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, having tears in the throat, choking with tears. —वाष्प-कल, अस्, आ, अम्, inarticulate through tears. —वाष्प-दुर्दिन, अस्, आ, अम्, clouded by tears. —वाष्प-पूर, अस्, m. a flood of tears. —वाष्प-प्रमोचन, अम्, n. the shedding of tears, act of shed-ding tears. —वाष्प-मोचन, अम्, n. the shedding of tears. —वाष्प-विक्लव, अस्, आ, अम्, overcome or agitated with tears, confused with weeping. —वाष्प-विन्दु, उस्, m. a tear-drop, tear. —वाष्प-सन्दिग्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, indistinct or hesitating through suppressed tears. —वाष्पाकुल (°प-आक्°), अस्, आ, अम्, inter-rupted by tears. —वाष्पाम्बु-पूर (°प-अम्°), अस्, m. a flood of tears. —वाष्पाविलेक्षण (°प-आविल-ईक्°), having the eyes dimmed by tears. —वाष्पोद्-भव (°प-उद्°), the rising or starting of tears.
वाष्पक: वाष्पक, अस्, m. a kind of vegetable or pot-herb, = मारिष; (आ), f. a drug (= हिङ्गु-पत्त्री).
वाष्पाय: वाष्पाय, Nom. A. वाष्पायते, -यितुम्, to weep, shed tears; to emit vapour or steam.
वाष्पिका: वाष्पिका or वाष्पीका, f. a drug (= हिङ्गु-पत्त्री).
वाष्पिन्: वाष्पिन्, ई, इणी, इ, discharging or shedding tears (at the end of a comp.).
वास्: वास् वास् (perhaps rather to be regarded as a Nom. fr. 1. वास below), cl. 10. P. वासयति (ep. also A. वासयते), -यितुम्, to fill with (perfumes &c.); to infuse (fragrant odours or other qualities), steep, macerate; to perfume, make fra-grant, fumigate, incense; to spice, season; cl. 4. A. वास्यते, to sound, cry, (in this sense for rt. वाश्, q. v.)
वास: 1. वास, अस्, m. perfuming, perfume; (अस्, आ), m. f. the plant Justicia Ganderussa. —वास-ताम्बूल, अम्, n. betel mixed with fragrant substances (such as car-damoms, camphor, &c.). —वास-योग, अस्, m. fra-grant powder sprinkled on the clothes, (especially) the red powder scattered about at the Holī festival.

वास 2. वास, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 6. वस्), dwell-ing, resting, living; a dwelling-place, house, habita-tion; site, situation, abode, place of staying or abid-ing, [cf. Hib. fos, ‘staying, resting.’] —वास-कर्णी, f. a hall where public exhibitions (as Nāches &c. are held). —वास-गृह, अम्, n. ‘dwelling-house,’ the inner part of a house, an inner or sleeping-room, bed-chamber. —वास-पर्यय, अस्, m. change of residence. —वास-भवन, अम्, n. or वास-भूमि, इस्, f. a place of abode, dwelling-place, house. —वास-यष्टि, इस्, f. a pole or pillar for a bird to perch on, a roosting perch. —वास-वेश्मन्, अ, n. the inner part of a house. —वासागार (°स-आग्°), अम्, n. ‘abiding apartment,’ the inner or sleeping apartment. —वासौकस् (°स-ओक्°), अस्, n. ‘dwelling-house,’ the inner or private apartments.
वास 3. वास, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 5. वस्), dress-ing, dress, cloth, clothes. —वास-सज्जा, f. a woman dressed in all her ornaments to receive her lover.
वासक: 1. वासक, अस्, आ or इका, अम्, perfuming, fumi-gating, filling with perfume; (अस्, आ or इका), m. f. ‘giving perfume,’ the plant Justicia Ganderussa.
2. वासक, अस्, आ or इका, अम्, causing to inhabit, making to dwell or abide, populating.
3. वासक, अस्, m. clothing, clothes. —वासक-सज्जा or वासक-सज्जिका, f. a woman dressed in all her ornaments to receive her lover.
वासन: 1. वासन, अम्, n. the act of perfuming, fumigating with fragrant vapours or incense, infusing, steeping.

2. वासन, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to an abode, fit for a dwelling; (अम्), n. causing to abide; abiding, abode; a particular posture (conceived to be pecu-liarly proper for ascetics during abstract meditation; also said to be practised by princes, when it is de-scribed as sitting with the knees bent and the feet turned backwards); any receptacle or vessel, a water-jar, box, basket; knowledge; (आ), f. knowledge de-rived from memory, the present consciousness of past perceptions or an impression remaining unconsciously in the mind from past good or evil actions and hence producing pleasure or pain (= संस्कार); fancy, imagination, idea, inclination [cf. दुर्-व्°]; false fancy, ignorance; expectation, desire, trust, confidence. —वासन-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, placed in a box or basket, packed, folded. —वासना-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, full of imagination, consisting in fancy. —वा-सनामय-त्व, अम्, n. the state of being full of imagination.
3. वासन, अस्, आ, अम्, enveloping, covering, cloth-ing; (अम्), n. cloth, clothes; an envelope.
वासिका: वासिका, f. See under 1. वासक above.
वासित: 1. वासित, अस्, आ, अम्, infused, steeped, perfumed, scented, made fragrant, filled with fragrance; spiced, seasoned (as sauces &c.); (अम्), n. the cry of birds, sound, (for वाशित, q. v.)

2. वासित, अस्, आ, अम्, peopled, populous (as a country); flourishing, famous, celebrated; possessed of, possessing, having; (अम्), n. the act of rendering populous or causing to be inhabited; knowledge (especially derived from memory, see वासना).
3. वासित, अस्, आ, अम्, clothed, dressed; (आ), f. a woman; a female elephant; the female of cattle.
वासतेय: वासतेय, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. वसति), habitable, fit or proper to be dwelt in; (ई), f. night.
वासि: वासि, इस्, m. abiding, dwelling; (इस्, ई), m. f. a small hatchet or axe, chopper, adze, chisel; [cf. वाशी।]
वासिन्: 1. वासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, abiding, staying, inhabiting; (ई), m. an inhabitant (at the end of a comp.); (इनी), f. a sort of white Jhiṇṭī or Barleria (= शुक्ल-झिण्टी).
2. वासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having or wearing clothes, dressed, arrayed, clothed, (पीत-कौशेय-वासिनी, a woman wearing a yellow silk garment.)
वासस्: वासस्, अस्, n. cloth, clothes, dress, a garment; a pall; a curtain. —वासः-कुटी, f. a tent. —वासः-खण्ड, अस्, अम्, m. n. a piece of cloth, a rag. —वासो-द, अस्, आ, अम्, giving clothes. —वासो-यु-ग, अम्, n. a pair of garments, suit of clothes, (the dress of the Hindūs usually consisting of two pieces of cloth, viz. a lower garment fastened round the waist, and an upper one thrown loosely over the shoulders.)
वास्य: वास्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be clothed; to be covered or pervaded.
वासत: वासत वासत, अस्, m. an ass.
वासन्त: वासन्त वासन्त, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. वसन्त), vernal, relating to spring, suitable to spring, produced in the spring season; being in the spring of life, young; attentive or diligent (in the performance of religious ceremonies &c.); situated, (? perhaps con-nected with 2. वास); (अस्), m. a camel; the Indian cuckoo; a young elephant, any young animal; the southern or western wind (= मलयानिल, q. v.); a sort of kidney-bean (Phaseolus Mungo), a kind of black bean (= कृष्ण-मुद्ग); the plant Vangueria Spinosa; a dissolute man; (ई), f. a large creeper, Gærtnera Racemosa; a species of jasmine, Jasminum Auriculatum (= माधवी, यूथी); long pepper; the trumpet-flower; N. of a deity; a festival in honour of Kāma-deva (held in the month Caitra; in some places Durgā is worshipped at this festival); a species of the Śakvarī metre. —वासन्ती-पूजा, f. the worship of Durgā in the month Caitra.
वासन्तक: वासन्तक, अस्, ई, अम्, vernal, sown or grown in spring; suitable to the spring season; relating or belonging to it, &c.
वासन्तिक: वासन्तिक, अस्, ई, अम्, vernal; (अस्), m. the buffoon or Vidūṣaka in a drama (see विदूषक); an actor, dancer (the spring being the season for dancing, &c.).
वासर: वासर वासर, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 3. वस्; cf. उषस्), Ved. shining, giving light, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda VIII. 48, 7. वासराणि = जगद्-वासकानि); (अस्, अम्), m. n. a day; (अस्), m. one of the Nāgas or serpents, a kind of snake; (ई), f. epi-thet of a cow. —वासर-सङ्ग, अस्, m. ‘day-junc-tion,’ the morning.
वासव: वासव वासव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. वसु), belong-ing to Indra; accompanied by the Vasus; (अस्), m., N. of Indra; (ई), f. the mother of Vyāsa. —वासव-दत्ता, f., N. of the wife of Nidhi-pati; of a work by Subandhu (describing the amours of Kandarpa-ketu and Vāsava-dattā). —वासवेश्वर-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha. —वासवोपम (°व-उप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, resembling or like Indra.
वासिषुम्फ: वासिषुम्फ वासिषुम्फ, N. of a place.
वासिष्ठ: वासिष्ठ वासिष्ठ, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. वसिष्ठ, q. v., cf. वाशिष्ठ), belonging to Vasiṣṭha, com-posed by or revealed to the Ṛṣi Vasiṣṭha (as the seventh Maṇḍala of the Ṛg-veda); (अस्), m. a son or descendant of Vasiṣṭha (applied as a patronymic to various Ṛṣis); (ई), f. a female descendant of Vasiṣṭha; (अम्), n. = योग-वासिष्ठ. —वासिष्ठ-रामायण, अम्, n. = योग-वासिष्ठ. —वासिष्ठ-लैङ्ग-पुराण, अम्, n., N. of a Purāṇa. —वा-सिष्ठ-सार, अस्, m. = योग-व्°. —वासिष्ठोपपु-राण (°ठ-उप्°), अम्, n., N. of an Upa-Purāṇa.
वासु: वासु वासु, उस्, m. (fr. rt. 6. वस्), N. of Viṣṇu (as dwelling in all beings); the soul; the Supreme Being considered as the soul of the universe. —वासु-पूज्य, अस्, m. the twelfth Jina of the present era. —वासु-भद्र, अस्, m. a N. of Kṛṣṇa.
वासू: वासू, ऊस्, f. (in theatrical language) a young girl, maiden.
वासुकि: वासुकि वासुकि, इस्, m. (fr. वसुक, said to be a N. of Kaśyapa), the serpent Vāsuki, sovereign of the snakes. —वासुकि-ह्रद, अस्, m., N. of a lake.
वासुकेय: वासुकेय, अस्, m. the serpent Vāsuki. —वासु-केय-स्वसृ, सा, f. ‘sister of Vāsuki,’ epithet of the goddess Manasā (presiding over serpents and regarded as wife of Jarat-kāru).
वासुक्र: वासुक्र वासुक्र, अस्, m. (fr. वसु-क्र), Ved. a patronymic of Vasu-karṇa; of Vasu-kṛt.
वासुदेव: वासुदेव वासुदेव, अस्, m. (fr. वसु-देव), ‘son of Vasu-deva,’ epithet of Kṛṣṇa; a descendant of Vasu-deva; N. of a class of persons peculiar to the Jainas; N. of an author; of a poet; of a phy-sician. —वासुदेव-प्रियङ्करी, f. a kind of shrub (= शतावरी). —वासुदेवोपनिषद् (°व-उप्°), त्, f., N. of one of the more recent Upaniṣads of the Atharva-veda.
वासुरा: वासुरा वासुरा, f. (fr. rt. 6. वस् or rt. वास्), night; the earth; a woman; a female elephant.
वास्त: वास्त वास्त, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. वस्त), made or derived from a goat, coming from goats, goatish, (also written बास्त।)
वास्तिक: वास्तिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to goats; (अम्), n. a collection of goats.
वास्तव: वास्तव वास्तव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. वस्तु), sub-stantial, real; being anything in the true sense of the word, substantiated, fixed, determined, demonstrated; (आ), f. dawn; (अम्), n. anything fixed or appointed. —वास्तवोषा, f. ‘real twilight,’ night, (according to some this is not a compound but two words, उषा, ‘dawn,’ being the explanation of वास्तवा।)
वास्तविक: वास्तविक, अस्, ई, अम्, substantial, real, material, genuine; demonstrated.
वास्तव्य: वास्तव्य वास्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम् (anom. fut. part. of rt. 6. वस्), fit to be abided or dwelt in, fit to be inhabited; making a habitation, inhabiting, dwelling; (अस्), m. a dweller, resident, inhabitant, citizen, dependant; [cf. ग्राम-व्°।]
वास्तु: वास्तु वास्तु, उस्, उ, m. n. (fr. rt. 6. वस्; see Uṇādi-s. 1. 77), the site or foundation of a house, ground suitable for building a house, a building-place, building-ground, site, ground [cf. पुर-व्°]; a house, habitation, abode, region; (उ), n. a kind of vegetable (= वास्तुक). —वास्तु-तत्त्व, अम्, n., N. of a part of the Smṛti-tattva. —वास्तु-प्रदीप, N. of a work. —वास्तु-याग, अस्, m. a sacrificial rite observed on measuring the ground and laying the foundation of a house. —वास्तु-याग-तत्त्व, अम्, n., N. of a part of the Smṛti-tattva (giving the rules for the above rite). —वास्तु-शास्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a work. —वास्तु-संशमन or वास्तु-संशमनीय, अम्, n. a cere-mony performed on laying the foundation or setting out the ground for a new house, a sacrifice performed on preparing a foundation or on entering a new man-sion. —वास्तु-ह, अम्, n. in Aitareya-Br. V. 14. in-terpreted to mean ‘what is left on the sacred spot.’ —वास्तोष्-पति, इस्, m. ‘lord of the Vāstu,’ i. e. ‘protector of the foundation of a house,’ or generally ‘house-protector,’ N. of one of the more recent deities of the Ṛg-veda (regarded as presiding over the founda-tion of a house, and addressed in VII. 54. and VII. 55); an epithet of Indra, (also written वास्तोस्-पति।)
वास्तुक: वास्तुक or वास्तूक, अम्, n. the pot-herb Che-nopodium Album.
वास्तुकी: वास्तुकी, f. a species of vegetable (= चिल्ली).
वास्तेय: वास्तेय वास्तेय, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. वस्ति), relat-ing or belonging to the belly, abdominal.
वास्त्र: वास्त्र वास्त्र, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. वस्त्र), made of cloth, covered with cloth, &c.
वास्थ: वास्थ वा-स्थ = वाः-स्थ। See under वार्।
वास्प: वास्प वास्प, अस्, m. (more correctly written वाष्प, q. v.), a tear, tears, hot vapour, &c.
वास्पेय: वास्पेय, अस्, m. the tree Nāga-keśara, (commonly called नागेशर्।)
वाह्: वाह् 1. वाह् (also written बाह्; connected with rt. 1. वह्), cl. 1. A. वाहते (ep. also P. वाहति), ववाहे, वाहितुम्, to endeavour, make effort, strive, exert one's self, try: Caus. वाहयति, -यितुम्, to cause to labour or work, use, employ, occupy.
वाह् 2. वाह्, ट्, -ही, ट् (fr. rt. 1. वह्), bear-ing, carrying, &c. (at the end of comps.; cf. भार-व्°, वज्र-व्°, Gram. 182. c).
वाहन: 1. वाहन, अम्, n. the act of making effort, en-deavouring, exertion.

2. वाहन, अम्, n. the act of carrying, bearing, conveying, conducting; the act of driving or govern-ing (horses); a vehicle, chariot, carriage, a convey-ance of any kind; any animal used in riding or draught, a horse, an elephant; (अस्), m., N. of a Muni; [cf. Old Germ. wagana, ‘a chariot;’ Hib. feun, ‘a chariot.’]
वाहयत्: वाहयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to labour, employ-ing, making use of.
वाहित: 1. वाहित, अस्, आ, अम्, exerted, endeavoured; mys-tified.
2. वाहित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to be borne or con-veyed; (अम्), n. a heavy burden.
वाह: वाह, अस्, आ, अम्, bearing, carrying, (अति-भार-वाह, carrying too heavy burdens); (अस्), m. bear-ing, carrying, drawing; a bearer, porter, carrier of burdens, &c.; any animal used for draught, a beast of burden; a horse; a buffalo; a bull; any vehicle, carriage, conveyance, car; the arm; air, wind; a measure of capacity containing ten Kumbhas (nearly equal to the weight of an English wey). —वाह-द्विषत्, अन्, m. a buffalo (said to be so called as ‘hostile to the horse’). —वाह-भ्रंश्, -भ्रट्, ट्, ट् (or वाह-भ्रंस्, -भ्रत्, त्, त्), falling from a vehi-cle, &c. —वाह-श्रेष्ठ, अस्, m. ‘best of draught-animals,’ a horse.
वाहक: वाहक, अस्, इका, अम्, bearing, carrying, convey-ing, conducting; (अस्), m. a porter, carrier; the driver of a chariot; a horseman.
वाहयित्वा: वाहयित्वा, ind. having caused to be conveyed.
वाहस्: वाहस्, आस्, m., Ved. one who carries or bears (at the end of comps.; cf. स्तोम-व्°, नृ-व्°, गिर्-व्°, ब्रह्म-व्°); ‘one who bears the oblation or sacrifice’ [cf. यज्ञ-व्°], epithet of Agni; (अस्), n. a hymn, (Sāy. = स्तोत्र।)
वाहस: वाहस, अस्, m. a water-course; a large snake (especially the boa constrictor); the pot-herb Mar-silia Dentata.
वाहिक: वाहिक, अस्, m. a car or vehicle drawn by oxen; a large drum.
वाहिन्: वाहिन्, ई, इनी, इ, bearing, carrying (often at the end of comps.); (ई), m. a chariot; (इनी), f. an army, body of forces; a division of an army (consisting of 81 elephants, 81 cars, 243 horse, 405 foot), a battalion; a river. —वाहि-त्थ, अम्, n. (for वाहि-स्थ), the part of an elephant's forehead below the frontal globes. —वाहिनी-निवेश, अस्, m. the camp of an army. —वाहिनी-पति, इस्, m. the lord or leader of an army, a general, commanding officer; ‘lord of rivers,’ epithet of the ocean.
वाहिष्ठ: वाहिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. bearing or carrying best, bearing most effectually, (according to Nirukta V. 1 = वोढृ-तम।)
वाहीक: 1. वाहीक, अस्, आ, अम्, carrying, bearing burdens; (अस्), m. an ox; N. of a priest.
वाहीक 2. वाहीक, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. वहिस्), outer, external; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a country (said to be part of the Pañjāb).
वाहुक: वाहुक, अस्, m., N. of a charioteer.
वाह्य: 1. वाह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be carried or borne; (अम्), n. a carriage, vehicle; (अस्), m. any beast of burden, an ox, horse, &c.

वि: वि 1. वि, ind. (thought by some to be for an original द्वि, meaning ‘in two parts;’ as a prepo-sition or prefix to verbs it is opposed to सम्, q. v., and expresses) apart, apart from, asunder, in different directions, to and fro, about, away, away from, off, &c. (e. g. वि-युज्, to disjoin, separate; वि-दॄ, to tear asunder; वि-कॄ, to scatter in different direc-tions; वि-चल्, to move to and fro; वि-च्छिद्, to cut away, cut off); when prefixed to some roots, वि gives a meaning opposite to the idea contained in the simple rt. (e. g. क्री, to buy; वि-क्री, to sell; स्मृ, to remember; वि-स्मृ, to forget); in other cases it appears either not to affect or simply to intensify that idea [cf. नश्, वि-नश्, हिंस्, वि-हिंस्]. वि may also be used with verbs or nouns, and other parts of speech derived from verbs, to express ‘division’ [cf. वि-भिद्, वि-भेद, वि-भज्, वि-भाग]; ‘distinction’ [cf. वि-शिष्, वि-शेष, वि-विच्, वि-वेक]; ‘discrimi-nation’ [cf. व्य्-अवच्छिद्, व्य्-अवच्छेद]; ‘distri-bution,’ ‘arrangement,’ ‘order’ [cf. वि-धा, वि-धान]; ‘opposition’ [cf. वि-रुध्, वि-रोध]; ‘discussion,’ ‘deliberation’ [cf. वि-चर्, वि-चार]; ‘privation’ [cf. वि-नी, वि-नयन]. वि may also be used with nouns, adjective or substantive, not immediately connected with verbs, to express ‘difference’ [cf. वि-लक्षण]; ‘variety’ [cf. वि-चित्र]; ‘distinction’ [cf. वि-शेष]; ‘intensity,’ ‘greatness,’ ‘largeness’ [cf. वि-कराल]; ‘change’ [cf. वि-कार]; ‘manifoldness’ [cf. वि-विध]; ‘con-trariety’ [cf. वि-लोम]; ‘impropriety,’ ‘deviation from right’ [cf. वि-जन्मन्, वि-कर्मिक]; ‘nega-tion’ or ‘privation’ (e. g. वि-जन, devoid of men; in this sense वि is used like निस्, q. v., and like 3. अ, q. v.); in this latter signification the use of वि often corresponds to that of the Latin dis, se, and the English prefixes a, ex, de, dis, in, un, &c.; [cf. Old Germ. wi-dar, ‘against;’ Pers. بى bī, ‘without;’ perhaps Lat. vê, in words like ve-cors, ve-sanus, vi in di-vi-dere; Lith. be, ‘without;’ Slav. beζ (perhaps = वहिस्).]

वि 2. वि, इस्, m. f. (according to Uṇādi-s. Zend vi; Gr. οἰ-ωνό-ς, αἰ-ε-τό-ς, ὤϊον, ὠόν; Lat. avis, ovum; Old Germ. ei; Angl. Sax. œg.] — 1. वि-गत, अम्, n. (for 2. see under वि-गम्), the flight of birds. —१। वि-च्छाय, अम्, n. (for 2. see s. v.), the shadow of a flock of birds.

विकाश 1. वी-काश, अस्, m. (for 1. वि-काश), manifestation, display; ether, heaven.
विकाशक: वि-काशक, अस्, इका, अम्, displaying, causing to appear or shine forth, illustrating; causing to expand or bloom, opening (= वि-कासक).
विकाशन: वि-काशन, अम्, n. manifestation, display, exhi-bition, extent; expansion, blowing (of a flower; but in this sense better वि-कासन); the causing to ex-pand or blow (= वि-कासन).
विकाशित: वि-काशित, अस्, आ, अम्, made visible, displayed, made to shine, illumined, resplendent; expanded.
विकाशिन्: वि-काशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, becoming visible or apparent, becoming manifested, shining forth; expanding, spread-ing, developing, opening, budding, blowing, (in these senses better वि-कासिन्।)
विचाकसत्: वि-चाकसत्, अत्, अती, अत्, Ved. See s. v.
विकाषिन्: विकाषिन् वि-काषिन् for विकासिन् and विकाशिन्, q. q. v. v.
विकिर: विकिर वि-किर, वि-किरत्, &c. See under वि-कॄ, p. 910, col. 3.
वि-किर, अस्, m. scattering, tearing, one who scat-ters or tears, a bird, a scattered portion or fallen fragment, anything dropped; a well.
विकुक्षि: विकुक्षि वि-कुक्षि, इस्, m., N. of a son of Ikṣvāku.
विकुञ्च्: विकुञ्च् वि-कुञ्च्, cl. 10. P. -कुञ्चयति, -यि-तुम्, to contract; to bend or turn back.
विकुञ्चित: वि-कुञ्चित, अस्, आ, अम्, contracted, crisped, curled; drawn into wrinkles, knitted (as the brow), frowning. —विकुञ्चित-ललाट-भृत्, त्, त्, त्, having a scowling brow.
विकुण्ठ: विकुण्ठ वि-कुण्ठ (perhaps ‘not blunted,’ ‘not worn out,’ ‘ever fresh;’ cf. अ-कुण्ठ), N. of Viṣṇu's heaven; (आ), f., N. of the mother of Viṣṇu.
विकुण्ठित: वि-कुण्ठित, अस्, आ, अम्, obtuse, blunt; weak, feeble.
विकुस्र: विकुस्र वि-कुस्र, अस्, m. (in Uṇādi-s. II. 15. said to be fr. rt. कस् with वि), the moon, (said to be also written वि-क्रस्र।)
विकूज्: विकूज् वि-कूज्, cl. 1. P. -कूजति, -कूजितुम्, to coo, chirp, sing (as a bird &c.), make any cry or sound, hum, buzz.
विकूजन: वि-कूजन, अम्, n. cooing, chirping, humming, grumbling, rumbling, (अन्त्र-विकूजन, rumbling of the bowels.)
विकूण्: विकूण् वि-कूण्, cl. 10. P. -कूणयति, -यितुम्, Ved. to contract.
विकूणन: वि-कूणन, अम्, n. a side-glance, leer, wink.
विकृ: विकृ वि-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to make different, form variously, give a different shape to anything, transform, alter, change, convert, cause to alter; to cause any one to change his state or opinions; to cause to change for the worse, distort, deprave, pervert, deform, render de-formed, spoil; to display; to form or produce variously (as sound, A.); to be changed, undergo a change, change for the worse, deteriorate, change one's state or opinions (A.); to rejoice (A.); to feel aversion (A.); to act in various ways (A.); to decorate in various manners; to move to and fro, become restless (A.); to put into practice, exercise; to distribute; to ex-tend; to destroy, annihilate; to act in a hostile or un-friendly way towards (with gen. or loc. of the person); to contend together: Pass. वि-क्रियते, &c., to be changed, undergo a change; to act as a substitute for, act in place of (with acc., Ved.): Caus. -कारयति, -यितुम्, to cause to change or be changed.

विकृ वि-कॄ, cl. 6. P. -किरति, -करितुम् or -करीतुम्, to scatter in different directions, throw about, sprinkle, toss about, disperse; to spread about, expand, extend; to dissolve; to scatter over, over-whelm, cover, fill with; to tear asunder, split, rend; to revile; to contaminate.
विकरण: वि-करण, अस्, m., scil. प्रत्यय, (in grammar) a term for the affix or conjugational characteristic which is placed between the root and terminations, the inserted conjugational affix; (according to Pāṇini these affixes are शप्, शपो लुक्, श्लु, श्यन्, श्नु, श, श्नम्, उ, यक्, and च्लि with its substitutes तासि, स्य, and सिप्, the first eight of which are added in the Present, Imperfect, Imperative, and Potential, and before a Kṛt which contains a mute palatal श्, when these affixes denote the Kartṛ or Agent, i. e. the Active; when, however, they denote the Karman or Bhāva, i. e. the Passive or Neuter, then यक् is added; च्लि is added in the Aorist, तासि in the Ist Future, स्य in the 2nd Future and Conditional, and सिप् before Leṭ.)
विकर्मिक: विकर्मिक, अस्, ई, अम्, transacting various affairs; doing forbidden acts; acting wrongly; (अस्), m. a clerk or superintendant of markets or fairs.
विकारित: वि-कारित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to be changed, made to undergo a change, converted, perverted; rendered unfavourable or unfriendly.
विकारिन्: वि-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, producing a change, modifying; undergoing a change; producing a change for the worse, spoiling; feeling emotion, falling in love; (ई), m., N. of the seventh year of Jupiter's cycle.
विकुर्वाण: वि-कुर्वाण, अस्, आ, अम्, undergoing or causing a change of form or of mind, &c.; feeling emotions of joy, &c., rejoicing, being glad.
विकृत: वि-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, altered, changed, modified, trans-formed, changed in form or feeling; changed for the worse, sick, diseased, mutilated, maimed, deformed, disfigured; unnatural; imperfect, unfinished, incom-plete; affected by passion, overcome by emotion; enter-taining feelings of disgust or aversion, averse, estranged; strange, extraordinary; (अम्), n. change, alteration; change for the worse, a diseased state; disgust, aver-sion. —विकृत-दर्शन, अस्, आ, अम्, changed in appearance. —विकृत-बुद्धि, इस्, इस्, इ, changed in mind, estranged, made unfriendly or ill-disposed. —विकृत-लोचन, अस्, आ, अम्, having excited eyes. —विकृत-वदन, अस्, आ, अम्, having a distorted face, ugly-faced. —विकृताकार (°त-आक्°), अस्, आ, अम्, changed in form or appearance, misshaped, distorted in form. —विकृताकृति (°त-आक्°), इस्, इस्, इ, having a deformed shape or aspect. —विकृताङ्ग (°त-अङ्°), अस्, आ, अम्, changed in form, having mis-shaped limbs, deformed. —विकृतानन (°त-आन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having a distorted countenance, ugly-faced.
विकृति: वि-कृति, इस्, f. change, alteration of any kind (as of purpose, mind, form, nature, &c.), change from a natural or healthy state, sickness, disease; change from a quiescent state, emotion, anger, wrath, fear; (in the Sāṅkhya philosophy) a production or that which is evolved from a previous प्र-कृति or pro-ducer (see वि-कार, col. 1); fermented or spirituous liquor; a species of metre (the stanza consisting of four lines of two syllables each, variously arranged); = डिम्भ (according to Śabda-k.); (इस्), m., N. of a king. —विकृति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessed of change, changed; diseased, wounded; changeable. —विकृति-विज्ञानीय, N. of a chapter in the Ash-ṭāṅga-hṛdaya-saṃhitā.
विक्रिया: वि-क्रिया, f. alteration, change; transformation, change of mind, &c., any change from a natural or quiescent state, disease, injury, mischief, emotion, anger, any sudden affection or seizure [cf. भूत-व्°, रोम-व्°]; a preparation or dish of rice, &c.
विकृत्: विकृत् वि-कृत्, cl. 6. P. -कृन्तति, -कर्तितुम्, to cut into or through, divide by cutting, tear to pieces, destroy.
विकर्त: वि-कर्त, वि-कर्त्तृ in गो-व्°, q. q. v. v.
विकृश्: विकृश् वि-कृश्, Caus. -कर्शयति, -यितुम्, to make thin, emaciate, attenuate; to distort, deform.
विकृष्: विकृष् वि-कृष्, cl. 1. P. -कर्षति, cl. 6. P. A. -कृषति, -ते, -कर्ष्टुम् or -क्रष्टुम्, to draw asunder, tear asunder, drag apart, draw across, drag hither and thither, draw different ways, drag to and fro, drag excessively, drag along, drag after, draw away, draw out, pull out, extend, draw away from; to withdraw, deprive of, withhold, keep back; to destroy; to pull or drag or draw (in general); to draw a furrow, plough (cl. 6); to draw (a bow-string, cl. 1), bend (a bow).
विकर्षण: वि-कर्षण, अस्, m. ‘the distractor,’ one of the five arrows of Kāmadeva; (अम्), n. the act of draw-ing asunder, pulling, drawing, dragging; the drawing (of a bow); the act of dragging or throwing across, a cross throw (in wrestling &c.).
विकर्षत्: वि-कर्षत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, dragging asunder or across.
विकृष्ट: वि-कृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, dragged asunder, drawn asunder or apart; analyzed; dragged hither and thither; dragged excessively; drawn towards, attracted, dragged, drawn, pulled, drawn (as a bow-string); drawn out, extended, protracted, long; sounded, making a noise (= शब्दायमान). —विकृष्ट-काल, अस्, m. a long period, (विकृष्ट-कालैस्, ind. for a long time or extended period.)
विकृष्य: वि-कृष्य, ind. having drawn or dragged asunder.
विकृष्यमाण: वि-कृष्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being dragged asunder, being dragged or pulled about hither and thither.
विकिरण: वि-किरण, अम्, n. (according to Śabda-k. वि-कीरण), the act of scattering, throwing or spreading about, dispersing, tearing; spreading abroad; know-ledge, fame; (अस्), m. gigantic swallow wort, Calo-tropis Gigantea (= अर्क).
विकिरत्: वि-किरत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, scattering about, sprinkling, throwing in different directions, covering (with arrows &c.).
विकीर्ण: वि-कीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, scattered or spread about, extended, diffused; celebrated, famous. —विकीर्ण-केश or विकीर्ण-मूर्धज, अस्, आ, अम्, having dishevelled hair. —विकीर्ण-रोमन्, अ, n. or विकीर्ण-सञ्ज्ञ, अम्, n. a sort of perfume (= स्थौणेय).
विकीर्य: वि-कीर्य, ind. having scattered about, having spread in different directions.
विकीर्यमाण: वि-कीर्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being scattered, being tossed about, being agitated, &c.
विकॢप्: विकॢप् वि-कॢप्, cl. 1. A. -कल्पते, -कल्पि-तुम्, to change or alternate with (with inst.); to be doubtful or questionable, be subject to doubt or alter-native, be optional or not decided: Caus. P. -कल्प-यति, -यितुम्, to prepare or arrange or dispose differ-ently; to prescribe variously; to make, compose, form; to change or exchange with anything; to divide (Ved.); to weigh alternatives, admit anything as doubtful or optional; to choose one out of two alternatives (Ved.); to doubt, consider as doubtful, be doubtful about, consider with distrust; to consider possible, conjecture, presume; to reflect upon.
विकल्पक: वि-कल्पक, at the end of an adj. comp. = वि-कल्प; [cf. निर्-व्°, स-व्°।]
वि-कल्पक; add — अस्, m. one who divides or distributes; one who prepares or arranges.
विकल्पन: वि-कल्पन, अम्, n. the giving or allowing an option or alternative, admitting of doubt or uncer-tainty; indecision; inconsideration.
विकल्पयत्: वि-कल्पयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, preparing or disposing differently, composing; exchanging with; weighing alternatives, deliberating, doubting.
विकल्पित: वि-कल्पित, अस्, आ, अम्, made optional, held to be optional; (in grammar) optionally enforced, applied or not at pleasure, (अ-विकल्पित, not subject to doubt, undoubted.)
विकल्पिन्: वि-कल्पिन्, ई, इनी, इ, possessing doubt or indecision, possessing an illusion, (नीलाशोक-विकल्पि-केश-नि-करः, having a mass of hair possessing the illusion of the dark Aśoka.)
विकेश: विकेश 1. वि-केश, अस्, ई, अम्, having loose or dishevelled hair; (ई), f. a woman with loose hair; a small braid or tress of hair first tied up separately and then collected into the Veṇī or larger braid.

2. वि-केश, अस्, ई, अम्, hairless, without hair, bald; (अस्), m., N. of a Muni; (ई), f. a woman without hair; N. of the wife of Śiva manifested in the form of Mahī or the Earth (one of his eight Tanus or visible forms).
विकेशिका: वि-केशिका, f. a piece of rag smeared with ghee or other substances and applied as a dressing to a sore, a kind of pledget.
विकोक: विकोक वि-कोक, अस्, m. [cf. कोक], N. of an Asura (son of Vṛka and killed by Kalki).
विकोष: विकोष वि-कोष or वि-कोश, अस्, आ, अम्, with-out a case or covering, without a husk, unsheathed (as a sword &c.), uncovered, denuded.
विकौतुक: विकौतुक वि-कौतुक, अस्, ई, अम्, having no desire or curiosity, incurious, indifferent.
विक्क: विक्क विक्क, अस्, m. a young elephant.
विक्त: विक्त विक्त। See under rt. विच्, p. 913, col. 2.
विक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, separated; empty, (probably for रिक्त, q. v.)
विक्रन्दित: विक्रन्दित वि-क्रन्दित, अस्, आ, अम् (see rt. क्रन्द्), crying or calling out, complaint.
विक्रम्: विक्रम् वि-क्रम्, cl. 1. P. A. -क्रामति, -क्र-मते, -क्रमितुम्, to step beyond, go beyond, pass beyond, to step on, go on, walk on, step aside, move or go aside, move away; to step or move apart (P.), become divided; to step over, stride over, step through, stride or stalk through, go through; to ad-vance, proceed, walk, pass, go; to attack, fight against, show valour or prowess (P.); to rise to or towards: Caus. P. -क्रमयति, -यितुम्, to cause to step or stride over or through.
विक्रम: वि-क्रम, अस्, m. stepping or going beyond, step-ping or striding over; a step, stride, pace [cf. त्रि-व्°]; going, proceeding, walking; overpowering, overcom-ing; heroism, prowess, heroic valour, great power or strength; strength in general, (विक्रमं कृ, to dis-play prowess, use one's strength); N. of a king, (see विक्रमादित्य); N. of Viṣṇu; of a city; of the forty-eighth year of Jupiter's cycle. —विक्रम-कर्मन्, अ, n. an act of prowess, feat of valour. —विक्रम-केश-रिन्, ई, m. ‘valour-lion,’ N. of king Vikramāditya. —विक्रम-चरित or विक्रम-चरित्र, अम्, n. ‘Vikrama's acts,’ N. of thirty-two stories (describ-ing the acts of Vikramāditya). —विक्रम-बाहु, उस्, m., N. of a king. —विक्रम-सिंह or विक्रम-सेन, अस्, m., N. of king Vikramāditya. —विक्रम-हीन, अस्, आ, अम्, destitute of valour, wanting in courage. —विक्रमादित्य (°म-आद्°), अस्, m. ‘valour-sun,’ N. of a celebrated Hindū king (of Ujjayinī or Oujein and founder of the era called Saṃvat [see संवत्], which begins 57 B. C.; he is said to have driven out the Śakas or Scythians and to have esta-blished his dominion over almost the whole of Northern India; he was one of the wisest of Hindū kings and a great patron of literature; nine cele-brated men of letters flourished at his court [see नव-रत्न], and innumerable legends are related of him [cf. विक्रम-चरित, सिंहासन-द्वात्रिंशत्-पुत्रिका-वार्त्ता] all teeming with exaggerations and absurdities; according to some he fell in a battle with his rival Śāli-vāhana, king of the south country or Deccan, and the legendary date given for his death is Kali Yuga 3044; there are, however, other kings called Vikramāditya, and the name has been applied to king Bhoja and even to Śāli-vāhana). —विक्र-मादित्य-कोष, N. of a work. —विक्रमार्क (°म-अर्°), अस्, m., N. of king Vikramāditya. —वि-क्रमार्जित (°म-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, acquired or con-quered by valour. —विक्रमोर्वशी (°म-उर्°), f. ‘valour-[won] Urvaśī,’ N. of one of the three cele-brated dramas of Kālidāsa.
विक्रमण: वि-क्रमण, अस्, m., Ved. a step, pace, stride; the stride of Viṣṇu, (see त्रि-विक्रम।)
विक्रमणीय: वि-क्रमणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be stepped on, to be overcome or overpowered.
विक्रममाण: वि-क्रममाण, अस्, आ, अम्, stepping or passing beyond, traversing, proceeding; striding along, taking giant steps; displaying strength, overpowering.
विक्रमिन्: विक्रमिन्, ई, इणी, इ, displaying valour or prowess, powerful, courageous, strong; chivalrous, gallant, ag-gressive; (ई), m. a hero; a lion; N. of Viṣṇu.
विक्रान्त: वि-क्रान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, stepped or passed beyond; valiant, mighty, victorious, overcoming; (अस्), m. a hero, warrior; a lion; N. of a Prajā-pati; (अम्), n. a step, stride; valour, prowess, military achievement; the jewel called वैक्रान्त. —विक्रान्त-गति, इस्, m. a man with a portly gait. —विक्रान्त-भीम, N. of a drama.
विक्रान्ति: वि-क्रान्ति, इस्, f. stepping on, striding; a horse's canter or gallop; heroism, valour, power, prowess.
विक्रान्तृ: वि-क्रान्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, displaying prowess, valiant; victorious; (ता), m. a hero, victor.
विक्रामत्: वि-क्रामत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, stepping beyond or aside, striding on, passing beyond; stalking; dis-playing valour or strength.
विचक्रमाण: वि-चक्रमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. striding, traversing.
विक्रय: वि-क्रय, अस्, m. sale, selling, vending. —विक्र-य-पत्त्र, अम्, n. a bill of sale. —विक्रयानुशय (°य-अन्°), अस्, m. rescission of sale. —विक्रयार्थम् (°य-अर्°), ind. for sale.
विक्री: विक्री वि-क्री, cl. 9. A. -क्रीणीते, -क्रेतुम्, to buy and sell, barter, trade (Ved.); to sell, vend; to sell or exchange for (with inst., e. g. गवां सह-स्रेण विक्रीणे, I sell for a thousand cows): Desid. A. -चिक्रीषते, to wish to sell, to desire to sell or ex-change for (with inst.).
विक्रयण: वि-क्रयण, अम्, n. the act of selling, vending.
विक्रयिक: विक्रयिक, अस्, आ, अम्, one who sells, selling; (अस्), m. a vender, salesman, dealer.
विक्रयिन्: विक्रयिन्, ई, m. a seller, vender.
विक्रायक: वि-क्रायक or वि-क्रायिक, अस्, m. a vender, seller.
विक्रीत: वि-क्रीत, अस्, आ, अम्, sold; (अस्), m., N. of a Prajā-pati; (अम्), n. sale.
विक्रेतृ: वि-क्रेतृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who sells, a vender, seller, selling.
विक्रेय: वि-क्रेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be sold, saleable, vendible.
विक्रीड्: विक्रीड् वि-क्रीड्, cl. 1. P. -क्रीडति, -क्रीडितुम्, to play with, to make a plaything of (with acc.); to sport.
विक्रीडित: वि-क्रीडित, अस्, आ, अम्, played with, played; (अम्), n. play, sport.
विक्रुश्: विक्रुश् वि-क्रुश्, cl. 1. P. -क्रोशति, -क्रोष्टुम्, to cry out, exclaim; to raise a cry; to sound; to invoke any one (acc.); to revile.

विजित: वि-जित, अस्, आ, अम्, conquered, subdued, defeated, won, gained. —विजित-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has conquered. —विजितात्मन् (°त-आत्°), आ, आ, अ, one who has conquered himself, self-subdued. —वि-जिताश्व (°त-अश्°), अस्, m., N. of a son of Pṛthu. —विजितासन (°त-आस्°), अस्, आ, अम्, indifferent about a seat. —विजितेन्द्रिय (°त-इन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having the organs of sense or passions subdued.
विजिति: वि-जिति, इस्, f. conquest, victory, triumphing over, vanquishing; victory over various enemies.
विजित्य: वि-जित्य, ind. having conquered, having won.
विजेतृ: वि-जेतृ, ता, त्री, तृ, victorious, a victor, conqueror, gainer, winner, (पुरां विजेतृ, ‘conqueror of towns,’ an epithet of Śiva.)
विजिन: विजिन विजिन, अस्, आ, अम्, m. f. n. sauce &c. mixed with rice-water or gruel; [cf. विजल।]
विजिहीर्षा: विजिहीर्षा वि-जिहीर्षा, f. (fr. Desid. of वि-हृ), wish or intention to roam about or take one's pleasure.
विजिहीर्षु: वि-जिहीर्षु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing or seeking to roam about or sport.
विजिह्म: विजिह्म वि-जिह्म, अस्, आ, अम्, curved, bent; crooked in mind or purpose, dishonest, depraved. —विजिह्म-ता, f. or विजिह्म-त्व, अम्, n. crooked-ness, dishonesty, craftiness.
विजीव्: विजीव् वि-जीव्, cl. 1. P. -जीवति, -जीवितुम्, to revive, return to life.
विजुल: विजुल विजुल, अस्, m. the silk-cotton tree.
विजृम्भ्: विजृम्भ् वि-जृम्भ्, cl. 1. A. -जृम्भते, -जृम्-भितुम्, to yawn, gape; to open (intrans.), unfold, expand, become expanded or developed or exhibited, spread out, blossom; to extend; to spring open, spring back (as a bow); to become displayed, break forth or out, appear, rise; to display activity or energy, exhibit courage, &c.
विजृम्भण: वि-जृम्भण, अम्, n. yawning, gaping; expand-ing, unfolding, displaying, exhibiting, extending; blossoming, budding; pastime, sport (especially amorous).
विजृम्भित: वि-जृम्भित, अस्, आ, अम्, yawned, gaped; ex-panded, opened, unfolded, displayed, exhibited, acted; blossomed; arisen, appeared; sported, wantoned; (अम्), n. pastime, sport; wish, desire; act. —वि-जृम्भित-स्नेह, अस्, आ, अम्, displaying affection.
विजेह्: विजेह् वि-जेह्, cl. 1. A. -जेहते, -जेहितुम्, to open the mouth.
विजेहमान: वि-जेहमान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. opening wide; darting forth, (Sāy. = प्रक्षिपत्।)
विजोषस्: विजोषस् वि-जोषस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. dis-united, estranged from each other, no longer friends.
विज्जन: विज्जन विज्जन, अस्, आ, अम्, m. f. n. sauce &c. mixed with rice-water or gruel.
विज्जल: विज्जल, अस्, आ, अम्, m. f. n. = विज्जन above; (अम्), n. an arrow. —विज्जल-पुर, N. of a town.
विज्जिल: विज्जिल, अस्, आ, अम्, m. f. n. sauce &c. mixed with rice-gruel.
विज्जाका: विज्जाका विज्जाका, f., N. of a female poet.
विज्जूलिका: विज्जूलिका विज्जूलिका, f., N. of a kind of plant (= जतुका).
विज्ञ: वि-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, knowing, intelligent; wise, learned; proficient, conversant, clever, experienced, skilful, prudent, discreet; (अस्), m. a wise man. —विज्ञ-ता, f. or विज्ञ-त्व, अम्, n. intelligence, wisdom, learning, skill, cleverness. —विज्ञ-बुद्धि, इस्, f. Indian spikenard (= जटा-मांसी).
विज्ञा: विज्ञा वि-ज्ञा, cl. 9. P. A. -जानाति, -जानीते, ज्ञातुम्, to distinguish, discern, understand, observe, perceive, know, recognise, know thoroughly or well, have a right knowledge of; to be familiar with; to find out, investigate, inquire, ascertain, learn, learn from (with gen.); to hear, to consider as; to explain; to become wise or learned (Manu IV. 20): Caus. -ज्ञपयति and -ज्ञापयति, -यितुम्, to make known, declare, report, communicate, announce to any one (acc.); to make any one understand, apprise, teach, instruct; to make a representation or request (in a respectful manner), ask, beg; to inform any one of anything (with two acc.): Desid. -जिज्ञासति, to wish to understand or know, &c.
विजिज्ञासा: वि-जिज्ञासा, f. a desire of knowing distinctly, wish to prove or try.
विज्ञप्त: वि-ज्ञप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, made known, reported, re-presented; apprised, respectfully informed or told.
विज्ञप्ति: वि-ज्ञप्ति, इस्, f. information, representation, re-spectful statement or communication; a report, an-nouncement.
विज्ञात: वि-ज्ञात, अस्, आ, अम्, discerned, understood, known, perceived; celebrated, famous, notorious. —विज्ञा-तार्थ (°त-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, one who is acquainted with any matter or the true state of a case.
विज्ञातृ: वि-ज्ञातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who knows or under-stands, an experienced person.
विज्ञान: वि-ज्ञान, अम्, n. the act of distinguishing or per-ceiving or recognising, discerning, understanding, comprehending, distinction, intelligence, knowledge, science, learning, worldly knowledge of any kind (including all subjects except that understanding of the true nature of God or Brahma which is acquirable only by abstract meditation and the study of the Vedas), wisdom; business, employment; music. —विज्ञान-कन्द, अस्, m. a proper N. —विज्ञान-कौमुदी, f., N. of a Buddhist woman. —विज्ञान-पाद, अस्, m. (see पाद), an epithet of Vyāsa. —वि-ज्ञान-भिक्षु, उस्, m., N. of the author of the Yoga-sāra-saṅgraha, the Yoga-vārttika, the Sāṅkhya-sāra, and the Brahmādarśa. —विज्ञान-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, consisting of knowledge or intelligence, all knowledge, intellectual (said of the first or innermost of the several sheaths of the soul). —विज्ञानमय-कोष, अस्, m. the sheath consisting of intelligence, the in-telligent sheath (of the soul, according to the Vedānta philosophy) or that sheath which is caused by the understanding being associated with the organs of perception. —विज्ञान-मातृक, अस्, m. ‘parent of knowledge,’ an epithet of Buddha. —विज्ञान-ललित, N. of a work. —विज्ञान-वाद, अस्, m. the theory of Vi-jñāna, ideal theory. —विज्ञानेश्वर (°न-ईश्°), अस्, m. ‘master of knowledge,’ N. of the author of the Mitākṣarā commentary.
विज्ञानिक: विज्ञानिक, अस्, ई, अम्, learned, well-informed, clever, skilful, proficient, conversant.
विज्ञापक: वि-ज्ञापक, अस्, इका, अम् (fr. the Caus.), who or what makes known or apprises, making known, giving information; (अस्), m. an informant; an instructor.
विज्ञापन: वि-ज्ञापन, अम्, आ, n. f. the act of making known or acquainting, teaching; representing, informing; information, instruction; respectful communication or representation.
विज्ञापनीय: वि-ज्ञापनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be made known or represented, to be apprised.
विज्ञापित: वि-ज्ञापित, अस्, आ, अम्, apprised, informed, in-structed; respectfully told or represented.
विज्ञाप्ति: वि-ज्ञाप्ति, इस्, f. representing, informing; respectful communication or representation.
विज्ञाय: वि-ज्ञाय, ind. having known or perceived, having understood, having ascertained, having recognised.
विज्ञेय: वि-ज्ञेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be perceived or known or understood; cognizable, intelligible, comprehen-sible, discernible, recognizable.
विज्वर: विज्वर वि-ज्वर, अस्, आ, अम्, free from fever or pain; free from distress; exempt from decay.
विझर्झर: विझर्झर वि-झर्झर, अस्, आ, अम्, making a harsh or rattling sound, discordant.
विञिलविन्दु: विञिलविन्दु विञिलविन्दु, N. of a town.
विञ्जामर: विञ्जामर विञ्जामर, अम्, n. the white of the eye.
विञ्जोली: विञ्जोली विञ्जोली, f. a line, row, range.
विट्: विट् विट् (also written बिट्; cf. rt. 1. विड्), cl. 1. P. वेटति, वेटितुम्, to sound; to curse, swear at, revile.
विट: विट, अस्, m. a voluptuary; a paramour; (in the drama) the companion of a prince or dissolute young man or sometimes of a courtezan, (he resembles in some respects the Vidūṣaka, being generally repre-sented as a parasite on familiar terms with his asso-ciate, but at the same time accomplished in the arts of poetry, music, and singing); a catamite; a rogue, cheat; N. of a mountain; the Khayar tree, Mimosa Catechu; a medicinal salt (= विड्-लवण); a rat; the orange tree; a branch and its shoot. —१। विट-प, अस्, m. a keeper of catamites. —विट-प्रिय, अस्, m. a kind of tree (= मुद्गर). —विट-माक्षिक, अस्, m. a sort of mineral (= ताप्य). —विट-लवण, अम्, n. a medicinal salt (= विड्-लवण, q. v.).
विटप: 2. विटप, अस्, अम्, m. n. (according to Uṇādi-s. III. 145. fr. rt. विट् in the sense ‘to sound’), the young branch of a tree or creeper; a new shoot or sprout, branch (in general); a bush; a clump, cluster, thicket, tuft; spreading, expansion; the septum of the scrotum. —विटप-शस्, ind. in branches, in shoots.
विटपिन्: विटपिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having branches; (ई), m. a tree (in general); the large Indian fig-tree, Ficus Indica. —विटपि-मृग, अस्, m. ‘tree-animal,’ a monkey, ape; [cf. तरु-मृग।]
विटङ्क: विटङ्क वि-टङ्क or वि-टङ्कक, अस्, अम्, m. n. (see rt. टङ्क्), a dove-cot, an aviary (perhaps in this sense fr. 2. वि, a bird, + टङ्क); the loftiest point.
विटङ्कित: वि-टङ्कित, अस्, आ, अम्, marked, stamped, laden with.
विटि: विटि विटि, इस्, f. yellow sanders. —विटि-कण्-ठी-रव, अस्, m., N. of the grammarian Varada-rāja.
विट्कारिका: विट्कारिका विट्-कारिका, विट्-चर, &c. See under 3. विष्।
विट्ठल: विट्ठल विट्ठल, अस्, m. (or commonly विठ्-ठल), N. of a god worshipped at Pandhar-pur or Punderpoor in the Bombay presidency, (he is stated to be an incarnation of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa himself, who is believed to have visited this city); N. of the author of the Prasāda commentary and of the Vaiṣ-ṇava-siddhānta-dīpikā. —विट्ठल-दीक्षित, अस्, m., N. of the author of the Kuṇḍa-maṇḍapa-siddhi.
विट्पण्य: विट्पण्य विट्-पण्य, विट्-पति, &c. See under 2. विश्।
विठङ्क: विठङ्क विठङ्क, अस्, आ, अम्, bad, vile.
विठर: विठर विठर, अस्, m. an epithet of Vṛhas-pati.
विड्: विड् 1. विड् (= rt. विट्, q. v.), cl. 1. P. वे-डति, वेडितुम्, to call out, cry out against, curse, swear at, revile; to break (?).
2. विड्, ट्, f. a fragment, bit (?).
विड: विड, अम्, n. a kind of factitious salt (procured by boiling earth impregnated with saline particles); a particular kind of fetid salt (used medicinally as a tonic aperient, commonly called Vit-lavan or Bit-noben, cf. विड्-लवण; it is black in colour and is prepared by fusing fossil salt with a small portion of Emblic Myrobalan, the product being muriate of soda with small quantities of muriate of lime, sulphur, and oxide of iron); a fragment, bit, portion (?). —विड-गन्ध, अम्, n. the medicinal salt described above.
विडङ्ग: विडङ्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, clever, able, skilful, con-versant; (अस्, अम्), m. n. Erycibe Paniculata, a vegetable and medicinal substance (considered of great efficacy as a vermifuge).
विडम्ब्: विडम्ब् वि-डम्ब्, cl. 10. P. -डम्बयति, -यि-तुम्, to imitate, act like (= अनु-कृ), copy, emulate, simulate (with acc., e. g. तडिद्-विलसितानि विडम्ब-यन्ति, they imitate the flashes of lightning); to give anything another form, transform, distort; to impose upon, deceive, cheat; to ridicule, deride, mock; to afflict.
विडम्ब: वि-डम्ब, अस्, m. imitation; afflicting, distress-ing, annoyance.
विडम्बन: वि-डम्बन, अम्, आ, n. f. imitation, copying, assuming a similar appearance or dress, disguise, masquerade, transformation, imposture, (कु-विडम्-बना, f. base imposture); deceiving, deception, fraud, breach of faith; disappointing, frustrating; afflicting, distressing, vexation, mortification, pain, distress; ridiculing, ridiculousness, ludicrousness.
विडम्बनीय: वि-डम्बनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be imitated, to be assumed as a disguise; to be distressed or annoyed.
विडम्बयत्: वि-डम्बयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, imitating, copying; assuming, putting on (a borrowed dress or appear-ance).
विडम्बित: वि-डम्बित, अस्, आ, अम्, imitated, copied, assumed, put on (as a borrowed from &c.), simulated, trans-formed, distorted; mocked at, ridiculed, derided; deceived, disappointed, frustrated; vexed, mortified; distressed, low, poor, abject; (अम्), n. an object of ridicule or contempt, despicable object.
विडम्बिन्: विडम्बिन्, ई, इनी, इ, imitating, resembling; causing deception or error.
विडारक: विडारक विडारक, अस्, m. = विडालक, a cat.
विडाल: विडाल विडाल, अस्, m. (also written बिडाल, in Uṇādi-s. I. 117. said to be fr. rt. विड्, ‘to cry out;’ according to others perhaps fr. विश् + आल, ‘having habitation with man’), a cat; the eye-ball; (ई), f. a female cat; N. of a plant (= विदारी, q. v.). —विडाल-पद, अस्, m. a measure of weight (the same as the Karṣa or weight of sixteen Māṣas). —विडाल-प-दक, अम्, n. the measure of a Karṣa.
विडालक: विडालक, अस्, m. a cat; application of ointment to the exterior of the eye (especially to the eyelids when the lashes have fallen off or are ulcerated); (अम्), n. yellow orpiment.
विडाली: विडाली, f. See under विडाल above.
विडी: विडी वि-डी, cl. 1. 4. A. -डयते, -डीयते, -डयितुम्, to fly asunder, fly apart, fly separately, fly on one side or obliquely.
विडीन: वि-डीन, अम्, n. the act of flying apart or ob-liquely, one of the different modes of flight attributed to birds; [cf. अ-विडीन; other modes of flight are अव-डीन, उड्डीन, नि-डीन, प्र-डीन, परि-डीन, सण्-डीन, डीन-डीनक, q. q. v. v.]
विडुल: विडुल विडुल, अस्, m. a sort of cane, Cala-mus Rotang.
विडूरज: विडूरज विडूर-ज, अम्, n. lapis lazuli, (for विदूर-ज, q. v.)
विडोजस्: विडोजस् विड्-ओजस् or विड्-औजस्, आस्, m. (said to be fr. विड् or 2. विश् + ओजस्), N. of Indra.
विड्गन्ध: विड्गन्ध विड्-गन्ध, विड्-ग्रह, &c. See under 3. विष्।
विण्ट्: विण्ट् विण्ट् (= rt. वुण्ट्), cl. 10. P. विण्ट-यति, &c., to kill; to waste away, perish, decay.
वितंस: वितंस वि-तंस, अस्, m. (see rt. तंस्), a bird-cage (perhaps fr. 2. वि, a bird, + तंस), any net or chain or apparatus for confining beasts or birds; [cf. वी-तंस।]
वितक्ष्: वितक्ष् वि-तक्ष्, cl. 1. P. -तक्षति, -तक्षि-तुम्, -तष्टुम्, Ved. to cut off; to cleave or split in pieces; to carve out, plane off, chisel; to wound.
वितष्ट: वि-तष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, hewn or carved out, planed, fashioned.
वितड्: वितड् वि-तड्, cl. 10. P. -ताडयति, -यितुम्, to strike or dash to pieces; to strike back; to strike against (with loc.); to wound.
वितण्ड: वितण्ड वि-तण्ड, अस्, m. (probably con-nected with वि-तड् above), a sort of lock or bolt with three divisions or wards; an elephant; (आ), f. cavil, captious objection, hypercriticism, perverse or frivolous argument (especially, in the Nyāya phil., idly carping at the arguments or assertions of another without attempting to establish the opposite side of the question), frivolous or fallacious controversy or wrangling, debate, criticism (in general); an esculent root, Arum Colocasia; the oleander plant, Nerium Odorum; a ladle, spoon; benzoin or storax (?).
वितण्डक: वि-तण्डक, अस्, m., N. of the author of a Dharma-śāstra.
वितत: वि-तत, अस्, आ, अम्, stretched out, extended, spread out, stretched, expanded; lengthened out, lengthened, elongated, large, broad, wide; spread over, covered, prepared, diffused, performed, accom-plished, celebrated; effected; (अम्), n. any stringed instrument, such as a lute, &c. —वितत-त्व, अम्, n. extendedness, extension, expansiveness, largeness. —वितत-धन्वन्, आ, m. one who has drawn a bow to its full stretch. —वितत-वपुस्, उस्, उस्, उस्, having an elongated body. —वितती-करण, अम्, n. the act of stretching out, spreading. —वितती-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to stretch out, expand, spread. —वितती-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, stretched out, spread, expanded.
वितथ: वितथ वि-तथ, अस्, आ, अम्, untrue, false, incorrect, unreal, vain, futile; [cf. यथा-तथ।] —वितथ-प्रयत्न, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose efforts are futile, endeavouring in vain. —वितथ-मर्याद, अस्, आ, अम्, incorrect in behaviour. —वितथी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, rendered vain or futile.
वितथ्य: वि-तथ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, untrue (= वि-तथ above).
वितद्रु: वितद्रु वितद्रु, उस्, f., N. of a river said to be situated in the Pañjāb.
वितन्: वितन् वि-तन्, cl. 8. P. A. -तनोति, -तनुते, -त-नितुम्, to stretch out, spread through, extend, expand, lengthen out, spread over, cover over, fill; to spread (a net, snare, &c.); to stretch (a cord &c.); to draw or bend (a bow); to unfold, develop, manifest, exhibit; to carry out, execute, perform, accomplish (any rite or ceremony); to offer an oblation, sacrifice, &c.; to effect, cause, produce; to prepare, make ready, arrange.
वितति: वि-तति, इस्, f. stretching out, spreading, extension, expansion; collection, quantity; a clump, cluster (of trees &c.).
वितत्य: वि-तत्य, ind. having stretched or spread out, hav-ing spread through; having stretched, having drawn or bent (as a bow); stretching into, extending far.
वितन्वत्: वि-तन्वत्, अन्, अती, अत्, stretching or spreading out, stretching, extending, expanding, bending (a bow &c.).
वितन्वान: वि-तन्वान, अस्, आ, अम्, extending, spreading out, &c.
वितान: वि-तान, अस्, अम्, m. n. stretching or spreading out, expansion; an awning, canopy, cover; a cushion; an oblation, sacrifice; the sacrificial hearth on which the sacred fires are kept, or the sacred fire itself; a heap, quantity; season, opportunity; (अम्), n. a form of the metre Anuṣṭubh or verse of four lines of eight syllables each, (each line of the stanza is said to con-sist of two Iambics, one Trochee, and one Spondee); leisure, rest, interval of occupation; (अस्, आ, अम्), empty, vacant; pithless, sapless; dull, stupid; wicked, abandoned. —वितान-मूलक, अम्, n. the fragrant root of Andropogon Muricatus (= उशीर). —वितान-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having a canopy or awning. —वि-तानी-करण, अम्, n. the act of overspreading or covering. —वतानी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कु-रुते, -कर्तुम्, to spread over, extend over (as a canopy &c.), form an awning, overshadow. —वि-तानी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, spread or extended over (as a canopy).
वितानक: वितानक, अस्, अम्, m. n. an awning, canopy, (especially) a cloth spread over a large open hall or court (in which dancing, singing, &c. are exhibited); an expanse; a heap, quantity; (अस्), m. the Māḍa tree.
वितानाय: वि-तानाय, Nom. A. -तानायते, &c., to become a canopy, turn into an awning.
वितायमान: वि-तायमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being stretched out, being spread abroad or overspread, being covered or shaded.
वितनु: वितनु वि-तनु, उस्, वी, उ, very thin, delicate, graceful.
वितन्तु: वितन्तु वि-तन्तु, उस्, m. a good horse; (उस्), f. a widow.
वितप्: वितप् वि-तप्, cl. 1. P. A. -तपति, -ते, -तप्-तुम्, to give out heat, be hot, burn; to warm one's self (or any member of the body, A.); to be heated, to feel or suffer pain; to pervade, penetrate (Ved.): Caus. -तापयति, -यितुम्, to make hot, heat, warm.
वितमस्: वितमस् वि-तमस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, free from darkness, light; exempt from the quality of igno-rance.
वितरण: वि-तरण, अम्, n. the act of crossing or passing over; donation, gift; giving up, abandoning.
वितर्क्: वितर्क् वि-तर्क्, cl. 10. P. -तर्कयति, -यितुम्, to reason or think about, make conjectures about (with acc.), to infer, conjecture, guess, suppose, imagine, think, believe; to anticipate, expect; to deliberate or reflect about, discuss (with acc.); to consider as, take for; to find out, ascertain.
वितर्क: वि-तर्क, अस्, m. reasoning, argument, inference, conjecture, guess, supposition, opinion, anticipation, discussion; deliberation, consideration of probabilities or alternatives, doubt, apprehension; a teacher, an instructor in divine knowledge.
वितर्कण: वि-तर्कण, अम्, n. reasoning, conjecturing, in-ferring, drawing an inference, argument, discussion, reflection; doubt.
वितर्कित: वि-तर्कित, अस्, आ, अम्, conjectured, imagined, anticipated, (अ-वितर्कित, unexpected.)
वितर्क्य: 1. वि-तर्क्य, ind. having deliberated or con-sidered, &c.
2. वि-तर्क्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be conjectured or supposed or imagined, questionable, doubtful.
वितर्ज्: वितर्ज् वि-तर्ज्, cl. 1. P. -तर्जति, -तर्जितुम्, to threaten, menace, revile, abuse, inveigh against, blame.
वितर्तुरम्: वितर्तुरम् वि-तर्तुरम्, वि-तर्तुराण। See p. 918, col. 1.
वि-तर्तुरम्, ind., Ved. with alternate movements, alternately, (Sāy. = परस्पर-व्यतिहारेण।)
वितर्दि: वितर्दि वि-तर्दि, इस्, f. or वितर्दिका, f. or वितर्दी, f. (said to be fr. rt. तृद्), a raised square piece of ground in the centre of a house or temple; a kind of covered terrace in the middle of a court-yard; a quadrangular seat or bench made of wood, a place in a court-yard for sitting in or standing under; a floor on four posts, a kind of altar or temporary stage or shed in the middle of a court-yard (for per-forming sacrifices &c. = वेदिका); a covered tempo-rary platform on which idols are sometimes placed; a verandah, balcony.
वितर्द्धि: वि-तर्द्धि, इस्, f. or वि-तर्द्धिका, f. or वि-तर्द्धी, f. = वि-तर्दि above.
वितल: वितल वि-तल, अम्, n. the second in order of the seven lower regions or regions under the earth; [cf. पाताल।] —वितल-लोक, अस्, m. the world or lower region of Vi-tala.
वितस्तपुरी: वितस्तपुरी वितस्त-पुरी, f., N. of a city.
वितस्ता: वितस्ता वितस्ता, f., N. of a river in the Pañjāb, now called Jhelum or Betusta or Behut (the Hydaspes of the Greeks; cf. पञ्च-नद).
वितस्ति: वितस्ति वि-तस्ति, इस्, f. (said to be fr. rt. तस् or तंस् with prep. वि), a long span measured by the extended thumb and little finger, equal to twelve Aṅgulas. —वितस्ति-देश्य, अस्, आ, अम्, almost a Vi-tasti long.
वितस्थान: वितस्थान वि-तस्थान, वि-तिष्ठमान। See under 1. वि-ष्ठा।
वि-तस्थान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (for वि-तिष्ठमान), stopping, being stopped or impeded.
वितिमिर: वितिमिर वि-तिमिर, अस्, आ, अम्, free from darkness, clear.
वितीर्ण: वि-तीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, crossed, passed, gone over or through; subdued, overcome; effaced; conveyed; given, bestowed, conferred, yielded, afforded; widely distant. —वितीर्ण-तर, अस्, आ, अम्, more widely distant, situated further off.
वितुद्: वितुद् वि-तुद्, cl. 6. P. A. -तुदति, -ते, -तोत्-तुम्, to pierce, strike, sting; to tear, scratch; to scourge, whip: Caus. -तोदयति, Ved. -तुदायति, -यितुम्, to pierce, strike, tear.
वितुद्यमान: वि-तुद्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being pierced, being struck, &c.
वितुन्न: वि-तुन्न, अम्, n. the pot-herb Marsilia Quadri-folia (= सु-निषण्णक); the aquatic plant Śaivala, Vallisneria Octandra; (आ), f. the tree Flacourtia Cata-phracta (= तामलकी).
वितुन्नक: वितुन्नक, अस्, m. Flacourtia Cataphracta; (अम्), n. coriander seed; blue vitriol; (इका), f. Flacourtia Cataphracta.
वितुष्ट: वितुष्ट वि-तुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, displeased, dis-satisfied.
वितूस्तय: वितूस्तय वि-तूस्तय (fr. तूस्त, q. v. + वि), Nom. P. -तूस्तयति, -यितुम्, to comb out matted or braided hair (= केशान् विजटी-कृ), clean or smooth the hair.
वितृद्: वितृद् वि-तृद्, cl. 7. P. A. -तृणत्ति, -तृन्त्ते, -तर्दितुम्, to pierce, bore, cleave; to break through; to excavate.
वितृप्: वितृप् वि-तृप्, cl. 4. P. -तृप्यति, -तर्पितुम्, -तर्प्तुम्, -त्रप्तुम्, to be satisfied, become satiated.
वितृप्त: वि-तृप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, satisfied, satiated.
वितृष्: वितृष् वि-तृष्, cl. 4. P. -तृष्यति, -तर्षि-तुम्, to be thirsty: Caus. -तर्षयति, -यितुम्, to make thirsty, cause to thirst.
वितृष्ण: वितृष्ण वि-तृष्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, free from thirst or desire, satisfied, content. —वितृष्ण-ता, f. or वितृष्ण-त्व, अम्, n. freedom from desire, satiety.
वितॄ: वितॄ वि-तॄ, cl. 1. P. -तरति, -तरितुम्, -त-रीतुम्, to pass across or over, cross over, go over, go or pass through, pervade; to convey or bring away; to give away; to give, grant, bestow, allow, yield, afford, favour with, (उत्तरं वितॄ, to favour with an answer); to give (medicine), apply a remedy; to forgive; to cause, produce (= जनयति, Kirāt. V. 31); to do, perform, effect; to increase, enhance: Caus. -तारयति, -यितुम्, to cause to go through, to carry through, accomplish: Intens., Ved. -तर्तूर्-यते, to pass over vehemently, labour or perform energetically.
वितरम्: वि-तरम्, ind., Ved. widely, vastly, exceedingly, (Sāy. on Ṛg-veda VIII. 100, 12 = अत्य्-अन्तम्।)
वितरित्रत्: वि-तरित्रत्, अत्, अती, अत्, Ved. excessively carrying through or accomplishing.
वितर्तुराण: वि-तर्तुराण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. alternating; (Sāy.) injuring, despoiling (= हिंसत्, Ṛg-veda VI. 47, 17).

वित्त: वित्त वित्त, वित्तक, वित्ति। See cols. 2, 3.

वित्त, अस्, आ, अम् (according to Pāṇ. VIII. 2, 56. the forms वित्त and विन्न belong to the root when used in cl. 7; according to Vopa-deva also in cl. 6), known, notorious, famous; found out, discovered, investigated, examined, discussed, judged; found, acquired, gained, possessed; (अम्), n. wealth, pro-perty, possessions, goods, money, substance, thing; power. —वित्त-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, desirous of wealth. —वित्त-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, produced by wealth. —वित्त-जानि, इस्, इस्, इ, one who has taken or married a wife, (Sāy. = लब्ध-भार्य।) —वित्त-द, अस्, m. ‘wealth-giver,’ one who gives away property, a benefactor. —वित्त-दुग्ध, अम्, n. ‘wealth-milk,’ wealth like milk. —वित्त-मात्रा, f. ‘materials of property,’ wealth. —वित्त-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having property, wealthy, opulent, rich. —वित्त-वर्धन, अस्, ई, अम्, increasing wealth, lucrative, profitable. —वित्त-विवर्धन, अस्, ई, अम्, increasing property or capital, bearing interest. —वित्त-शाठ्य, अम्, n. cheating in money matters. —वित्त-हीन, अस्, आ, अम्, deprived of wealth, indigent. —वित्तागम (°त-आग्°), अस्, m. acquisition of property, any source of wealth, means of acquiring property. —वित्तेश (°त-ईश), अस्, m. ‘lord of riches,’ epithet of Kuvera. —वित्तेहा (°त-ईहा), f. desire of wealth, cupidity, avarice.
वित्रप: वित्रप वित्रप, अस्, m. a proper N.
वित्रस्: वित्रस् वि-त्रस्, cl. 1. 4. P. -त्रसति, -त्रस्-यति, -त्रसितुम्, to tremble, be frightened: Caus. -त्रासयति, -यितुम्, to cause to tremble, terrify.
वित्रस्त: वि-त्रस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, frightened, alarmed, terrified.
वित्रास: वि-त्रास, अस्, m. fear, terror, alarm.
वित्रासित: वि-त्रासित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to tremble, fright-ened, terrified. —वित्रासित-विहङ्गम, अस्, आ, अम्, having (its) birds frightened away.
वित्वक्षण: वित्वक्षण वि-त्वक्षण, अस्, m., Ved. = वि-शेषेण तनू-कर्तृ, one who greatly thins or emaciates or destroys (his enemies; see rt. त्वक्ष्).
वित्सन: वित्सन वित्सन, अस्, m. an ox, bull (= वृषभ).
विथ्: विथ् विथ् (= rts. वेथ्, 1. विध्), cl. 1. A. वेथते, विविथे or विवेथे, वेथिष्यते, अवेथिष्ट, वेथितुम्, to ask, beg.
विथुर: विथुर विथुर, अस्, आ, अम् (connected with rt. व्यथ्), agitated, troubled, (Sāy. = व्यथित); trembling, frail, fragile, weak, feeble, poor, (Sāy. = हीन); (अस्), m. a thief; a demon, Rākṣasa; (आ), f. a widow (according to Sāy.).
विथुर्य: विथुर्य, Nom. P. विथुर्यति, -यितुम्, Ved. to be agitated or troubled, (Sāy. = व्यथते।)
विथ्या: विथ्या विथ्या, f. a kind of plant (commonly called Go-jihvā).
विद्: विद् 1. विद्, cl. 2. P. वेत्ति (ep. also A. वित्ते, 3rd pl. A. विदते or विद्रते; a form of the Perf., viz. वेद contracted from विवेद, is often substituted for the Pres. वेत्ति; 3rd pl. विदुस्, contracted from विविदुस्, being also much used for विदन्ति, वेत्थ for वेत्सि, &c.), Impf. अवेत् (Ist sing. अवेदम्, 2nd sing. अवेत् or अवेस्, 3rd pl. अवि-दुस् and according to Vopa-deva also अविदन्; 3rd pl. A. अविदत or अविद्रत), Pot. विद्यात्, Impv. वेत्तु or विदां-करोतु (3rd pl. A. विदताम् or वि-द्रताम्), विवेद (according to Vopa-deva also वि-दाम्-बभूव), वेदिष्यति (sometimes वेत्स्यति), अवेदीत्, वेदितुम् (originally ‘to see,’ = Lat. video); to perceive, understand, know, learn, ascertain, find out, experience, feel; to consider, regard, look upon, value, take for, name, call (especially in the 3rd pl. विदुः of वेद above, used with a present significa-tion, e. g. तं स्थविरं विदुः, they consider or call him aged; राजर्षिर् इति मां विदुः, they consider me a Rājarṣi); to notice, take notice of (with gen.; Ved.); to convey, bestow, grant (Ved.); cl. 6. P. A. विन्दति, -ते (in Ṛg-veda I. 7, 7. विन्-धे = 1st sing. A. विन्दे, 3rd pl. ep. विन्दते), Pot. विन्देत् (ep. विन्द्यात्, Ved. 1st sing. P. विदेयम्, A. विदेय), विवेद (3rd sing. Ved. विविदत् = लब्-ध-वान् in Ṛg-veda VII. 21, 6), विविदे (2nd sing. विविदिषे, Ved. विवित्से; 3rd pl.
