विपरिक्रामम्: वि-परिक्रामम्, ind., Ved. having walked round, going all about.
विपरिगा: विपरिगा वि-परि-गा, cl. 3. P. -जिगाति, -गा-तुम्, to go over, be overturned or upset (as a cart).
विपरिच्छिद्: विपरिच्छिद् वि-परि-च्छिद् (-छिद्), cl. 7. P. A. -च्छिनत्ति, -च्छिन्त्ते, -च्छेत्तुम्, to cut on all sides, cut round, cut to pieces, cut off, destroy utterly.
विपरिच्छिन्न: वि-परिच्छिन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, cut on all sides, cut to pieces, cut off, utterly destroyed. —विपरिच्छिन्न-मूल, अस्, आ, अम्, having the roots cut completely round or off, entirely uprooted.
विपरिणम्: विपरिणम् वि-परि-णम् (-नम्), Pass. -णम्-यते, to be changed into; to undergo change or alteration.
विपरिणमन: वि-परिणमन, अम्, n. changing, alteration, un-dergoing change or alterations.
विपरिणाम: वि-परिणाम, अस्, m. change of state or form, transformation, change, alteration.
विपरिणामिन्: वि-परिणामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, undergoing or producing change of state or form.
विपरितप्: विपरितप् वि-परि-तप्, cl. 4. A. or Pass. -तप्यते, to be greatly distressed, suffer great pain.
विपरिधा: विपरिधा वि-परि-धा, cl. 3. P. A. -दधाति, -धत्ते, -धातुम्, to exchange, change, alter.
विपरिधाय: वि-परिधाय, ind. having changed, having changed a dress.
विपरिधाव्: विपरिधाव् वि-परि-धाव्, cl. 1. P. A. -धा-वति, -ते, -धावितुम्, to run about, run in all direc-tions; to run through, overrun.
विपरिमुच्: विपरिमुच् वि-परि-मुच्, Pass. -मुच्यते, to be freed from, be released from.
विपरिम्लै: विपरिम्लै वि-परि-म्लै, cl. 1. P. A. -म्लायति, -ते, -म्लातुम्, to fade or wither away entirely.
विपरिम्लान: वि-परिम्लान, अस्, आ, अम्, entirely faded, com-pletely withered.
विपरिलुप्: विपरिलुप् वि-परि-लुप्, cl. 6. P. A. -लुम्-पति, -ते, -लोप्तुम्, to break to pieces or destroy utterly, break up, annihilate.
विपरिलुप्त: वि-परिलुप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, broken or destroyed utterly, broken up.
विपरिलोप: वि-परिलोप, अस्, m. breaking or destroying utterly.
विपरिवृत्: विपरिवृत् वि-परि-वृत्, cl. 1. A. -वर्तते, &c., -वर्तितुम्, to turn round, revolve, move in a circle; to roll about; to go to and fro, wander all round, wander about; to turn round or back, return; to be changed or altered; to surround, attend upon (with acc.): Caus. -वर्तयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to cause to turn round or revolve.
विपरिवर्तन: वि-परिवर्तन, अस्, ई, अम्, causing to turn round, causing to return; (ई), f., scil. विद्या, a magical knowledge producing the return of any one; (अम्), n. turning about, turning away from or back.
विपरिवर्तमान: वि-परिवर्तमान, अस्, आ, अम्, wandering or roaming about.
विपरिवर्तित: वि-परिवर्तित, अस्, आ, अम्, turned away from or back, reverted, averted.
विपरिवर्त्य: वि-परिवर्त्य, ind. having turned round, having turned away.
विपरिवृत्ति: वि-परिवृत्ति, इस्, f. turning round, revolution.
विपरी: विपरी वि-परी (-परि-इ), cl. 2. P. -पर्य्-एति, -एतुम्, to go or turn round in an opposite direction; to turn round the wrong way; to go round, return.
विपरीत: वि-परीत, अस्, आ, अम्, turned round, turned the wrong way, reversed, inverted, inverse, converse, opposite, adverse, perverse, contrary, repugnant; con-trary to what is right, wrong, contrary to rule, incor-rect; being the reverse of anything (abl.); being in altered or changed circumstances; acting in an oppo-site manner, having a contrary disposition, going asunder or in opposite directions, different; cross; disagreeable; inauspicious, unfavourable; (आ), f. a perverse woman; a disloyal or unchaste wife. —वि-परीत-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, or विपरीत-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, or विपरीत-कर्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, acting in a con-trary manner, perverse, contradictory. —विपरीत-क्रीडा, f., N. of the 125th chapter of the Śārṅga-dhara-paddhati. —विपरीत-गति, इस्, इस्, इ, going backwards, going in a contrary or reverse direction; (इस्), f. inverse or reverse motion. —विपरीत-चेतस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, contrary-minded, having a perverted mind or impaired mental faculties. —विपरीत-ता, f. or विपरीत-त्व, अम्, n. contrariety, inversion, per-verseness, reverse or opposite state or condition; counterpart. —विपरीत-पथ्या, f. a sort of metre. —विपरीत-बोध, अस्, आ, अम्, having a perverted understanding or intellect. —विपरीत-रत, अम्, n. inverted sexual intercourse. —विपरीत-लक्षणा, f. ironical description of an object by mentioning its contrary properties. —विपरीत-वृत्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, act-ing or behaving in a contrary manner. —विपरीता-ख्यानकी (°त-आख्°), f. a sort of metre. —विपरी-तायन (°त-अय्°), अम्, n. a contrary Ayana or progress of the sun from solstice to solstice. —विप-रीतायन-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, (in astronomy) situated in contrary Ayanas.
विपर्यय: वि-पर्यय, अस्, m. reverse, inversion, contra-riety, (विपर्यये, on the contrary; रात्रेर् विपर्-ययः, the contrary of night, i. e. day); inverted order or succession, perverseness, obstruction, opposi-tion; change, interchange, exchange, barter, (द्र-व्य-व्°, exchange of goods, buying and selling, trade); morbid change, reverse of fortune, calamity, mis-fortune, adverse fate; error, transgression, trespass; misapprehension, mistake, failure of conception; per-verseness of disposition; change of purpose or conduct, enmity, hostility; overthrow, destruction, annihilation.
विपर्याय: वि-पर्याय, अस्, m. = वि-पर्यय, reverse, con-trariety, &c.
विपरे: विपरे वि-परे (-परा-इ), cl. 2. P. -परैति, -परैतुम्, Ved. to go back again, return.
विपर्णक: विपर्णक वि-पर्णक, अस्, m. the Palāśa tree, Butea Frondosa.
विपर्यस्: विपर्यस् वि-पर्य्-अस् (-परि-अस्), cl. 4. A. -अस्यते, -असितुम्, to throw or turn over, overturn, turn the wrong way, reverse, invert; to change about, interchange, exchange.
विपर्यस्त: वि-पर्यस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, reversed, inverted, re-verse, opposite, contrary; interchanged, inverted (in grammar); erroneously conceived to be real. —वि-पर्यस्त-पुत्रा, f. a woman bearing no male chil-dren. —विपर्यस्त-मनश्-चेष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, hav-ing mind and actions perverted or inverted.
विपर्यस्य: वि-पर्यस्य, ind. having turned over, having inverted, having changed or exchanged.
विपर्यास: वि-पर्यास, अस्, m. reverse, contrariety, opposi-tion; interchange [cf. वि-पर्यय]; error, mistake, delusion, imagining what is unreal or false to be real or true, error, mistake; (अम्), ind., Ved. alternately.
विपर्यावृत्: विपर्यावृत् वि-पर्य्-आ-वृत् (-परि-आ-वृत्), cl. 1. A. -वर्तते, &c., to be turned back: Caus. -वर्-तयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to cause to turn away from, cause to be overturned.
विपर्यूह्: विपर्यूह् वि-पर्य्-ऊह् (-परि-ऊह्), cl. 1. P. -ऊहति, -ऊहितुम्, Ved. to place or fix separately.
विपर्व: विपर्व वि-पर्व, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. dismem-bered, mutilated, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda I. 187, 1 = विच्छिन्न-सन्धिक।)
विपल: विपल वि-पल, अम्, n. a moment, instant (= a Pala or second or, according to some, (1/6)th of it); a simple breathing (or, according to some, (1/10)th of it).
विपलाय्: विपलाय् वि-पलाय् (fr. rt. अय् = rt. 5. इ with पला for परा and वि), cl. 1. A. -पलायते, -यितुम्, to run away in different directions.
विपलायन: वि-पलायन, अम्, n. running away, flying in different directions.
विपलायित: वि-पलायित, अस्, आ, अम्, run away, running away, routed, put to flight.
विपल्यङ्ग्: विपल्यङ्ग् वि-पल्य्-अङ्ग् (-परि-अङ्ग्), Caus. -अङ्गयति, -यितुम्, Ved. to envelop, surround.
विपल्यय्: विपल्यय् वि-पल्य्-अय् (fr. rt. अय् = rt. 5. इ with पलि for परि and वि), cl. 1. A. -पल्ययते, &c., Ved. to go back, turn round, return.
विपव्य: विपव्य वि-पव्य। See under वि-पू, P. 928.
वि-पव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be cleansed or purified.
विपशिन्: विपशिन् वि-पशिन्, ई, m. (probably fr. rt. 1. पश् with वि), a Buddhist saint, the first of the seven principal Buddhas.
विपा: विपा वि-पा, cl. 1. P. -पिबति, &c., -पातुम्, to drink at different times; to drink up.
विपिपान: वि-पिपान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. drinking much or variously; drinking especially, (Sāy. = विशेषेण पिबत्, Ṛg-veda I. 112, 15; = विपीत-वत् or वि-पिबत्, Ṛg-veda VII. 22, 4.)
विपीत: वि-पीत, अस्, आ, अम्, drunk up. —विपीत-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has drunk up.
विपाटल: विपाटल वि-पाटल, अस्, आ, अम्, pale-red.
विपाठ: विपाठ विपाठ, अस्, m. (perhaps for वि-पाट, fr. rt. पट्), a kind of large arrow (described by the commentator on the Mahā-bhārata as विशालो वैशाखी-मुख-वत्).
विपाण्डु: विपाण्डु वि-पाण्डु, उस्, उस्, उ, pale, pallid (Kirāt. IV. 24), painted with different yellow colours.
विपाण्डुर: वि-पाण्डुर, अस्, आ, अम्, pale, pallid, white.
विपादिका: विपादिका वि-पादिका, f. (fr. पाद with वि), a disease of the foot, a sore or tumour on the foot; a riddle, enigma.
विपापा: विपापा वि-पापा, f., N. of a river.
विपाल: विपाल वि-पाल, अस्, आ, अम्, having no keeper or attendant, unguarded, unattended.
विपाश्: विपाश् वि-पाश्, ट्, f. (according to Sāy. fr. rt. पट् or rt. पश्), the Vipāś or Vipāśā river, (see below.) —विपाट्-छुतुद्री, f. du. the rivers Vipāś and Śutudrī, (in Ṛg-veda III. 33. is a dialogue between Viśvā-mitra and these two rivers.)
विपाश: वि-पाश, अस्, आ, अम्, unnoosed, uncorded, unfast-ened, untied, unfettered, freed from a noose, devoid of fastenings or ties; (आ), f. the Vipāśā or Beas river, one of the five rivers of the Pañjāb (said to be so called as having destroyed the cord which the Muni Vasiṣṭha had tied round his neck when about to hang himself through grief for the death of his son slain by Viśvā-mitra; this river is considered to be indentical with the Hyphasis of Arrian, the Greek name being a corruption of Bipasha; it rises in the Himālaya, and after a course of about 220 miles joins the Sutlej south-east of Amritsar).
विपाशिन्: वि-पाशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. without fastenings, with unloosed or dissevered fastenings or cords.
विपिन: विपिन विपिन, अम्, n. (according to Uṇā-di-s. II. 52. fr. rt. वेप्), a wood, forest, thicket, grove. —विपिन-तिलक, a species of metre.
विपिन; add — (अस्, आ, अम्), thick, dense.
विपिनाय: विपिनाय, Nom. A. विपिनायते, &c., to be like a wood or thicket.
विपिनाय, Nom. A. विपिनायते, &c., to resemble a wood, turn into a forest, be counted for a forest.
विपुल: विपुल वि-पुल, अस्, आ, अम् (see rt. पुल्), large, great, extensive, broad, wide, spacious, roomy, capacious; abundant; deep, profound; (अस्), m. the mountain Meru (or the western branch of it); the Himālaya mountain; a respectable man; N. of a pupil of Deva-śarman (who guarded the virtue of Ruci, his preceptor's wife, when tempted by Indra during her husband's absence); (आ), f. the earth; N. of Dākṣāyaṇī in Vipula; a form of the Āryā metre in which the line is irregularly divided by the cesura or pause, (three species of this form are rec-koned, viz. Ādi-vipulā, having the pause in the first line; Antya-vipulā, having it in the second; Ubhaya-vipulā, having it in both lines.) —विपुल-च्छाय, अस्, आ, अम्, having ample shade, shady, umbrageous. —विपुल-जघना, f. a woman with large hips. —विपुल-ता, f. or विपुल-त्व, अम्, n. largeness, greatness, magnitude, extent, width, spaciousness. —विपुल-मति, इस्, इस्, इ, endowed with great un-derstanding. —विपुल-रस, अस्, m. ‘having abun-dant juice,’ the sugar-cane. —विपुल-व्रत, अस्, आ, अम्, one who practises great devotion. —विपुल-श्रोणी, f. (a woman) having swelling hips, round-limbed. —विपुलायताक्ष (°ल-आय्°, °त-अक्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having large and long eyes. —विपुलेक्षण (°ल-इक्°), अस्, ई, अम्, large-eyed. —विपुलोरस्क (°ल-उर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, broad-chested.
विपुलक: विपुलक वि-पुलक, अस्, ई, अम्, free from erection of the hair, devoid of horripilation.
विपुलिन: विपुलिन वि-पुलिन, अस्, आ, अम्, without islands, having no islands or sandbanks.
विपुष्ट: विपुष्ट वि-पुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, ill-fed, under-fed; [cf. पुष्ट-विपुष्टौ।]
विपू: विपू वि-पू, cl. 9. P. -पुनाति, -पवितुम्, to cleanse thoroughly, purify effectually.
विपूय: 1. वि-पूय, अस्, m. the Muñja grass, Saccharum Munja (so called from being cleaned before being made into ropes).
विपृक्वत्: विपृक्वत् विपृक्वत् [cf. rt. 1. पृच्], Ved. = सर्वतो व्याप्तम्, that which is everywhere diffused, (Ṛg-veda V. 2, 3.)
विपृच्: विपृच् वि-पृच्, क्, f. (see rt. 1. पृच्), Ved. disuniting, expelling, driving away, (Sāy. = पृथक्-करण।)
विपृच्छम्: विपृच्छम् वि-पृच्छम्, ind. to ask, to make various inquiries, (Sāy. = विविधम् प्रष्टुम्, Ṛg-veda VII. 86, 3.)
विपृथ: विपृथ वि-पृथ, अस्, m., N. of a son of Citraka.
विपृथु: विपृथु वि-पृथु, उस्, m., N. of a king.
विप्रकृ: विप्रकृ वि-प्र-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कु-रुते, -कर्तुम्, to treat with disrespect, hurt, injure; to offend, disturb, oppress.
विप्रकार: वि-प्रकार, अस्, m. treating with disrespect, in-jury, offence; contumely, abuse; opposition, coun-teraction; retaliation; wickedness; various manner.
विप्रकारिन्: वि-प्रकारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, treating with contempt, opposing, opposed to, retaliating.
विप्रकृत: वि-प्रकृत, अस्, आ, अम्, treated with disrespect or contempt, injured, offended, oppressed; reviled, abused; opposed, counteracted; retaliated, requited.
विप्रकृति: वि-प्रकृति, इस्, f. injury, offence; abuse, con-tumely; retort, retaliation.
विप्रकृष्: विप्रकृष् वि-प्र-कृष्, cl. 1. P. -कर्षति, -कर्ष्टुम्, -क्रष्टुम्, to draw apart, draw away, draw out.
विप्रकर्ष: वि-प्रकर्ष; add — dragging away, carrying off, removal; distant removal; a long interval (of time); difference, distinction, contrast.
विप्रकृष्ट: वि-प्रकृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, drawn or removed away, drawn out, extended, protracted, lengthened; remote, distant; carried away, carried off; (अम्), ind. far, far away. —विप्रकृष्ट-त्व, अम्, n. re-moteness, distance.
विप्रकृष्टक: वि-प्रकृष्टक, अस्, आ, अम्, remote, distant.
विप्रकॄ: विप्रकॄ वि-प्र-कॄ, cl. 6. P. -किरति, -करि-तुम् or -करीतुम्, to scatter or throw about, spread abroad.
विप्रकीर्ण: वि-प्रकीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, thrown about, scattered or spread abroad, dispersed; dishevelled, loose; dashed to pieces; outstretched, expanded, wide, broad. —विप्रकीर्ण-शिरोरुह, अस्, आ, अम्, having dishevelled or flowing hair.
विप्रगम्: विप्रगम् वि-प्र-गम्, cl. 1. P. -गच्छति, -गन्तुम्, to go apart or asunder, be dispersed or scattered.
विप्रचित्ति: विप्रचित्ति विप्रचित्ति, इस्, m., N. of a Dānava.
विप्रचिन्त्: विप्रचिन्त् वि-प्र-चिन्त्, cl. 10. P. -चिन्तयति, -यितुम्, to meditate or reflect on, think about.
विप्रचिन्त्य: वि-प्रचिन्त्य, having reflected on, having thought about.
विप्रणश्: विप्रणश् वि-प्र-णश् (-नश्), cl. 1. 4. P. -ण-शति, -णश्यति, -नंष्टुम्, -नष्टुम् (see 2. प्र-णश्), to be lost, disappear; to have no effect or result, bear no fruit: Caus. -णाशयति, -यितुम्, to cause to be lost.
विप्रनष्ट: वि-प्रनष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (not वि-प्रणष्ट, see 2. प्र-णश्; cf. Pāṇ. VIII. 4, 36), lost, disappeared, vanished; vain, fruitless. —विप्रनष्ट-विशेषक, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has lost his discriminative faculty.
विप्रतिकृ: विप्रतिकृ वि-प्रति-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, &c., to counteract, oppose.
विप्रतिकार: वि-प्रतिकार, अस्, m. counteraction, opposition, contradiction, reverse; retaliation.
विप्रतिकृत: वि-प्रतिकृत, अस्, आ, अम्, counteracted, opposed; requited.
विप्रतिपद्: विप्रतिपद् वि-प्रति-पद्, cl. 4. A. -पद्यते, -पत्तुम्, to go in different or opposite directions, go hither and thither, turn here and there; to be per-plexed or confused, be uncertain how to act, waver; to differ, be of different opinions or interests, be mutually opposed.
विप्रतिपत्ति: वि-प्रतिपत्ति, इस्, f. going in different or opposite directions, perplexity, confusion; difference, opposition (of opinion or interests), mutual contrariety, dis-crepancy, contest, dispute, contradiction, conflict (of evidence), dissent, objection (in argument); various acquirement or acquisition, conversancy; mutual con-nection or relation.
विप्रतिपद्य: वि-प्रतिपद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be mutually opposed or contradicted, to be contested; to be variously acquired.
विप्रतिपद्यमान: वि-प्रतिपद्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being disputed or contested; being in course of acquirement.
विप्रतिपन्न: वि-प्रतिपन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, gone in different or opposite directions, perplexed, confused, bewildered; mutually opposed, opposite, dissentient, being at variance; contradicted, disputed, contested; con-versant or acquainted with in various ways; mutually connected.
विप्रतिभा: विप्रतिभा वि-प्रति-भा, cl. 2. P. -भाति, -भातुम्, to appear as, seem.
विप्रतिषिद्ध: विप्रतिषिद्ध वि-प्रतिषिद्ध, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. सिध् with प्रति and वि), contradicted, opposed, prohibited, forbidden.
विप्रतिषेध: वि-प्रतिषेध, अस्, m. a grammatical term im-plying that two different operations can be undertaken according to two different rules (the last mentioned being then generally regarded as operative पर-विप्रतिषेधेन, ‘by the prohibition of the other’).
विप्रतिसार: विप्रतिसार वि-प्रतिसार, अस्, m. (fr. rt. सृ with प्रति and वि), repentance; evil, wickedness, evil action; hate, enmity, rage, wrath.
विप्रतॄ: विप्रतॄ वि-प्र-तॄ, Caus. -तारयति, -यितुम्, to impose upon, deceive, cheat.
विप्रतारित: वि-प्रतारित, अस्, आ, अम्, imposed upon, deceived.
विप्रथ्: विप्रथ् वि-प्रथ्, cl. 1. A. -प्रथते (Ved. also P. -प्रथति), -प्रथितुम्, to spread out, extend (Ved. P.), to be widely extended, be expanded or spread abroad: Caus. -प्रथयति, -यितुम्, to spread out, extend, spread abroad, celebrate; to display, exhibit.
विप्रथयत्: वि-प्रथयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, spreading abroad, diffusing.
विप्रथित: वि-प्रथित, अस्, आ, अम्, spread out, spread abroad, widely diffused or extended.
विप्रदह: विप्रदह वि-प्र-दह, अस्, m. (probably fr. rt. 1. दह् with प्र and वि), dried fruit or roots, &c.
विप्रदुष्ट: विप्रदुष्ट वि-प्रदुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (see rt. दुष्), very sensual or dissolute, spoiled, vitiated, defiled; corrupt, bad. —विप्रदुष्ट-भाव, अस्, आ, अम्, having a very vicious or sensual disposition, vicious, sensual, corrupt, bad.
विप्रदुह्: विप्रदुह् वि-प्र-दुह्, cl. 2. P. -दोग्धि, -दोग्-धुम्, Ved. to receive, accept, take, (Sāy. विप्र-दुहन्ति = लभन्ते, Ṛg-veda IV. 24, 9.)
विप्रधाव्: विप्रधाव् वि-प्र-धाव्, cl. 1. P. A. -धावति, -ते, -धावितुम्, to run in different directions, disperse.
विप्रबुध्: विप्रबुध् वि-प्र-बुध्, cl. 4. A., 1. P. -बुध्-यते, -बोधति, &c., to awake: Caus. -बोधयति, -यितुम्, to awaken, arouse; to admonish, advise, explain.
विप्रबुद्ध: वि-प्रबुद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, awakened, awake.
विप्रबोधित: वि-प्रबोधित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Caus.), aroused, admonished, explained.
विप्रमुच्: विप्रमुच् वि-प्र-मुच्, cl. 6. P. A. -मुञ्चति, -ते, -मोक्तुम्, to loosen, unfasten, take off; to liberate, release, set free, deliver; to discharge, cast, hurl, shoot: Pass. -मुच्यते, to be liberated or released.
विप्रमुक्त: वि-प्रमुक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, set free, loosed, loosened, let go, escaped, liberated; discharged, shot; free from, (गुण-व्°, free from qualities.) —विप्रमुक्त-भय, अस्, आ, अम्, removed from danger, free from fear.
विप्रमुच्य: वि-प्रमुच्य, ind. having taken off, having libe-rated or released, having discharged.
विप्रमोच्य: वि-प्रमोच्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be liberated or freed from.
विप्रमुह्: विप्रमुह् वि-प्र-मुह्, Caus. -मोहयति, -यि-तुम्, to bring into confusion or disorder, render confused.
विप्रमोहित: वि-प्रमोहित, अस्, आ, अम्, utterly bewildered, in-fatuated; fascinated.
विप्रया: विप्रया वि-प्र-या, cl. 2. P. -याति, -यातुम्, to go asunder, run away in disorder.
विप्रयाण: वि-प्रयाण, अम्, n. going or flying away, flight, retreat.
विप्रयात: वि-प्रयात, अस्, आ, अम्, gone apart or asunder, fled in all directions, run away in disorder.
विप्रयुज्: विप्रयुज् वि-प्र-युज्, cl. 7. P. A. -युनक्ति, -युङ्क्ते, -योक्तुम्, to disunite, separate, dissever, deprive of (with inst.): Pass. -युज्यते, to be dis-united, be separated from (with inst.): Caus. -योज-यति, -यितुम्, to disunite, cause to be separated from (with inst.), to deprive of, free from, release from.
विप्रयुक्त: वि-प्रयुक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, disjoined, disunited, sepa-rated, severed, divorced; separated from, freed from, released from (with inst. or at the end of a comp., e. g. बन्धन-व्°, freed from fetters); deprived of, without (e. g. मणि-व्°, without jewels); absent from, away from.
विप्रयुज्य: वि-प्रयुज्य, ind. having separated, having de-prived of.
विप्रयोग: वि-प्रयोग, अस्, m. disjunction, disunion, dissocia-tion, severance, separation, divorce, absence, the sepa-ration of lovers; separation from (with inst. and even with सह, e. g. प्रियैर् or प्रियैः सह विप्र-योगः, separation from loved objects); quarrel, disa-greement; the being fit or deserving.
विप्रयोजित: वि-प्रयोजित, अस्, आ, अम्, separated from, deprived of, freed or delivered from (with inst.).
विप्रलप्: विप्रलप् वि-प्र-लप्, cl. 1. P. -लपति, -लपि-तुम्, to discourse or speak about variously, discuss; to talk idly, prate, prattle, wrangle; to complain, lament, bewail.
विप्रलपित: वि-प्रलपित, अस्, आ, अम्, discussed, debated about.
विप्रलप्त: वि-प्रलप्त, अम्, n. discussion, debate, disquisition.
विप्रलाप: वि-प्रलाप, अस्, m. talking idly, prattling, prattle, unmeaning discourse, nonsense, mutual contradiction, wrangling, quarrelling, quarrel; infraction of a pro-mise or engagement, deception.
2. वि-प्रलाप, अस्, आ, अम्, free from talk or dispute.
विप्रलभ्: विप्रलभ् वि-प्र-लभ्, cl. 1. A. -लभते (ep. also -लम्भते), -लब्धुम्, to overreach, deceive, cheat; to mock, insult, to disregard, violate; to receive back, regain, recover: Caus. -लम्भयति, -यितुम्, to mock, insult; to offend against, violate.
विप्रलब्ध: वि-प्रलब्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, cheated, deceived, tricked; hurt, injured; disappointed; (आ), f. a female disappointed by her lover's breaking his appointment, (one of the incidental characters in a drama.)
विप्रलब्धृ: वि-प्रलब्धृ, धा, ध्री, धृ, deceiving; one who deceives, a deceiver, traitor.
विप्रलम्भ: वि-प्रलम्भ, अस्, m. overreaching, deceiving, tricking, disappointing, deceiving by false assertions or by not keeping a promise, deception, deceit (in general); quarrel, disagreement; separation of lovers; disunion, disjunction.
विप्रलम्भक: वि-प्रलम्भक, अस्, इका, अम्, deceiving, a deceiver, fallacious. —विप्रलम्भ-त्व, अम्, n. deceptiveness, fallaciousness.
विप्रलम्भन: वि-प्रलम्भन, अम्, n. the act of overreaching or deceiving, deception.
विप्रलम्भिन्: वि-प्रलम्भिन्, ई, इनी, इ, deceiving, deceptive fallacious.
विप्रली: विप्रली वि-प्र-ली, cl. 4. A. -लीयते, &c., to dissolve away, become dissolved; to be dispersed.
विप्रलीन: वि-प्रलीन, अस्, आ, अम्, dispersed or scattered in all directions (said of a defeated army).
विप्रलुड्: विप्रलुड् वि-प्र-लुड्, Caus. -लोडयति, -यितुम्, to stir about, agitate, disturb, throw into disorder or confusion, disorder, disarrange, spoil.
विप्रलोडित: वि-प्रलोडित, अस्, आ, अम्, disarranged, spoiled.
विप्रलुप्: विप्रलुप् वि-प्र-लुप्, cl. 6. P. A. -लुम्पति, -ते, -लोप्तुम्, to tear away, carry off, snatch away, rob, plunder; to break in upon, interrupt, disturb, confound: Pass. -लुप्यते, to be robbed or plundered.
विप्रलुप्त: वि-प्रलुप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, snatched away, carried off, plundered; broken in upon, interrupted, disturbed.
विप्रलुम्पक: वि-प्रलुम्पक, अस्, इका, अम्, rapacious, exacting, avaricious.
विप्रलुभ्: विप्रलुभ् वि-प्र-लुभ्, Caus. A. -लोभयते, -यितुम्, to allure, entice, try to lead astray or deceive.
विप्रलू: विप्रलू वि-प्र-लू, cl. 9. P. A. -लुनाति, -लु-नीते, -लवितुम्, to cut off, sever, pluck, gather.
विप्रलून: वि-प्रलून, अस्, आ, अम्, cut off, plucked off, gathered.
विप्रवद्: विप्रवद् वि-प्र-वद्, cl. 1. P. A. -वदति, -व-दते, -वदितुम्, to speak variously, be at variance with one another, disagree.
विप्रवस्: विप्रवस् वि-प्र-वस् (see rt. 6. वस्), cl. 1. P. -वसति, -वस्तुम्, to dwell at a distance, dwell abroad, be absent: Caus. -वासयति, -यितुम्, to cause to dwell away, banish, expel; to take away, remove.
विप्रवसित: वि-प्रवसित, अस्, आ, अम्, withdrawn, departed.
विप्रवास: वि-प्रवास, अस्, m. dwelling at a distance, residence in a foreign country, staying abroad.
विप्रवासन: वि-प्रवासन, अम्, n. banishment, expulsion; residence abroad.
विप्रवासित: वि-प्रवासित, अस्, आ, अम्, banished, removed.
विप्रोषित: वि-प्रोषित, अस्, आ, अम् (वि-प्र-उषित), dwelling abroad, absent, away from; banished. —विप्रोषित-भर्तृका, f. a woman whose husband or lover is absent.
विप्रोषित वि-प्रोषित, &c. See under वि-प्र-वस्, col. 2.
विप्रोष्य: वि-प्रोष्य, ind. having dwelt abroad, having been absent, returning after having been absent.
विप्रव्यध्: विप्रव्यध् वि-प्र-व्यध्, cl. 4. P. -विध्यति, -व्यद्धुम्, to strike through, strike down.
विप्रविद्ध: वि-प्रविद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, struck through, struck.
विप्रश्निका: विप्रश्निका वि-प्रश्निका, f. (fr. rt. प्रछ् with वि), a female fortune-teller.
विप्रसृ: विप्रसृ वि-प्र-सृ, cl. 1. P. -सरति, &c., to spread, be expanded or extended.
विप्रस्था: विप्रस्था वि-प्र-स्था, cl. 1. A. (sometimes P.) -तिष्ठते (-ति), -स्थातुम्, to go away, depart; to extend, be extended.
विप्रहीण: विप्रहीण वि-प्रहीण, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 3. हा with प्र and वि), deprived of, destitute of.
विप्रिय: विप्रिय वि-प्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, unpleasant, disagreeable, disliked, distasteful, unbeloved; (अम्), n. offence, transgression. —विप्रिय-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, doing what is displeasing, acting unkindly, offensive.
विप्रुत: विप्रुत वि-प्रुत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. = वि-प्लुत, immersed, submerged; having torn or wounded limbs, (Sāy. = विश्लिष्टावयव।)
विप्रुष्: विप्रुष् वि-प्रुष्, ट्, f. (also written वि-प्लुष्, see rts. 1. प्रुष्, प्लुष्), a drop of water or other liquid; a spot, mark, dot. —विप्रुड्-ढोम, अस्, m., Ved. an expiatory offering designed to atone for the drops of Soma accidentally let fall at a sacrifice. —वि-प्रुष्-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, filled with drops.
विप्रे: विप्रे वि-प्रे (-प्र-इ), cl. 2. P. -प्रैति, -प्रै-तुम्, to go forth in different directions, depart in different ways; to be dispersed or scattered.
विप्रेत: वि-प्रेत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone forth, departed.
विप्रेक्ष्: विप्रेक्ष् वि-प्रेक्ष् (-प्र-ईक्ष्), cl. 1. A. -प्रेक्षते, -प्रेक्षितुम्, to look here and there, look on all sides; to regard, consider.
विप्लु: विप्लु वि-प्लु, cl. 1. A. -प्लवते, -प्लोतुम्, to swim or float or drift in different directions, float about, fluctuate, be submerged; to be dispersed or scattered; to fall into disorder or confusion, become disarranged or confused; to be lost or ruined, to come to disgrace or dishonour: Caus. -प्लावयति, -यितुम्, to cause to swim or float about, cause to drift hither and thither; to make known, spread abroad, make public, divulge; to bring to ruin or calamity; to perplex, confuse, confound, (in this sense the form वि-प्लवयति is found.)
विप्लव: वि-प्लव, अस्, m. floating or drifting about or in different directions; confusion, perplexity, contra-riety, opposition, perversity; trouble, disaster, evil, calamity; sin, wickedness; the rust on a mirror (Kirāt. II. 26); tumult, rapine, extortion; predatory or devastating warfare, devastation; affray, scuffle, disturbance; terrifying an enemy by shouts and gestures; spreading abroad, divulging, (विप्लवं गम्, to become known.) —विप्लव-तस्, ind. in consequence of misfortune, by reason of disturbance.
2. वि-प्लव, अस्, आ, अम्, not having a vessel, without a ship.
विप्लवमान: वि-प्लवमान, अस्, आ, अम्, floating or drifting about, falling into disorder.
विप्लाव: वि-प्लाव, अस्, m. causing tumult or disturbance, devastating; deluging, inundating; a horse's canter or gallop.
विप्लावित: वि-प्लावित, अस्, आ, अम्, made to drift or swim about, turned adrift, floated; spread abroad, divulged.
विप्लाव्य: वि-प्लाव्य, ind. having caused to swim or float about; having caused to be deluged or devastated, having confused or disturbed; having divulged, hav-ing made public or common, (applied in Manu XI. 198. to the teaching of the Veda to improper persons or at improper seasons.)
विप्लुत: वि-प्लुत, अस्, आ, अम्, turned adrift, confounded, disturbed, fallen into confusion, scattered, dispersed; devastated, ravaged; ruined, disgraced, dishonoured, lost, disappeared; overwhelmed; drowned, deluged, bathed; obscured, dimmed, disfigured; depraved, wicked, abandoned, dissolute, addicted to evil prac-tices, guilty of lewdness or promiscuous intercourse; contrary, adverse, averse. —विप्लुत-नेत्र or वि-प्लुत-लोचन, अस्, आ, अम्, having eyes bathed or dimmed (with tears, joy, &c.).
विप्लुष्: विप्लुष् वि-प्लुष्, ट्, f. (also written वि-प्रुष्; see rts. प्लुष्, 1. प्रुष्), a drop of any fluid; a spot, dot.
विप्सा: विप्सा विप्सा, f. = वीप्सा, repetition, suc-cession.
विफल्: विफल् वि-फल्, cl. 1. P. A. -फलति, -ते, -फलितुम्, to bear or produce fruit, become fruitful.
विफल: विफल वि-फल, अस्, आ, अम्, fruitless, use-less, ineffectual, unmeaning, vain, idle; (आ), f. a kind of plant or tree (= केतकी), —विफल-ता, f. or विफल-त्व, अम्, n. fruitlessness, unprofitableness. —विफल-प्रेरण, अस्, आ, अम्, flung in vain. —विफली-करण, अम्, n. frustrating, foiling, de-feating; doing anything in vain. —विफली-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to make fruit-less or useless, frustrate, foil. —विफली-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, rendered fruitless or ineffectual, frustrated; done in vain. —विफलीकृत-यत्न, अस्, आ, अम्, making fruitless efforts. —विफली-भविष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, becoming or become useless or unprofitable. —वि-फलीभविष्णु-ता, f. or विफलीभविष्णु-त्व, अम्, n. unprofitableness. —विफली-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -भवितुम्, to become useless, be unprofit-able. —विफली-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, become useless.
विबन्ध्: विबन्ध् वि-बन्ध्, cl. 9. P. -बध्नाति, -बन्द्-धुम्, to bind or fasten on different sides, fasten on both sides, fasten; to stretch out, extend: Intens. -बाबधे, Ved. to lavish, bestow liberally, distribute, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda VII. 36, 5. वि-बाब-धे = वि-बध्नाति = ददाति; according to others the form वि-बाबधे is assigned to वि-बाध्); to set free.
विबद्ध: वि-बद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, bound or fastened on different sides, fastened; entirely stopped, obstructed, consti-pated.
विबध्य: वि-बध्य, ind. having bound or fastened.
विबन्ध: वि-बन्ध, अस्, m. binding, obstruction, constipa-tion, ischury.
विबन्धन: वि-बन्धन, अम्, n. the act of fastening or bind-ing on both sides, (परस्पर-विबन्धन, अस्, आ, अम्, mutually bound, depending on each other.)
विबाध्: विबाध् वि-बाध्, cl. 1. A. -बाधते, -बाधि-तुम्, to press or drive asunder or in different direc-tions; to press hard upon, drive away, chase away; to oppress, molest, harass, torment, persecute, pain, injure: Intens. वि-बाबधे (see under वि-बन्ध्).
विबाधा: वि-बाधा, f. pressure, pain, agony, anguish.
विबाल्य: विबाल्य वि-बाल्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. passed beyond a state of youth, in full vigour; swollen (said of a river).
विबुध्: विबुध् वि-बुध्, cl. 4. A. -बुध्यते, -बोद्-धुम्, to awake (intrans.), be awake or awakened; to become conscious, perceive, observe, learn, ascer-tain: Caus. -बोधयति, -यितुम्, to awaken; to cause to perceive or observe, make conscious, restore to consciousness.
विबुद्ध: 1. वि-बुद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, wide awake, awakened, aroused, awake, expanded, blossomed; clever, expe-rienced, knowing, skilful (e. g. कर्मसु विबुद्-धः, skilful in business). —विबुद्ध-कमल, अस्, आ, अम्, having expanded lotuses.
2. वि-बुद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, without consciousness, unconscious.
विबुध: वि-बुध, अस्, m. a learned or wise man, teacher, Paṇḍit; a god, immortal; the moon; N. of the author of the Janma-pradīpa. —विबुध-प्रिया, f. ‘favourite of the gods,’ N. of a metre. —विबुध-विजय, अस्, m. a victory (won) by the gods. —वि-बुध-विद्विष्, ट्, or विबुध-शत्रु, उस्, m. a foe of the gods; a demon. —विबुधाधिपति (°ध-अध्°), इस्, or विबुधेश्वर (°ध-ईश्°), अस्, m. the lord of the immortals.
विबुधान: वि-बुधान, अस्, m. a wise man, teacher, pre-ceptor.
विबुध्य: वि-बुध्य, ind. having become conscious, having perceived or learnt.
विबोध: 1. वि-बोध, अस्, m. awaking; perceiving, observ-ing, discovering; intelligence; (in the drama) the unfolding of the faculties, becoming conscious, awak-ing, (one of the Vyabhicāra-bhāvas.)
2. वि-बोध, अस्, m. want of consciousness, inat-tention, absence of mind.
विबोधन: वि-बोधन, अम्, n. the act of awakening, awak-ing.
विबोधित: वि-बोधित, अस्, आ, अम्, awakened, aroused; caused to perceive or know, instructed.
विब्बोक: विब्बोक विब्बोक, अस्, m. (also written बिब्-बोक, विव्वोक, q. q. v. v.), (in erotic poetry) affec-tation of indifference to a beloved object through pride and conceit.
विब्रू: विब्रू वि-ब्रू, cl. 2. P. A. -ब्रवीति, -ब्रूते, &c. (see rt. ब्रू), to speak out, say, speak, utter; to speak in detail, particularize, interpret, explain, declare; to speak of or about (with acc.); to speak at variance; to say what is false, declare falsely, ex-plain falsely; to contradict, disagree with, be at vari-ance with; to dispute, contend about (Ved. A.).
विब्रुवत्: वि-ब्रुवत्, अन्, अती (ep. अन्ती), अत्, speaking out, speaking, saying, declaring, particularizing, interpret-ing; speaking falsely, saying what is untrue or unjust.
विब्रुवाण: वि-ब्रुवाण, अस्, आ, अम्, speaking out, saying, declaring, uttering.
विभज्: विभज् वि-भज्, cl. 1. P. A. -भजति, -ते, -भक्तुम् (Ved. inf. -भाजम्), to divide, apportion, distribute, assign; to share together or with each other, participate in (A.); to take possession of; to separate, divide, part, cut; to honour, worship: Caus. -भाज-यति, -यितुम्, to cause to distribute or divide or share, apportion: Pass. of Caus. -भाज्यते, to be caused to be divided, be apportioned.
विभक्त: वि-भक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, divided, portioned, par-titioned; parted, separated, distinct; different, multi-farious; retired, secluded, isolated; measured; regu-lar, symmetrical; ornamented; (अस्), m. an epithet of Kārttikeya; (अम्), n. solitude, separatedness; isolation. —विभक्त-ज, अस्, m. a son born after the partition of the family property between his parents and brethren.
विभक्ति: वि-भक्ति, इस्, f. a division, partition; part, portion, share of inheritance, &c.; (in grammar) inflection of nouns, declension, an affix of declension, case; (according to Pāṇini's system) a termination or in-flection either of a case or of the persons of a tense, (certain Taddhita affixes which are used like case-terminations have also the name वि-भक्ति।)
विभक्तृ: वि-भक्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who distributes or dispenses, a dispenser, distributer.
विभजनीय: वि-भजनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be apportioned or partitioned; to be divided, divisible.
विभज्य: वि-भज्य, ind. having divided or parted, having portioned or distributed, having allotted.
विभज्यमान: वि-भज्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being divided or parted; being apportioned.
विभाग: वि-भाग, अस्, m. division, separation, disjunction, (one of the twenty-four Guṇas of the Nyāya); por-tion, part, share; the share or portion of an inherit-ance; partition of inheritance, law of inheritance, distri-bution, apportionment; arrangement; a section, (कूर्-म-व्°, a section of a globe, hemisphere); the numerator of a fraction (in arithmetic). —विभाग-कल्पना, f. apportioning or allotment of shares or portions. —वि-भाग-तस्, ind. according to a part or share, pro-portionately. —विभाग-धर्म, अस्, m. the law of division, rule of inheritance. —विभाग-पत्त्रिका, f. a deed of partition. —विभाग-भाज्, क्, m. one who shares in a portion of property already distributed, (applied especially to a son by a father and mother of the same tribe, born subsequently to a distribution of property amongst his parents and brethren, in which case he inherits the portion allotted or reserved to the parents.) —विभाग-शस्, ind. according to a part or share, part by part, share by share, propor-tionately. —विभागेच्छु (°ग-इच्°), उस्, उस्, उ, wish-ing for a partition or distribution.
विभाजन: वि-भाजन, अम्, n. the act of causing to share or distribute, participation.
विभाजित: वि-भाजित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to be divided, dis-tributed, apportioned, partitioned.
विभाज्य: वि-भाज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be divided or appor-tioned, portionable, divisible.
विभाज्यमान: वि-भाज्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being caused to be divided, being distributed or apportioned.
विभञ्ज्: विभञ्ज् वि-भञ्ज्, cl. 7. P. -भनक्ति, -भङ्क्-तुम्, to break asunder, break to pieces.
विभग्न: वि-भग्न, अस्, आ, अम्, broken asunder, broken to pieces, shattered, crushed.
विभङ्ग: वि-भङ्ग, अस्, m. breaking, fracture; division; stopping, stoppage, obstruction; bending, contracting (especially of the eyebrows); expression or play of features.
विभङ्गिन्: विभङ्गिन्, ई, इनी, इ, wavy, undulating, wrinkled.
विभव: वि-भव, अस्, m. power, might, supreme power, superhuman power; substance, thing, property, wealth; magnanimity, lofty-mindedness; emanci-pation from existence; N. of the thirty-sixth year of Jupiter's cycle. —विभव-तस्, ind. according to power, according to dignity or majesty; in regal state or ceremony. —विभव-मद, अस्, m. the pride of power. —विभव-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessed of power, wealthy.
विभा: विभा 1. वि-भा, cl. 2. P. -भाति, -भातुम्, to shine or gleam forth; to shine brightly, glitter; to appear as, appear to be, seem; to come to light, be visible, appear; to lighten up, illuminate, brighten.

2. वि-भा, f. light, lustre; a ray of light; beauty. —विभा-कर, अस्, m. ‘light-maker,’ the sun; fire; N. of a kind of plant or tree (= अर्क, चित्रक). —विभा-वस्, आन्, m. (a doubtful word), the sun (?). —विभा-वसु, उस्, उस्, उ, abounding in light, (Sāy. दीप्ति-रोचन); (उस्), m. the sun, fire; the moon; a sort of necklace or garland; N. of a Gandharva (who is said to have stolen the Soma from Gāyatrī as she was carrying it to the gods). —विभा-साह्, ट्, ट्, ट्, Ved. splendor-surpassing.
विभात्: वि-भात्, आन्, आती, or आन्ती, आत्, shining, splendid; (आती), f. epithet of the dawn.
विभात: वि-भात, अस्, आ, अम्, shining, bright, luminous; (अम्), n. dawn, day-break.
विभावन्: विभा-वन्, वा, वरी, व, Ved. radiant, shining, resplendent, illuminating, (in Ṛg-veda X. 8, 4. वि-भावा is by some translated ‘the divider,’ as if from वि-भू); (वरी), f. the dawn (= उषस्, Naigh. I. 8); night, (in this sense वि is probably privative); turmeric; a harlot, bawd; the shreds of a garment torn in a scuffle (?).
विभाण्डक: विभाण्डक विभाण्डक, अस्, m., N. of a hermit; of a Muni (son of Kaśyapa and father of Ṛṣya-śṛṅga).
विभाण्डी: वि-भाण्डी, f. a kind of creeping plant (= आ-वर्-तकी).
विभाव: वि-भाव, अस्, m. any condition which excites or develops a particular state of mind or body, (in dramatic composition one of the three divisions of Bhāvas, the other two being Anu-bhāvas and Sāt-tvika-bhāvas, see भाव); any causative or exciting property (as dress, perfumes, &c. causing amorous desire, extravagant gesture causing mirth, distress causing tenderness, arms and tumult causing wrath or heroism); a friend, acquaintance.
2. वि-भाव, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 2. वि-भा), Ved. shining forth.
विभाष्: विभाष् वि-भाष्, cl. 1. A. -भाषते, -भा-षितुम्, to speak variously; to speak against, revile, abuse.
विभाषा: वि-भाषा, f. an alternative, option, one of two ways; (in grammar) the allowing a rule to be optional, (it is of two kinds, viz. 1. प्राप्त-व्° or प्राप्ते व्°, an option allowed in a particular opera-tion which another rule makes necessary; 2. अप्राप्-त-व्° or अप्राप्ते व्°, an option allowed in a particu-lar operation which another rule makes impossible.)
विभाषित: वि-भाषित, अस्, आ, अम्, made optional (in gram-mar).
विभाष्य: वि-भाष्य, ind. having reviled or abused.
विभास्: विभास् वि-भास्, cl. 1. A. (Ved. also P.) -भासते (-भासति), -भासितुम्, to shine brightly or pleasantly, be bright: Caus. -भासयति, &c., to cause to shine, illuminate, brighten.
विभासा: वि-भासा, f. shining brightly, light, lustre.
विभासित: वि-भासित, अस्, आ, अम्, made bright, lighted, illu-minated, shining.
विभिद्: विभिद् वि-भिद्, cl. 7. P. A. -भिनत्ति, -भिन्त्ते, -भेत्तुम्, to split or break in two, break in pieces, cleave apart or asunder, cleave, divide, separate, pierce, open; to loosen, untie; to scatter, disperse, dispel, drive away, destroy; to disunite, cause disunion, set at variance, estrange: Pass. -भिद्-यते, to burst asunder; to become disunited; to be set at variance, be estranged or alienated; to change, become changed: Caus. -भेदयति, -यितुम्, to divide; to alienate, estrange; to dispel, remove.
विबिभित्सु: वि-बिभित्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to break asunder, purposing to cleave or pierce.
विभिद्य: वि-भिद्य, ind. having split in two, having cut asunder, having cleaved; having divided or separated, &c.
विभिद्यमान: वि-भिद्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being broken or split asunder; being divided or scattered; being pierced or wounded.
विभिन्दु: वि-भिन्दु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. splitting or cleaving asunder, dissevering, shattering; (उस्), m., Ved. a proper N.
विभिन्न: वि-भिन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, broken or split asunder, divided, pierced, broken, wounded; scattered, dis-persed, dispelled, destroyed; bewildered estranged, alienated, perplexed, deceived; moved to and fro; disappointed; become faithless; various, different; mixed, intermixed, mingling (with inst.); (अस्), m. an epithet of Śiva. —विभिन्न-तमिस्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having the darkness dispelled. —विभिन्न-ता, f. or विभिन्न-त्व, अम्, n. the state of being broken or split asunder; the state of being scattered, &c.
विभेत्तृ: वि-भेत्तृ, ता, m. one who splits or breaks asun-der, a destroyer.
विभेद: वि-भेद, अस्, m. breaking asunder, dividing, breaking, division, separation; piercing, wounding; violating; bewildering, perplexing, confusing; con-tradiction; enmity, opposition; variety, distinction.
विभेदन: वि-भेदन, अम्, n. the act of splitting or cleaving asunder; breaking, dividing; separating, setting at variance.
विभी: विभी 1. वि-भी, cl. 3. P. -बिभेति, &c., to be afraid of, fear: Caus. -भीषयति, &c., to frighten, terrify, intimidate.
2. वि-भी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, free from fear.
विभीत: वि-भीत, अस्, आ, अम्, fearless; (अस्, आ, अम्), m. f. n. the plant Terminalia Belerica.
विभीतक: विभीतक, अस्, ई, अम्, m. f. n. the tree Termi-nalia Belerica.
विभीषक: वि-भीषक, अस्, इका, अम्, frightening, terrifying, intimidating, threatening, bullying; (इका), f. the act of terrifying, terror; a means of terrifying. —विभी-षिका-स्थान, अम्, n. an object or means of terri-fying.
विभीषण: वि-भीषण, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, terrifying, intimi-dating, terrific, fearful, terrible, formidable, horrible; bullying or blustering (as language); (अम्, आ), n. f. the act of terrifying, the property of exciting fear, a means of terrifying, terror; (अस्), m., N. of a brother of Rāvaṇa, (his other brothers were Kuvera [by a different mother] and Kumbha-karṇa; both Rāvaṇa and Vibhīṣaṇa are said to have propitiated Brahmā by their penances, so that the god granted them both boons, and the boon chosen by Vibhīṣaṇa was that he should never, even in the greatest cala-mity, stoop to any mean or wicked action; hence he is represented in the Rāmāyaṇa as opposing and endeavouring to counteract the malice of his brother Rāvaṇa, in consequence of which he was so ill-treated and insulted by Rāvaṇa that, leaving Laṅkā, he joined the side of Rāma, by whom, after the death of Rāvaṇa, Vibhīṣaṇa was placed on the throne of Laṅkā); N. of several kings, (in later times Vibhīṣaṇa appears to have been used as a general name of the kings of Laṅkā.) —विभीषण-वाक्य, अम्, n. ‘speech of Vibhīṣaṇa,’ N. of several chapters in the Sundara-kāṇḍa of the Rāmāyaṇa. —विभीषणाभिषेक (°ण-अभ्°), अस्, m. ‘inau-guration of Vibhīṣaṇa,’ N. of the ninety-first chapter of the Sundara-kāṇḍa of the Rāmāyaṇa (according to one recension).
विभीषयत्: वि-भीषयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, terrifying, causing terror or alarm.
विभीदक: विभीदक विभीदक, अस्, m., Ved. a kind of tree (from the nuts of which dice are made; cf. वि-भीतक); dice, gambling, (Sāy. = अक्ष।)
विभुग्न: विभुग्न वि-भुग्न, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. 1. भुज्), bent, bowed, crooked.
विभू: विभू 1. वि-भू, cl. 1. P. A. -भवति, -ते, -भवितुम्, to arise, be produced, become developed, be manifested, expand, appear; to pervade; to be equal to, suffice for; to prevail, have power, be capable of, be able to (with inf.): Caus. -भावयति, -यितुम्, to cause to arise, cause to be developed or expand, make manifest, develop, cause to appear clearly, manifest, reveal, show forth, display; to cause to be apart, separate; to perceive distinctly, find out, trace out, discover, ascertain, detect, ob-serve, know, feel; to recognise; to suppose, fancy, imagine; to suppose anything (acc.) of or about any one (loc.); to think about, reflect upon; to make clear, establish, prove, decide; to convict, con-vince: Pass. of Caus. -भाव्यते, to be considered or regarded as, to appear, seem.
2. वि-भू, ऊस्, &c., Ved. expanding, pervading, epithet of a particular Prāṇa.
विबोभुवत्: वि-बोभुवत्, अत्, अती, अत् (fr. the Intens.), Ved. spreading in every direction.
विभवत्: वि-भवत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, pervading, prevailing.
विभावक: वि-भावक, अस्, आ, अम्, causing to appear clearly, manifesting, showing, illustrating; discussing.
विभावन: वि-भावन, अम्, आ, n. f. the causing to appear distinctly, clear perception, distinguishing or perceiv-ing distinctly, conception, imagination, examination, discrimination, judgment, clear ascertainment; dis-cussion; (in rhetoric) description of effects not arising from the usual causes, peculiar causation; or, according to some, description by negatives, bring-ing out the qualities of any object more clearly than by positive description. —विभावनालङ्कार (°ना-अल्°), अस्, m. (in rhetoric) the rhetorical figure de-scribed above.
विभावनीय: वि-भावनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, distinguishable, ascer-tainable, to be judged or determined.
विभावित: वि-भावित, अस्, आ, अम्, made to appear clearly, manifested; proved, established; judged, discrimi-nated; perceived, ascertained, seen, conceived, known, understood, convicted, convinced. —विभावित-त्व, अम्, n. the state of being perceived or judged.
विभाविन्: विभाविन्, ई, इनी, इ, filled with amorous sentiments, exciting emotion of love, (see वि-भाव, col. 1.)
विभाव्य: वि-भाव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, distinguishable, to be clearly perceived or seen or observed; remarkable; to be conceived or imagined.
विभु: वि-भु, उस्, उस्, or वी, उ (in Ved. the fem. is always विभ्वी, Pāṇ. IV. 1, 47), being everywhere, pervading all material things, developing in all direc-tions, omnipresent, eternal (Ved.); mighty, very powerful or great, excellent, eminent, supreme; ca-pable, able to (with inf., e. g. पूरयितुं विभुः, able to fill); firm, solid, hard; (उस्), m. (Ved. acc. विभ्वम्, Ved. nom. pl. विभ्वस्), ether; space; time; the soul; a lord, ruler, sovereign, master, owner (often used in addressing a superior); N. of Brahmā; of Viṣṇu; of Śiva; of a son of Bhṛgu; a servant. —विभु-क्रतु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. mighty in action, effecting much, (Sāy. = बहु-कर्मन्।) —विभु-ता, f. or विभु-त्व, अम्, n. might, power, capacity, supremacy. —विभु-प्रमित, अम्, n., Ved. the hall of Brahmā. —विभु-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. mighty, powerful. —विभू-वसु, उस्, उस्, उ (for विभु-वसु), Ved. having mighty treasures or wealth.
विभूत: वि-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, arisen, produced, developed, manifested, appeared, displayed; great, mighty. —विभूत-द्युम्न, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. abounding in glory or in food, (Sāy. = प्रभूत-यशस् or प्रभूतान्न।) —विभूत-राति, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. mak-ing great gifts.
विभूति: वि-भूति, इस्, m. great power, might, dominion, supremacy, dignity; great success, prosperity, wel-fare; superhuman power (consisting of eight facul-ties, especially attributed to Śiva, but supposed also to be attainable by human beings through a course of austere worship in honour of that deity, viz. अणि-मन्, the power of becoming as minute as an atom; लघिमन्, extreme lightness; प्राप्ति, the power of attaining or reaching anything, as illustrated by the power of touching the moon with the tip of the finger; प्राकाम्य, irresistible will; महिमन्, illimitable bulk; ईशिता, supreme dominion; वशिता, the power of subjugating by magic; and कामाव-सायिता, the power of suppressing all desires); the ashes of cow-dung &c. (with which Śiva is said to smear his body, and hence used in imitation of him by devotees); (इस्, इस्, इ), Ved. very powerful, mighty. —विभूति-द्वादशी, f., N. of a particular Vrata or religious observance. —विभूति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, powerful, possessed of excellence or dignity, super-human; smeared with ashes. —विभूति-योग, अस्, m., N. of the sixth canto of the Śiva-gītā.
विभ्वन्: वि-भ्वन्, आ, &c., Ved. displayed, developed, dif-fused; great, mighty; (आ), m., N. of a son of Su-dhanvan (brother of Ṛbhu, q. v., regarded as one of the three Ṛbhus). —विभ्व-तष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. cut out or fashioned by Vibhvan (said of the rivers which were supposed to be carved out by him, as the artificer of Varuṇa); modelled by Vi-bhvan, very perfect or handsome (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda V. 58, 4). —विभ्वा-सह् (विभ्वा for विभ्व), Ved. conquering or overcoming the mighty, (Sāy. = महतो-ऽभिभवितृ।)
विभूष्: विभूष् वि-भूष्, cl. 1. 10. P. -भूषति, -भूषयति, -भूषितुम्, -भूषयितुम्, to deco-rate, adorn; to shine forth, appear, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda I. 112, 4. विभूषति may = व्य्-आप्तो भवति, the rt. भूष् being sometimes used in the Veda as another form of rt. 1. भू, in the sense of ‘to obtain, attain.’)
विभूषण: वि-भूषण, अम्, n. decoration, ornament. —वि-भूषणोद्भासिन् (°ण-उद्°), ई, इनी, इ, glittering with ornaments.
विभूषा: वि-भूषा, f. ornament, decoration; light, lustre, splendor, beauty.
विभूषित: वि-भूषित, अस्, आ, अम्, adorned, decorated, orna-mented. —विभूषिताङ्ग (°त-अङ्°), अस्, आ, अम्, decorated about the body.
विभूषिन्: वि-भूषिन्, ई, इणी, इ, adorning, decorating; adorned, decorated.
विभूष्य: वि-भूष्य, ind. having adorned or decorated.
विभृ: विभृ वि-भृ, cl. 1. P. A. -भरति, -ते, cl. 3. P. A. -बिभर्ति, -बिभृते, &c., -भर्तुम्, to support; to bear or carry in different directions, spread out; to distribute, diffuse (A.): Intens. (for Intensive forms see under rt. भृ), to move to and fro, wave about, brandish, toss about; to roam or sport about, (according to Sāy. in this sense for वि-हृ; cf. वि-भृत्र।)
विभृत: वि-भृत, अस्, आ, अम्, upheld, supported, main-tained, held, retained.
विभृत्र: वि-भृत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. borne in various direc-tions, (Sāy. = नाना-स्थानेषु विहृत); employed in various sacred rites, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda I. 71, 3. वि-भृत्राः = अग्नि-होत्रादि-कर्मणि विहरन्त्यः।)
विभृत्वन्: वि-भृत्वन्, आ, m., Ved. one who bears or sup-ports.
विभ्रंश्: विभ्रंश् वि-भ्रंश् (sometimes written वि-भ्रंस्), cl. 4. P., 1. A. -भ्रश्यति, -भ्रंशते, -भ्रंशितुम्, to fall down, fall, go to ruin, decay; to fall away, fall off; to disappear, vanish; to be unfortunate, fail; to fall away from, stray from, be separated from (with abl.); to be deprived of, lose: Caus. -भ्रंशयति, -यितुम्, to cause to fall off, strike or knock off, break off, to cause to fall, lead astray, seduce; to cause to disappear or vanish, destroy, annihilate, ruin; to divert from (with abl.), deprive of.
विभ्रंश: वि-भ्रंश, अस्, m. falling away, &c.; a precipice.
विभ्रंशित: वि-भ्रंशित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Caus.), caused to fall away; struck off, broken off; led astray, seduced; made to disappear, destroyed; deprived of. —विभ्रंशित-ज्ञान, अस्, आ, अम्, deprived of reason or consciousness. —विभ्रंशित-पुष्प-पत्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having the flowers and leaves knocked off.
विभ्रंशिन्: वि-भ्रंशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, falling away, falling off; dropping, falling, fallen.
विभ्रष्ट: वि-भ्रष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen away or off, broken off or from, separated from, gone astray; fallen, de-cayed, failed, ruined, lost, disappeared, vanished. —विभ्रष्ट-तिमिर, अस्, आ, अम्, whose darkness has vanished or disappeared (said of the sky). —वि-भ्रष्ट-हर्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen from or deprived of joy.
विभ्रम्: विभ्रम् वि-भ्रम्, cl. 1. 4. P. -भ्रमति, -भ्राम्यति, -भ्रमितुम्, to wander or roam about, roam through or over; to flit or hover about; to move to and fro, roll about; to disperse, scatter, scare or frighten away; to fall into disorder or confusion, become disarranged or bewildered: Caus. -भ्रम-यति, -भ्रामयति, -यितुम्, to confuse, perplex.
विभ्रम: वि-भ्रम, अस्, m. roaming or wandering about, whirling round, whirling or rolling about, going round, any whirling motion; error, mistake, blunder, erroneous use or application; hurry, confusion, agita-tion, perturbation, flurry (one of the classes of femi-nine action proceeding from love, as when a woman through flurry puts on her ornaments in the wrong places); amorous action of any kind; caprice, whim; beauty, grace; play (of the eyes); rapture; doubt, apprehension; (आ), f. old age. —विभ्रम-तन्त्र or विभ्रम-सूत्र, N. of a treatise on grammar (attributed to Hema-candra).
विभ्रमत्: वि-भ्रमत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, roaming about, roaming through, whirling round.
विभ्रमित्वा: वि-भ्रमित्वा (anom. ind. part.), having whirled or frightened away.
विभ्रान्त: वि-भ्रान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, whirled about, agitated, bewildered, hurried, flurried, confused (through pre-cipitation &c.). —विभ्रान्त-नयन, अस्, आ, अम्, having rolling eyes. —विभ्रान्त-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, bewildered or confused in mind. —विभ्रान्त-शील, अस्, आ, अम्, confused in mind or disposition; drunk, intoxicated, insane; (अस्), m. a monkey; the disk of the sun or moon.
विभ्रान्ति: वि-भ्रान्ति, इस्, f. whirling round, going round, error, confusion; hurry, flurry, precipitation.
विभ्राज्: विभ्राज् 1. वि-भ्राज्, cl. 1. A. -भ्राजते, -भ्रा-जितुम् (Ved. inf. विभ्राजम्), to shine forth, shine, glitter, gleam, be bright or radiant; to shine through: Caus. -भ्राजयति, -यितुम्, to cause to radiate or beam or shine.
2. वि-भ्राज्, ट्, ट्, ट्, shining, splendid, luminous; elegant, richly dressed or decorated; (ट्), m., N. of the author of the hymn Ṛg-veda X. 170 (having the patronymic Saurya).
विभ्राजत्: वि-भ्राजत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, shining, glittering.
विभ्राजमान: वि-भ्राजमान, अस्, आ, अम्, resplendent, glittering, shining, dazzling, radiant, bright.
विभ्राजित: वि-भ्राजित, अस्, आ, अम्, made splendid or bright, caused to shine.
विभ्राष्टि: वि-भ्राष्टि, इस्, f., Ved. radiance, flame, blaze.
विमंह्: विमंह् वि-मंह्, cl. 1. A. -मंहते, &c., Ved. to distribute, bestow.
विमंहमान: वि-मंहमान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. distributing, giving.
विमज्ज्: विमज्ज् वि-मज्ज्, cl. 6. P. -मज्जति, &c., to plunge or dive in, enter into, (probably wrongly for नि-मज्ज्): Caus. -मज्जयति, &c., to submerge, cause to plunge into or enter in.
विमत: विमत वि-मत, वि-मति। See under वि-मन्।

वि-मत, अस्, आ, अम्, disagreed, disagreeing, dis-senting, disapproving; at variance, inconsistent, averse, hostile to; slighted, despised, offended, displeased; of a different mind or disposition; (अस्), m. an enemy.
विमत्सर: विमत्सर वि-मत्सर, अस्, आ, अम्, free from envy or jealousy, unenvious, unambitious.
विमथ्: विमथ् वि-मथ् or वि-मन्थ्, cl. 1. 9. P. -म-थति, -मन्थति, -मथ्नाति (Ved. generally A. -मथ्नीते), &c., -मथितुम्, -मन्थितुम्, to crush or dash to pieces, rend asunder, bruise (Ved. A.); to cut to pieces, annihilate, destroy, disperse, scatter; to confuse, perplex, bewilder, embarrass.
विमथित: वि-मथित, अस्, आ, अम्, crushed or dashed to pieces, rent asunder, bruised, destroyed, annihilated.
विमथ्नत्: वि-मथ्नत्, अन्, अती, अत्, dashing to pieces, crush-ing, destroying.
विमथ्य: वि-मथ्य, ind. having crushed completely, having destroyed.
विमाथ: वि-माथ, अस्, m. the act of crushing or destroy-ing utterly.
विमाथिन्: वि-माथिन्, ई, इनी, इ, crushing or dashing to pieces, destroying.
विमद्: विमद् वि-मद्, cl. 4. P. -माद्यति (Ved. also -मदति), &c., -मदितुम्, to become perplexed or confused, be disconcerted; to confound, embarrass, disturb: Caus. -मादयति, &c., -यितुम्, to cause to be perplexed, to confuse, embarrass; to intoxicate.
विमत्त: वि-मत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, intoxicated; being in rut, ruttish.
विमद: वि-मद, अस्, आ, अम्, free from intoxication; joyless; (अस्), m., N. of the author of the hymns Ṛg-veda X. 20-26 (having the patronymic Aindra or Prājāpatya; Vasu-kṛt Vāsukra is also regarded as the author of these hymns).
विमदित: वि-मदित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Caus.), = वि-मत्त।
विमध्य: विमध्य वि-मध्य, Ved. an unfathomable depth, (Sāy. on Ṛg-veda IV. 51, 3. explains तमसो विमध्ये by अत्यन्त-गाढान्धकारे, ‘in un-fathomable darkness.’)
विमन्: विमन् वि-मन्, cl. 8. 4. A., 1. P. -मनुते, -मन्यते, -मनति, &c., -मन्तुम्, to distinguish (?, Ved.); to dishonour, offend: Caus. -मानयति, -यितुम्, to dishonour, slight, treat with disrespect.
विमति: वि-मति, इस्, f. difference of mind or opinion, dissent, disagreement; dislike, aversion; stupidity. —विमति-ता, f. difference of opinion, want of mind, stupidity.
विमान: 1. वि-मान, अस्, अम्, m. n. (for 2. see under 2. वि-मा), disrespect, dishonour.

2. वि-मान, अस्, अम्, m. n. (for 1. वि-मान see under वि-मन्), a measure; a car or chariot of the gods (sometimes serving as a seat or throne, sometimes self-moving and carrying its occupant through the skies; other descriptions make the Vimāna more like a house or palace, and one kind is said to be seven stories high; that of Rāvaṇa was called पुष्पक, q. v.); any car or vehicle; a horse; a palace, the palace of an emperor or supreme monarch. —विमान-गमन, अम्, n. ‘going in a car,’ N. of the fifty-second chapter of the Krīḍā-khaṇḍa of the Gaṇeśa-Purāṇa. —विमान-चारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, travelling in a celestial car. —विमान-ता, f. the state or condition of a chariot. —विमान-प्रभुता, f. the ownership or possession of a celestial chariot. —विमान-यान, अस्, आ, अम्, going or driving in a car. —विमान-राज, अस्, m. the driver of a chariot of the gods. —विमान-वत्, ind. like a self-moving car, (Kirāt. VII. 4.) —वि-मान-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, standing on a divine chariot.
1. वि-मान; add — (अस्, आ, अम्), without honour, dishonoured, disgraced.
विमानित: वि-मानित, अस्, आ, अम्, dishonoured, slighted, treated with disrespect.
विमनस्: विमनस् वि-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, changed in mind or feeling; averse, displeased; out of one's mind, distraught, depressed in mind or spirit, sad, distressed, discomposed; heart-broken; absent in mind, thinking of something else; perplexed, dis-ordered, bewildered.
विमनस्क: वि-मनस्क, अस्, आ, अम्, out of one's mind, de-pressed in spirit, heart-broken, sad, melancholy, be-wildered.
विमनीकृत: विमनी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, altered in mind or feeling; displeased, offended; depressed in mind, sad, sorrowful.
विमनीभूत: विमनी-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, become changed in mind or feeling; brought into a melancholy frame of mind.
विमन्यु: विमन्यु वि-मन्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, free from anger or passion, free from grief.
वि-मन्यु; add — (उस्), m. excessive desire, eager-ness (Ved.).
विमय: विमय वि-मय, अस्, m. (see rt. मे), change, exchange, barter.
विमर्द: वि-मर्द, अस्, m. crushing, bruising; devasta-tion, destruction, pressing or rubbing together, fric-tion; the trituration of perfumes; rubbing against, touch, contact; conjunction of the sun and moon, total obscuration, eclipse; war, battle; weariness, tediousness; the plant Cassia Esculenta. —विमर्-दार्ध (°द-अर्°), अम्, n. the time from the appa-rent conjunction to the end of an eclipse. —विमर्-दोत्थ (°द-उत्°), अस्, m. a scent arising from the trituration of perfumes.
विमर्श: वि-मर्श, अस्, m. consideration, deliberation, in-vestigation, trial, examination by reason, reasoning, discussion, hesitation; a conflicting judgment. —वि-मर्श-वादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, uttering discussions, one who reasons, a reasoner.
विमर्ष: वि-मर्ष, अस्, m. dissatisfaction, displeasure; want of forbearance, impatience, (in these senses वि is privative); change in the prosperous course of a dramatic plot, unforeseen reverse or adverse event in the course of a love-story. —विमर्षाङ्ग (°ष-अङ्°), a division of the dramatic Vimarṣa (of which there are said to be thirteen).
विमल: विमल वि-मल, अस्, आ, अम्, stainless, free from dirt or impurity, spotless, pure, clean; white, transparent, beautiful; (अस्), m. an Arhat or Jaina deified sage; N. of the father of Padma-pāda; of a son of Su-dyumna; (आ), f. a particular plant, = सप्तला, (commonly called Charmaghās); a sort of soil; N. of Dākṣāyaṇī; (अम्), n. silver gilt; talc. —विमल-तन्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a Tantra work. —विमल-ता, f. or विमल-त्व, अम्, n. stainlessness, cleanliness, purity, clearness. —विमल-दान, अम्, n. a gift or offering to a deity. —विमल-नाथ-पुराण, N. of a Jaina work by Kṛṣṇa-dāsa. —विमल-प्रभा, f., N. of one of the wives of Narendrāditya. —विमल-मणि, इस्, m. ‘clear-gem,’ crystal. —विमलात्मक (°ल-आत्°), अस्, आ, अम्, pure-minded, clean, pure. —वि-मलात्मन् (°ल-आत्°), आ, आ, अ, pure-souled, unde-filed, pure. —विमलादित्य (°ल-आद्°), अस्, m. ‘clear-sun,’ a particular form of the sun. —विमलाद्रि (°ल-अद्°), इस्, m. ‘pure mountain,’ N. of the mountain Vimala or Girnar in Gujarāt, (this mountain is cele-brated for its inscriptions; it is also called Śatruñ-jaya, q. v.) —विमलार्थक (°ल-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, of pure purpose, pure-minded; pure, clean, clear. —विम-लाश्व (°ल-अश्°), N. of a country in Kaśmīra. —विमली-करण, अम्, n. the act of making pure. —विमली-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, &c., to make clean or pure. —विमलेश्वर-तीर्थ (°ल-ईश्°), अम्, n., N. of a chapter in the Śiva-Purāṇa.
विमलोग्यतन्त्र: विमलोग्य-तन्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a Tantra work.
विमस्तकित: विमस्तकित वि-मस्तकित, अस्, आ, अम्, be-headed, decapitated.
विमहत्: विमहत् वि-महत्, आन्, अती, अत्, very great, immense.
विमहस्: वि-महस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. of various or excellent might or splendor, very vigorous, very brilliant or resplendent.
विमहि: वि-महि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. very large or great, (Sāy. = विशेषेण महत्।)
विमा: विमा 1. वि-मा, cl. 3. A. -मिमीते, &c. (see rt. 2. मा), Ved. to bellow, roar, cry (?).

विमा 2. वि-मा (see rt. 3. मा), cl. 2. P., 3. 4. A. -माति, -मिमीते, -मायते, -मातुम्, (Ved.) to measure out, to traverse, pass over (a course); (Ved.) to set in order, set right, prepare; to count, count over; to measure; to pervade; to make in various ways.
विमिमान: वि-मिमान, अस्, आ, अम्, measuring out, preparing, making; measured, conceived, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda I. 155, 6 = विविधम् मिमान।)
विमांस: विमांस वि-मांस, अस्, अम्, m. n. unclean meat (as the flesh of dogs &c.).
विमातृ: विमातृ वि-मातृ, ता, f. a stepmother, a fa-ther's wife. —विमातृ-ज, अस्, m. a stepmother's son.
विमाय: विमाय वि-माय, अस्, आ, अम्, devoid of magic, free from illusion.
विमार्ग: विमार्ग वि-मार्ग, अस्, m. a bad road, by-road; a wrong road (literally or figuratively); evil conduct, immorality; a broom, brush; [cf. rt. मार्ग्।] —विमार्ग-गामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, going in a wrong road, following an evil course.
विमार्गण: वि-मार्गण, अम्, n. the act of searching or seek-ing for.
विमि: विमि वि-मि (see rt. 1. मि), cl. 5. P. A. -मि-नोति, -मिनुते, -मातुम्, Ved. to fix, build, erect.
विमित: वि-मित, अस्, आ, अम्, fixed, built; (अम्), n., Ved. a square shed or large building resting on four posts.
विमिन्वत्: वि-मिन्वत्, अन्, अती, अत्, fixing; (Sāy.) separating and fixing (= परि-च्छिन्दत् स्थापयत्, Ṛg-veda IV. 56. 1).
विमिश्र्: विमिश्र् वि-मिश्र्, cl. 10. P. -मिश्रयति, -यि-तुम्, to mix or mingle together.
विमिश्र: वि-मिश्र, अस्, आ, अम्, mixed or mingled together, commingled.
विमिश्रित: वि-मिश्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, mixed together, mingled; mixed with, attended or accompanied by.

विमर्दिन्: वि-मर्दिन्, ई, इनी, इ, crushing to pieces, destroy-ing, removing,

विमर्षण: वि-मर्षण, अस्, m., N. of a king of the Kirātas.
विमर्षिन्: वि-मर्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, disliking, dissatisfied, averse; impatient, intolerant.

विरच्: विरच् वि-रच्, cl. 10. P. -रचयति, -यितुम् (Aor. व्य्-अररचत्; in one passage -अरीरचत्), to arrange, construct, fabricate, contrive, form, make, prepare; to compose, write (a book); to put on, lay on, inlay; to effect, perform: Pass. -रच्यते (Aor. व्य्-अरचि), to be arranged or composed.
विरचन: वि-रचन, अम्, आ, n. f. the act of arranging, arrangement; constructing, contriving, contrivance; making; compiling, composing, composition, com-pilation; embellishing; embellishment, any artificial or ornamental fabric.
विरचनीय: वि-रचनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be made, to be com-posed, &c.
विरचयत्: वि-रचयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, arranging, making, fabricating, composing, embellishing, &c.
विरचय्य: वि-रचय्य, ind. having arranged, having com-posed; having marked out.
विरचित: वि-रचित, अस्, आ, अम्, arranged, trimmed, con-structed, formed, contrived, made, prepared; written, compiled, composed; put on, worn; put in, inlaid, set; embellished, ornamented, furnished with (with inst.). —विरचित-वपुस्, उस्, उस्, उस्, having the body arranged.
विरज: विरज वि-रज। See under वि-रजस् below.

वि-रज, अस्, आ, अम्, free from dust; (अस्), m., N. of Viṣṇu; of a son of Tvaṣṭṛ; (आ), f. a plant (commonly called Kavitthānī); Dūrvā grass; N. of a river; of the wife of Nahuṣa (daughter of a class of Manes called Sva-svadha). —विरजा-क्षेत्र, अम्, n., N. of a place.
विरजस्: विरजस् वि-रजस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, free from dust; devoid of passion, passionless; free from the men-strual excretion; (आस्), m., N. of a son of Paurṇa-māsa; of a son of Vasiṣṭha; of a son of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra; (आस्), f. a woman who has ceased to men-struate. —वि-रजस्-तमस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, free from (the qualities of) passion and ignorance. —विरजो-ऽम्बर-भूषण, अस्, आ, अम्, having apparel and ornaments free from dust.
विरजस्क: वि-रजस्क, अस्, आ, अम्, free from dust, &c., = वि-रजस्; (आ), f. a woman who has ceased to menstruate.
विरजीकृ: विरजी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to render free from dust or passion. —विरजी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, freed from dust, unsoiled, clean; exempt from passion.
विरजीभू: विरजी-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -भवितुम्, to become free from dust or passion. —विरजी-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, free from dust, clean, clear; free from passion, pure, holy.
विरञ्च: विरञ्च वि-रञ्च, अस्, m. (perhaps connected with वि-रच्), N. of Brahmā; [cf. विरिञ्च।]
विरञ्चि: वि-रञ्चि, इस्, m., N. of Brahmā.
विरञ्ज्: विरञ्ज् वि-रञ्ज्, cl. 1. 4. P. A. -रजति, -ते, -रज्यति, -ते, -रङ्क्तुम्, to be changed in colour, be discoloured, lose the natural colour; to become changed in disposition, become indifferent to, take no interest in, regard with indifference, become estranged or disaffected, grow cold: Caus. -रञ्ज-यति, -यितुम्, to colour, dye, make of various colours; to cause to be indifferent, make estranged, cause to dislike.
विरक्ति: वि-रक्ति, इस्, f. change of disposition or feeling, estrangement, alienation of mind, aversion, disincli-nation, dissatisfaction; absence of affection or attach-ment, freedom from passion, weanedness from the world, (in these senses वि appears to be privative.)
विराग: वि-राग, अस्, m. change of colour or feeling, change of nature, (applied in Vedic grammar to the change in consonants which mutually affect each other); absence of desire or passion, indifference, disinclina-tion; disregard of all sensual enjoyment either in this world or the next; stoicism. —विराग-विष-भृत्, त्, त्, त्, cherishing the poison of dislike, har-bouring the poison of aversion. —विरागार्ह (°ग-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, qualified for freedom from passion.
विरागिन्: विरागिन्, ई, इणी, इ, changed in feeling, estranged; void of passion or desire.
विरट: विरट विरट, अस्, m. a kind of black Agal-lochum; N. of a king.
विरण्: विरण् वि-रण्, Caus. -रणयति, -यितुम्, to make to sound forth, cause to sound, play upon (a musical instrument).
विरण: विरण विरण, अम्, n. a fragrant grass used in certain religious ceremonies, Andropogon Aroma-ticum or Muricatum; [cf. वीरण।]
विरथ: विरथ वि-रथ, अस्, आ, अम्, having no car or chariot, chariotless.
विरद्: विरद् वि-रद्, cl. 1. P. -रदति, &c., Ved. to divide, separate, sever, cut through, open; to conduct, convey; to bestow.
विरप्श्: विरप्श् वि-रप्श् (according to some रप्श् may be fr. an old Desid. form of rt. रप् or रभ्, according to Sāy. रप्श् is fr. rt. रप् = लप्), cl. 1. A. -रप्शते, &c., Ved. to be full to overflowing, be ready to burst, to be distended or inflated; to have too much of (inst.); to be praised or hymned, (Sāy. = विविधं स्तूयते); to shine forth variously, (Sāy. = विविधं राजते); to sound forth, utter a murmuring sound.
विरप्श: वि-रप्श, अम्, n., Ved. sound, voice, utterance, (Sāy. विरप्शम् = वाक्यम्; but in Ṛg-veda IV. 50, 3. विरप्शम् = विशेषेण शब्देन स्तोत्रं यथा भवति तथा।)
विरप्शिन्: वि-रप्शिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. copious, abundant, great, powerful, mighty, (according to Nirukta III. 3 = महत्); singing, sounding forth, loud-sounding, uttering various sounds of praise, having various sounds or utterances, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda IV. 17, 20. विरप्शी = बहु-विध-शब्दवान्; in Ṛg-veda I. 8, 8. विरप्शी = विविध-वाक्य-युक्ता, and appears to be used for विरप्शिनी); shaking, tossing, rocking.
विरम्: विरम् वि-रम्, cl. 1. P. -रमति (rarely also A. -रमते), -रन्तुम्, to cease or desist from, rest from (with abl.); to leave off or discontinue anything (especially applied to discontinuing a speech, e. g. विरराम or even वचनं विरराम, he ceased speaking), stop, pause, end, come to an end (e. g. रात्रिर् व्यरंसीत्, the night ended): Caus. -रमयति, -रामयति, -यितुम्, to cause to leave off or discontinue, make to cease or desist from; to bring to an end, finish.
विरत: वि-रत, अस्, आ, अम्, ceased from, desisting from (with abl., e. g. पापाद् विरतः, ceased from sin), stopped, ceased (e. g. विरतेषु मुनिषु, when the Munis had ceased speaking); rested, ended, con-cluded. —विरत-प्रसङ्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has left off a habit or practice, one whose occupation has ceased, having no occupation. —विरताशय (°त-आश्°), अस्, आ, अम्, one whose desires have ceased, one who has resigned worldly intentions.
विरति: वि-रति, इस्, f. cessation, discontinuance, stop, rest, pause, end, term; indifference.
विरम: वि-रम, अस्, m. ceasing, desisting, cessation; sunset.
विरमत्: वि-रमत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, ceasing, desisting, resting, stopping; sporting or playing about.
विरमित: वि-रमित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Caus.), made to cease, stopped.
विरम्य: वि-रम्य, ind. having ceased or desisted.
विराम: वि-राम, अस्, m. leaving off, cessation, rest, repose, discontinuance (of working, speaking, &c.); stop-page, stop, pause, pause of the voice, stoppage of sound; (in gram.) ‘the stop,’ N. of a small oblique stroke placed under a consonant to denote that it is quiescent, i. e. that it has no vowel inherent or other-wise pronounced after it, (this mark is sometimes used in the middle of conjunctions of consonants; but its proper use, according to native grammarians, is only as a stop at the end of a sentence ending in a conso-nant); end, conclusion, term; N. of Viṣṇu.
विरल: विरल विरल, अस्, आ, अम् (perhaps for विल-ल, possessing holes), having interstices, separated by intervals (whether of space or time); not close or compact, open in texture, not thick or dense, fine, thin, delicate; loose, relaxed, wide apart; rare, un-frequent; single; remote; little, few; (अम्), ind. rarely, seldom, unfrequently; (अम्), n. sour curds, coagulated milk (= दधि). —विरल-जानुक, अस्, m. ‘having knees wide apart,’ a bandy-legged man. —विरल-द्रवा, f. gruel made of rice or other grain with the addition of ghee, &c. (= श्लक्ष्ण-यवागू)। —विरलागत (°ल-आग्°), अस्, आ, अम्, happening rarely, of unfrequent occurrence, rare. —विरली-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, &c., to make rare, lessen, diminish. —विरलेतर (°ल-इत्°), अस्, &c., ‘other than wide apart,’ dense, thick, compact, close.
विरलित: विरलित, अस्, आ, अम्, not compacted, not dense, (अ-वि-रलित-कपोलम्, ind. with closely-united cheeks.)
विरस्: विरस् वि-रस्, cl. 1. P. -रसति, -रसितुम्, to cry out, cry aloud, scream, shriek.
विरस: विरस वि-रस, अस्, आ, अम्, juiceless, sapless, flavourless, tasteless, insipid; painful; (अस्), m. pain.
विरह्: विरह् वि-रह्, cl. 1. 10. P. -रहति, -रहयति, -रहितुम्, &c., to abandon, desert, relinquish, leave.
विरह: वि-रह, अस्, m. separation, parting, absence, (espe-cially) the separation of lovers; separation from (with inst.); loneliness, distance; want; abandonment, de-sertion, cessation, relinquishment. —विरह-गुणित, अस्, आ, अम्, increased by separation. —विरह-ज or विरह-जनित, अस्, आ, अम्, arising from or produced by separation. —विरह-ज्वर, अस्, m. the anguish of separation. —विरह-व्यापद्, त्, त्, त्, impaired or decreased by absence. —विरह-शयन, अम्, n. a solitary couch or bed, i. e. one slept on alone. —वि-रहाधिगम (°ह-अध्°), अस्, m. experiencing the absence of any one, (according to Malli-nātha = विरह-ज्ञान।) —विरहानल (°ह-अन्°), अस्, m. the fire of separation. —विरहार्त (°ह-आर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, pained by the absence of a lover. —विरहा-वस्था (°ह-अव्°), f. a state of separation or absence. —विरहोत्कण्ठिता (°ह-उत्°), f. a woman who longs after her absent lover or husband, one distressed by the absence of her husband (said to be one of the incidental characters in a drama).
विरहयत्: वि-रहयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, abandoning, relinquish-ing, deserting.
विरहय्य: वि-रहय्य, ind. having abandoned, having for-saken, leaving.
विरहित: वि-रहित, अस्, आ, अम्, abandoned, deserted, for-saken, relinquished, left, left alone, solitary, lonely, retired or withdrawn from company, separated; de-void of, exempt from, bereft of, destitute of, free from (with inst. or at the end of a comp., and sometimes even with gen.).
विरहिन्: विरहिन्, ई, इणी, इ, being separated from, absent (from another), apart from; lonely, solitary; (इणी), f. a woman separated from her husband or suffering the pangs of absence from her lover; wages, hire.
विराज्: विराज् 1. वि-राज्, cl. 1. P. A. -राजति (in Ved. only P.), -ते, -राजितुम्, to reign over, rule, govern (Ved. P.); to be illustrious or eminent, be conspicuous, appear to advantage, shine forth, shine out, shine, glitter; to appear as: Caus. -राजयति, -यितुम्, to cause to shine forth, make to glitter, fill with bright-ness, give radiance or lustre, brighten, illuminate.

2. वि-राज्, ट्, ट्, ट्, shining, radiant; (ट्), m. splendor, beauty; a man of the regal or military class; the first progeny of Brahmā, (according to Manu I. 32, &c., Brahmā having divided his own substance into male and female, produced from the female the male power Virāj, who then produced the first Manu or Manu Svāyambhuva, who then created the ten Prajā-patis; the Bhāgavata-Purāṇa states that the male half of Brahmā was Manu, and the other half Śata-rūpā, and does not allude to the intervention of Virāj; other Purāṇas describe the union of Śata-rūpā with Virāj or Puruṣa in the first instance, and with Manu in the second; as a sort of secondary creator, Virāj is sometimes called Prajā-pati, while in Ṛg-veda X. 90, 5. he is represented as born from Puruṣa, and Puruṣa from him; in the Atharva-veda VIII. 10, 24, XI. 8, 30, Virāj is spoken of as a female, and regarded as a cow, being elsewhere, however, identi-fied with Prāṇa); ‘ruler of the various forms of bodies,’ N. of Intellect located in and ruling over the collective aggregate of bodies, the consciousness which perceives collections or aggregates (in the Vedānta phil.); the body; N. of a son of Rādhā; of a district; (ट्), f. a particular Vedic metre consisting of four Pādas of ten syllables each, (in Ṛg-veda X. 130, 5. this metre is represented as attaching itself to Mitra and Varuṇa, and in Aitareya-Br. I. 4. Virāj is mystically regarded as ‘food,’ and invocations are directed to be made in this metre when food is the especial object of prayer.) —विराट्-कामा, f. a Vedic form of the Sammā metre. —विराट्-क्षेत्र, अम्, n., N. of a district. —विराट्-पूर्वा, f. a Vedic form of the Tri-ṣṭubh metre. —विराट्-सुत, अस्, m. ‘son of Virāj,’ epithet of a class of Pitṛs called Soma-sads (Manu III. 195). —विराट्-स्थाना, f. a Vedic form of the Tri-ṣṭubh metre. —विराट्-स्वरूप, अस्, आ, अम्, consisting of Virāj, (applied to the Supreme Being.) —विराड्-देह, अस्, m. ‘having the body of Virāj,’ a term for the universe. —विराड्-रूपा, f. a Vedic form of the Tri-ṣṭubh metre (3 × 11 + 8 or rather + 7, giving forty syllables in all).
विराजत्: वि-राजत्, अन्, अन्ती (ep. also अती), अत्, shining, splendid; handsome.
विराजमान: वि-राजमान, अस्, आ, अम्, shining, brilliant, splen-did, handsome, gorgeous.
विराजयत्: वि-राजयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to shine, giving radiance or lustre to, brightening.
विराजित: वि-राजित, अस्, आ, अम्, illuminated, irradiated, splen-did; made visible, manifested.
विराट: विराट विराट, अस्, m., N. of one of the midland or north-west districts of India (perhaps Berar); N. of an ancient king of a particular district in India, (the Pāṇḍavas being obliged to live in con-cealment during the thirteenth year of their exile, journied to the court of this king and entered his service in various disguises.) —विराट-ज, अस्, m. = राज-पट्ट, a sort of inferior diamond (said to be found in the country Virāṭa). —विराट-पर्वन्, अ, n., N. of the fourth book of the Mahā-bhārata (describ-ing the adventures of the Pāṇḍu princes when living in the service of king Virāṭa).
विराटक: विराटक, अस्, m. a diamond of inferior quality.
विराणिन्: विराणिन् वि-राणिन्, ई, m. (probably fr. rt. रण् with वि), an elephant.
विराध्: विराध् वि-राध्, cl. 4. P. -राध्यति, &c., -राद्धुम्, to lose or be deprived of anything (inst., Ved.); to hurt, offend, injure, do an injury: Caus. -राधयति, -यितुम्, to oppose, thwart, be at vari-ance, disagree.
विराद्ध: वि-राद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, opposed, thwarted; injured, hurt, offended, treated with disrespect, reviled, abused.
विराद्धृ: वि-राद्धृ, धा, ध्री, धृ, opposing, thwarting; offending, injuring; abusive, calumnious.
विराध: वि-राध, अस्, m. opposition, prevention; vexa-tion, annoyance; a kind of Rākṣasa.
विराधन: वि-राधन, अम्, n. the act of opposing, injuring, hurting; pain, agony, anguish.
विराधयत्: वि-राधयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, opposing, being at variance, disagreeing with.
विराध्यत्: वि-राध्यत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, opposing, thwarting; offending, annoying, injuring, being at variance.
विराल: विराल विराल, अस्, m. = विडाल, a cat, q. v.
विराव: वि-राव, अस्, m. crying or shouting out, clamour, sound, noise.
विरि: विरि वि-रि or वि-री (see rts. 1. रि, री), cl. 9. P. A. -रिणाति, -रिणीते, -रेतुम्, Ved. to cleave asunder, separate, cut to pieces, kill, destroy, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda IV. 19, 3. वि-रिणाः = व्य्-अरिणाः = विशेषेण हतवान् असि।)
विरिच्: विरिच् वि-रिच्, cl. 7. P. A. -रिणक्ति, -रिङ्क्ते, -रेक्तुम्, to empty, make empty, evacuate: Pass. -रिच्यते, to extend or be extended, reach out, sur-pass, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda IV. 16, 5. वि-रेचि = अति-रिरिचे, अधिको बभूव); to be emptied or purged: Caus. -रेचयति, -यितुम्, to cause purg-ing, purge, empty, make empty, cleanse, purify.
विरिक्त: वि-रिक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, evacuated, emptied, purged.
विरेक: वि-रेक, अस्, m. purging, evacuation of the bowels; a purgative, cathartic.
विरेचन: वि-रेचन, अम्, n. purging, evacuation of the bowels; a purgative. —विरेचन-द्रव्य, अम्, n. any purging substance or medicine.
विरेचित: वि-रेचित, अस्, आ, अम्, purged, emptied, evacuated.
विरेच्य: वि-रेच्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be purged or emptied.
विरिञ्च: विरिञ्च वि-रिञ्च or वि-रिञ्चन, अस्, m. a N. of Brahmā.
विरिञ्चि: वि-रिञ्चि, इस्, m., N. of Brahmā; of Viṣṇu; of Śiva.
विरिफित: विरिफित वि-रिफित, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. de-prived of the sound of र्; pronounced or uttered with great effort.
विरिब्ध: विरिब्ध वि-रिब्ध, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. रिभ् with वि), sounded; (अस्), m. a note, tone, sound (= स्वर).
विरिभित: वि-रिभित, see Scholiast on Pāṇ. VII. 2, 18.
विरेभित: वि-रेभित, अस्, आ, अम्, sounded, uttered.
विरिश्: विरिश् वि-रिश् or वि-लिश् (see rt. रिश्), cl. 6. A. -रिशते, &c., Ved. to be dragged or rent apart, to be disarranged or disordered; to be torn off, break off, become rent or torn.
विरिष्ट: वि-रिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. rent asunder, broken off, out of due order; (अम्), n. a defect in a sacri-fice, (also written वि-लिष्ट।)
विरु: विरु वि-रु, cl. 2. P. -रौति, -रवीति, -रवितुम्, to roar aloud, scream or shout out, cry, buzz, hum, yell, bray; to sound, jingle, rattle; to lament, weep, appeal to with lamentations, call on, invoke: Caus. -रावयति, -यितुम्, to roar or scream aloud, fill with noise or clamour; to make to sound or resound.
विरव: वि-रव, अस्, m., Ved. outcry, clamour, sound, noise.
विराविन्: वि-राविन्, ई, इणी, इ, shouting or roaring out, re-sounding, crying, singing; lamenting; (इणी), f. weep-ing, crying; a broom; N. of a river.
विरुत: वि-रुत, अस्, आ, अम्, roared aloud, screamed; re-sounded, resounding, filled with cries, (मयूर-विरुत, filled with the cries of peacocks); (अम्), n. shrieking, howling, crying, singing, humming (of bees), chirping; clamour, noise, din, howling (of the wind &c.), sound, tone.
विरुवत्: वि-रुवत्, अन्, अती, अत्, howling, crying, shrieking, &c.
विरुच्: विरुच् वि-रुच्, cl. 1. A. -रोचते (Ved. also P. -रोचति, in Raghu-v. VI. 5. and in one or two other later works the Aor. P. व्य्-अरुचत् is found), -रोचितुम्, to shine forth, glitter, be bright or radiant; to be conspicuous, become visible, appear; to become eminent or famous; to cause to shine, illuminate, make bright (P.); to please, delight: Caus. -रोच-यति, -यितुम्, to cause to shine, illuminate, brighten; to find pleasure in, delight in; to sport with.
विरुक्मत्: विरुक्मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. shining, brilliant, splendid; (आन्), m. a bright weapon.
विरोक: वि-रोक, अस्, m. a ray of light; (अम्), n. a hole, chasm.
विरोकिन्: वि-रोकिन्, ई, इणी, इ, Ved. shining, glowing, gleam-ing, bright.
विरोचन: वि-रोचन, अस्, आ, अम्, shining, illuminating; (अस्), m. the sun; the moon; fire; N. of the son of Prahlāda or Prahrāda; (अम्), n. (?), light, lustre. —विरोचन-वध, अस्, m., N. of a chapter of the Krīḍā-khaṇḍa of the Gaṇeśa-Purāṇa. —विरोचन-सुत, अस्, m. ‘son of Virocana,’ epithet of Bali (sovereign of Mahābali-pura).
विरोचमान: वि-रोचमान, अस्, आ, अम्, shining, glittering, radiant.
