विरोचयत्: वि-रोचयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to shine, mak-ing bright.
विरोचिष्णु: वि-रोचिष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, shining; illuminating, making visible.
विरुज्: विरुज् वि-रुज्, cl. 6. P. -रुजति, -रोक्तुम्, to break to pieces, tear asunder; to destroy.
2. वि-रुज्, क्, f. violent pain, severe sickness.
विरुग्ण: वि-रुग्ण, अस्, आ, अम् (less correctly written वि-रुग्न), broken to pieces, torn asunder; bent; blunted; destroyed.
विरुज्य: वि-रुज्य, ind. having broken to pieces, having torn asunder.
विरुद्: विरुद् वि-रुद्, cl. 2. P. -रोदिति, -रोदितुम्, to weep or cry aloud, sob, lament, bewail.
विरुद: वि-रुद, अस्, m. crying; proclaiming; a laudatory poem, panegyric. —विरुदावली (°द-आव्°), f., N. of a poem by Raghu-deva celebrating the praises of a certain king of Mithilā.
विरुदित: वि-रुदित, अम्, n. loud lamentation, intense grief, bewailing.
विरुध्: विरुध् 1. वि-रुध् (= वि-रुह्), cl. 1. P. -रो-धति, &c., Ved. to grow or sprout out, shoot forth.

विरुध् 2. वि-रुध्, cl. 7. P. A. -रुणद्धि, -रुन्द्धे, -रोद्धुम्, to hinder, obstruct; to en-counter opposition (A., Ved.): Pass. -रुध्यते (ep. also P. -ति), to be impeded or checked or kept back or withheld; to be opposed to, contend with, com-bat (with inst., or with inst. and सह, or with gen., or with loc., or with acc. and प्रति); to be at variance, disagree, be inconsistent; to fail: Caus. -रोधयति, -यितुम्, to cause to hinder or obstruct, to render hostile, set at variance; to oppose, en-counter, fight against, contend with: Pass. of Caus. -रोध्यते, to be impeded or kept back; to be ren-dered hostile or set at variance: Desid. -रुरुत्सति, to wish to oppose, intend commencing hostility.
विरुद्ध: वि-रुद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, opposed, hindered, checked, restrained, arrested, obstructed, blocked or shut up, besieged, barred or locked up, blockaded; opposed or contrasted in quality (as sweet to sour &c.); con-trary, repugnant, opposite, contradictory, perverse, reverse, (a reason) proving the reverse (in logic); incongruous, inconsistent, incompatible, mutually dis-agreeing (as medicine and food); hostile, adverse, at variance, at enmity; unpropitious, unfavourable, dis-agreeable; prohibited, forbidden; excluded, disquali-fied; doubtful, uncertain; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a class of deities; (अम्), n. opposition, hostility, disagreement, discord, a feeling of repugnance; (अम्), ind. per-versely, incongruously. —विरुद्ध-ता, f. or विरुद्-ध-त्व, अम्, n. opposition, contrariety, perverseness, incongruity; hostility, enmity, disagreeableness. —वि-रुद्ध-धी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, having a hostile disposition, malevolently disposed, malignant. —विरुद्ध-प्र-सङ्ग, अस्, m. a prohibited or unlawful occupation. —विरुद्ध-भुज्, क्, क्, क्, eating incompatible or unsuitable food. —विरुद्ध-भोजन, अम्, n. in-compatible food. —विरुद्ध-लक्षण, अम्, n., N. of a section of the Purāṇa-sarva-sva. —विरुद्-धाचरण (°ध-आच्°), अम्, n. a wrong or improper course of conduct. —विरुद्धान्न (°ध-अन्°), अम्, n. incompatible or forbidden food.
विरोद्धव्य: वि-रोद्धव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be opposed, to be obstructed, &c.
विरोध: वि-रोध, अस्, m. opposition, obstruction, hin-drance, impediment; impediment to the successful progress of a plot (in a drama); restraint, check; blocking up, surrounding, investing, siege, blockade, confinement; contradiction (in logic), contrariety, antithesis, contrast; inconsistency, opposition of qualities (in food, medicine, &c.); hostility, enmity, animosity, quarrel, war, calamity, misfortune; (ई), f. a fixed rule, ordinance (?). —विरोध-कारक, अस्, इका, अम्, causing opposition or disagreement, fomenting quarrels. —विरोध-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, causing hindrance or opposition; an enemy; (त्), m., N. of the nineteenth year of Jupiter's cycle. —विरोधा-भास (°ध-आभ्°), अस्, m. the semblance of oppo-site qualities, a particular figure in rhetoric. —वि-रोधालङ्कार (°ध-अल्°), अस्, m. (in rhetoric) ‘the ornament of contradiction,’ a particular figure of speech or mode of writing. —विरोधोक्ति (°ध-उक्°), इस्, f. adverse or contradictory speech, quarrel, dispute, mutual contradiction.
विरोधक: वि-रोधक, अस्, इका, अम्, opposing, contradicting, incongruous.
विरोधन: वि-रोधन, अम्, n. the act of opposing, hinder-ing, obstructing, preventing, blockading, besieging, encountering, defying; opposition, resistance, con-tradiction; incongruity, inconsistency.
विरोधित: वि-रोधित, अस्, आ, अम्, opposed, contended against, fought with, rendered hostile, set at variance.
विरोधिन्: वि-रोधिन्, ई, इनी, इ, opposing, hindering, prevent-ing, obstructing, besieging; obstructive; excluding, disqualifying; inimical, adverse, hostile; contradic-tory, inconsistent; having opposite or incompatible qualities (as food, medicine, &c.); contentious, quar-relsome; (ई), m. an opponent, enemy; N. of the fifty-seventh year of Jupiter's cycle; (इनी), f. a woman who causes enmity or promotes quarrels (between husband and wife &c.).
विरोध्य: 1. वि-रोध्य, ind. having opposed, having con-tended with.
2. वि-रोध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be opposed or con-tended against.
विरुष्: विरुष् वि-रुष्, cl. 1. P. -रोषति, &c., -रो-षितुम् or -रोष्टुम्, to displease, annoy, irritate.
विरुष्ट: वि-रुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, very angry, very much irri-tated.
विरुष्यमाण: वि-रुष्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being very angry at (with gen.).
विरोष: वि-रोष, अस्, आ, अम्, very angry, wrathful.
विरोष वि-रोष। See under वि-रुष्, col. 2.
विरुह्: विरुह् वि-रुह्, cl. 1. P. -रोहति, -रोढुम्, to grow or shoot out, shoot forth, sprout, bud; to go forth, arise, proceed; to mount, ascend, increase: Caus. -रोहयति, -रोपयति, -यितुम्, to cause to grow, plant; to cause to grow over or cicatrize, heal; to thrust out, remove, expel, dethrone.
विरूढ: वि-रूढ, अस्, आ, अम्, grown or shot out, budded, blossomed; grown, increased, arisen, produced, born; ascended, mounted, ridden. —विरूढ-बोध, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose intelligence has increased or matured.
विरोपण: वि-रोपण, अस्, ई, अम्, causing to grow, planting; causing to grow over, healing.
विरोपित: वि-रोपित, अस्, आ, अम्, planted; caused to grow over, healed. —विरोपित-व्रण, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose wound is healed or cicatrized.
विरोह: वि-रोह, अस्, m. growing out, shooting forth.
विरोहण: वि-रोहण, अम्, n. the act of growing out, &c.
विरुक्षण: विरुक्षण वि-रूक्षण, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. rt. रूक्ष् with वि), making rough or dry, drying, astrin-gent; (अम्), n. the act of roughening or contract-ing, acting as an astringent; censure, blame, reviling, abuse; oath, imprecation.
विरूक्षित: वि-रूक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, made rough; smeared over, covered.
विरूप्: विरूप् वि-रूप्, cl. 10. P. -रूपयति, -यितुम्, to deform, make deformed, disfigure, mutilate.
विरूप: वि-रूप, अस्, आ, or ई, अम्, deformed, badly formed, misshapen, ugly, unusual in form or nature, mon-strous, unnatural; of various form, multiform, diver-sified; (अस्), m., N. of one of the descendants of Vaivasvata Manu; N. of a descendant of Aṅgiras (author of the hymns Ṛg-veda VIII. 43, 44, 64); (आस्), m. pl., N. of a family belonging to the race of Aṅgiras; (अम्), n. deformity, irregular or mon-strous shape; difference of form, variety of nature or character; (आ), f., N. of the wife of Yama. —वि-रूप-करण, अम्, n. deformation, disfiguring. —वि-रूप-चक्षुस्, उस्, m. ‘diversely-eyed,’ epithet of Śiva, (see विरूपाक्ष।) —विरूप-ता, f. deformity, malformation. —विरूप-रूप, अस्, आ, अम्, having a deformed shape, of a monstrous form, misshapen. —विरूपाक्ष (°प-अक्°), अस्, ई, अम्, diversely-eyed, having deformed eyes; (अस्), m. an epithet of Śiva (as represented with an odd number of eyes, one being in his forehead, cf. त्रि-लोचन); N. of a Rudra; of a teacher of the Haṭha-vidyā.
विरूपक: वि-रूपक, अस्, इका, अम्, deformed, misshapen; monstrous, frightful, hideous; (अस्), m. a nickname.
विरूपित: वि-रूपित, अस्, आ, अम्, deformed, disfigured, muti-lated.
विरेपस्: विरेपस् वि-रेपस्, आस्, आस्, अस् (see rt. 1. रिप्), stainless, faultless, without blemish or defect.
विरेफ: विरेफ वि-रेफ, अस्, m. the absence of the letter र्; a river, stream.
विल्: विल् विल्, cl. 6. P. विलति, वेलितुम्, to cover, conceal, clothe; to break or divide, (in this sense more usually written बिल्); cl. 10. P. वेलयति, -यितुम्, to throw, cast, direct, send.
विल: विल, अम्, n. an aperture, opening, hole, chasm, vacuity; a burrow, cave, cavern, den; the vagina; (अस्), m. one of Indra's horses; a sort of reed or cane, Calamus Rotang. —विल-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, mak-ing holes, burrowing; (ई), m. a mouse. —विलङ्-गम, अस्, m. ‘hole-goer,’ a serpent, snake. —वि-ल-धावन, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. (sensu obsceno) rimam tergens. —विल-योनि, इस्, इस्, इ, of the breed of Vila (said of horses). —विल-वास, अस्, आ, अम्, living in holes, burrowing; (अस्), m. an animal which lives in holes; a polecat (= जाहक). —विल-वासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, living in a hole, burrowing; (ई), m. a snake. —विल-शय, अस्, ई, अम्, living or burrowing in holes; (अस्), m. any animal that lives in holes; a snake. —विल-शायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, lying in a hole, living in holes; (ई), m. any animal that lives in holes. —विले-वासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, living or burrowing in holes; (ई), m. a snake. —विले-शय, अस्, m. any animal living in holes; a snake; a rat; a hare or rabbit; N. of a teacher of the Haṭha-vidyā. —विलेश्वर (°ल-ईश्°), अस्, m., N. of a place of pilgrimage; (perhaps incorrectly for बिल्वेश्वर।) —विलौकस् (°ल-ओक्°), आस्, आस्, अस्, living in a hole; (आस्), m. any animal that lives in holes.
विलस: विलस, अस्, आ, अम्, see Gaṇa Tṛṇādi to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 80.
विलक्ष्: विलक्ष् वि-लक्ष्, cl. 10. P. A. -लक्षयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to distinguish, mark, characterize; to observe, perceive, see, notice; to be without the power of fixing the eye on any object, to become bewildered or confused or embarrassed.
विलक्ष: वि-लक्ष, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. लक्ष with वि in a privative sense or expressing difference), markless, unmarked, having no distinguishing mark or aim; having no characteristic mark or property; having a different mark, having a character different to what is usual or natural, strange, extraordinary; bewildered, embarrassed; astonished, surprised; abashed, ashamed. —विलक्ष-ता, f. or विलक्ष-त्व, अम्, n. absence of mark or aim, absence of distinguishing property; confusion, bewilderment, surprise; shame. —वि-लक्षी-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, &c., to make bewil-dered or confused, scoff at, insult. —विलक्षी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, scoffed at, insulted.
विलक्षण: 1. वि-लक्षण, अम्, n. the act of distinguishing, perceiving, seeing, observing.

2. वि-लक्षण, अस्, आ, अम्, having no distinguish-ing marks; having different or opposite marks or characteristics, having distinguishing qualities or features, other, different, strange, extraordinary; (अम्), n. any state or condition which is without distinguishing mark or for which no cause can be assigned, vain or causeless state.
विलक्षित: 1. वि-लक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, distinguished, marked, recognised, discerned, perceived, seen, observed, noticed, discernible by; perplexed, dismayed, dis-concerted, affected without cause, embarrassed, puz-zled, vexed, annoyed, disappointed.
2. वि-लक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, undistinguished, un-discriminated, unmarked.
विलक्ष्य: वि-लक्ष्य, ind. having perceived or noticed, hav-ing observed; having become bewildered or confused.
विलग्: विलग् वि-लग्, cl. 1. P. -लगति, &c., to hang to, cling to, stick to, hold on to (with loc.).
विलगित: वि-लगित, अस्, आ, अम्, attached to, &c., (but see वि-लगित below.)
विलगित वि-लगित or वि-लङ्गित, referred to rt. लङ्ग् with वि in Pāṇ. VI. 4, 24, Vārtt. 1.
विलग्न: वि-लग्न, अस्, आ, अम्, clung to, clinging to, fastened or attached to, resting on, fixed on, connected with; brought close to; gone by, passed away; slender, thin, delicate (said of the waist); (अम्), n. = लग्न, the rising of constellations, a horoscope, &c.; the waist, middle (as connecting the upper and lower parts of the body). —विलग्न-मध्या, f. a woman with a slender waist.
विलग्य: वि-लग्य, ind. having clung to, having stuck to.
विलङ्घ्: विलङ्घ् वि-लङ्घ्, cl. 1. P. A. -लङ्घति, -ते, -लङ्घितुम्, to leap or spring about, jump, skip; cl. 10. P. or Caus. -लङ्घयति, -यितुम्, to leap or jump over, overstep, pass over, pass or rise beyond, pass by, transgress, violate, neglect, contemn; to over-come, surmount, get the better of, surpass, excel, frustrate; to rise towards, ascend to; to give up, abandon; to act wrongly towards, offend; to cause to pass over the right time for eating, cause to fast, make to abstain from food.
विलङ्घन: वि-लङ्घन, अम्, n. the act of passing beyond, transgressing, overstepping; striking against, trans-gression, offence.
विलङ्घनीय: वि-लङ्घनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be overstepped or passed over, to be transgressed.
विलङ्घयित्वा: वि-लङ्घयित्वा, anom. ind. part. having surpassed or surmounted.
विलङ्घित: वि-लङ्घित, अस्, आ, अम्, overleaped, overstepped, transgressed; overcome, surpassed, excelled. —वि-लङ्घिताकाश (°त-आक्°), अस्, आ, अम्, passing or rising beyond the sky.
विलङ्घिन्: वि-लङ्घिन्, ई, इनी, इ, transgressing, ascending to.
विलङ्घ्य: वि-लङ्घ्य, ind. having jumped or passed over, having omitted or neglected.
विलज्ज्: विलज्ज् वि-लज्ज्, cl. 6. A. -लज्जते (some-times also P. -लज्जति), -लज्जितुम्, to become ashamed or abashed, feel ashamed, blush.
विलज्ज: वि-लज्ज, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. लज्जा with वि in a priva-tive sense), shameless, unabashed.
विलज्जत्: वि-लज्जत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, being ashamed, feeling ashamed, modest, bashful.
विलज्जमान: वि-लज्जमान, अस्, आ, अम्, ashamed, abashed, modest, blushing.
विलज्जित: वि-लज्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, ashamed, abashed.
विलप्: विलप् वि-लप्, cl. 1. P. A. -लपति, -ते, -ल-पितुम्, -लप्तुम्, to wail, moan, weep, cry, utter cries or lamentations, to mourn, bewail, lament (with acc.), complain; to speak variously, talk much or idly, prattle, chatter, talk (in general): Caus. -लाप-यति, -यते, -यितुम्, to cause to mourn or lament; to cause to speak much (A.).
विलपत्: वि-लपत्, अन्, अन्ती (ep. also अती), अत्, lamenting, wailing, moaning, complaining; prating, talking idly or wildly; talking, speaking.
विलपन: वि-लपन, अम्, n. the act of lamenting, wailing, complaining, &c.; chattering, talking idly or wildly; talking; the dirt or sediment of any oily substance (as of clarified butter &c.). —विलपन-विनोद, अस्, m. removing (grief) by weeping.
विलपमान: वि-लपमान, अस्, आ, अम्, lamenting, wailing, weeping.
विलपित: वि-लपित, अस्, आ, अम्, lamented, bewailed; chat-tered; spoken idly, spoken; (अम्), n. lamentation, wailing; a moan, wail.
विलपिष्यत्: वि-लपिष्यत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, about to lament or bewail.
विलप्य: वि-लप्य, ind. having bewailed or lamented, lamenting, bewailing.
विलप्यत्: वि-लप्यत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत् (ep. for वि-लपत्), lamenting, bewailing.
विलाप: वि-लाप, अस्, m. lamentation, crying, wailing, moaning, complaint; a moan, wail, groan.
विलभ्: विलभ् वि-लभ्, cl. 1. A. -लभते, -लब्धुम्, to take away, remove; to grant, bestow, provide; to consign, hand over, deliver: Caus. -लम्भयति, -यितुम्, to cause to receive or fall to the share of 9with double acc.): Desid. -लिप्सते, to desire to take away, wish to share.
विलब्ध: वि-लब्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, taken away, taken; given, bestowed, consigned.
विलम्भ: वि-लम्भ, अस्, m. giving, gift, donation; libe-rality.
विलम्ब्: विलम्ब् वि-लम्ब्, cl. 1. A. -लम्बते (ep. also P. -लम्बति), -लम्बितुम्, to hang on both sides (Ved.), hang down, hang on, hang to or from, be attached to (with loc.); to sink, set, decline; to continue hanging, linger, loiter, delay (e. g. मा वि-लम्बस्व, do not delay), tarry, hesitate, procrasti-nate: Pass. -लम्ब्यते, to be lingered or loitered, to be delayed: Caus. -लम्बयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to cause to linger or loiter, detain, delay; to spend un-profitably, waste, lose; to put off, procrastinate; to loiter, delay.
विलम्ब: वि-लम्ब, अस्, m. hanging or falling down, pen-dulousness; slowness, tardiness, delay, procrastina-tion; N. of the sixth year of Jupiter's cycle.
विलम्बत्: वि-लम्बत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, hanging down, falling down, delaying.
विलम्बन: वि-लम्बन, अम्, n. hanging down or from, de-pending; delaying, delay, procrastination, retarding.
विलम्बमान: वि-लम्बमान, अस्, आ, अम्, hanging down, hang-ing from; hanging or suspended on; declining, set-ting (said of the sun).
विलम्बिका: वि-लम्बिका, f. retardation of the feces, constipation.
विलम्बित: वि-लम्बित, अस्, आ, अम्, hanging or falling down, depending; pendulous; hanging on, closely con-nected with or dependent on; retarded, procrasti-nated, slow, tardy; slow (as time in music or in chanting the Veda &c.; cf. वृत्ति); spent use-lessly, wasted; (अम्), ind. slowly, tardily; (अम्), n. delay, (अ-विलम्बितम्, ind. without delay); (अस्, अम्), m. n. slow time. —विलम्बित-गति, इस्, इस्, इ, slow or tardy in motion; epithet of a kind of metre. —विलम्बित-फल, अस्, आ, अम्, having the fruit or fulfilment delayed.
विलम्बिन्: वि-लम्बिन्, ई, इनी, इ, hanging down or from, de-pending, pendulous; delaying, retarding, dilatory, slow; (ई), m. the thirty-second year of the Indian cycle.
विलम्ब्य: वि-लम्ब्य, ind. having lingered or loitered, loitering, dallying, (अ-विलम्ब्य, without delay.)
विलय: विलय वि-लय, &c. See under वि-ली, p. 938.
वि-लय, अस्, m. dissolution, liquefaction, death, destruction, destruction of the world, (विलयं गम्, to be dissolved, to end.)
विलला: विलला वि-लला, f. (probably fr. rt. लल् with वि), a sort of plant, Sida Cordifolia (= श्वेत-बला).
विलस्: विलस् वि-लस्, cl. 1. P. -लसति, -लसितुम्, to gleam, flash, glitter, shine; to shine forth, come to light, appear, arise, be manifested; to play, sport, be sportive or wanton, be amused or delighted; to jump or frisk about, move about, dart, wave; to sound, echo.
विलसत्: वि-लसत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, flashing, shining, glitter-ing, brilliant, beautiful, splendid; shining forth, ap-pearing; playing, sporting, sportive, wanton; frisk-ing or moving about, waving, darting, flashing (as lightning); sounding, echoing. —विलसत्-पताक, अस्, आ, अम्, having a gleaming or waving flag. —वि-लसन्-मरीचि, इस्, इस्, इ, having rays of light gleam-ing or playing.
विलसन: वि-लसन, अम्, n. the act of flashing, gleaming, sporting, dallying, play, sport.
विलसित: वि-लसित, अस्, आ, अम्, gleaming, glittering, shin-ing, shining forth, appearing, appeared, manifested; played, sported; sportive, wanton; (अम्), n. gleam-ing, flashing; appearance, manifestation, (विद्या-व्°, manifestation of knowledge); a gleam, flash; sport, play, pastime, dalliance, wanton gestures; a brilliant action, action or gesture (in general).
विलास: वि-लास, अस्, m. sport, pastime, play, merriness, (especially) amorous pastime, diversion (with women, dancers, singers, &c.), dalliance, coquetry, affecta-tion of coyness, wantonness, (a form of feminine gesture considered as indicative of amorous senti-ments, such as change of place, posture, gait, look, hiding at the approach of a lover, assuming a look of displeasure, &c.); grace, elegance, charm, beauty. —विलास-कानन, अम्, n. a pleasure-grove, pleasure-ground. —विलास-मन्दिर, अम्, n. a pleasure-house, summer-house. —विलास-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, sportive, playful, dallying, wanton; (अती), f. a wanton or coquettish woman. —विलास-विभवानस (?), अस्, आ, अम्, greedy, covetous.
विलासन: वि-लासन, अम्, n. (perhaps for the more correct form वि-लसन), sport, pastime, play, dalliance, wantonness; fascination.
विलासिका: वि-लासिका, f. a drama in one act on any light subject or adventure.
विलासिन्: वि-लासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, wanton, sportive, coquettish, playful, dallying; (ई), m. a sporter, voluptuary, sen-sualist; fire; the moon; a snake; an epithet of Viṣṇu; of Kṛṣṇa; of Śiva; of Kāma, god of love; (इनी), f. a wanton woman, harlot; a coquettish woman, any woman.
विलाता: विलाता विलाता, f., Ved. a young girl (?).
विलाल: विलाल वि-लाल, अस्, m. (fr. rt. लल् with वि), an instrument, machine (= यन्त्र); a cat, (in this sense = विडाल, विराल, q. q. v. v.)
विलिख्: विलिख् वि-लिख्, cl. 6. P. -लिखति, -लेखितुम् (Ved. inf. -लिखस्), to scratch, scratch up, tear, tear open, scarify, scrape, rub, rub against, touch, reach to; to scratch in or on, make a furrow or mark, make an incision, write, write down, delineate, paint: Caus. -लेखयति, -यितुम्, to cause to scratch, cause to write.
विलिखत्: वि-लिखत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, scratching, tearing, scraping, writing, &c.
विलिखन: वि-लिखन, अम्, n. the act of scratching, scraping, writing, &c.
विलिखित: वि-लिखित, अस्, आ, अम्, scratched, scraped, scarified.
विलिख्य: वि-लिख्य, ind. having scratched, having written, &c.
विलेखन: वि-लेखन, अम्, n. making an incision or mark or furrow; dividing, splitting; digging, delving, rooting up.
विलेखिन्: वि-लेखिन्, ई, इनी, इ, scratching, scraping, touching, reaching.
विलिप्: विलिप् वि-लिप्, cl. 6. P. A. -लिम्पति, -ते, -लेप्तुम्, to smear over, besmear, plaster, spread over, anoint; to smear or spread on; to pollute: Pass. -लिप्यते, to be anointed, be smeared over.
विलिप्त: वि-लिप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, smeared over, besmeared, anointed, plastered, smeared.
विलिम्पित: वि-लिम्पित, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr. the Caus.), smeared over, besmeared.
विलेप: वि-लेप, अस्, m. ointment, unguent, (especially the fragrant unguent of sandal, agallochum, &c.); anointing, plastering; mortar, plaster; (ई), f. rice-gruel.
विलेपन: वि-लेपन, अम्, n. the act of smearing, anointing, plastering over, smearing or anointing the body (with fragrant oils, &c.); perfume for the person (as unguent or oil of sandal, saffron, camphor, bdellium, &c.); ointment of any kind; (ई), f. a woman scented with perfumes, &c.; rice-gruel.
विलेपनिन्: विलेपनिन्, ई, इनी, इ, possessing unguents or per-fumes, (अ-विलेपनिन्, deprived of ointments.)
विलेपिन्: वि-लेपिन्, ई, इनी, इ, smearing or plastering over, one who anoints, &c.
विलेप्य: वि-लेप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be spread over or plastered; (अस्), m. rice-gruel.
विलिस्तेङ्गा: विलिस्तेङ्गा विलिस्तेङ्गा, f., N. of a Dānavī (of whom Indra was enamoured).
विलिह्: विलिह् वि-लिह्, cl. 2. P. A. -लेढि, -लीढे, -लेढुम्, to lick, lick up, lap.
विलेलिहत्: वि-लेलिहत्, अत्, अती, अत् (Intens. pres. part.; in Mahā-bh. Śānti-p. 8075. वि-लेलिहन्, nom. case masc.), licking continually.
विलेलिहान: वि-लेलिहान, अस्, आ, अम्, continually or repeatedly licking.
विली: विली वि-ली, cl. 4. A. -लीयते, -लातुम् or -ले-तुम्, to cling to, lie close to, stick to, cleave to, be united or addicted or attached to; to settle on, alight or perch on; to become disunited or dissolved, be-come liquid, melt away; to become dissipated or dispersed, become ineffectual; to fall to pieces, be destroyed, perish, vanish, disappear, become hidden; cl. 1. P. -लयति, to make liquid or fluid, melt: Caus. -लीनयति, -लापयति, -लालयति, -लाययति, (according to some grammarians this last is the form to be used when not speaking of liquefying butter or similar substances, see Pāṇ. VII. 3, 39), -यितुम्, to cause to become disunited or dissolved, cause to be dissolved in (with loc.); to make liquid, dissolve, melt; to cause to vanish or disappear, destroy.
विलयन: वि-लयन, अम्, n. the act of dissolving, liquefy-ing, dissolution, liquefaction, destroying; corroding, eating away; removing, taking away; attenuating; an attenuant, escharotic (in medicine).
विलापित: वि-लापित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Caus.), caused to be dissolved, liquefied.
विलाप्यमान: वि-लाप्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being caused to be dissolved, being liquefied.
विलायम्: वि-लायम्, ind. becoming dissolved, melting away, becoming dispersed, (अभ्र-विलायम्, in the manner of the dissolving of a cloud, Kirāt. XI. 79.)
विलायित: वि-लायित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Caus.), made liquid, dissolved, melted.
विलीन: वि-लीन, अस्, आ, अम्, clinging to, sticking or cleav-ing to, attached to, addicted to, immersed in; settled on, alighting on [cf. शाखा-व्°]; contiguous to, in contact with, united or blended with; infused into the mind, imagined; dissolved, liquid, liquefied, melted, semifluid (as melted oil or butter, &c.); disappeared, perished, vanished. —विलीन-षट्पद, अस्, आ, अम्, having bees clinging or attached.
विलीय: वि-लीय, ind. having settled down, having become dissolved, having disappeared.
विलीयत्: वि-लीयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, clinging to, settling; be-coming dissolved, liquefying.
विलीयमान: वि-लीयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being dissolved or melted, &c., disappearing, being hidden.
विलुञ्च्: विलुञ्च् वि-लुञ्च्, cl. 1. P. -लुञ्चति, -लुञ्चितुम्, to tear off, tear out, pluck off, tear to pieces.
विलुञ्चन: वि-लुञ्चन, अम्, n. the act of tearing off.
विलुठ्: विलुठ् वि-लुठ्, cl. 6. P. -लुठति, -लुठितुम्, to roll, roll or move about, move to and fro, quiver, flicker; to agitate, move, stir, rouse, excite.
विलुठत्: वि-लुठत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, rolling, moving to and fro, sparkling.
विलुठित: वि-लुठित, अस्, आ, अम्, agitated, excited.
विलुड्: विलुड् वि-लुड् (closely connected with वि-लुल्), Caus. -लोडयति, &c., to agitate, stir about, stir up, rouse, move to and fro, toss about; to turn over, upset; to disarrange, disturb, disorder, confuse, throw into disorder or confusion.
विलोडन: वि-लोडन, अम्, n. the act of agitating, shaking, stirring, churning, rolling, tossing.
विलोडन वि-लोडन, &c. See under वि-लुड्, col. 2.
विलोडयितृ: वि-लोडयितृ, ता, m. an agitator, disturber.
विलोडित: वि-लोडित, अस्, आ, अम्, agitated, shaken, churned; rolling or tumbling on the ground; (अम्), n. butter-milk (= तक्र).
विलोड्यमान: वि-लोड्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being agitated, being stirred about or up, being tossed about; being thrown into disorder, being disarranged.
विलुण्ट्य: विलुण्ट्य वि-लुण्ट्य, ind. having taken away, having taken off the husk, (in Pañca-tantra, p. 121, 13, a better reading has लुञ्चित्वा।)
विलुण्ठ्: विलुण्ठ् वि-लुण्ठ्, cl. 1. P. -लुण्ठति, -लुण्-ठितुम्, to carry off, rob, plunder, steal: Pass. -लुण्ठ्यते, to be plundered or ravaged.
विलुण्ठन: वि-लुण्ठन, अम्, n. the act of plundering, robbing.
विलुण्ठित: वि-लुण्ठित, अस्, आ, अम्, robbed, plundered, pil-laged; rolled or rolling about (= वि-लुठित).
विलुप्: विलुप् वि-लुप्, cl. 6. P. A. -लुम्पति, -ते, -लोप्तुम्, to tear or break off, cut off; to tear or break to pieces, pull out or up; to tear or carry away, carry off, ravish, seize, plunder, rob, pillage; to destroy, confound, ruin; to fall to pieces, be ruined (A.): Pass. -लुप्यते, to be torn away or carried off, be plundered, be destroyed, perish, be lost, disappear, fail: Caus. -लोपयति, -यितुम्, to tear or carry away, withhold, keep back; to cause to disappear, destroy, ruin, oppress, extinguish.
विलुप्त: वि-लुप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, torn off or away, broken off, broken; carried off or away, snatched away, seized, taken, plundered, robbed; destroyed, ruined, lost; impaired, mutilated.
विलुम्पक: वि-लुम्पक, अस्, इका, अम्, one who breaks or cuts off; one who seizes or robs; a robber, ravisher.
विलुम्पत्: वि-लुम्पत्, अन्, अती, or अन्ती, अत्, tearing or pluck-ing off, tearing, &c.
विलोप: वि-लोप, अस्, m. carrying off, seizing, taking away; a break or interruption in the Saṃhitā (according to the Prātiśākhyas).
विलोपन: वि-लोपन, अम्, n. the act of tearing or breaking to pieces, cutting off, destroying, destruction.
विलोपित: वि-लोपित, अस्, आ, अम्, torn away, broken, ruined, destroyed, oppressed, extinguished, put out.
विलुभ्: विलुभ् वि-लुभ्, cl. 4. P. -लुभ्यति, -लोभि-तुम् or -लोब्धुम्, to become disordered or disar-ranged, fall into disorder or confusion: Caus. -लोभ-यति, -यितुम्, to lead astray, perplex, confuse; to allure, entice, tempt; to divert, amuse, delight.
विलुभित: वि-लुभित, अस्, आ, अम्, disordered, disarranged, disturbed, agitated, bewildered; tossed or shaken about. —विलुभित-प्लव, अस्, आ, अम्, going in an agitated manner.
विलोभ: वि-लोभ, अस्, m. attraction, delusion, seduction.
विलोभन: वि-लोभन, अम्, n. the act of leading astray, per-plexing, beguiling; allurement, attraction, temptation, seduction; flattering, praise, commendation (especially by contrast with inferiority).
विलोभयत्: वि-लोभयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, alluring, enticing; diverting, amusing, delighting.
विलोभित: वि-लोभित, अस्, आ, अम्, allured, beguiled; deceived; flattered, praised.
विलोभ्य: वि-लोभ्य, ind. having enticed or beguiled, having fascinated, &c.
विलोभ्यमान: वि-लोभ्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being allured or en-ticed, being fascinated, being overcome.
विलुल्: विलुल् वि-लुल् (closely connected with वि-लुड्), cl. 1. P. -लोलति, &c., to move or roll about; to become disarranged or confused: Caus. -लोलयति, -यितुम्, to cause to move or roll about, agitate, dis-turb.
विलुलित: वि-लुलित, अस्, आ, अम्, moved hither and thither; shaken down, falling down, rolling down; shaken, shaking about, agitated, waving, tremulous, unsteady, fickle; disordered, disarranged. —विलुलितालक (°त-अल्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having disordered or dishevelled locks.
विलोल: वि-लोल, अस्, आ, अम्, moving or shaking about; shaking, trembling, tremulous, fickle, unsteady, loose; rolling (as the eye), rolling or tossing about, waving. —विलोल-ता, f. or विलोल-त्व, अम्, n. tremulousness, unsteadiness; rolling (of the eyes). —विलोल-हार, अस्, आ, अम्, having necklaces tossing about.
विलोलन: वि-लोलन, अम्, n. the act of shaking; stirring, agitating.
विलोलित: वि-लोलित, अस्, आ, अम्, moved hither and thither, shaken about, agitated, tossed about. —विलोलित-दृश्, क्, क्, क्, rolling the eyes, having tremulous eyes.
विलून: विलून वि-लून, अस्, आ, or ई, अम्, cut asunder, cut off, cut, (Pāṇ. IV. 1, 52, Vārtt. 3.)
विलोक्: विलोक् वि-लोक्, cl. 1. A. -लोकते, -लोकितुम्, to look at or upon, regard; to examine, test, study; cl. 10. P. or Caus. -लोकयति, -यितुम्, to look at, look on or upon, look towards, behold, regard, ob-serve, consider, examine; to perceive, see, discover, be aware of; to look over or beyond (with acc.): Pass. -लोक्यते, to be seen, be visible.
विलोकन: वि-लोकन, अम्, n. the act of looking or regarding, discerning, seeing, spying; sight, observation.
विलोकनीय: वि-लोकनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be looked at; worthy of being looked at, agreeable, beautiful. —विलोकनीय-ता, f. or विलोकनीय-त्व, अम्, n. a state worthy of being looked at, loveliness, beauty.
विलोकयत्: वि-लोकयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, looking at, seeing; dis-cerning.
विलोकित: वि-लोकित, अस्, आ, अम्, looked at, beheld, seen, observed, regarded, examined, contemplated; (अम्), n. a look, glance.
विलोक्य: वि-लोक्य, ind. having looked at, having seen or observed, having perceived or noticed or witnessed; having regard to, paying attention to.
विलोक: विलोक वि-लोक, अस्, आ, अम्, apart from the world, solitary, lonely.
विलोचन: विलोचन वि-लोचन, अम्, n. the eye, sight. —विलोचन-पात, अस्, m. a cast or glance of the eye, a glance, look. —विलोचनाम्बु (°न-अम्°), उ, n. ‘eye-water,’ tears.
विलोटक: विलोटक वि-लोटक, अस्, m. (fr. rt. लुट् with वि), a sort of fish, Clupea Cultrata (= नल-मीन).
विलोम: विलोम वि-लोम, अस्, ई, अम्, against the hair, against the grain, out of the usual or proper course, reverse, inverted, inverse, turned the wrong way, turned backward, contrary, opposite; produced in the reverse order [cf. विलोम-ज]; (अस्), m. reverse order, opposite course, reverse; a snake; a dog; an epithet of Varuṇa (the regent of the waters); (अम्), n. a water-wheel or machine for raising water from a well (= अर-घट्टक); (ई), f. Emblic Myrobalan. —विलोम-क्रिया, f. reverse action, doing anything in reverse order or backwards; (in arithmetic) rule of inversion. —विलोम-ज or विलोम-जात, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘born out of the proper course or in the reverse order,’ i. e. one whose father and mother have their stations reversed, the father being of an inferior caste and the mother of a superior. —विलोम-जिह्व, अस्, m. an elephant (as having a tongue which moves backwards ?). —विलोम-त्रैराशिक, अम्, n. rule of three inverse. —विलोम-वर्ण, अस्, m. ‘of reverse caste,’ a man of mixed or inferior birth, (see विलोम-ज above.) —विलोम-विधि, इस्, m. an inverted rite, reversed ceremony; (in arithmetic) rule of inversion. —विलोमाक्षर-काव्य (°म-अक्°), अम्, n. a poem which may be read either backwards or forwards; = राम-कृष्ण-काव्य, q. v. —विलोमोत्पन्न (°म-उत्°), अस्, आ, अम्, = विलोम-ज above.
विलोमित: वि-लोमित, अस्, आ, अम्, reversed, inverted, made averse or disaffected.
विलोहित: विलोहित वि-लोहित, अस्, आ, अम्, of a deep-red or purple colour; (अस्), m. epithet of Rudra and Fire (as identified with Rudra); (आ), f. (according to some), epithet of one of the tongues of fire; [cf. सु-लोहित।]
विल्ल: विल्ल विल्ल, अम्, n. (probably connected with विल), a pit, hole, a basin for water round the root of a tree (= आलवाल); Asa Fetida. —विल्ल-मूला, f. a sort of yam (= वाराही).
विल्व: विल्व विल्व, अस्, m. (fr. rt. विल्, also written बिल्व, q. v.), the tree Ægle Marmelos (commonly called Bel); (अम्), n. the fruit of the Bel; a particu-lar weight, (see बिल्व।) For the compounds of विल्व see बिल्व।
विवक्वस्: विवक्वस् विवक्वस्, वान्, m. (fr. rt. वच्, q. v.), Ved. one who repeats (praises), praising, a praiser, (Sāy. = स्तुतीनां वक्तृ।)
विवक्षा: विवक्षा विवक्षा, f. (fr. Desid. of rt. वच्), a wish or desire to speak; meaning, sense; intention, pur-pose, wish, desire; a question. —विवक्षा-वशात्, ind. according to the meaning (of a speaker or writer).
विवक्षण: विवक्षण, अस्, &c., Ved. (fr. rt. वच् or rt. 1. वह्), ‘making eloquent,’ or according to Sāy. ‘bring-ing to heaven’ (= स्वर्ग-प्रापण-शील), an epithet of Soma.
विवक्षत्: विवक्षत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, desiring to mention, wishing or intending to speak.
विवक्षमाण: विवक्षमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, wishing or desiring to speak about.
विवक्षित: विवक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, wished or intended to be spoken or said; purposed, intended; meant, signified, really meant, literal (not figurative); wished, desired; favourite, handsome; (अम्), n. what is intended to be said or declared, meaning, sense, purpose, intention, any desired object or aim; (आ), f. meaning, purpose, wish (?). —विवक्षित-त्व, अम्, n. the being intended or meant to be said.
विवक्षु: विवक्षु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to speak, intending to say.
विवच्: विवच् वि-वच् (see rt. वच्), cl. 2. P. -वक्ति (in the non-conjugational tenses also A.), -वक्तुम्, to de-clare, announce, explain, interpret, solve; to dispute about, speak against, oppose in argument; to speak va-riously or differently, to dispute with one another (A.).
विवक्तृ: वि-वक्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who declares or ex-plains, &c.
विवाक: वि-वाक, अस्, m. one who decides causes, a judge; [cf. प्रश्न-व्°, प्राड्-व्°।]
विवाक वि-वाक, वि-वाच्। See under वि-वच्।
विवाच्: वि-वाच्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. of various speech, having various speeches, variously praising, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda VI. 33, 2. वि-वाचः = विविध-स्तुति-रूपा वाचो येषाम्, whose words have the form of many kinds of praise); (क्), f., Ved. various speech or praise; N. of a particular sacrifice in which various prayers and praises are repeated; dispute, controversy, contention, strife (= सङ्ग्राम, Naigh. II. 17).
विवञ्चिषु: विवञ्चिषु विवञ्चिषु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. Desid. of rt. वञ्च्), wishing to deceive; crafty, deceitful.
विवत्सा: विवत्सा वि-वत्सा, f. a calfless cow, one whose calf is dead.
विवद्: विवद् वि-वद्, cl. 1. P. A. -वदति, -ते, -व-दितुम्, to dispute, oppose in argument, contradict, controvert, litigate, dispute about, discuss about (with loc. of the thing disputed about); to dispute with or engage in a discussion with any one (acc.); to cry out: Caus. -वादयति, -यितुम्, to cause to dispute or liti-gate, commence an action or lawsuit: Intens. -वाव-दीति, &c., to roar aloud.
विवदत्: वि-वदत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, wrangling, disputing, argu-ing, contending, debating, contradicting; litigating.
विवदमान: वि-वदमान, अस्, आ, अम्, disputing, contending, mutually disagreeing or contradictory; litigating; crying out.
विवदित: वि-वदित, अस्, आ, अम्, disputed, controverted, liti-gated.
विवाद: वि-वाद, अस्, m. a dispute, quarrel, controversy, debate, contest, strife, contention; an argument; contest at law, legal dispute, litigation, lawsuit; crying out, sound. —विवाद-कल्पतरु, उस्, m., N. of a work. —विवाद-चन्द्र, अस्, m., N. of a compen-dium of civil law by an author named Misarū-miśra. —विवाद-चिन्तामणि, इस्, m., N. of a work by Vā-caspati-miśra. —विवाद-भङ्गार्णव (°ग-अर्°), अस्, m., N. of a compendium of civil law by Jagan-nātha (compiled at the close of the eighteenth cen-tury). —विवाद-शमन, अम्, n. the allaying or settling of a dispute, pacification. —विवाद-सं-वाद-भू, ऊस्, f. a matter or subject of controversy and discussion. —विवादानुगत (°द-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, ‘gone through a lawsuit,’ disputed, litigated. —विवादार्थिन् (°द-अर्°), ई, इनी, इ, seeking for a dispute; (ई), m. a litigant, prosecutor, plaintiff. —वि-वादास्पदी-भूत (°द-आस्°), अस्, आ, अम्, become the subject of a lawsuit, litigated, contested at law.
विवादिन्: विवादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, disputing, contending, litigating, disputatious, contentious; a litigant, party in a lawsuit.
विवावदत्: वि-वावदत्, अत्, अती, अत्, Ved. roaring aloud.
विवध्: विवध् वि-वध् (a defective verb, see rt. वध्), Ved. to destroy utterly.
विवध: विवध वि-वध, अस्, m. (probably fr. rt. 1. वह् with वि), a yoke for carrying burdens, a load; a road, highway; storing grain, hay, &c.; a ewer, pitcher; [cf. वी-वध।]
विवधिक: विवधिक, अस्, m. a man who carries a burden; a dealer, peddler, hawker; [cf. वीवधिक।]
विवन्दिषु: विवन्दिषु विवन्दिषु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. Desid. of rt. वन्द्), intending to praise; wishing to salute.
विवप्: विवप् वि-वप्, cl. 1. P. A. -वपति, -ते, -वप्-तुम्, to strew or scatter about.
व्युप्त: व्युप्त व्य्-उप्त, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. वि-वप्), scat-tered about, disordered, dishevelled. —व्युप्त-केश, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, having dishevelled hair; (अस्), m. epi-thet of Rudra and Fire (as identified with Rudra).
विवर: वि-वर, अस्, m. expansion, opening, widening, separation; (अम्), n. a fissure, hole, chasm, cave, cavern, burrow, hollow, vacuity; a sequestered or solitary place; interval, intermediate space, space; a breach, fault, flaw, defect, vulnerable place, weak point, wound; a symbolical expression for the number nine, (see रन्ध्र।) —विवर-नालिका, f. a pipe, fife, flute. —विवरे-सद्, त्, त्, त्, abiding in inter-mediate space, an inhabitant of the sky.
विवर्जन: वि-वर्जन, अम्, n. the act of excluding, abandon-ing, leaving, shunning.
विवर्ण: विवर्ण वि-वर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, colourless, want-ing colour, changing colour, pale, wan, pallid; bad-coloured, discoloured; low, vile; unlettered, ignorant, stupid; (अस्), m. a man of low caste or of degrading occupation, an outcast. —विवर्ण-मणी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, (a bracelet &c.) which has its jewels ren-dered discoloured. —विवर्ण-वदन, अस्, आ, अम्, pale-faced.
विवर्त: वि-वर्त, अस्, m. turning round, revolving, revolu-tion, going or whirling round; dancing; rolling onwards; unrolling, rolling back, returning, rolling about, moving hither and thither, changing from one state to another, passing through various existences or states of being; modification, altered condition; human error (consisting in the mistaking unreal objects and conceiving them to be what they are not, as mirage for water, a rope for a snake, &c.); the unreal (as opposed to Brahma the only real essence); collection, assemblage, heap, multitude. —विवर्त-वाद, अस्, m. maintaining or asserting that Brahma or the one eternal essence manifests himself in various illusory forms.
विवर्ध्: विवर्ध् वि-वर्ध्, cl. 10. P. -वर्धयति, -यि-तुम्, to cut off, sever.
विवर्धन: 1. वि-वर्धन, अम्, n. (for 2. see वि-वृध्), the act of cutting off, cutting, dividing.

2. वि-वर्धन, अम्, n. (for 1. see वि-वर्ध्), the act of increasing, augmenting, increase, growth, augmentation, amplification, aggrandizement; (अस्, आ or ई, अम्), growing, increasing, advancing, furthering.
विवर्धित: 1. वि-वर्धित, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. see वि-वृध्), cut off, cut, divided.
2. वि-वर्धित, अस्, आ, अम् (for 1. see वि-वर्ध्), increased, augmented, enlarged; advanced, furthered; gratified, delighted.
विवर्षत्: वि-वर्षत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, deluging with rain.
विवल्: विवल् वि-वल्, cl. 1. P. A. -वलति, -ते, -व-लितुम्, to turn away, avert.
विवलित: वि-वलित, अस्, आ, अम्, turned away, averted.
विवल्ग्: विवल्ग् वि-वल्ग्, cl. 1. P. -वल्गति, &c., to leap, jump, spring; to burst asunder.
विवश: विवश वि-वश, अस्, आ, अम्, unrestrained, un-subdued, uncontrolled; independant; subject, sub-jected; apprehensive of death; desirous of death (as having the soul free from worldly cares and fears).
विवस्: विवस् 1. वि-वस् (see rts. 3. वस्, 2. उष्, 2. व्य्-उष्), cl. 6. P. -उच्छति, &c., Ved. to shine forth, shine, dawn: Caus. -वासयति, -यितुम्, to cause to shine.

विवस् 2. वि-वस्, cl. 2. A. -वस्ते, -वसितुम्, to exchange clothes; to wear, put on (a garment), clothe: Caus. -वासयति, -यितुम्, to clothe, put on, cover: Pass. of Caus. -वास्यते, to be clothed or clad in.

विवस् 3. वि-वस्, cl. 1. P. -वसति, -वस्तुम्, to change an abode, to depart, go off, retire, with-draw; to dwell, abide; to pass, spend (time &c.); to pass away: Caus. -वासयति, -यितुम्, to cause to dwell apart, banish, expel, drive into exile, transport, dismiss.
विवस्वत्: विवस्वत्, आन्, m. ‘the brilliant one,’ N. of the Sun, (sometimes regarded as one of the eight Ādityas or sons of Aditi, his father being Kaśyapa; elsewhere he is said to be a son of Dākṣāyaṇī and Kaśyapa; in epic poetry he is held to be the father of Manu Vaivasvata [or according to another legend of Manu Sāvarṇi by Sa-varṇā], and therefore a kind of parent of the human race [see Manu]; in Ṛg-veda X. 17, 1. he is described as the father of Yama Vaivasvata, and in Ṛg-veda X. 17, 2. as father of the Aśvins by Saraṇyū, and elsewhere as father of both Yama and Yamī; according to Nīla-kaṇṭha, the name विवस्वत् is derived fr. 2. वि-वस्, in the sense विशेषेण आच्छा-दयति); N. of Aruṇa (charioteer of the Sun); of the seventh or present Manu, (more properly called Vaivasvata, as son of Vivasvat); a god; N. of the author of the hymn Ṛg-veda X. 13 (having the patronymic Āditya); N. of the author of a Dharma-śāstra; (अती), f., N. of the city of the Sun.
विवस्वन्: विवस्वन्, आ, &c., Ved. shining, possessing bright-ness; (Sāy. also ‘possessing wealth;’ in Ṛg-veda VIII. 102, 22. विवस्वभिः = ऋत्विग्भिः।)
विवासन: 2. वि-वासन, अम्, n. the act of banishing, banish-ment, exile.
व्युष्ट: 1. व्युष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, burnt, (perhaps to be written व्य्-उष्ट, see above.)

2. व्य्-उष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, dawned, become day-light or dawn; become bright or clear; (अम्), n. dawn, day-break (personified as a son of Kalpa, in which case to be regarded as masc.), day; fruit, result, consequence.
3. व्य्-उष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, dwelt, lodged; passed; one who has passed a night or lodged for a night.
विवास: 1. वि-वास, अस्, m. banishment, expulsion. —विवास-करण, अम्, n. causing banishment, banishment, transporting.
2. वि-वास, अस्, आ, अम्, or वि-वासस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, without clothes, naked.
विवासित: वि-वासित, अस्, आ, अम्, banished, expelled, forced into exile, transported.
विवास्य: वि-वास्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be expelled or exiled.
विवास्यमान: वि-वास्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being banished, being exiled.
व्युषित: 1. व्य्-उषित, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. = 2. व्य्-उष्ट below.

व्युषित 2. व्य्-उषित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 3. वि-वस्), lived away, dwelling abroad; dwelt, lodged, passed (e. g. व्य्-उषितो रात्रिम्, he lodged for a night, i. e. he passed or spent a night). —व्युषि-ताश्व (°त-अश्°), अस्, m., N. of a king descended from Daśa-ratha.
विवसन: विवसन वि-वसन, अस्, आ, अम्, destitute of garments, unclothed, naked; (अस्), m. a Jaina ascetic.
विवस्त्र: वि-वस्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, devoid of clothing, unclothed, naked.
विवह्: विवह् वि-वह्, cl. 1. P. -वहति, -वोढुम्, to bear away, remove, carry off, lead away; to conduct home, take in marriage, marry: Caus. -वाहयति, -यि-तुम्, to cause to marry, give in marriage; to marry.
विवह: वि-वह, अस्, m. ‘carrying away,’ epithet of one of the seven tongues of fire.
वि-वह; add — N. of one of the seven winds.
विवाह: वि-वाह, अस्, m. the taking a wife, marriage, (eight kinds of marriage are enumerated in Manu III. 21, viz. Brāhma, Daiva, Ārṣa, Prājāpatya, Āsura, Gān-dharva, Rākṣasa, and Paiśāca; see also Yājñavalkya I. 58 — 61.) —विवाह-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, desirous of marriage. —विवाह-चतुष्टय, अम्, n. a quadru-ple marriage, the marrying four wives. —विवाह-तत्त्व, अम्, n., N. of a part of the Smṛti-tattva. —विवाह-दीक्षा, f. the marriage rite, marriage ceremony. —विवाह-दीक्षा-तिलक, अस्, अम्, m. n. a Tilaka made on the forehead for a matrimonial cere-mony. —विवाह-दीक्षा-विधि, इस्, m. the preparatory rites of matrimony. —विवाह-यज्ञ, अस्, m. a matri-monial sacrifice. —विवाह-विधि, इस्, m. the law of marriage. —विवाह-वृन्दा-वन, N. of an astro-logical work by Keśavārka. —विवाहार्थ (°ह-अर्°), अस्, m. purpose of marriage, a marriage suit. —विवा-हेच्छु (°ह-इच्°), उस्, उस्, उ, desirous of marriage.
विवाहित: वि-वाहित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to marry, married.
विवाहिन्: विवाहिन्, ई, इनी, इ, taking a wife, marrying; re-lating to marriage; [cf. अ-विवाहिन्।]
विवाह्य: वि-वाह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be married, marriageable; (अस्), m. a son-in-law; a bridegroom.
विवोढृ: वि-वोढृ, ढा, m. one who takes in marriage, a bridegroom, husband.
व्यूढ: व्यूढ 1. व्य्-ऊढ, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. वि-वह्), married. (For 2. व्य्-ऊढ see under व्य्-ऊह्।)

2. व्य्-ऊढ, अस्, आ, अम्, placed or moved apart, widely separated, expanded, developed, wide, broad; large, great, firm, compact; placed in order or array, arrayed, marshalled, arranged; placed out of order, disarranged, transposed, altered. —व्यूढ-कङ्कट, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has arranged or put on armour, equipped in mail, accoutred, mailed, armed. —व्यू-ढ-छन्दस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. having the metres disarranged or out of order. —व्यूढोरस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, or व्यूढोरस्क (°ढ-उर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having an expanded chest, broad-chested, (व्यूढ = विपुल, comm.)
विवा: विवा वि-वा, cl. 2. P. -वाति, -वातुम्, to blow on all sides, blow in every direction, blow, blow through.
विवात्: वि-वात्, आन्, आती or आन्ती, आत्, blowing on all sides, blowing, blowing gently.
विवाश: विवाश विवाश, आस्, m. pl., N. of a mythical caste in Plaksha-dvīpa (corresponding to the Vaiśyas).
विविंशति: विविंशति वि-विंशति, इस्, m., N. of one of Dhṛtarāṣṭra's sons.
विविक्वस्: विविक्वस् विविक्वस्, आन्, m. (fr. rt. विच्), Ved. one who possesses discrimination, discriminating; an epithet of Indra (in Ṛg-veda III. 57, 1).
विविक्ष्: विविक्ष् विविक्ष्, विविक्षत्, &c. See under rt. 1. विश्, p. 941, col. 2.
विविक्ष्, ट्, ट्, ट्, or ड्, ड्, ड् (fr. the Desid.), one who wishes to enter, (see Vopa-deva III. 151.)
विविग्न: विविग्न वि-विग्न, अस्, आ, अम्, very agitated or alarmed, terrified; very angry.
विविच्: विविच् वि-विच्, cl. 7. 3. P. A. -विनक्ति, -विङ्क्ते, -वेवेक्ति, -वेविक्ते, -वेक्तुम्, to separate or divide asunder, rend or tear asunder; to distinguish, discriminate, decide, judge between (two sides of a question); to alter; to tear up, remove: Caus. -वेच-यति, -यितुम्, to separate, distinguish, discriminate.
विविक्त: वि-विक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, separated, disjoined, detached, kept apart, scattered, abstracted, sequestered; single, alone, lonely, solitary, private, deserted; distinguished, discriminated, judged; discriminative, judicious; pro-found (as judgment or thought); pure, faultless; intent on; (अम्), n. separation, loneliness, privacy, abstraction; a solitary place. —विविक्त-तर्क, अस्, आ, अम्, clear in reasoning. —विविक्त-ता, f. the being separated, separation, loneliness, privacy; an empty or free space. —विविक्त-भाव, अस्, आ, अम्, having a mind separated or abstracted (from other pursuits), intent on any object. —विविक्त-वर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, having letters or syllables distinctly enunciated. —विविक्त-सेविन्, ई, इनी, इ, seeking solitude, solitary, retired, recluse. —विविक्तासन (°त-आस्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having a secluded seat, sitting in a sequestered place.
विविचि: वि-विचि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. separating, discriminating, a discriminator, (Sāy. = विवेचक); (इस्), m. ‘the separator,’ epithet of Agni.
विविच्य: वि-विच्य, ind. having discriminated or judged, having discussed or considered; having properly dis-criminated; dividing or discriminating in regular order; severally, one by one.
विवेक: वि-वेक, अस्, m. discrimination, judgment, the faculty of distinguishing and classifying things ac-cording to their real properties; (in the Vedānta system) the power of separating the invisible Spirit from the visible world, (or spirit from matter, truth from untruth, reality from mere semblance or illu-sion); true knowledge; discretion; discussion, in-vestigation; a receptacle for water, reservoir, basin (= जल-द्रोणी). —विवेक-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, produced or arising from discrimination. —विवेक-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, skilled in discrimination, intelligent. —विवेक-ज्ञान, अम्, n. knowledge arising from discrimina-tion, faculty of discrimination. —विवेक-ता, f. or विवेक-त्व, अम्, n. judgment, discrimination, the faculty of judgment. —विवेकदृश्व-ता, f. or विवेक-दृश्व-त्व, अम्, n. the character of a discerning man, discrimination, discernment. —विवेक-दृश्वन्, आ, m. one who sees or is conversant with true know-ledge, a wise or discerning man. —विवेक-पदवी, f. ‘path of discrimination,’ reflection. —विवेक-विलास, अस्, m., N. of a work. —विवेक-सार, N. of a general Vedānta disquisition in sixteen sections by Rāmendra-yati. —विवेक-सिन्धु, N. of an elementary treatise on the Vedānta by Mukunda-rāja.
विवेकिन्: विवेकिन्, ई, इनी, इ, discriminating, discriminative, judicious, prudent, discreet; (ई), m. a judge, dis-criminator, sage, philosopher. —विवेकि-ता, f. or वि-वेकि-त्व, अम्, n. discriminativeness, discrimination, discussion.
विवेक्तव्य: वि-वेक्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be distinguished or discriminated, to be discussed or judged.
विवेक्तृ: वि-वेक्तृ, ता, m. one who judges, a judge, decider (of questions or causes), sage, wise man.
विवेचन: वि-वेचन, अम्, आ, n. f. the act of discrimination, discriminating or distinguishing (as truth from false-hood, reality from semblance), the making a distinc-tion; investigation, judgment, decision.
विवेचनीय: वि-वेचनीय or वि-वेच्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be distin-guished or judged, to be discussed, distinguishable.
विवेचित: वि-वेचित, अस्, आ, अम्, discriminated, distinguished, investigated.
विविध: विविध वि-विध, अस्, आ, अम्, of various sorts or kinds, divers, manifold, sundry, various, multiform; (अम्), n. variety of action or gesture. —विविध-रूप-धृत्, त्, त्, त्, having various forms. —विविधा-गम (°ध-आग्°), अस्, आ, अम्, comprising various sacred (or traditional) works. —विविधोपल-भू-षित (°ध-उप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, decorated with various jewels.
विविशिवस्: विविशिवस्, आन्, उषी, अत्, one who has entered, (see Pāṇ. VII. 2, 68.)
विवीत: विवीत वि-वीत, अस्, m. an inclosed spot of ground (abounding in grass, wood, &c.), a preserved or inclosed pasture ground, paddock. —विवीत-भर्तृ, ता, m. the owner of a preserved or inclosed pasture.
विवृ: विवृ वि-वृ, cl. 5. 9. P. A. -वृणोति, -वृणुते, वृणाति, -वृणीते (in the Veda the form व्य्-अवर् frequently becomes व्य्-आवर् or व्य्-आवः), -वरितुम्, -वरीतुम्, to uncover, spread out, open, unfold, dis-play, discover, reveal, make clear, illuminate, make manifest, proclaim, publish, explain, describe, com-ment upon; to cover over, cover up, stop up; to obtain (Ved., according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda VII. 90, 4. विवव्रुः = व्यवृण्वन् = अलभन्त).
विवरण: वि-वरण, अम्, n. the act of uncovering, spreading out, expanding, opening, unfolding, displaying, ex-posing, laying bare or open; explanation, exposition, interpretation, gloss, comment, translation; detailing, describing, description, specification, detailed account; a sentence.
विवरिषु: विवरिषु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to make manifest or display; wishing to explain or declare.
विवार: वि-वार, अस्, m. dilatation, expansion; open or expanded state of the organs of speech, expansion of the throat in articulation, (one of the Ābhyantara-prayatnas or efforts of articulate utterance which take place within the mouth, opposed to सं-वार।)
विवृण्वत्: वि-वृण्वत्, अन्, अती, अत्, making manifest, explain-ing, declaring.
विवृण्वान: वि-वृण्वान, अस्, आ, अम्, uncovering, explaining, publishing, &c.
विवृत: वि-वृत, अस्, आ, अम्, uncovered, unconcealed, (अ-वि-वृत, hidden, concealed), unclosed, opened, open (as the organs of speech for articulation); bare, barren (as ground, earth, &c.); spread out, expanded, ex-tended, extensive, ample, spacious, large; displayed, unfolded, exposed, discovered, made manifest, evi-dent; published, divulged, proclaimed, explained, interpreted, expounded; (अम्), ind. openly, in the sight of every one; (आ), f. a particular disease, an ulcer attended with much pain and heat; (अम्), n. (in grammar) open articulation, approach of the tongue towards the organ of speech but without contact. —विवृत-पौरुष, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose prowess is displayed, displaying valour. —विवृत-स्मयन, अम्, n. an open smile, a smile by which the teeth are shown. —विवृताक्ष (°त-अक्°), अस्, ई, अम्, open-eyed, large-eyed; (अस्), m. a cock. —विवृतास्य (°त-आस्°), अस्, आ, अम्, open-mouthed.
विवृतवत्: विवृतवत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has opened.
विवृति: वि-वृति, इस्, f. expansion, making clear, manifesta-tion; display; exposure, discovery; explanation, ex-position, gloss, comment, interpretation. —विवृति-विमर्शिनी, f., N. of a work by Abhinava-gupta.
विवृत्य: वि-वृत्य, ind. having uncovered, having opened, having expanded, displaying wide.
विवृक्ण: वि-वृक्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. entirely severed or cut asunder, cut off, (Sāy. = विशेषतश् छिन्न।)
विवृज्: विवृज् वि-वृज्, Caus. or cl. 10. P. A. -वर्ज-यति, -ते, -यितुम्, to exclude; to avoid, shun, abandon, leave; to distribute, give: Pass. of Caus. -वर्ज्यते, to be avoided.
विवर्जनीय: वि-वर्जनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be excluded, to be abandoned, to be shunned or avoided, to be quitted.
विवर्जयत्: वि-वर्जयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, avoiding, shunning, leaving.
विवर्जित: वि-वर्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, left, abandoned; avoided by, shunned by (with inst. or at the end of a comp.); destitute of, deprived of, entirely free or exempt from, without, (मान-विवर्जितम्, ind. without honour, dishonourably); excepting, excluding; dis-tributed, given.
विवर्ज्य: वि-वर्ज्य, ind. having avoided, having abandoned.
विवृक्त: वि-वृक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, abandoned, left; (आ), f. a woman disliked or deserted by her husband (= दुर्-भगा).
विवृण्: विवृण् वि-वृण्, cl. 6. P. -वृणति, &c., or Caus., to exhilarate.
विवृत्: विवृत् वि-वृत्, cl. 1. A. -वर्तते (rarely P. -वर्तति), -वर्तितुम्, to turn round, roll round, re-volve, whirl round; to roll onwards, become unrolled; to roll over; to turn or roll about, roll or turn hither and thither, move about, wind about; to move through; to roll or turn away from, depart from, turn back, return; to roll down, descend; to attack: Caus. -वर्तयति, -यितुम्, to cause to turn round or revolve, cause to alternate.
विवर्तन: वि-वर्तन, अम्, n. (in some senses fr. the Caus.), turning round, revolving, revolution (as of a wheel &c.), whirling or going round, circumambulating (an altar &c.); reverential salutation; rolling back, returning; rolling down, descending; passing through a change or succession of various states or existences; existing, being, abiding, continuing; tossing to and fro; causing to revolve or go round; whirling round; causing to change, overturning.
विवर्तमान: वि-वर्तमान, अस्, आ, अम्, turning back or round, revolving, rolling onwards, turning back, declining, setting (as the sun), returning, recoiling; continuing or abiding (in any course of action).
विवर्तित: वि-वर्तित, अस्, आ, अम्, turned round, revolved, rolled or rolling about; whirled round; turned or moved about, moving hither and thither; unrolled, unfolded; returned, turned back or away, averted, turned the wrong way, distorted, bent, bent down.
विवर्तिन्: वि-वर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, turning round, revolving; turning back.
विवृत्त: वि-वृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, turned or twisted round, whirling, revolving, rolling.
विवृत्ति: वि-वृत्ति, इस्, f. turning round, revolution, rolling, whirling, tumbling; (in grammar) interval between two vowels, hiatus. —विवृत्ति-पूर्व, अस्, आ, अम्, preceded by a hiatus. —विवृत्त्य्-अभिप्राय, अस्, m. an intended or apparent hiatus.
विवृत्सत्: विवृत्सत् विवृत्सत्। See under rt. 1. वृत्।
विवृत्सत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत् (fr. the Desid.), wishing to be or exist.
विवृध्: विवृध् वि-वृध्, cl. 1. A. -वर्धते, -वर्-धितुम्, to grow up, increase, swell, become en-larged, become powerful; to prosper, thrive; to spring up, arise; to have reason to rejoice or be congratulated: Caus. -वर्धयति, -यितुम्, to cause to grow or increase, enlarge, augment, magnify, amplify; to cause to prosper, advance, further; to elevate; to gratify, exhilarate.
विवर्धत्: वि-वर्धत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, increasing, growing bigger, thriving, &c.
विवर्धमान: वि-वर्धमान, अस्, आ, अम्, growing up, increas-ing, thriving.
विवृद्ध: वि-वृद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, grown up, increased, en-larged, enhanced, augmented, intensified; large, abundant. —विवृद्ध-मत्सर, अस्, आ, अम्, whose anger or resentment is increased.
विवृद्धि: वि-वृद्धि, इस्, f. growth, increase, great growth, augmentation, enlargement; prosperity.
विवृष्: विवृष् वि-वृष्, cl. 1. P. -वर्षति, -वर्षि-तुम्, to rain down, rain: Caus. -वर्षयति, -यितुम्, to cause to rain, rain down upon.
विवृह्: विवृह् वि-वृह् (see rt. 1. वृह्), cl. 6. P. -वृहति, -वर्हितुम्, Ved. to rend asunder, tear to pieces, break up, split; to tear away, draw away, tear out, remove.
विवृढ: वि-वृढ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. torn asunder, rent.
विवृहत्: विवृहत् विवृहत्, अन्, m., N. of the author of the hymn Ṛg-veda X. 163 (having the patro-nymic Kāśyapa).
विवे: विवे वि-वे, cl. 1. P. A. -वयति, -ते, &c., Ved. to interweave.
व्यूत: व्य्-ऊत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. interwoven, &c. See s. v.
व्य्-ऊत, अस्, आ, अम्, interwoven, &c. = व्य्-उत above.
व्यूत व्य्-ऊत, व्य्-ऊति। See under व्य्-उत।
विवेन्: विवेन् वि-वेन्, cl. 1. P. A. -वेनति, -ते, &c., to be hostile or ill-disposed, (in Ṛg-veda V. 78, 1. मा वि-वेनतम् = मा वि-कामौ भवतम्, [O Aśvins] be not ill-disposed.)
विवेल्ल्: विवेल्ल् वि-वेल्ल्, cl. 1. P. -वेल्लति, &c., to struggle, tremble.
विव्रत: विव्रत वि-व्रत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. perform-ing various religious actions or ceremonies; many-actioned (said of horses; Sāy. = विविध-कर्मन्).
विव्रश्च्: विव्रश्च् वि-व्रश्च्, cl. 6. P. -वृश्चति, &c., Ved. to cut off, cut asunder, separate, sever; to destroy; to be cut asunder, cut off, (Sāy. on Ṛg-veda III. 53, 22 = विच्छिद्यते।)
विवृश्चत्: वि-वृश्चत्, अन्, अती, or अन्ती, अत्, Ved. cutting asunder, separating, scattering.
विव्वोक: विव्वोक विव्वोक, अस्, m. (etymology doubt-ful), affectation of indifference, (one of the ten forms of amorous dalliance practised by women to excite love; cf. वि-कृत।)
विश्: विश् 1. विश् (some of the forms and meanings of this rt. are identical with those of rt. 2. विष्), cl. 6. P. विशति (ep. also A. -ते), विवेश, वेक्ष्यति, अविक्षत्, वेष्टुम् (Ved. Impv. 2nd sing. विविड्ढि = प्रविश, according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda I. 27, 10, but cf. rt. 2. विष्), to enter, enter in (with acc.); to pierce, penetrate; to pervade; to sit or settle down on (with acc.); to come to, come into the possession of, fall to the lot of; to undertake, begin, (in Naigh. II. 14. वेशिष्टि is enumerated among the गति-कर्माणः): Caus. वेशयति, -यितुम्, अवीविशत्, to cause to enter, &c.: Desid. विविक्षति: Intens. वेविश्यते, वेवेष्टि; [cf. Zend vīś, ‘to come;’ Gr. ἵκ-ω, ἱκ-νέ-ο-μαι, ἱκ-αν-ω, ἱκ-έ-τη-ς, ἱκ-τήρ, ἱκ-τήρ, ἱκετή-σιο-ς, ἱκ-ανό-ς, ἴκ-μενο-ς.].

2. विश्, ट्, m. (Ved. loc. pl. विक्षु, Ṛg-veda IV. 37, 1), a man who settles down on or occupies the soil, an agriculturist, merchant, a man of the third or agri-cultural caste (= वैश्य, q. v.); a man in general; people; N. of any class of gods designated by troops (Ved.); (ट्), f. entrance; a family, house, tribe, host, race (Ved.); a daughter; [cf. Zend vīś, ‘a house, hamlet;’ Goth. vaihts; Angl. Sax. wiht; Old Germ. ni-wiht, eo-wiht, neo-wiht.] —विट्-पण्य, अम्, n. the wares of a man of the mercantile class, goods, merchandise. —विट्-पति, इस्, m. a chief of men of the mercantile class, head merchant; a daughter's husband, son-in-law. —विट्-शूद्र, आस्, m. pl. Vaiśyas and Śūdras. —विशाम्-पति, इस्, m. a lord of men, lord of people, a king, sovereign, (perhaps so called as especially ‘lord of the Vaiśyas,’ the Brāhmans being his superiors and the Kṣatriyas his equals.) —विश्-पति, इस्, m., Ved. lord of the house, lord of men, lord of the people, king; epithet of Agni; [cf. Zend viś-paiti; Lith. wies-patis, wies-patene; Mold. hospodar; (perhaps also) Gr. δεσπότης. ] —विश्-पत्नी, f., Ved. the mistress or protec-tress of mankind (applied to the fire of attrition).
विविक्षत्: विविक्षत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, wishing to enter.
विविक्षु: विविक्षु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing or intending to enter.
विविश्वस्: विविश्वस्, आन्, उषी, अत्, = विविशिवस् above; [cf. also विविश्वस् under rt. विछ्।]
विश: विश = 2. विश् (at the end of a comp.); (अम्), n. the film or fibres of the stalk of the water-lily (= विष, विस). —विशं-वरा, f. = पल्ली. —विश-कण्ठिन्, ई, m. a kind of crane; [cf. विस-कण्-ठिका।] —विशाकर (°श-आक्°), अस्, m. ‘filled with fibres,’ the plant Euphorbia (= भद्र-चूड).
विशत्: विशत्, अन्, अती, or अन्ती, अत्, entering, entering into, penetrating, &c.
विश्य: विश्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. belonging to the people, kindly disposed to the people, (Sāy. = विड्भ्यो हित।)
विष्ट: 1. विष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. see p. 946, col. 3), en-tered, penetrated, pervaded. —विष्ट-पुर, अस्, m., N. of a Ṛṣi; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a family.
2. विष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (for 1. see p. 941, col. 2), pervaded; (आ), f. the feces, excrement.
विष्टि: 1. विष्टि, इस्, f. (for 2. see p. 946, col. 3), N. of particular astronomical Karaṇas; N. of a daughter of Sūrya and Chāyā. —विष्टि-व्रत, अम्, n. a parti-cular religious ceremony in honour of Viṣṭi.

2. विष्टि, इस्, इस्, इ (for 1. see p. 941, col. 2), per-forming, labouring; (इस्), f. pervading, penetrating; occupation, act, action; hire, wages; unpaid labour; sending, dispatching; consigning to hell.
वेश: वेश वेश, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. विश्), entrance, ingress, access; a house, dwelling, abode; a house of prostitutes; a neighbour (Ved., Sāy. = प्रतिवेश्य, Ṛg-veda IV. 3, 13); dress, apparel; ornament, decora-tion [cf. वेष]; disguise, masquerade; [cf. Gr. οἶκο-ς, οἰκά-α; Lat. vicu-s, vic-inu-s; Goth. veihs; Angl. Sax. wic.] —वेश-दान, अस्, m. the sunflower (= सूर्य-शोभा). —वेश-धारिन्, ई, m. ‘wearing a disguise,’ a hypocrite, false devotee. —वेश-भृत्, त्, त्, त्, wearing dress or ornament, dressed, adorned; disguised. —वेश-वाट, अम्, n. house and court.
विशङ्क्: विशङ्क् वि-शङ्क्, cl. 1. A. -शङ्कते, -शङ्कि-तुम्, to suspect, doubt.
विशङ्क: वि-शङ्क, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. वि privative + शङ्का), fearless, undaunted; (अम्), ind. fearlessly.
विशङ्कनीय: वि-शङ्कनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be suspected or doubted, doubtful, suspicious; questionable.
विशङ्कमान: वि-शङ्कमान, अस्, आ, अम्, suspecting, doubting, fearing, apprehending.
विशङ्का: वि-शङ्का, f. suspicion, doubt, fear, apprehension.
विशङ्कट: विशङ्कट वि-शङ्कट, अस्, आ or ई, अम् (for वि-सङ्कट), great, large; strong, vehement; (अम्), ind. vehemently.
विशद्: विशद् वि-शद्, Caus. -शातयति, -यितुम्, to cause to fall to pieces, break to pieces; to rend asunder; to scatter in all directions.
विशद: वि-शद, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be connected with वि-शद् above), clear, pure, pellucid, spotless, perspi-cuous; white, of a white colour; evident, apparent, obvious, manifest; beautiful; (अस्), m. white, the colour. —विशद-प्रभ, अस्, आ, अम्, of pure efful-gence, shedding pure light. —विशदी-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, -कर्तुम्, to make clear, explain, illustrate.
विशातन: वि-शातन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. the Caus.), causing to fall to pieces, rending asunder; setting free, de-livering.
विशातयित्वा: वि-शातयित्वा (anom. ind. part.), having broken in pieces, having scattered.
विशय: विशय वि-शय, अस्, m. (fr. rt. शी with वि), doubt, uncertainty; refuge, asylum.
विशयिन्: विशयिन्, ई, इनी, इ, dubious, uncertain; doubting.
विशाय: वि-शाय, अस्, m. sleeping and watching alternately (applied to watchmen who sleep and watch by turns; cf. उप-शाय).
विशर: वि-शर, अस्, m. splitting, bursting; destroying, killing, slaying, slaughter.
विशल: विशल विशल, अस्, m. (for विशाल?), N. of the son of Abja; (आ), f., N. of a town; [cf. वैशली।]
विशल्य: विशल्य वि-शल्य, अस्, आ, अम्, free from thorns or darts; free from trouble or embarrass-ment, without care or pain; (आ), f. a twining shrub, Menispermum Cordifolium; a sort of pot-herb; the plant Croton Polyandrum (commonly called Danti); Convolvulus Turpethum (commonly called Teori); a sort of fruit, Langaliya; (probably) N. of a stream or river. —विशल्य-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, freeing from pain or distress; (त्), m. the climbing plant Echites Di-chotoma. —विशल्या-सङ्गम, अस्, m. ‘union with Viśalyā,’ N. of a chapter of the Revā-māhātmya. —विशल्या-सम्भव, अस्, m. ‘origin of Viśalyā,’ N. of a chapter of the Revā-māhātmya.
विशस्: विशस् वि-शस्, cl. 1. P. -शसति, -शसितुम्, to cut up, dissect, kill, destroy; to immolate, sacrifice.
विशसन: वि-शसन, अम्, n. the act of cutting up, dissect-ing; killing, slaying, immolating, slaughter; ruin; N. of one of the divisions of Naraka; (अस्), m. a sabre, crooked sword.
विशसित: वि-शसित, अस्, आ, अम्, cut up, dissected; killed, im-molated; rude, ill-mannered, (see 1. वि-शस्त below.)
विशसितृ: वि-शसितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who cuts up or dissects (Manu V. 51), a dissector; a killer, immolator.
विशस्त: 1. वि-शस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, cut up, dissected; bold, fierce, ill-mannered, rude.
विशस्त 2. वि-शस्त, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. शंस् with वि), praised, celebrated.
विशस्तृ: वि-शस्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. one who kills or dis-sects; (ता), m. an immolator, sacrificer; a Cāṇḍāla.
विशस्य: वि-शस्य, ind. having cut up or dissected, having immolated.
विशस्त्र: विशस्त्र वि-शस्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, weaponless, disarmed, unarmed. —विशस्त्र-त्व, अम्, n. an un-armed or defenceless condition.
विशाकार: विशाकार विशाकार, अस्, m. the plant Eu-phorbia, (probably for विशाकर, see under विश।)
विशाख: विशाख वि-शाख, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. शाखा with वि), branchless; having spreading branches; (अस्), m., N. of Kārttikeya; of a son of Kārttikeya (as son of Agni); an attitude in shooting (standing with the feet a span apart); a solicitor, petitioner, beggar; a spindle; (आ), f. or (ए), f. du., N. of one of the lunar asterisms (figured by a decorated gateway or arch and containing four or originally two stars placed under the regency of a dual divinity, इन्द्राग्नी, Indra and Agni; it is probably to be connected with the quadrangle of stars ι, α , β, γ Libræ; see नक्-षत्र); the cucurbitaceous plant Momordica Cha-rantia, (in this sense fem. sing.) —विशाख-ज, अस्, m. ‘born under the asterism Viśākha,’ the orange, Citrus Aurantium (as coming into season when the sun is in this asterism, or about the end of October). —विशाख-दत्त, अस्, m., N. of the author of the Mudrā-rākṣasa drama. —विशाख-यूप, अस्, m., N. of a king.
विशाखल: विशाखल, अम्, n. an attitude in shooting. (See वि-शाख।)
विशाखिल: विशाखिल विशाखिल, अस्, m., N. of an author.
विशाप: विशाप विशाप, अस्, m., N. of a Muni.
विशारण: वि-शारण, अम्, n. the act of splitting, shattering, destroying.
विशारद: विशारद विशारद, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be connected with विशाल), learned, wise; skilful, skilled in, versed in, conversant with (often at the end of comps., cf. सर्व-शास्त्र-व्°); famous, celebrated; confident, bold, presuming.
विशाल: विशाल विशाल, अस्, आ, अम् (in Uṇādi-s. I. 117. said to be fr. rt. 1. विश्; according to some connected with 2. वि-श्रि), large, great, wide, broad, extensive; great, eminent, illustrious; (अस्), m. a sort of deer; a sort of bird; N. of a son of Tṛṇa-vindu; (आ), f., N. of the city Ujjayinī or Ougein; of another town (see वैशाली, वैशली); the bitter apple, Cucumis Colocynthis; (ई), f. a particular plant (= अज-मोदा). —विशाल-कुल, अम्, n. a great or illustrious family; (अस्, आ, अम्), of noble family. —विशाल-कुल-सम्भव, अस्, आ, अम्, sprung from an illustrious race. —विशाल-ता, f. or विशाल-त्व, अम्, n. largeness, greatness, width, breadth, expansion, magnitude, bulk; eminence, distinction. —विशाल-त्वच्, क्, m. ‘having large bark,’ the tree Echites Scholaris. —विशाल-नगर, अम्, n., N. of a town. —विशाल-नेत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, large-eyed. —विशाल-पुरी, f., N. of a town. —विशालाक्ष (°ल-अक्°), अस्, ई, अम्, large-eyed, having beautiful eyes; (अस्), m. epithet of Śiva; of Garuḍa; N. of a son of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra; (ई), f. epithet of Pārvatī; N. of a daughter of Śāṇḍilya.
विशिक्षु: विशिक्षु वि-शिक्षु, उस्, उस्, उ (see शिक्षु), Ved. especially instructing or accomplishing, (Sāy. = विशेषेण शिक्षयितृ, साधयितृ।)
विशिख: विशिख वि-शिख, अस्, आ, अम्, devoid of the Śikhā or tuft of hair left on the head after tonsure; pointless, without a point or top, without a crest; weak (Ved. ?); (अस्), m. an arrow; an iron crow, (in these and some following senses वि may denote intensity or largeness); a sort of Śara or reed; (आ), f. a spade; a hoe; a minute arrow; a sort of pin or needle; a spindle; a highway, broad or carriage road; a barber's wife; a sick room or the dwelling of the sick. —विशिख-श्रेणी or विशिखावली (°ख-आव्°), f. a line of arrows.
विशिञ्ज्: विशिञ्ज् वि-शिञ्ज्, cl. 2. A. -शिङ्क्ते, -शिञ्जितुम्, to sound, resound, tinkle.
विशिञ्जान: वि-शिञ्जान, अस्, आ, अम्, sounding, singing, uttering cries; tinkling.
विशित: विशित वि-शित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 1. शि or rt. शो with वि), sharpened, sharp.
विशिप: विशिप विशिप, अम्, n. (in Uṇādi-s. III. 145. said to be fr. rt. 1. विश्), a house; a palace; a temple.
विशिशिप्र: विशिशिप्र विशि-शिप्र, अस्, m. (so divided in the Pada text), Ved. ‘deprived of jaws’ or ‘noseless,’ N. of a person represented in Ṛg-veda V. 45, 6, as conquered by Manu, (Sāy. = विगत-हनु; Sāy. also says that Manu may stand for Indra, and Viśi-śipra may mean Vṛtra.)
विशिष्: विशिष् वि-शिष्, cl. 7. P. -शिनष्टि, -शेष्टुम्, to distinguish, make distinct or different; to particu-larize, specify, define, describe; to excel (with acc.): Pass. -शिष्यते, to be distinguished; to differ or be different from; to be better than or more excellent than (with abl. and sometimes with inst., e. g. मौ-नात् सत्यं विशिष्यते, truth is more excellent than silence; यज्ञैः स्थितिर् विशिष्यते, continuance in duty is better than sacrifices); to be of more weight; to be best: Caus. -शेषयति, -यितुम्, to distinguish, make distinct or different, define.
विशिष्ट: वि-शिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, distinguished, distinct, par-ticular, especial, special, peculiar; having distinctive qualities or exclusive properties; superior, excellent, choice, more excellent, better; distinguished by, en-dowed with, possessed of, having; (अस्), m., N. of Viṣṇu. —विशिष्ट-ता, f. or विशिष्ट-त्व, अम्, n. distinction, individuality, the having distinguishing or characteristic qualities, speciality, peculiarity (of any kind); excellence, superiority, eminence. —वि-शिष्ट-बुद्धि, इस्, f. ‘differenced knowledge,’ dis-tinguishing knowledge (e. g. the knowledge of ‘a man carrying a staff’ which distinguishes him from ‘a man’ indifferently). —विशिष्ट-वर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, having a distinguished colour. —विशिष्टाद्वैत-वा-दिन् (°ट-अद्°), ई, इनी, इ, one who asserts the identity of what is distinct, i. e. of the two distinct things Prakṛti and Puruṣa with Brahma. —विशिष्टोपमा (°ट-उप्°), f. a particular comparison. —विशिष्टोप-मा-युक्त (°ट-उप्°), अम्, n., scil. रूपक, a meta-phor which contains a particular comparison (said to be a variety of the Rūpaka or metaphor general).
विशेष: वि-शेष, अस्, m. the act of distinguishing or dis-criminating, discrimination; difference, distinction, individuality, individual identity (consisting in dis-tinction from every other individual or species), characteristic difference, peculiar mark, special pro-perty, speciality, peculiarity (sometimes at the begin-ning of compounds and to be translated by ‘peculiar,’ ‘special,’ &c., cf. विशेष-गुण); particularity; (in the Vaiśeṣika school of the Nyāya phil.) the eternal distinguishing nature or individual essence of each of the nine Dravyas or substances (i. e. of each of the five atoms of earth, water, fire, air, and mind, and of ether, time, space, and soul; these nine eternal substances are said to be so essentially different that one can never be the other); predicament (in logic); peculiar attribute; (in grammar) a word which de-fines or limits the meaning of another word, (any word in which the general meaning of another word is merged is said to be the Viśeṣa of that word); a distinguishing mark made on the forehead with sandal; species, kind, sort, variety, mode, manner, various method (often at the end of comps., e. g. वृक्ष-विशेष, a kind of tree; तपो-विशेषाः, m. pl. various kinds of penance: and sometimes to be translated by ‘different,’ ‘special,’ e. g. पुरुष-व्°, a different man; दशा-व्°, a special condition); variation, change, alteration for the better, amend-ment; a favourable turn or crisis in sickness; a dis-tinct or different object; a limb, member; distinc-tion, peculiar merit, excellence, superiority; the best of anything (at the end of comps. or even at the beginning, and sometimes to be translated by ‘excel-lent,’ ‘superior,’ e. g. रस-व्°, an excellent juice, cf. प्रसाधन-व्°); a particular figure in rhetoric (said to be of three kinds, cf. विशेषोक्ति, col. 3); N. of the mundane egg; विशेषेण or विशेषात्, ind. especially, particularly, even more. —विशेष-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, peculiarly desirous or amorous. —विशेष-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, making a distinction, dis-tinguishing. —विशेष-गुण, अस्, m. a special or distinct quality, distinguishing property; an object or substance of a single and distinct kind (as soul, time, space, ether, and the atoms of earth, water, fire, air, and mind). —विशेष-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, knowing distinctions, critical, intelligent, wise, dis-criminating, a connoisseur. —विशेष-तस्, ind. espe-cially, particularly, in particular, specifically. —विशे-ष-धर्म, अस्, m. a peculiar or different duty; a special law. —विशेष-पदार्थ (°द-अर्°), अस्, m. (in the Nyāya) the category of particularity. —विशे-ष-प्रतिषेध, अस्, m. a special exception. —वि-शेष-प्रमाण, अम्, n. special authority. —विशे-ष-भावना, f. reflecting on or perceiving differ-ences; (in mathematics) a particular operation in extracting roots, composition by the difference of the products. —विशेष-रमणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, especially delightful, particularly pleasant. —विशेष-लक्षण, अम्, n. any specific or characteristic mark or sign. —विशेष-लिङ्ग, अम्, n. a particular mark, specific property, attribute of a subordinate class. —विशेष-वचन, अम्, n. a special text, different text, special rule or precept. —विशेष-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessed of some distinguishing property, peculiar, excellent, superior, better. —विशेष-विद्वस्, आन्, m. eminently learned, a sage, philosopher. —विशेष-विधि, इस्, m. a special rule or observance, special form. —वि-शेष-व्याप्ति, इस्, f. (in logic) a form of Vyāpti or pervasion, (according to Śabda-k. = प्रतियोगि-व्य-धिकरण-स्वसमानाधिकरणात्यन्ताभावा-प्रतियोगित्व।) —विशेष-शालिन्, ई, इनी, इ, possessing peculiar merit or excellence. —विशेष-शास्त्र, अम्, n. (in grammar) a special rule (= अप-वाद). —वि-शेषातिदेश (°ष-अत्°), अस्, m. a special supplemen-tary rule. —विशेषार्थम् (°ष-अर्°), ind. for the sake of distinction or difference. —विशेषार्थिन् (°ष-अर्°), ई, इनी, इ, seeking for excellence or dis-tinction; particular in searching for (anything). —वि-शेषोक्ति (°ष-उक्°), इस्, f. (in rhetoric) ‘statement of distinction’ or ‘description of excellence,’ (either coupling cause with effect so as to explain any pecu-liar condition or enhancing the beauty of a subject by dwelling upon certain adverse circumstances in spite of which this excellence exists); enumeration of merits, panegyric. —विशेषोच्छ्वसित (°ष-उच्°), अम्, n. the peculiar breath or life (of another), a peculiar treasure (applied to an object especially dear). —विशेषोद्देश (°ष-उद्°), अस्, m. (in the Nyāya) a particular kind of enunciation.
विशेषक: वि-शेषक, अस्, आ, अम्, distinguishing, discrimina-tive, characteristic, attributive; (अस्, अम्), m. n. any distinguishing property or characteristic; an attribute, predicate; a mark on the forehead made with sandal &c. (worn either as an ornament or for sectarial dis-tinction; पत्त्र-विशेषक, strokes or lines drawn on the face with pigments); discriminative faculty or perception; a particular arrangement of poetical composition. —विशेषक-च्छेद्य, अम्, n. a parti-cular form of Tilaka or sectarial mark, (according to Śabda-k. = चतुःषष्टि-कलान्तर्गत-षष्ठ-कला।)
विशेषण: वि-शेषण, अस्, ई, अम्, distinguishing, discrimina-tive, attributive; distinctive (as a property &c.); (अम्), n. the act of distinguishing or discriminating, distinction, discrimination; a distinguishing mark or attribute; a word which particularizes or defines another word, the ‘differencer’ or distinguisher of another word (which other word is called वि-शेष्य, q. v.); an epithet, attribute, adjective; a word used in apposition. —विशेषण-ता, f. the state of a dis-tinguisher or of distinguishing, the being a distin-guishing mark; the being an adjective; individuality. —विशेषणता-सम्बन्ध, अस्, m. the relation of predicability, relation of predicate to subject. —वि-शेषण-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, endowed with discrimi-nation; having a distinguishing attribute. —विशे-षण-वर्ग, अस्, m., N. of a division of the Śabda-ratnāvalī lexicon.
विशेषणीय: वि-शेषणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be distinguished or discriminated; to be marked as different or distinct; to be particularized.
विशेषित: वि-शेषित, अस्, आ, अम्, distinguished, made different or distinct, defined, separated, divided; having as an attribute, distinguished by an attribute; predicated; excellent, superior.
विशेष्य: वि-शेष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be distinguished or dis-criminated; requiring to be defined or determined; distinguished, pre-eminent, principal, primary, chief; (अम्), n. the word to be ‘differenced’ or distin-guished, the thing or object to be particularized or defined by another word (which other word is called विशेषण, q. v.), a substantive, noun, the object or subject of a predicate, (according to some, in these senses, also masc.) —विशेष्य-ता, f. the being to be described or defined; the condition of a substantive.
विशेष्यक: वि-शेष्यक in तद्वद्-विशेष्यक, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to (an object) possessing such an attribute.
विशीर्षन्: विशीर्षन् वि-शीर्षन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. headless, without a head.
विशील: विशील वि-शील, अस्, आ, अम्, ill-behaved, indecorous, immoral; badly conducted, ill-mannered, not observing approved usages.
विशुध्: विशुध् वि-शुध्, cl. 4. P. -शुध्यति, -शोद्-धुम्, to be completely purified or cleansed; to become pure: Caus. -शोधयति, -यितुम्, to purify, cleanse.
विशुद्ध: वि-शुद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, completely purified or cleansed; cleared; clean; pure, free from all vice or fault; pious, virtuous, honest; humble, modest, compliant; rectified, corrected, accurate; (अम्), n. a kind of mystical circle in the body, (see चक्र, cf. विशुद्धि-चक्र।) —विशुद्ध-धिषण, अस्, आ, अम्, having the understanding or mind purified. —विशुद्ध-भाव, अस्, आ, अम्, having a pure mind or disposition, pure-minded. —विशुद्ध-वंश्य, अस्, आ, अम्, of a pure family. —विशुद्ध-सत्त्व-प्रधान, अस्, आ, अम्, chiefly characterized by pure goodness. —विशुद्धात्मन् (°ध-आत्°), आ, आ, अ, having a pure soul, pure-minded, innocent. —विशुद्-धेश्व-तन्त्र (°ध-इश्°), अम्, n., N. of a work.
विशुद्धि: वि-शुद्धि, इस्, f. complete purity; purifying; pu-rification, sanctification, holiness; rectitude, rectifica-tion, correction, correctness, removal of error or doubt; equality, sameness, similarity; (in algebra) a sub-tractive quantity. —विशुद्धि-चक्र, अम्, n. a kind of mystical circle or mark in the body (said by some to be in the region of the throat). —विशुद्धि-भाज्, क्, क्, क्, possessing purity, free from sin or vice, pure.
विशोधन: वि-शोधन, अम्, n. the act of purifying, cleaning, freeing from soil, defect, or sin; expiation; (ई), f. a particular plant or tree (= दन्ती); N. of the capital of Brahmā.
विशोधनीय: वि-शोधनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be purified or cleansed, to be freed from taint or sin; to be rectified or corrected.
विशोधित: वि-शोधित, अस्, आ, अम्, purified, cleansed, freed from soil or taint.
विशोधितव्य: वि-शोधितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, = वि-शोधनीय above.
विशोधिन्: वि-शोधिन्, ई, इनी, इ, purifying, cleaning, clearing; (इनी), f. a particular plant (= नाग-दन्ती). —विशो-धि-ता, f. or विशोधि-त्व, अम्, n. purifying, clean-ing; clearing, freeing from obstructions; rectifying, correcting. —विशोधिनी-वीज, अम्, n. = जय-पाल (according to Śabda-k.).
विशोध्य: वि-शोध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be purified or cleaned, to be freed from taint or fault; to be rectified; (अम्), n. a debt.
विशुभ्: विशुभ् वि-शुभ्, cl. 1. A. -शोभते, -शोभि-तुम्, to shine brightly, be beautiful.
विशुष्: विशुष् वि-शुष्, cl. 4. P. -शुष्यति, -शोष्टुम्, to become very dry, dry up, to become withered: Caus. -शोषयति, -यितुम्, to make dry, dry up, desiccate.
विशुष्क: वि-शुष्क, अस्, आ, अम्, completely dried up, very dry; withered; thirsty.
