XIV. 30), to be flashed: Caus. -स्फारयति, -स्फोरयति, -यितुम्, to cause to tremble, make to quiver or vibrate, draw (a bow); to make to glitter or flash, cause to shine: Pass. of Caus. -स्फार्यते, to be made to quiver or vibrate (as a bow).
विस्फारयत्: वि-स्फारयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to tremble or vibrate, drawing (a bow), drawing to the full stretch.
विस्फारित: वि-स्फारित, अस्, आ, अम्, made to vibrate or trem-ble; twanged or drawn (as a bow-string); shaken; trembling, tremulous, flashing; made open, displayed, manifested, evident, apparent.
विस्फार्यमाण: वि-स्फार्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being drawn or twanged (as a bow-string); being made open or manifest.
विस्फुरत्: वि-स्फुरत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, quivering, throb-bing, trembling; swelling, enlarging; struggling, resisting.
विस्फुरमाण: वि-स्फुरमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, quivering, throbbing, trembling. —विस्फुरमाणौष्ठ (°ण-ओष्°), अस्, आ or ई, अम्, having quivering or trembling lips.
विस्फुरित: वि-स्फुरित, अस्, आ, अम्, quivering, shaken, tre-mulous; swollen, enlarged.
विस्फुर्य: वि-स्फुर्य, ind. (Mahā-bh. Vana-parvan 15639. वि-स्फूर्य), having trembled or quivered, quivering.
विस्फुर्ज्: विस्फुर्ज् वि-स्फुर्ज्, cl. 1. P. -स्फूर्जति, -स्फूर्जितुम्, to roar, resound, thunder.
विस्फूर्जथु: वि-स्फूर्जथु, उस्, m. roaring, resounding, thun-dering, rumbling; a clap of thunder; rolling. —वि-स्फूर्जथु-प्रख्य, अस्, आ, अम्, like or resembling a clap of thunder.
विस्फूर्जित: वि-स्फूर्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, resounded, resounding; (अम्), n. roar, shout; rolling.
विस्फुल्: विस्फुल् वि-स्फुल् (also written वि-ष्फुल्, Pāṇ. VIII. 3, 76; connected with वि-स्फुर्, col. 2), cl. 6. P. -स्फुलति, -स्फुलितुम्, to quiver; to leap about, jump for joy, go merrily.
विस्फुलत्: वि-स्फुलत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, trembling, shaking, quivering; going briskly or merrily; appearing.
विस्फुलिङ्ग: वि-स्फुलिङ्ग, अस्, m. a spark of fire; a sort of poison.
विस्फोट: विस्फोट वि-स्फोट, अस्, आ, m. f. a boil, tumour, pustule; small-pox.
विस्मि: विस्मि वि-स्मि, cl. 1. A. -स्मयते (some-times also P. -स्मयति), -स्मेतुम्, to wonder, be sur-prised; to wonder at, be surprised at (with inst., loc., or acc.); to admire; to be proud of (with inst.): Caus. -स्माययति, -स्मापयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to cause to wonder; to astonish any one (acc.) with anything (inst.).
विस्मय: वि-स्मय, अस्, m. wonder, surprise, amazement, astonishment, admiration; dismay; pride, arrogance; doubt, uncertainty, perplexity; (in the drama) one of the Bhāvas. —विस्मय-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, causing astonishment or admiration. —विस्मयङ्-गम, अस्, आ, अम्, being an object of astonishment, astonishing. —विस्मय-हर्ष-मूल, अस्, आ, अम्, caused by astonishment and joy. —विस्मयाकुल (°य-आक्°), अस्, आ, अम्, bewildered with wonder, amazed, astounded. —विस्मयान्वित (°य-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, filled with wonder, astonished, surprised. —विस्मयाविष्ट (°य-आव्°), अस्, आ, अम्, filled with astonishment or wonder. —विस्मयोत्फुल्ल-नयन or विस्मयोत्फुल्ल-लोचन (°य-उत्°), अस्, आ, अम्, hav-ing eyes wide open or staring with astonishment.
विस्मयत्: वि-स्मयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, wondering, admiring, being surprised, being dismayed.
विस्मयिन्: विस्मयिन्, ई, इनी, इ, astonished, surprised, amazed.
विस्मापन: वि-स्मापन, अम्, n. the act of causing wonder or surprise, exciting astonishment; (अस्, ई, अम्), astonishing, surprising; (अस्), m. illusion, deceit; a city of the Gandharvas (a kind of magical or en-chanted city that appears and disappears unexpect-edly); an epithet of Kāma (god of love).
विस्मित: वि-स्मित, अस्, आ, अम्, astonished, surprised, amazed, wonderstruck, astounded, dismayed, disconcerted, per-plexed; (आ, अम्), f. n. a species of the Ati-dhṛti metre (= मेघ-विस्फूर्जित). —विस्मित-मानस, अस्, आ, अम्, surprised or perplexed in mind. —विस्मि-तानन (°त-आन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having a surprised face.
विस्मिति: वि-स्मिति, इस्, f. astonishment, wonder, surprise.
विस्मेर: वि-स्मेर, अस्, आ, अम्, wondering, astonished, sur-prised.
विस्मृ: विस्मृ वि-स्मृ, cl. 1. P. -स्मरति (ep. also A. -ते), -स्मर्तुम्, to forget, be unmindful of, lose the remembrance of (with acc. or gen.): Pass. -स्मर्यते, Aor. व्य्-अस्मारि, to be forgotten: Caus. -स्मारयति, -यितुम्, to cause to forget.
विस्मरण: वि-स्मरण, अम्, n. the act of forgetting, ob-livion.
विस्मरणीय: वि-स्मरणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be forgotten; worthy of being forgotten.
विस्मरत्: वि-स्मरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, forgetting, losing the remembrance of, unmindful of (anything).
विस्मर्य: वि-स्मर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be forgotten.
विस्मृत: वि-स्मृत, अस्, आ, अम्, forgotten, passed out of the memory or recollection. —विस्मृत-पूर्व-संस्का-र, अस्, आ, अम्, forgetting a former promise or reso-lution. —विस्मृत-संस्कार, अस्, आ, अम्, one who forgets an agreement.
विस्मृति: वि-स्मृति, इस्, f. forgetting, forgetfulness, loss of memory, oblivion.
विस्र: विस्र विस्र, अम्, n. (said to be fr. rt. विस्), a smell like that of raw meat; (आ), f. a particular substance smelling like raw meat (= हपुषा)। —विस्र-गन्धि, इस्, m. ‘smelling like raw meat,’ yellow orpiment. —विस्र-ता, f. or विस्र-त्व, अम्, n. rawness of smell.
विस्रंस्: विस्रंस् वि-स्रंस्, cl. 1. A. -स्रंसते, -स्रं-सितुम्, to fall asunder, fall down, drop; slip off: Caus. -स्रंसयति, -यितुम्, to cause to drop.
विस्रंस: वि-स्रंस, अस्, आ, m. f. falling down, falling asun-der, relaxation, laxness, weakness, debility, decay.
विस्रंसन: वि-स्रंसन, अम्, n. the act of falling; flowing, dropping; loosening, unfastening, untying; a laxative, aperient.
विस्रस्: वि-स्रस्, Ved. = वि-स्रस्त below (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda VIII. 48, 5).
विस्रस् वि-स्रस्। See under वि-स्रंस् above.
विस्रसा: वि-स्रसा, f. decay, decrepitude, weakness, the in-firmity of old age.
विस्रस्त: वि-स्रस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen down, loosened, detached; infirm, weak. —विस्रस्त-हार, अस्, आ, अम्, having the necklace slipped off.
विस्रब्ध: वि-स्रब्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, trusted, confided in; steady, diligent; tame, humble, placid, &c. (See वि-श्रब्ध।)
विस्रम्भ: वि-स्रम्भ, अस्, m. trust, confidence; affection, regard, affectionate solicitation; acquaintance; kill-ing, &c. (See वि-श्रम्भ।)
विस्रम्भिन्: वि-स्रम्भिन्, ई, इणी, इ, trusting, confiding in, &c. (See वि-श्रम्भिन्।)
विस्रु: विस्रु वि-स्रु, cl. 1. P. -स्रवति, -स्रोतुम्, to flow forth or away, flow, stream, trickle, ooze: Caus. -स्रावयति, -यितुम्, to cause to flow forth (as blood &c.).
विस्राव: वि-स्राव, अस्, m. flowing forth, dropping, trickling.
विस्रावण: वि-स्रावण, अम्, n. the act of causing to flow out; bleeding; distilling; a spirit distilled from molasses.
विस्रावणीय: वि-स्रावणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, = वि-स्राव्य below.
विस्रावित: वि-स्रावित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to flow out; bled.
विस्रावितव्य: वि-स्रावितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, = वि-स्राव्य below.
विस्राव्य: वि-स्राव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be made to flow; to be bled, requiring bleeding.
विस्रुत: वि-स्रुत, अस्, आ, अम्, flowed forth, flowed, dropped, flowing; spread, diffused, stretched.
विस्रुति: वि-स्रुति, इस्, f. flowing forth, oozing, flow.
विस्रुह्: विस्रुह् वि-स्रुह्, f. (fr. rt. 1. रुह् or स्रु with वि-स्), Ved. a stream, river, (Sāy. विस्रुहः = नद्यः, Ṛg-veda VI. 7, 6); a plant, (perhaps वि-स्रुहा; according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda V. 44, 3. विस्रुहा = विस्रुहाणाम् = ओषधीनाम्, ‘of plants;’ cf. वीरुध्, वीरुधा।)
विस्वन्: विस्वन् वि-स्वन्, cl. 1. P. -स्वनति, -स्वनि-तुम्, to sound forth, sound, (but see वि-ष्वन्।)
विस्वर: विस्वर वि-स्वर, अस्, आ, अम्, discordant, un-harmonious, unmusical.
विस्वाद: विस्वाद वि-स्वाद, अस्, आ, अम्, tasteless, flavourless, insipid.
विहग: विहग विह-ग, विहङ्-ग, &c. See वि-ह under 1. वि-हा below.
विहन्: विहन् वि-हन्, cl. 2. P. -हन्ति (ep. even cl. 4. P. -हन्यति), -हन्तुम्, to strike apart, separate; to strike down, strike violently, strike; to destroy utterly, kill, destroy; to afflict; to oppose, impede, resist; to strike back, reject, refuse, deny; to hinder, interrupt, obstruct: Caus. -घातयति, -यितुम्, to cause to be killed or destroyed; to afflict, drive into straits.
विहत्: वि-हत्, f. a cow that miscarries from unseasonable gestation.
विहत: वि-हत, अस्, आ, अम्, struck, killed, completely destroyed; hurt; opposed, impeded, resisted; (अस्), m. a Buddhist or Jaina temple.
विहति: वि-हति, इस्, f. striking, killing; defeat; failure; (इस्), m. a friend, companion.
विहनन: वि-हनन, अम्, n. the act of striking; killing outright; hurting, injury; opposition, obstruction, impediment; a bow for cleaning cotton; [cf. तूल-कार्मुक।]
विहर: विहर वि-हर, &c. See under वि-हृ, col. 3.
वि-हर, अस्, m. taking away; expanding, going apart or in different directions, separation, disunion, absence; changing, exchanging.
विहर्ष: विहर्ष वि-हर्ष, अस्, m. excessive joy or gladness, pleasure.
2. वि-हर्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, joyless, mournful.
विहव: विहव वि-हव। See under वि-ह्वे, p. 953.
वि-हव, अस्, m., Ved. an invocation, invitation.
विहव्य: विहव्य वि-हव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be offered; (अस्), m., N. of a descendant of Aṅgiras (author of Ṛg-veda X. 128).
वि-हव्य; add — to be invoked or invited, (in this sense fr. हु = rt. ह्वे।)
विहम्: विहम् वि-हस्, cl. 1. P. -हसति, -हसितुम्, to laugh gently, smile, laugh; to laugh at (with acc.).
विहसत्: वि-हसत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, laughing, smiling.
विहसन: वि-हसन, अम्, n. laughing gently, smiling (= मध्यम-हास्य), laughing.
विहसित: वि-हसित, अस्, आ, अम्, smiled, laughed; smiled at; (अम्), n. a gentle laugh, smile, laugh.
विहस्य: वि-हस्य, ind. having smiled; laughing at, ridi-culing, contemning.
विहस्यमान: वि-हस्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being laughed at, being smiled upon.
विहास: वि-हास, अस्, m. a gentle laugh, smile.
विहस्त: विहस्त वि-हस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, handless, help-less; confounded, perplexed, bewildered; wise, learned.
विहा: विहा 1. वि-हा, cl. 3. A. -जिहीते, &c., Ved. to go apart, (Sāy. वि-जिहीष्व = वि-गच्छ, Ṛg-veda V. 78, 5), become expanded, open, gape open (Lat. dehisco, Gr. χαίνω).
2. वि-हा, ind. (according to Uṇādi-s. IV. 36. fr. 1. वि-हा), heaven, paradise, sky.

विहा 3. वि-हा, cl. 3. P. -जहाति (2nd sing. Impv. वि-जहीहि, Kirāt. XI. 31), -हातुम्, to relin-quish, quit, abandon, leave, give up or lay aside entirely, lose: Caus. -हापयति, -यितुम्, to cause to quit or abandon.
विह: वि-ह (for 2. वि-हा below), the sky, air (only used in comps.). —विह-ग, अस्, m. ‘sky-goer,’ a bird; a cloud; an arrow; the sun; the moon; a planet. —विहगोपघुष्ट (°ग-उप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, resounding with (the notes) of birds, resonant with birds. —विहङ्-ग, अस्, आ, अम्, sky-going, flying, going swiftly; (अस्), m. a bird; a cloud; an arrow; the sun; the moon. —विहङ्-गम, अस्, m. ‘sky-goer,’ a bird; the sun; (आ), f. a pole or yoke for carrying burdens (= भार-यष्टि). —विहङ्ग-राज, अस्, m. ‘king of the birds,’ epithet of Garuḍa (the vehicle of Viṣṇu).
विहङ्गिका: विहङ्गिका, f. a sort of pole or yoke for carrying burdens.
विहायस्: वि-हायस्, आस्, आस्, अस् (probably formed fr. 1. वि-हा above, as 1. धायस् fr. rt. 1. धा), ‘expanding,’ extensive, vast, great (= महत् according to Naigh. III. 3), all-pervading; (Sāy. = विविध-गमन-युक्त); (perhaps) going quickly, impetuous, spirited, active; (आस्, अस्), m. n. the open air, air, space (Gr. χάος), sky, atmosphere; (आस्), m. a bird.
विहायस: वि-हायस, अस्, अम्, m. n. heaven, sky, atmo-sphere; (अस्), m. a bird.
विहायसा: वि-हायसा, ind. (inst. c. of वि-हायस् above), through the sky or air; heaven, sky, atmosphere.
विहापित: वि-हापित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to abandon or give up; made to yield, extorted, given up, given; (अम्), n. gift, donation.
विहाय: वि-हाय, ind. having abandoned or left.
विहीन: वि-हीन, अस्, आ, अम्, entirely abandoned, left, deserted, destitute, bereaved, deprived of, void or devoid of, free from, without. —विहीन-ता, f. the state of being wholly abandoned, abandonment. —वि-हीन-योनि, इस्, इस्, इ, low-born, base-born, brutish.
विहीन वि-हीन। See under 3. वि-हा above.
विहार: वि-हार, अस्, m. taking away, removing; expan-sion, opening; too great expansion of the organs of speech (consisting in too great lengthening or drawl-ing in pronunciation; opposed to सं-हार; cf. व्य्-आस); walking for pleasure or amusement, taking an airing, wandering, roaming, gadding, going about; sporting, play, sport, recreation, pastime, pleasure, relaxation; a pleasure-garden, garden; a Buddhist or Jaina temple or convent (originally the hall where the Buddhist priests met or walked about; afterwards these halls were used as temples, and sometimes be-came the centre of a whole monastic establishment); a temple; the palace of Indra or a banner (= वै-जयन्त?); a palace; N. of a district; the shoulder; a sort of bird, = विन्दु-रेखक; (in Vedic ritual) a term for varying a verse (by taking it to pieces, joining to each of its Pādas a Pāda taken from another verse, and reciting both parts in such a way as if they formed only one verse; cf. व्य्-अतिमर्श). —विहार-गृह, अम्, n. a pleasure-house, play-house, theatre. —विहार-भूमि, इस्, f. ground or place for roaming about, grazing ground, pasturage. —विहार-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, taking pleasure or relax-ation, enjoying one's self.
विहिंस्: विहिंस् वि-हिंस्, cl. 7. 1. P. -हिनस्ति, -हिंसति, -हिंसितुम्, to injure severely, injure, hurt, damage.
विहिंसक: वि-हिंसक, अस्, इका, अम्, injuring, hurting.
विहिंसत्: वि-हिंसत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, injuring, harming, hurt-ing.
विहिंसित: वि-हिंसित, अस्, आ, अम्, injured, hurt, &c.
विहितवत्: विहित-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has performed or undertaken.
विहिति: वि-हिति, इस्, f. action, performance, acting, doing; arrangement.
विहित्रिम: विहित्रिम, अस्, आ, अम्, done according to rule.
विहुत्मती: विहुत्मती वि-हुत्-मती, f. (a Kvip formation fr. rt. हु with prep. वि and affix मत्), a special oblation or offering, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda 1. 134, 6. विहुत्मतीनाम् = विशेषेण होमवती-नाम् or else आह्वानवतीनाम्।)
विहृ: विहृ वि-हृ, cl. 1. P. A. -हरति, -ते, -हर्-तुम्, to take away, remove, destroy; to go in various directions; to walk or roam about or ramble for pleasure, saunter, amuse or divert one's self, sport, (in Ṛg-veda 1. 28, 7. विजर्भृतस् = विशेषेण पुनः पुनर् विहारं कुरुतः); to vary, change, alternate, mix; to spend or pass (time &c.); to live.
विहरण: वि-हरण, अम्, n. the act of taking away or removing, taking; going about for pleasure or exer-cise, rambling, roaming, taking a walk or airing; expatiating; relaxation, pastime, pleasure.
विहरणीय: वि-हरणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be taken away; to be rambled or sported.
विहरत्: वि-हरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, roaming for pleasure, sauntering about, ranging at large.
विहर्तृ: वि-हर्तृ, ता, m. one who takes away, a robber; one who rambles about, rambling, roaming; a roamer.
वि-हर्तृ; add — one who amuses himself.
विहारक: विहारक or विहारिक, अस्, इका, अम्, roaming or walking about, a roamer; belonging to a Buddhist temple or convent.
विहारिन्: विहारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, expanding; taking pleasure or relaxation, wandering or roaming about for pleasure, enjoying one's self; beautiful.
विहृत: वि-हृत, अस्, आ, अम्, expanded; sported, played; taken out, transposed, varied, (in Vedic ritual applied to the transposing of the Pādas in singing the Ṣo-ḍaśī hymns, see वि-हार); (अम्), n. one of the ten blandishments or feminine modes of indicating love, hesitation or reluctance to avow feelings to a lover, (some of the others are लीला, ललित, कुट्टमित, मोट्टायित, वि-च्छित्ति, किल-किञ्चित, &c., q. q. v. v.)
विहृति: वि-हृति, इस्, f. taking away; opening, expansion; sport, pastime, pleasure.
विहृत्य: वि-हृत्य, ind. having opened or spread out, having expanded; having roamed about or sported, having rambled, having disported.
विहेठ: विहेठ वि-हेठ, अस्, m. (see rt. हेठ्), hurt, injury; the act of afflicting or harassing.
विहेठक: वि-हेठक, अस्, m. an injurer, one who inflicts pain or injury on another; a reviler.
विहेठन: वि-हेठन, अम्, n. the act of injuring, hurting, wounding, killing; afflicting, distressing; rubbing, grinding; injury, harm, pain, sorrow, affliction.
विह्रु: विह्रु वि-ह्रु (ह्रु = ह्वृ, cf. वि-ह्वृ below), cl. 9. P. -ह्रुणाति, &c., Ved. to injure, hurt, destroy, (Sāy. वि-ह्रुणाति = वि-ह्वरति, Ṛg-veda I. 166, 12.)
विह्रुत: वि-ह्रुत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. injured, hurt, spoiled [cf. अ-व्°]; fractured, dissevered, (Sāy. = वि-च्छिन्न, वि-बाधित।)
विह्लण: विह्लण विह्लण, अस्, m., N. of a native of Kaśmīra (author of the following poem). —विह्लण-काव्य, अम्, n. ‘the poem of Vihlaṇa,’ N. of a poem (containing the Caura-pañcāśikā, said to have been recited when Vihlaṇa was on the point of being put to death by king Vīra-siṃha, whose daughter he had secretly espoused).
विह्वल्: विह्वल् वि-ह्वल्, cl. 1. P. -ह्वलति, -ह्वलि-तुम्, to shake or move about, stagger, tremble, be agitated.
विह्वल: वि-ह्वल, अस्, आ, अम्, shaking about, agitated, alarmed, perturbed, disquieted, confused, overcome with fear, beside one's self, delirious; distressed, afflicted; languishing; desponding; fused, liquid. —विह्वल-ता, f. or विह्वल-त्व, अम्, n. agitation, perturbation, consternation, anxiety. —विह्वली-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, made confused or agitated; fused, liquid.
विह्वलत्: विह्वलत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, trembling, agitated.
विह्वलित: वि-ह्वलित, अस्, आ, अम्, agitated, alarmed, stag-gering.
विह्वृ: विह्वृ वि-ह्वृ, cl. 1. P. -ह्वरति, -ह्वर्तुम्, Ved. to be crooked, curved; to hurt (?).
विह्वे: विह्वे वि-ह्वे, cl. 1. P. A. -ह्वयति, -ते, &c., to call upon, invoke, worship.
वी: वी 1. वी, cl. 2. P. वेति (2nd sing. Impv. वीहि, 3rd pl. व्यन्तु), विवाय, वेष्यति, अवैषीत्, वेतुम्, to go, move; to go towards, ap-proach, (in Ṛg-veda I. 77, 2. वेः 2nd sing. Impf. = वेति = गच्छति); to pervade; to bring, convey, offer; to attain, obtain, accept; to conceive, become pregnant, engender, bring forth; to desire, love, wish for, (according to Nirukta IX. 42, 43. वीताम् = पि-बताम् or कामयेताम्); to eat, enjoy, consume, partake of (with gen. or acc.); to send, throw, hurl, cast; to drive (in this sense regarded as a substitute for rt. अज्): Pass. or cl. 4. A. वीयते, to be gone, &c.: Caus. वाययति, -यितुम्, Aor. अवीवयत्, to cause to go or approach; to cause to obtain or accept; to cause to eat or partake of; to cause to desire or love; to cause to conceive (in this sense also वापयति): Desid. विवीषति: Intens. वेवीयते, वेवयीति, वेवेति, (see also वेवी); [cf. Gr. οἴσω, οἴαξ, οἰήϊον; Lat. in-vītus, in-vitare.]

2. वी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, Ved. going, moving, (according to Sāy. वेः = गन्त्र्याः, Ṛg-veda III. 5, 5); pervad-ing, extensive, (Sāy. = व्याप्त, Ṛg-veda IV. 5, 8); (ईस्), f. the act of going, motion; covering. (For वी, ‘a bird,’ see under 2. वि, p. 908.)

वी 3. वी (वि-इ), cl. 2. P. व्य्-एति (3rd pl. वि-यन्ति), Impf. व्य्-ऐत्, Perf. वीयाय, व्य्-एतुम् (for व्ययति, व्यययति, see व्यय्), to go apart or in different directions; to go or extend in every direc-tion, to be diffused or scattered, become distributed or divided; to go away, disappear, vanish, be lost; to go through, traverse: cl. 4. A. वीयते, to go apart or away, &c., (Sāy. वीयसे = गच्छसि, Ṛg-veda IX. 86, 37; according to some वीयसे is an Intens. form.)
वीक: वीक, अस्, m. (according to Uṇādi-s. III. 47. fr. वी, a substitute for rt. अज्), a bird; air, wind; the mind.
वीत: 1. वीत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone, approached; led round the sacrificial fire (said of a horse, Ṛg-veda 1. 162, 15); accepted, acceptable, approved, liked, loved; desired, wished for, beautiful (Ved.); tranquil, quiet, tame, unfit for war; (अस्), m. a horse or elephant untrained or unfit for war; (अम्), n. the goading of an elephant. —वीत-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. most acceptable, (Sāy. = अतिशयेन कान्त, Ṛg-veda VII. 1, 18.) —वीत-पृष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having beautiful backs (said of horses, Sāy. = कान्त-पृष्-ठ, Ṛg-veda I. 162, 7). —वीत-वार, अस्, आ, अम् (see 2. वार), Ved. having a handsome tail, (Sāy. = क्रान्त-बल, प्राप्त-बल, Ṛg-veda VIII. 46, 23.)

2. वीत, अस्, आ, अम् (for 3. वीत see under rt. व्ये), gone away, departed, disappeared; set free, loosed, let go, exempt, freed from, devoid of. —वीत-कल्-मष, अस्, आ, अम्, freed from taint or sin. —वीत-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, free from desire. —वीत-घृण, अस्, आ, अम्, one from whom mercy has departed, merciless. —वीतघृण-ता, f. mercilessness. —वीत-जन्म-जरस, अस्, आ, अम्, not subject to birth or old age. —वीत-दम्भ, अस्, आ, अम्, free from pride, not proud, humble, lowly. —वीत-भय, अस्, आ, अम्, fearless, undaunted; (अस्), m. epithet of Viṣṇu. —वीत-भी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, free from fear, intrepid. —वीत-मत्सर, अस्, आ, अम्, free from envy, free from passion. —वीत-मन्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, exempt or free from sorrow; free from resentment or anger. —वीत-मल, अस्, आ, अम्, free from obscurity or darkness, clear, pure. —वीत-मोह, अस्, आ, अम्, freed from illusion. —वीत-राग, अस्, आ, अम्, having the passions gone, free from passions or affections, dispassionate, devoid of desire, calm, tranquil; colourless, bleached; (अस्), m. a sage with subdued passions; a deified Buddhist or Jaina saint. —वीत-राग-स्तुति, इस्, f., N. of a work. —वीत-विरुद्ध-बुद्धि, इस्, इस्, इ, one whose hostile feelings have passed away, without hostile intentions, peaceable. —वीत-शङ्क, अस्, आ, अम्, freed from fear, fearless. —वीत-शोक, अस्, आ, अम्, free from care or sorrow; (अस्), m. the Aśoka tree, Jonesia Aśoka. —वीत-शोक-भयाबाध (°य-आब्°), अस्, आ, अम्, free from the disturbance of sorrow and fear. —वीत-स्पृह, अस्, आ, अम्, free from wish or desire. —वीत-हव्य, अस्, m., N. of a descendant of Aṅgiras (author of the hymn Ṛg-veda VI. 15); of a king. —वीतोच्चय-बन्ध (°त-उच्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having the fastening of the knot gone, (Kirāt. VIII. 51.) —वीतोत्तर (°त-उत्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having no answer, unable or disinclined to reply; (अम्), ind. without answering.
वीत वीत, वीति, &c. See p. 953, col. 2.
3. वीत, अस्, आ, अम् (for 1. and 2. वीत see p. 953, col. 2), covered, clothed, put on, worn. —वीत-सू-त्र, अम्, n. the sacred thread or cord; [cf. नि-वीत, उप-वीत।]
वीति: वीति, इस्, f. going, moving, motion; engendering, producing; eating, food, (वीती, Ved. inst. = वीत्या, ‘with food,’ Ṛg-veda VI. 16, 46); enjoyment; cleaning, cleansing; light, lustre; (इस्), m. a horse. —वीति-होत्र, अस्, m., N. of Agni or fire; of the sun; of a son of Priya-vrata; of a son of Tāla-jaṅgha; (अस्, आ, अम्), Ved. one who offers the sacrificial meal to the gods; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a sect of fire-worshippers; of a branch of the Haihaya tribe. —वीति-होत्रक, अस्, m., N. of Agni or fire; of the sun.
व्यत्: व्यत्, अन्, अती, अत्, going, moving, &c., (Sāy. व्यन्तः = गच्छन्तः, Ṛg-veda VI. 1, 4.)
व्यत् व्यत्। See under rt. 1. वी, p. 953.
वीकाश: 2. वी-काश, अस्, m. (for 2. वि-काश), absence of manifestation; solitude, privacy.
वीक्ष्: वीक्ष् वीक्ष् (वि-ईक्ष्), cl. 1. A. वीक्षते (ep. also P. -ति), वीक्षितुम्, to see, behold, view, ob-serve, look at, consider, regard, discern, (हृदि वीक्ष्, to see in the heart, ponder); to look upon as, regard as (e. g. पितृ-वद् वीक्ष्, to look upon as a father): Pass. वीक्ष्यते, to be seen; to look like, appear, seem.
वीक्ष: वीक्ष, अस्, आ, m. f. sight, gazing at, seeing, investigation; (अम्), n. surprise, astonishment; any visible object. —वीक्षापन्न (°ष-आप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, one who experiences surprise, astonished, sur-prised.
वीक्षण: वीक्षण, अम्, आ, n. f. the act of seeing or observing, looking at, sight.
वीक्षणीय: वीक्षणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, visible, perceptible, ob-servable.
वीक्षमाण: वीक्षमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, seeing, looking at, ob-serving, regarding.
वीक्षित: वीक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, seen, viewed, beheld, re-garded, considered; (अम्), n. a look, glance, sight.
वीक्ष्य: 1. वीक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, visible, perceptible; to be gazed at, astonishing, wonderful; (अम्), n. any visible object, anything to be gazed at; wonder, surprise; (अस्), m. a dancer, actor; a horse.
2. वीक्ष्य, ind. having seen or viewed, having considered.
वीक्ष्यमाण: वीक्ष्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being seen or beheld, being gazed at.
वीङ्ख्: वीङ्ख् वीङ्ख् (वि-इङ्ख्), Caus. वीङ्खयति, यितुम्, to toss to and fro (trans.).
वीङ्खा: वीङ्खा, f. going, moving, proceeding, progress, locomotion; a particular mode of moving; dancing; one of a horse's paces; cowach, Carpopogon Pruriens (= शूक-शिम्बी); = सन्धि (according to Śabda-k.).
वीङ्ग्: वीङ्ग् वीङ्ग् (वि-इङ्ग्), cl. 1. P. वीङ्गति, वीङ्-गितुम्, Ved. to move to and fro, oscillate.
वीङ्गित: वीङ्गित, अस्, आ, अम्, moved to and fro.
वीचयन: वीचयन वी-चयन, अम्, n. (for वि-चयन, see under 3. वि-चि, p. 914), research, inquiry.
वीचि: वीचि वीचि, इस्, m. f. (according to Uṇādi-s. IV. 72. fr. rt. वे), a wave, small wave, ripple; in-constancy, thoughtlessness; pleasure, delight, happi-ness; leisure, interval, rest; a ray of light; small, little. —वीचि-क्षोभ, अस्, m. agitation or roughness of waves. —वीचि-मालिन्, ई, m. ‘wave-garlanded,’ the ocean.
वीची: वीची, f. = वीचि above. —वीची-तरङ्ग-न्याय, अस्, m. wave-undulation-method, (according to the Bhā-ṣā-pariccheda 166 and Siddhānta-muktāvalī, p. 103, the cause of the production of sound in the ear.)
वीज्: वीज् वीज् [cf. rt. 1. विज्], cl. 1. A. वीजते, वीजितुम्, to go; cl. 10. P. वीजयति, यितुम् (perhaps a Nom. fr. व्यज, q. v.), to fan, cool by blowing upon or fanning: Pass. वीज्यते, to be fanned; [cf. Lat. vigeo.]
वीजन: वीजन, अम्, n. fanning, the being fanned; a fan [cf. व्यजन]; a thing, substance; (अस्), m. a sort of pheasant; the ruddy goose.
वीजित: 1. वीजित, अस्, आ, अम्, fanned, cooled by fanning.
2. वीजित, अस्, आ, अम्, sown with seed, sown with, having for seed.
वीज्यमान: वीज्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being fanned, fanned.
वीज: वीज वीज, अम्, n. (in the older language frequently written बीज; perhaps fr. rt. जन् with वि; according to some connected with rt. 1. वी), seed (of plants &c.), seed-corn, grain; semen virile; (perhaps also) quicksilver; marrow; any germ, ele-ment, beginning, cause, source, primary cause or principle, origin; the germ or origin of any compo-sition (as of a poem, of the plot of a drama, of a magical formula, &c.); calculating primary causes, analysis, algebra; truth, divine truth (as the seed or cause of being); the mystical letter or syllable which forms the essential part of the Mantra of any deity; receptacle, place of deposit; a particular correction in astronomy; (अस्), m. = वीजक, the citron tree. —वीज-कर्तृ, ता, m. ‘producer of seed,’ epithet of Śiva. —वीज-काण्ड-प्ररोहिन्, ई, इणी, इ, or वीज-काण्ड-रुह, अस्, आ, अम्, springing from a seed or from the (slip or portion taken from a) stalk. —वीज-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, producing semen; (त्), n. an aphro-disiac. —वीज-कोश or वीज-कोष, अस्, m. a seed-vessel, the pericarp of a flower; the seed-vessel of the lotus; (ई), f. a pod, legume. —वीज-क्रिया, f. the operation of analysis, elemental or algebraic solution. —वीज-गणित, अम्, n. calculation of pri-mary causes, causal calculus, analysis, algebra; N. of a treatise on algebra. —वीज-गर्भ, अस्, m. the plant Trichosanthes Diœca. —वीज-गुप्ति, इस्, f. ‘seed-protection,’ a pod, legume. —वीज-तस्, ind. from seed, according to the seed. —वीज-त्व, अम्, n. the being an origin or cause, causality. —वीज-दर्शक, अस्, m. ‘explainer of the germ or plot of a play,’ a play-director, stage-manager. —वीज-धानी, f., N. of a river. —वीज-धान्य, अम्, n. coriander. —वीज-न्यास, अस्, m. (in dramatic language) laying down or making known the germ or plot of a play. —वीज-पादप, अस्, m. the plant Semecarpus Anacardium (= भल्लातक). —वीज-पुर, incorrect for वीज-पूर. —वीज-पुरुष, अस्, m. the progenitor of a tribe or family. —वीज-पुष्प, अम्, n. common citron; a thorny plant, Vangueria Spinosa (= म-रुवक). —वीज-पुष्पिका, f. a sort of grain, An-dropogon Saccharatus. —वीज-पूर or वीज-पूरक, अस्, m. ‘seed-filling,’ common citron; a variety of citron, Citrus Medica; (अम्), n. the fruit of the citron. —वीज-पूर्ण, अस्, m. ‘seed-filled,’ epithet of the common citron (= छोलङ्ग); Citrus Medica. —वीज-पेशिका, f, ‘seed-sheath,’ the scrotum. —वीज-प्रद, अस्, आ, अम्, yielding seed, sowing seed, &c.; generating; (अस्), m. a generator. —वीज-प्रबोध, अस्, m., N. of a commentary on the Vīja-gaṇita. —वीज-प्ररोह, अस्, आ, अम्, or वीज-प्ररोहिन्, ई, इणी, इ, growing from seed. —वीज-फलक, अस्, m. the plant Citurs Medica; a citron or lemon. —वीज-मति, इस्, f. (in algebra) a mind capable of analysis, penetration of causes or principles, causal sagacity. —वीज-मन्त्र, अम्, n. epithet of a mystical syllable with which a Mantra or magical formula commences. —वीज-मातृका, f. the pericarp or seed-vessel of the lotus. —वीज-मात्र, अम्, n. only as much as is required for seed, only what is required for the procreation of offspring or for the preservation of a family; epithet of the ninth Maṇḍala of the Ṛg-veda. —वीज-मुक्तावली, f., N. of a work. —वीज-यज्ञ, अस्, m. ‘seed-offering,’ N. of a particular allegorical sacrifice or offering. —वीज-रत्न, अस्, m. ‘having gems of seeds,’ a kind of bean. —वीज-रुह, अस्, आ, अम्, growing from seed; (अस्), m. grain, corn. —वीज-रेचन, अम्, n. Croton Jamalgota (= जय-पाल). —१। वीज-वत्, ind. like seed. —२। वीज-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessing seed, furnished or pro-vided with seed; provided with grain. —वीज-व-पन, अम्, n. the act of sowing seed. —वीज-वर, अस्, m. ‘best of grains,’ a kidney-bean, Phaseolus Radiatus. —वीज-वाप, अस्, m. a sower of seed; the act of sowing seed. —वीज-वापिन्, ई, m. ‘sowing seed,’ a sower. —वीज-वाहन, अस्, m. ‘seed-bearer,’ N. of Śiva. —वीज-वृक्ष, अस्, m. the plant Ter-minalia Tomentosa. —वीज-सञ्चय, अस्, m. a heap or collection of seed or grain. —वीज-सू, ऊस्, f. ‘bringing forth seed,’ the earth. —वीज-सेक्तृ, ता, m. a sprinkler of seed, procreator, progenitor. —वीज-हरा or वीज-हारिणी, f. ‘taking away seed,’ epithet of a witch (a daughter of Duḥsaha). —वीजा-कृत, see below. —वीजाक्षर (°ज-अक्°), अम्, n. the first syllable of a magical formula, the syllable at the commencement of a Mantra or form of prayer. —वीजाङ्कुर (°ज-अङ्°), अस्, m. a sprout or first shoot from a seed, seed-shoot, seed-lobe, cotyledon, seedling; (औ), m. du. seed and shoot, seed and blade. —वीजाङ्कुर-वत्, ind. (in phil.) like the (continuous succession of) seed and shoot. —वीजा-ढ्य (°ज-आढ्°), अस्, आ, अम्, abounding in seed; (अस्), m. = वीज-पूर. —वीजाध्यक्ष (°ज-अध्°), अस्, m. ‘presiding over seed,’ epithet of Śiva. —वीजापहा-रिणी (°ज-अप्°), f. = वीज-हरा. —वीजाभिधान (°ज-अभ्°), अम्, n., N. of a Tantra work. —वीजाम्ल (°ज-अम्°), अम्, n. = वृक्षाम्ल. —वीजार्णव-तन्त्र (°ज-अर्°), अम्, n., N. of a Tantra work. —वीजाश्व (°ज-अश्°), अस्, m. ‘seed-horse,’ an entire horse, stallion. —वीजोत्कृष्ट (°ज-उत्°), अम्, n. good seed. —वीजोदक (°ज-उद्°), अम्, n. ‘seed-water, grain-like water,’ hail. —वीजोप्ति (°ज-उप्°), इस्, f. sowing seed. —वीजोप्ति-चक्र, अम्, n. a kind of astrological diagram shaped like a serpent for indicating good or bad luck following on the sowing of seed. —वीजोप्ति-विधि, इस्, m. the manner of sow-ing seed.
वीजक: वीजक, अम्, n. seed; = वीज above (at the end of comps.); (अस्), m. common citron, Citrus Medica (= मातुलङ्ग); a citron or lemon; Terminalia Tomentosa (= पीत-शाल); the position of the arm of a child at birth; N. of a poet.
वीजल: वीजल, अस्, आ, अम्, furnished with seed or grain, seedy.
वीजा: वीजा, ind. by or with seed, sowing with seed. —वीजा-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, &c., to sow with seed, sow; to harrow over after sowing. —वीजा-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, sown with seed, sown; harrowed or ploughed over after sowing.
वीजिक: वीजिक, अस्, आ, अम्, seedy, abounding in seeds; see Gaṇa Kumud-ādi to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 80.
वीजिन्: वीजिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having or possessing seed, bearing seed, seedy; being of the race or blood of (at the end of a comp., cf. राज-व्°); (ई), m. a real proge-nitor (as opposed to क्षेत्रिन्, the nominal father or merely the husband of a woman, Manu IX. 51 sq.); a procreator, father (in general); the sun.
वीज्य: वीज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, sprung or produced from seed; sprung from or belonging to any family; of a good family (at the end of a comp.).
वीटा: वीटा वीटा, f. a small piece of wood shaped like a barley-corn and about a span long, (it was struck with a stick or bat in a kind of game, like hockey, played by boys; according to others the वीटा was a metal ball of some kind; see Mahā-bh. Ādi-p. 5050, Schol.)
वीटि: वीटि वीटि, इस्, or वीटिका or वीटी, f. (said to be fr. rt. इट् with वि), the betel plant, Piper Betel (= ताम्बूल-वल्लिका); a preparation of the Areca nut with spices and chunam enveloped in a leaf of the betel plant, betel, Pān; a tie, fastening; [cf. वेत्र, वेतस; cf. also Gr. ἴ-τυ-ς, ἰ-τέα; Lat. vi-tex, vitta, vi-men, vi-ti-s; Old Germ. wi-d, wi-da; Angl. Sax. widde.]
वीडु: वीडु वीडु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. strong, firm, &c., see वीऌउ. —वीडु-जम्भ, &c., see वीऌउ-जम्भ। —वीड्व्-अङ्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having strong limbs, firm in body.
वीणा: वीणा वीणा, f. (in Uṇādi-s. III. 15. said to be fr. rt. 1. वी), the Vīṇā or Indian lute, (an instru-ment of the guitar kind, supposed to have been invented by Nārada, q. v., usually having seven wires or strings raised upon nineteen frets or supports fixed on a long rounded board, towards the ends of which are two large gourds; its compass is said to be two octaves, but it has many varieties according to the number of strings, &c.); lightning. —वीणा-दण्ड, अस्, m. ‘lute-stick,’ the neck or long rounded board of a lute. —वीणानुबन्ध (°णा-अन्°), अस्, m. the tie of a lute or lower part of one of its ends where the wires are fixed (sometimes called ‘the tail-piece’). —वीणा-भिद्, त्, f. a kind of lute, (वीणा-भिदां विवेक, description of the different kinds of lutes.) —वीणा-वाद or वीणा-वादक, अस्, m. a player on the Vīṇā, a lutanist. —वीणास्य (°णा-आस्°), अस्, m. ‘lute-faced,’ epithet of Nārada (the son of Brahmā and inventor of the Vīṇā described above).
वीणिन्: वीणिन्, ई, इनी, इ, furnished with lutes, a player on a lute.
वीतंस: वीतंस वी-तंस, अस्, m. (for वि-तंस, q. v.), a cage, a chain or net for confining birds or beasts; an enclosure for taming birds or animals, an aviary, menagerie; a place for keeping or preserving game, preserve.
वीतन: वीतन वीतन, औ, m. du. (possibly con-nected with वि-तन्), the sides or cartilages of the larynx or throat (= कृक-पार्श्व-द्वय).
वीथि: वीथि वीथि, इस्, or वीथी, f. (probably fr. rt. 1. वी or 3. वी), a row, line; a road; a terrace in front of a house; a stall, shop; a sort of drama (or the dramatic narration of an amatory intrigue, said to be in one act and to be performed by one or two play-ers); (इस्), f. a particular division of the planetary sphere (comprising three asterisms). —वीथ्य्-अङ्ग, अम्, n. a division or constituent part of the dramatic entertainment called Vīthi, (it is described as a kind of dialogue consisting in quibble, equivoque, jest, abuse, and the like.)
वीथिका: वीथिका, f. = वीथि, a road, &c.; a hall.
वीध्र: वीध्र वीध्र, अस्, आ, अम् (according to Uṇādi-s. II. 26. fr. rt. इन्ध् with वि), clear, clean, pure; (अम्), n. the sky, atmosphere; wind; fire; [cf. Gr. αἰθρία.]
वीन्: वीन् वीन् (वि-इन्), cl. 8. P. वीनोति, &c., Ved. to cause to go out, drive away, remove, scatter, dis-perse, (Sāy. = विविधं गमयति); to send forth in various ways, (Sāy. = विविधम् प्रेरयति); to bestow.
वीना: वीना वीना, f., N. of a river.
वीनाह: वीनाह वीनाह, अस्, m. = वि-नाह, the top or cover of a well.
वीन्व्: वीन्व् वीन्व् (वि-इन्व्), cl. 1. P. वीन्वति, &c., = वीन् above.
वीप्सा: वीप्सा वीप्सा, f. (fr. the Desid. of व्य्-आप्, q. v.), ‘the desire of pervading (with any property or quality simultaneously or continuously),’ several or successive order or series, the arrangement of things or properties in regular succession or each by each, repetition, the repetition of words to imply continu-ous or successive action (e. g. वृक्षं वृक्षं सिञ्चति, he waters tree after tree; प्रभुर् भूतम् भूतम् अभि सर्व-प्राणिष्व् अस्ति, the supreme being is in all living beings creature after creature; cf. Pāṇ. VIII. 1, 4).
वीबुकोश: वीबुकोश वीबुकोश, अस्, m. (?), a cowri.
वीभ्: वीभ् वीभ् (= rt. चीभ्), cl. 1. A. वीभते, वीभितुम्, to boast.
वीर्: वीर् 1. वीर् (वि-ईर्), Caus. वीरयति (Impf. -ऐरयत्, Aor. Ved. -ऐरत्), -यितुम्, Ved. to scatter or drive in various directions; to split into pieces, break, divide asunder, break open, (Sāy. व्य्-ऐरत् = उद्घा-टित-वत्, Ṛg-veda II. 15, 8.)
वीर् 2. वीर्, cl. 10. P. (perhaps to be re-garded as a Nom. fr. वीर below), वीर-यति, -यितुम्, to be powerful or valiant; to make heroic effort, display heroism, act like a hero.
वीर: वीर, अस्, आ, अम् (according to Uṇādi-s. II. 13. fr. वी substituted for rt. अज्; according to some perhaps for an original वार, fr. rt. वृ), heroic, mighty, powerful, strong, robust, excellent, eminent; (अस्), m. a hero, brave man, warrior, champion, eminent man; the last Jina or Jaina pontiff of the present era; an actor; heroism (as one of the eight Rasas which give to poetic and dramatic composition its flavour or taste; the Rasa of heroism is said to be displayed by munificence, clemency, and valour; the Vīra-carita, q. v., exhibits an example of this Rasa); the flower Nerium Odorum; fire; sacrificial fire [cf. वीर-हन्]; (आ), f. the wife of a hero; a wife, mother, matron; a sort of perfume (commonly called Murā); a medicinal root (= क्षीर-काकोली); the plant Fla-courtia Cataphracta; the drug Elabāluka; the plantain tree; a sort of Asclepias, Asclepias Rosea; opposite-leaved fig-tree; Convolvulus Paniculatus (the white and dark kinds); the tree Gmelina Arborea; an aloe; the plant called Atis; spirituous liquor or a particular kind of it; N. of a river; (अम्), n. a reed, Arundo Tibialis; the root of ginger (?); pepper; rice-gruel; the root of Costus Speciosus; the root of Andropogon Muricatus; [cf. probably Gr. ἥρω-ς, Ἥρα, Ἡρακλῆς, εἰρήν; Lat. vir; Goth. vair; Angl. Sax. wer; Lith. vyra-s.] —वीर-कर्म, अम्, n., Ved. hero-forming (seed). —वीर-कीट, अस्, m. ‘worm of a hero,’ a pitiful warrior. —वीर-केशरिन्, ई, m., N. of a king. —वीरङ्-करा, f., N. of a river. —वीर-चरित or वीर-चरित्र, अम्, n. ‘exploits of the hero,’ N. of a celebrated drama by Bhava-bhūti (= महा-वीर-चरित, q. v.). —वीर-जयन्तिका, f. a kind of dance performed by soldiers after a victory or on going to battle, a war-dance; war, battle. —वीर-तन्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a Tantra work. —वीर-तर, अस्, आ, अम्, bolder; (अस्), m. a great hero; an arrow; a corpse (?); (अम्), n. = वीरण, Andropogon Muri-catus. —वीरतरासन (°र-आस्°), अम्, n. a particular posture. —वीर-तरु, उस्, m. the tree Pentaptera Arjuna; the shrub Barleria Longifolia. —वीर-ता, f. or वीर-त्व, अम्, n. heroism. —वीर-धन्वन्, आ, m. ‘having a powerful bow,’ epithet of Kāma-deva (god of love). —वीरन्-धर, अस्, m. a peacock; fighting with wild beasts; a leather cuirass or jacket; N. of a river. —वीर-पट्ट, अस्, m. a kind of mili-tary dress or war accoutrement. —वीर-पत्त्रा, f. a kind of plant (= वि-जया); N. of a river (Ved.). —वी-र-पत्नी, f. the wife of a hero. —वीर-पर्ण, अम्, n. a particular drug (= सुर-पर्ण). —वीर-पाण or वीर-पान, अम्, n. the drink of warriors, (taken, before or during a battle, for refreshment or to raise the courage.) —वीर-पाण्ड्य, अस्, m., N. of a king. —वीर-पुष्पी, f. a kind of plant (= सिन्दूर-पुष्-पी). —वीर-पेशस्, आस्, m., Ved. a vigorous frame, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda IV. 11, 3. the masc. is used for the neut.) —वीर-प्रजायिनी, f. the mo-ther of a hero. —वीर-प्रजावती, f. the mother of a hero. —वीर-प्रसवा, f. a woman who brings forth heroes. —वीर-बाहु, उस्, m. ‘strong-armed,’ N. of Viṣṇu; of a king. —वीर-भद्र, अस्, m. a distinguished hero; an Ava-tāra or son of Śiva, (in the Vāyu-Purāṇa he is said to have been created from Śiva's mouth in order to spoil the sacrifice of Dakṣa, and is described as having a thousand heads, a thou-sand eyes, a thousand feet, and wielding a thousand clubs; his appearance is fierce and terrific, he is clothed in a tiger's skin dripping with blood, and he bears a blazing bow and battle-axe; in another Purāṇa he is described as produced from a drop of Śiva's sweat; this form of Śiva is said to be more especially wor-shipped in the Marāṭha country); N. of one of the Rudras; of an author; a horse fit for the Aśva-medha sacrifice; a fragrant grass (= वीरण). —वीर-भद्रक, अम्, n. the fragrant grass Andropogon Muricatus. —वीर-भानु, उस्, m., N. of a king; of a work. —वीर-भार्या, f. the wife of a hero. —वीर-भुक्ति, N. of a place, (probably for तीर-भुक्ति।) —वीर-भूपति, इस्, m., N. of the patron of Cauṇḍapācārya. —वीर-मातृ, ता, f. the mother of a hero. —वीर-मुकुन्द-देव, अस्, m., N. of a king (the patron of Mārkaṇḍeya-kavīndra). —वीर-मुद्रिका, f. an ornament or ring worn on the middle toe. —वीर-रजस्, अस्, n. red lead, minium (= सिन्-दूर). —वीर-रस, अस्, m. the Rasa of heroism, (see रस।) —वीर-रेणु, उस्, m., N. of Bhīma-sena. —वीर-लोक, अस्, m. ‘hero-world,’ region of warriors or champions. —वीर-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, abounding in heroes, having a champion or hero; accompanied with heroes or progeny; (अती), f. a woman whose husband is liv-ing; a particular fragrant plant (= मांस-रोहिणी); N. of a river. —वीर-वत्सा, f. the mother of a hero. —वीर-वर, अस्, m. a proper N. —वीर-वामन, अस्, m., N. of an author. —वीर-विप्लावक, अस्, m. ‘disturber of the sacrificial fire,’ a Brāhman who performs oblations with money procured from the lowest or Śūdra caste. —वीर-विरुद, N. of a kind of artificial verse; [cf. शूर-श्लोक।] —वीर-वृक्ष, अस्, m. the marking-nut plant, Semecarpus Anacardium; the tree Pentaptera Arjuna; a sort of grain, Andro-pogon or Holcus Sorghum. —वीर-शय्या, f. a parti-cular posture; [cf. वीर-स्थान।] —वीर-शुष्म, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having heroic or mighty strength, very powerful or efficacious. —वीर-श्रेष्ठ, अस्, m. a matchless hero. —वीर-समन्वित, अस्, आ, अम्, attended or accompanied by heroes. —वीर-सिंह, अस्, m., N. of a king of Gūrjara; of the author of the Durgā-bhakti-taraṅgiṇī. —वीर-सिंह-देव, अस्, m., N. of the patron of Mitra-miśra. —वीर-सू, ऊस्, f. ‘hero-bearing,’ the mother of a hero; the mother of a male child. —वीर-सेन, अस्, m. ‘having an army of heroes,’ N. of the father of Nala; (अम्), n., N. of a particular plant (= आरुक). —वीरसेन-ज or वीरसेन-सुत, अस्, m. ‘son of Vīra-sena,’ epithet of Nala (a celebrated prince, hero of several well-known poems and episodes, as the Nalopākhyāna, Naiṣadha, Nalodaya, &c.). —वीर-सैन्य, अम्, n. garlic. —वीर-सोम, अस्, m., N. of the author of the Hasti-vaidyaka. —वीर-स्कन्ध, अस्, m. ‘having powerful shoul-ders,’ a buffalo. —वीर-स्थान, अम्, n. a particular posture (practised by ascetics; cf. वीरासन). —वीर-हण, अस्, ई, अम्, hero-killing. —वीर-हत्या, f. the killing of a man, murder of a son, (Manu XI. 41.) —वीर-हन्, आ, m. ‘destroyer of the sacrificial fire,’ a Brāhman who has suffered the sacred domestic fire to become extinct (either from carelessness, impiety, or absence); N. of Viṣṇu. —वीराम्ल (°र-अम्°), अस्, m. a kind of dock or sorrel (= अम्ल-वेतस)। —वीरारुक (°र-आर्°), अम्, n. a medicinal plant (= आरुक). —वीराशंसन (°र-आश्°), अम्, n. ‘the place wished for by heroes,’ the post of danger in a battle; a forlorn hope; keeping watch. —वीरा-सन (°र-आस्°), अम्, n. ‘hero-sitting, hero-posture,’ kneeling on one knee; sleeping out in the open air, the station of a guard or sentinel; a bivouac; a particular posture in sitting practised by ascetics, (sitting on the thighs, one leg being in the other, = पर्यङ्क, q. v., see 1. आसन); a field of battle. —वीरेश (°र-ईश), अस्, m. ‘chief of heroes,’ N. of Śiva or Vīra-bhadra. —वीरेश्वर (°र-ईश्°), अस्, m. ‘chief of heroes,’ epithet of Śiva or Vīra-bhadra, q. v.; any great hero. —वीरेश्वर-लिङ्ग, अम्, n., N. of a sacred Liṅga. —वीरोज्झ (°र-उज्°), अस्, m. ‘sacri-ficial-fire abandoning,’ a Brāhman who omits offering burnt offerings or neglects his sacrificial fire. —वीरो-पजीविक (°र-उप्°), अस्, m. ‘subsisting by the sacri-ficial fire,’ a Brāhman who claims alms or presents for having preserved his sacrificial fire.
वीरक: वीरक, अस्, m., Ved. = वीर, a hero; the plant कर-वीर, q. v.
वीरण: वीरण, अस्, m., N. of a sage (father of Vīraṇī); of the father of Asiknī; of a teacher of the Yajur-veda; (ई), f. a side-glance, leer; a deep place; N. of a daughter of Vīraṇa and mother of Cākṣuṣa; (अम्), n. a fragrant grass, Andropogon Muricatus; [cf. विरण, वैरिण।]
वीरणिन्: वीरणिन्, ई, m., N. of a Muni.
वीरयु: वीरयु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. fond of heroes, desiring heroes; (Sāy.) desiring to kill heroes.
वीराय: वीराय, Nom. A. वीरायते, &c., to act like a hero, show heroism.
वीरिका: वीरिका, f., N. of a woman.
वीरिणी: वीरिणी, f. the mother of a hero (Ved.); N. of a river; of a wife of Dakṣa (daughter of Vīraṇa and mother of a thousand sons, = असिक्नी).
वीर्य: वीर्य, अम्, n. vigour, strength, power; heroism, prowess, valour, fortitude, courage, firmness; virile energy, virility; dignity, consequence; splendor, lustre; semen virile; the seed of plants, &c.; (आ), f. vigour, energy, virility. —वीर्य-ज, अस्, m. a son. —वीर्य-धर, आस्, m. pl., N. of a race. —वीर्य-पार-मिता, f. one of the six perfections (with Buddhists). —वीर्य-प्रपात, अस्, m. discharge of semen virile. —वीर्य-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessing vigour, vigor-ous, strong, stout, robust; efficacious, overcoming, victorious. —वीर्य-विरहित, अस्, आ, अम्, devoid of prowess or vigour, &c. —वीर्य-विशिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, possessed of courage, vigour, &c. —वीर्य-वृद्धि-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, causing an increase of virile energy; (अम्), n. an aphrodisiac. —वीर्य-शालिन्, ई, इनी, इ, possessing vigour or heroism, strong, heroic. —वीर्य-शुल्क, अस्, आ, अम्, having prowess or heroism as its price, to be purchased by valour. —वीर्य-हानि, इस्, f. loss of vigour or virile energy; impotence. —वीर्य-हीन, अस्, आ, अम्, deprived of strength; cowardly; seedless. —वीर्या-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. = वीर्य-वत्. —वीर्यावदान (°य-अव्°), अम्, n. effecting anything by prowess; (आनि), n. pl. valour and achievements. —वीर्यावधूत (°य-अव्°), अस्, आ, अम्, overcome or surpassed in prowess.
वीरानक: वीरानक वीरानक, अम्, n. (?), N. of a town.
वीरुध्: वीरुध् वीरुध्, त्, f. (fr. rt. 1. रुध् = rt. 1. रुह् with वि; cf. वि-स्रुह्), a spreading creeper; a branch, shoot; a plant which grows again after being cut; a shrub, plant in general.
वीळु: वीळु वीऌउ or वीडु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. strong, firm, (sometimes written वीलु); (उ), n. anything strong, a fortified place, stronghold; [cf. according to some Gr. Ἴλιος] —वीऌउ-जम्भ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having strong jaws or teeth, (Sāy. = दृढ-दन्त।) —वीऌउ-द्वेषस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. hating the strong or violent (said of Brahmaṇas-pati). —वीऌउ-पत्मन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. strong-going, moving with rapid flight. —वीऌउ-पवि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. having strong tires (said of the chariot of the Maruts). —वीऌउ-पाणि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. strong-handed, strong-hoofed. —वीऌउ-हर्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, Ved. having strong or violent joy, exulting, fiercely passionate.
वीळय: वीऌअय, Nom. P. वीऌअयति, -यितुम्, Ved. to be strong.
वीऌअय; correct — also P. A. वीऌअयति, -ते, to make firm or strong, be strong.
वीळित: वीऌइत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. made strong, strengthened, (Sāy. = दृढी-कृत, Ṛg-veda III. 53, 19.)
वीवध: वीवध वी-वध, अस्, m. = वि-वध, a yoke or pole for carrying burdens; a burden; storing or heaping corn; a road.
वीवधिक: वीवधिक, अस्, ई, m. f. a man or woman who car-ries a load by means of a yoke; a general dealer.
वीविध: वीविध वीविध for वि-विध, q. v.
वीवृत: वीवृत वीवृत, अस्, आ, अम्, = वि-वृत, revealed, published.
वीष्: वीष् 1. वीष् (वि-ईष्), cl. 1. P. A. वीषति, -ते, वीषितुम्, Ved. to go in various directions, spread, be extended.
वीष् 2. वीष् (वि-इष्, see rt. 3. इष्), cl. 1. P. वीच्छति, &c., Ved. to seek for.
वीहार: वीहार वीहार, अस्, m. (for वि-हार, q. v.), a temple, sanctuary, (especially) a Jaina or Buddhist convent or temple.
वुक: वुक वुक, अस्, m. a species of plant, (a va-rious reading for वक, q. v.)

P. Gr. ἐρύω, ἀρνέομαι, ὄρομαι, ὤρα, εὑρίσκω; ἀρά, ἀρείνω, ἄριστος, ἦρα, βούλομαι, βουλή, βελτίων, βέλτιστος; perhaps Lat. aperio, operio, probably velum, velare; verus, valeo, valor; velle: Old Germ. wara, wâr, ‘true;’ wari, werna, warnôn, weljan, ‘to choose:’ Goth. varjan, valjan: Angl. Sax. ware, ‘heed;’ wreon, ‘to cover;’ warian, werian, ‘to ward off;’ wearne, warnian, wearnian, willan.]
वृणान: वृणान, अस्, आ, अम्, choosing, preferring; suppli-cating, adoring.
वृण्वत्: वृण्वत्, अन्, अती, अत्, choosing, electing, preferring (especially as a husband or wife).
वृण्वान: वृण्वान, अस्, आ, अम्, choosing, selecting, &c.
वृत: वृत, अस्, आ, अम्, surrounded, covered, screened, defended; chosen, selected; hired; preferred; agreed, assented to; served; affected by; vitiated, spoiled; (अम्), n., Ved. a treasure, wealth (according to Naigh. II. 10). —वृत-पत्त्रा, f. a kind of plant (= पुत्र-दात्री).
वृति: वृति, इस्, f. surrounding, encompassing; hiding, secreting; an enclosure, hedge, fence, an enclosed piece of ground or place enclosed for particular culti-vation (especially that of the Piper Betel, which in many parts of India is surrounded and screened by mats); selecting, choosing, preferring, appointing; a selection, choice, soliciting, asking, requesting; a request. —वृतिङ्-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, making an en-closure, surrounding, encompassing; (अस्), m. the plant Flacourtia Sapida.
वृत्य: 1. वृत्य, अस्, आ, अम्, (for 2. see p. 958, col. 1), to be surrounded or encompassed, &c.; to be chosen, eligible, preferable, excellent.
2. वृत्य, अस्, आ, अम् (for 1. see p. 956, col. 1), to be abided or stayed or remained, &c.
वृंह्: वृंह् वृंह् (= rts. 2. वृह्, बृंह्, 2. बृह्), cl. 1. P. वृंहति, वृंहितुम्, to grow, in-crease; to roar, bellow (frequently applied to the noise made by elephants); cl. 1. and 10. P. वृं-हति, वृंहयति, to speak; to shine: Caus. वृं-हयति, -यितुम्, to cause to increase, to augment, strengthen, fatten; [cf. Gr. βράχω, βράζω, βράγχος, βρόγχος, βρόχθος, (probably also) βράσσω, βρυχάομαι; ῥόχθος, ὀρεχθέω, ῥαχία, ῥέγχω, ῥόγχος.]
वृंहण: वृंहण, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, causing to increase, nourishing, fostering, fattening, nutritious; (अस्), m. a kind of sweetmeat (made of sugar, milk, spices, &c. fried in ghee, and powdered with coarse sugar, &c.); (अम्), n. the act of fattening, nourishing. —वृंहण-त्व, अम्, n. the quality of strengthening.
वृंहणीय: वृंहणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be increased; to be nourished or fatted or strengthened.
वृंहत्: वृंहत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, growing, increasing; roar-ing, bellowing, making a cry.
वृंहयितव्य: वृंहयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be increased, &c.
वृंहित: वृंहित, अस्, आ, अम्, grown, increased; cherished, nourished; (अम्), n. the roar or noise made by ele-phants; (आ), f., N. of one of the Mātṛs attending on Skanda (also written वृंहिला).
वृक्: वृक् वृक्, cl. 1. A. वर्कते, ववर्के, वर्-कितुम्, to take, accept, seize: Caus. वर्-कयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अववर्कत् or अवीवृकत्: Desid. विवर्किषते: Intens. वरीवृक्यते, वर्-वर्क्ति, वरिव्°, वरीव्°, वर्वृकीति, वरिव्°, वरीव्°।
वृक: वृक, अस्, आ, अम् (according to Uṇādi-s. III. 41. fr. rt. वृ; perhaps connected with rt. व्रश्च्), seiz-ing, rapacious, malignant, impious (Ved.); (अस्), m. a wolf; a jackal; a hyena; a crow; a plough (as tearing up the earth, Ved.; Sāy. = लाङ्गल); = व-ज्र (according to Naigh. II. 20); = स्तेन (Naigh. III. 24); an epithet of the moon (Ved.); the tree Sesbana Grandiflora (= वक-पुष्प); turpen-tine; compounded perfume; N. of an Asura; of a son of Pṛthu; of a son of Vijaya; of a son of Kṛṣṇa; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people (see वार्-केण्य, cf. Pāṇ. V. 3, 115); (आ), f. the plant Cis-sampelos Hexandra, = अम्ब-ष्ठा; (ई), f. a she-wolf, (in Ṛg-veda I. 117, 18. the nom. case is वृकीस्); a kind of plant, = पाठा; [cf. Gr. λύκό-ς; Lat. lupu-s; Goth. vulf-s; Angl. Sax. wulf; Slav. vluk-u; Lith. vilka-s.] —वृक-कर्मन्, आ, m., N. of a leader of the Daityas. —वृक-ताति, इस्, f., Ved. wolfishness, rapacity (see Pāṇ. V. 4, 41); wolf-like, rapacious; [cf. ज्येष्ठ-ताति।] —वृक-तेजस्, आस्, m., N. of a son of Dhruva. —वृक-दंश, अस्, m. ‘wolf-biting,’ a dog. —वृक-देवा, f., N. of a daughter of Devaka. —वृक-धूप, अस्, m. compounded perfume; turpentine. —वृक-धूर्त, अस्, m. ‘wolf-rogue,’ a jackal. —वृक-प्रेक्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, having the eyes of a wolf, looking at (anything) like a wolf. —वृकाक्षी (°क-अक्°), f. a kind of plant (= त्रि-वृत्). —वृकाराति (°क-अर्°), इस्, m. or वृकारि (°क-अरि), इस्, m. ‘wolf-enemy,’ a dog. —वृकासुर-वध (°क-अस्°), अस्, m. ‘kill-ing of the Asura Vṛka,’ N. of the ninety-sixth chapter of the Krīḍā-khaṇḍa of the Gaṇeśa-Purāṇa. —वृ-कोदर (°क-उद्°), अस्, m. ‘wolf-bellied,’ a N. of Brahmā; of Bhīma (the second son of Pāṇḍu, so called from his enormous appetite).
वृकल: वृकल, अस्, m., N. of a son of Dhruva.
वृक्क: वृक्क वृक्क, अस्, आ, m. f. (according to some also) अम्, n. the heart [cf. बुक्क]; a kidney, (in this sense usually in the dual.)
वृक्कक: वृक्कक, औ, m. du. the kidneys.
वृक्ण: वृक्ण वृक्ण, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. व्रश्च्), cut, divided; cut down; torn; broken. —वृक्ण-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has cut or severed.
वृक्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, cut, torn, &c. See s. v.
वृक्त: वृक्त वृक्त, वृक्ति। See under rt. 1. वृज्।

वृक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, cleared, cleaned; spread, strewn. —वृक्त-बर्हिस्, इस्, इस्, इस्, Ved. one who has cleared the बर्हिस् (said of a sacrificial priest or Ṛtv-ij); one who has spread or strewn the sacrificial grass. (Sāy. = स्तीर्ण-बर्हिस्, Ṛg-veda III. 2, 5.)
वृक्ष्: वृक्ष् वृक्ष् (perhaps connected with rt. वृ), cl. 1. A. वृक्षते, ववृक्षे, वृ-क्षितुम्, to select, take, accept; to cover; to keep off.
वृक्ष: वृक्ष वृक्ष, अस्, m. (probably connected with rt. 2. वृह्; in Uṇādi-s. III. 66. said to be fr. rt. व्रश्च्, or fr. rt. वृक्ष्, ‘to cover’), a tree, shrub. —वृक्ष-कुक्कुट, अस्, m. ‘tree-cock,’ a wild cock. —वृक्ष-खण्ड, अम्, n. ‘a party, i. e. number of trees,’ a grove. —वृक्ष-गुल्मावृत (°म-आव्°), अस्, आ, अम्, covered with trees and shrubs. —वृक्ष-चर, अस्, आ, अम्, going or living in trees; (अस्), m. ‘tree-goer,’ a monkey. —वृक्ष-च्छाया, f. the shade of a tree; (अम्), n. the shade of many trees, a grove. —वृक्ष-जातीय, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to the genus tree. —वृक्ष-तल, अम्, n. the foot of a tree or the ground about it. —वृक्ष-धूप, अस्, m. ‘tree-resin,’ turpentine. —वृक्ष-नाथ, अस्, m. ‘lord of trees,’ the Indian fig-tree. —वृक्ष-निर्यास, अस्, m. the exudation of trees, gum, resin. —वृक्ष-निवास, अस्, m. dwelling or living in a tree. —वृ-क्ष-पाक, अस्, m. the Indian fig-tree. —वृक्ष-भक्षा, f. a kind of parasitical plant (= वन्दाक)। —वृक्ष-भवन, अम्, n. ‘tree-abode,’ the hol-low of a tree. —वृक्ष-भिद्, त्, f. ‘tree-splitter,’ an axe. —वृक्ष-भेदिन्, ई, m. ‘tree-splitter,’ a carpenter's chisel; a hatchet. —वृक्ष-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, abounding with trees, consisting of trees. —वृक्ष-मर्कटिका, f. ‘tree-monkey,’ a squirrel. —वृक्ष-मूल, अम्, n. the root of a tree. —वृक्षमूल-निकेतन, अस्, आ, अम्, dwelling at the roots of trees (as a hermit). —वृक्ष-मृद्-भू, ऊस्, m. ‘tree-earth-born,’ a sort of cane or reed, Calamus Fascicularis. —वृक्ष-युद्ध, अम्, n. a fight with trees (instead of clubs). —वृक्ष-रुह, अस्, आ, m. f. ‘tree-grower,’ a parasitical plant which has its roots attached to another plant (as Cymbidum Tessa-loides). —वृक्ष-रोपक, अस्, m. a planter of trees. —वृक्ष-रोपण, अम्, n. the planting of trees. —वृक्ष-रोपिन्, ई, इणी, इ, planting trees. —वृ-क्ष-वाटी or वृक्ष-वाटिका, f. a grove of trees or garden near the residence of a minister of state, &c. —वृक्ष-श, अस्, m. (श said to be fr. rt. शी, ‘to sleep’), a lizard, a chameleon. —वृक्ष-शायिका, f. ‘tree-sleeper,’ a squirrel. —वृक्ष-सर्पी, f., Ved. a female tree-serpent. —वृक्ष-सेचन, अम्, n. the watering of trees. —वृक्ष-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, or वृक्ष-स्थायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, or वृक्ष-स्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, staying in or on a tree. —वृक्षाग्र (°ष-अग्°), अम्, n. the top of a tree. —वृक्षाङ्घ्रि (°ष-अङ्°), इस्, m. the root of a tree. —वृक्षा-दन (°ष-अद्°), अस्, m. a carpenter's chisel or adze; a hatchet, chopper; the Indian fig-tree; the Piyāl tree, Buchanania Latifolia; (ई), f. a para-sitical plant, Epidendron; the shrub Hedysarum Gangeticum. —वृक्षादि-रुहक or वृक्षादि-रूढक, अम्, n. the embracing or entwining (of a creeper) round a tree &c., embracing (in general). —वृक्षादि-विद्या (°ष-आद्°), f. the science of tree &c., botany. —वृक्षाम्ल (°ष-अम्°), अस्, m. the hog-plum, Spondias Mangifera; (अम्), n. acid seasoning, the fruit of the tamarind so used. —वृक्षायुर्-वेद (°ष-आय्°), अस्, m., N. of a short treatise by Sura-pāla on the planting and culti-vation of trees. —वृक्षारोपक (°ष-आर्°), अस्, m. the planter of a tree. —वृक्षारोपण (°ष-आर्°), अम्, n. the act of planting trees. —वृक्षार्हा (°ष-अर्°), f. = महा-मेदा. —वृक्षालय (°ष-आल्°), अस्, m. ‘having a tree for an abode,’ a bird. —वृक्षा-वास (°ष-आव्°), अस्, m. ‘living in trees, living in the hollow of trees,’ an ascetic; a bird. —वृक्षाश्रयिन् (°ष-आश्°), ई, m. ‘tree-dweller,’ a kind of small owl. —वृक्षोत्थ (°ष-उत्°), अस्, आ, अम्, growing on a tree. —वृक्षोत्पल (°ष-उत्°), अस्, m. the tree Pterospermum Acerifolium (= कर्णि-कार).
वृक्षक: वृक्षक, अस्, m. a small tree; the tree Wrightea Antidysenterica (= कुटज); any tree.
वृगल: वृगल वृगल, अम्, n., Ved. = विदल, a pea, split peas, (अर्ध-वृगल, half a pea.)
वृच्: वृच् वृच् = rt. 1. वृज्, q. v.
वृचया: वृचया वृचया, f., Ved., N. of a woman (said to have been given by Indra to Kakṣīvat).
वृचीवत्: वृचीवत् वृचीवत्, आन्, m., Ved., N. of the oldest of the sons of the Asura Vara-śikha; (अन्तस्), m. pl. the sons or family of Vara-śikha (slain by Indra).
वृज्: वृज् 1. वृज्, cl. 1. P. वर्जति, cl. 7. P. (Ved. also A.) वृणक्ति, वृङ्क्ते (in this class the rt. is sometimes written वृच्), cl. 2. A. वृक्ते (in this cl. the rt. is sometimes written वृञ्ज्, to which the 3rd sing. Pres. वृङ्क्ते may be referred), व-वर्ज, ववृजे, (according to some also) ववर्च, ववृञ्जे, वर्जिष्यति, -ते (Ved. वर्क्ष्यति, -ते), अवर्जीत्, अवर्जिष्ट (Vedic forms अवृक्, वर्क्, वर्क्तम्; Perf. part. fem. ववर्जुषी), वर्जितुम्, (according to some also) वृञ्जितुम् (Ved.
