व्यतिगत: व्य्-अतिगत, अस्, आ, अम्, passed by, elapsed.
व्यतिगा: व्यतिगा व्य्-अति-गा (वि-अति-), cl. 3. P. -जिगाति, गातुम्, to pass by.
व्यतिचर्: व्यतिचर् व्य्-अति-चर् (वि-अति-), cl. 1. P. (ep. also A.) -चरति (-ते), -चरितुम्, to transgress against, commit an offence against, offend.
व्यतिचुम्ब्: व्यतिचुम्ब् व्य्-अति-चुम्ब् (वि-अति-), cl. 1. P. -चुम्बति, -चुम्बितुम्, to kiss or touch closely, be in immediate contact with.
व्यतिचुम्बित: व्य्-अतिचुम्बित, अस्, आ, अम्, touching closely, in immediate contact with.
व्यतिजल्प्: व्यतिजल्प् व्य्-अति-जल्प् (वि-अति-), cl. 1. P. -जल्पति, -जल्पितुम्, to chatter together, gossip, talk with one another.
व्यतिजि: व्यतिजि व्य्-अति-जि (वि-अति-), cl. 1. P. A. -जयति, -ते, -जेतुम्, to overcome, surpass, excel.
व्यतितन्: व्यतितन् व्य्-अति-तन् (वि-अति-), cl. 8. A. -त-नुते, -तनितुम्, to extend mutually, vie with each other in extending or spreading out.
व्यतितॄ: व्यतितॄ व्य्-अति-तॄ (वि-अति-), cl. 1. P. -तरति, -तरितुम् or -तरीतुम्, to pass completely across, pass over successfully, overcome.
व्यतिनी: व्यतिनी व्य्-अति-नी (वि-अति-), cl. 1. P. -नयति, &c., Ved. to allow to pass away.
व्यतिभा: व्यतिभा व्य्-अति-भा (वि-अति-), cl. 2. A. -भाते, -बभे, to shine forth fully or brightly (used imper-sonally).
व्यतिभू: व्यतिभू व्य्-अति-भू (वि-अति-), cl. 1. A. -भ-वते, &c., to vie with any one (acc.), contend for precedence or superiority.
व्यतिमर्श: व्यतिमर्श व्य्-अतिमर्श (वि-अति-), अस्, m. (in Vedic ritual) a particular kind of विहार, q. v., (it is described as the mutual transposition of the several Pādas or half verses or whole verses of the first and second Vālakhilya hymns which are repeated in sets, two being always taken together.)
व्यतिमर्शम्: व्य्-अतिमर्शम्, ind., Ved. having skipped or passed over, having missed or taken alternately, alter-nating.
व्यतिमुह्: व्यतिमुह् व्य्-अति-मुह् (वि-अति-), cl. 4. P. -मुह्-यति, &c., to be excessively perplexed or embarrassed.
व्यतिमूढ: व्य्-अतिमूढ, अस्, आ, अम्, excessively perplexed or embarrassed, utterly distracted.
व्यतिया: व्यतिया व्य्-अति-या (वि-अति-), cl. 2. P. -याति, यातुम्, to go completely through, penetrate, per-vade (with acc., Ved.); to pass by, flow on (as time).
व्यतियात: व्य्-अतियात, अस्, आ, अम्, gone by, passed, spent.
व्यतियु: व्यतियु व्य्-अति-यु (वि-अति-), cl. 2. P., 9. P. A. -यौति, -युनाति, -युनीते, -यवितुम्, to join with one another, unite mutually, mix together, inter-mingle.
व्यतिरा: व्यतिरा व्य्-अति-रा (वि-अति-), cl. 2. A. -राते, व्य्-अत्य्-अरे, see Pāṇ. VI. 4, 64.
व्यतिरिच्: व्यतिरिच् व्य्-अति-रिच् (वि-अति-), Pass. -रिच्यते, to reach far beyond, leave behind, surpass, excel (with abl. or acc.); to be separated from, differ from, deviate.
व्यतिरिक्त: व्य्-अतिरिक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, reaching beyond, passing or projecting beyond, surpassing, excelling, excessive, immoderate; separate, different from, distinct from: excepted; withdrawn, withheld; (अम्), ind. with the exception of, except, without (e. g. स्वर-व्°, except the accent).
व्यतिरेक: व्य्-अतिरेक, अस्, m. reaching or passing beyond, ex-celling, excellence; separation from, distinction, differ-ence, separateness, deviation; exception, exclusion, negation, interception; contrariety, contrast, dissimili-tude, a particular figure in rhetoric or poetry (the con-trasting of things compared in some respects with each other); logical discontinuance (opposed to अन्वय), negative inference; (एण), ind. with exception of, without; (ए), ind. on the contrary supposition. —व्य-तिरेक-व्याप्ति, इस्, f. ‘pervasion of difference or dissimilitude,’ a comprehensive argument derived from negation or non-existence of certain qualities. —व्यतिरेकालङ्कार (°क-अल्°), अस्, m. the rheto-rical figure called Vyatireka, (see above.)
व्यतिरेकिन्: व्य्-अतिरेकिन्, ई, इणी, इ, passing beyond, excelling, distinguishing, discriminating; excepting; different, reverse. —व्यतिरेकि-लिङ्ग, अम्, n. an exclusive mark, i. e. a negative property (which excludes its subject from the class possessing the corresponding positive property). —व्यतिरेक्य्-उदाहरण, अम्, n. illustration by contrast or negation (of certain pro-perties).
व्यतिरुह्: व्यतिरुह् व्य्-अति-रुह् (वि-अति-), cl. 1. P. -रो-हति, -रोढुम्, to pass into various states of being, attain to or obtain another (state): Caus. -रोपयति or -रोहयति, -यितुम्, to eject, expel, remove, dis-possess.
व्यतिरोपित: व्य्-अतिरोपित, अस्, आ, अम्, ejected, displaced, ex-pelled, ousted, dispossessed, removed from rightful possession.
व्यतिलङ्घिन्: व्यतिलङ्घिन् व्य्-अतिलङ्घिन्, ई, इनी, इ, passing or falling away from, slipping away.
व्यतिलू: व्यतिलू व्य्-अति-लू (वि-अति-), cl. 9. A. -लुनीते (also P. -लुनाति if joined with इतरेतर, अन्योन्य, or परस्पर, see Pāṇ. 1. 3, 16), -लवितुम्, to cut or hurt one another, cut mutually.
व्यतिवह्: व्यतिवह् व्य्-अति-वह् (वि-अति-), cl. 1. A. -व-हते, &c., to bear mutually or reciprocally, (see Vopa-deva XXIII. 55.)
व्यतिवृत्: व्यतिवृत् व्य्-अति-वृत् (वि-अति-), cl. 1. A. -वर्-तते, &c. (in Fut., Cond., and Aor. also P., see rt. 1. वृत्), -वर्तितुम्, to go or pass over, pass through; to escape, avoid; to glide or pass away, elapse; to depart from (with abl.), leave, quit, abandon.
व्यतिषञ्ज्: व्यतिषञ्ज् व्य्-अति-षञ्ज् (वि-अति-सञ्ज्), cl. 1. P. -षजति (sometimes A. -षजते), -षङ्क्तुम्, to connect mutually, mix together (P.); to change (A.): Pass. -षज्यते, to be mutually connected.
व्यतिषक्त: व्य्-अतिषक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, mutually connected or joined or related, &c.; intermarried, intermarrying.
व्यतिषङ्ग: व्य्-अतिषङ्ग, अस्, m. mutual connection, reci-procal junction or relation; fastening or tying to-gether; absorption (in Vedic grammar). —व्यति-षङ्ग-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having mutual connection, connected, united, mixed.
व्यतिसन्दह्: व्यतिसन्दह् व्य्-अति-सन्-दह् (वि-अति-सम्-), cl. 1. P. -दहति, -दग्धुम्, to burn up entirely.
व्यतिसृप्: व्यतिसृप् व्य्-अति-सृप् (वि-अति-), cl. 1. P. -सर्-पति, -सर्प्तुम् or -स्रप्तुम्, to move to and fro, fly in every direction.
व्यतिसर्पत्: व्य्-अतिसर्पत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, going or flying in all directions.
व्यतिहन्: व्यतिहन् व्य्-अति-हन् (वि-अति-), cl. 2. P. -हन्ति, -हन्तुम्, to strike one another; to strike again, strike in return.
व्यतिघ्नत्: व्य्-अतिघ्नत्, अन्, अती, अत्, striking again or in return.
व्यतिहस्: व्यतिहस् व्य्-अति-हस् (वि-अति-), cl. 1. P. -ह-सति, -हसितुम्, to laugh at each other.
व्यतिहृ: व्यतिहृ व्य्-अति-हृ (वि-अति-), cl. 1. A. -हरते, &c., to take or receive mutually, take in exchange.
व्यतिहार: व्य्-अतिहार, अस्, m. barter, exchange; reciprocity; exchange of blows or abuse.
व्यती: व्यती 1. व्य्-अती (वि-अति-इ), cl. 2. P. व्यत्य्-एति, -एतुम्, to pass away or over, pass by, elapse; to go away, depart from, deviate or swerve from, leave (with abl.), take an irregular course; to go beyond, transgress, to pass a person or place (with acc.); to pass or spend (a fixed time, &c.); to sur-pass, excel, overcome, conquer; to disregard, neg-lect, omit.

व्यती 2. व्यती (perhaps connected with rt. 1. वी or with व्य्-अती), Ved., according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda IV. 32, 17. व्यतीनाम् = गमनवताम् अश्वानाम्, of swift-going horses; on Ṛg-veda I. 155, 6. व्यतीन् = विविधान् एव स्व-भावान्, various states or revolutions.
व्यतियत्: व्य्-अतियत्, अन्, अती, अत्, passing away, passing by, &c.; disregarding, paying no attention to (any-thing).
व्यतीत: व्य्-अतीत, अस्, आ, अम्, passed away, passed by, elapsed, passed over, gone; departed, dead; departed from, left, abandoned; disregarded, omitted.
व्यतीत्य: व्य्-अतीत्य, ind. having passed by, having gone through or passed over.
व्यत्यय: व्य्-अत्यय, अस्, m. passing or going away, going in a different direction, contrariety, opposition, oppo-sition to the usual rule, (व्यत्ययेन, by an irregu-larity, against the usual rule, in opposition to the usual rule); reverse; inverted or reverse order; transposi-tion, transmutation, interchange.
व्यतीपात: व्यतीपात व्य्-अतीपात, अस्, m. (fr. rt. पत् with वि and अति), falling entirely away, total departure, deviation from (right), excessive sin, great or por-tentous calamity, any portent or prodigy indicating or occasioning calamity (as a comet, earthquake, &c.); disrespect, contempt; the seventeenth of the astronomical Yogas; the day of new moon (when it falls on Ravi-vāra or Sunday, and when the moon is in certain mansions, such as Śravaṇā, Dhaniṣṭhā, &c.); a malignant aspect of the sun and moon (when they are on opposite sides of either solstice and their minutes of declination are the same; cf. वैधृत).
व्यत्यस्: व्यत्यस् 1. व्य्-अत्य्-अस् (वि-अति-अस्), cl. 2. A. व्य्-अति-स्ते (1st sing. -अति-हे, 2nd sing. -अति-से, Pāṇ. VII. 4, 50, 52), to be above, excel, surpass.
व्यत्यस् 2. व्य्-अत्य्-अस् (वि-अति-अस्), cl. 4. P. -अस्यति, -असितुम्, to throw or place in an inverted position, invert, place across.
व्यत्यस्त: व्य्-अत्यस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, thrown or placed in an inverted position, reversed, inverted, changed into the opposite; contrary, opposite, placed across or crosswise, crossed, (व्यत्यस्त-पाणिना, with crossed hands.)
व्यत्यास: व्य्-अत्यास, अस्, m. inverted position, inverted or reverse order; contrariety, oppositeness, opposition, reverse.
व्यत्यासम्: व्य्-अत्यासम्, ind., Ved. having inverted, having placed crosswise; alternating, alternately.
व्यत्यूह्: व्यत्यूह् व्य्-अत्य्-ऊह् (वि-अति-ऊह्, see rt. 1. ऊह्), cl. 1. P. -ऊहति, -ऊहितुम्, Ved. to place or arrange differently; to be ever changing the order of any-thing.
व्यथ्: व्यथ् व्यथ्, cl. 1. A. व्यथते (ep. also P. -ति), विव्यथे, व्यथिष्यते, अव्य-थिष्ट (Ved. व्यथिषत्), व्यथितुम् (Ved. Inf. व्यथिष्यै), to tremble, be agitated or disquieted or afflicted; to suffer pain, be sorrowful or unhappy or vexed, fall into misfortune; to be afraid of, fear (with abl.); to suffer; to dry, become dry: Pass. व्यथ्यते: Caus. व्यथयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अविव्य-थत्, to disquiet, pain, afflict, make uneasy; to destroy, baffle; to frighten; to lead or turn away: Desid. विव्यथिषते: Intens. वाव्यथ्यते, वाव्यत्ति; [cf. Goth. vithon; (perhaps also) Gr. ὄθη, ὄθομαι, ὠθέω, ἐνοσί-χθων, ἔννοσις.]
व्यथक: व्यथक, अस्, इका, अम्, inflicting pain, paining, causing pain, torturing, painful; distressing, afflict-ing, causing alarm.
व्यथत्: व्यथत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, trembling, sorrowing, being in pain or trouble.
व्यथन: व्यथन, अम्, n. the act of giving pain, paining; (in Vedic grammar) change, alteration, variation.
व्यथनीय: व्यथनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be pained or afflicted, capable of being agitated or disturbed.
व्यथमान: व्यथमान, अस्, आ, अम्, quivering, trembling, feeling pain.
व्यथयत्: व्यथयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, paining, distressing, disquieting.
व्यथा: व्यथा, f. disquietude, perturbation, agitation; pain, agony; anguish, ache; distress; alarm, fear; disease. —व्यथा-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, causing pain (bodily or mental), painful, excruciating. —व्यथान्-वित (°था-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, suffering pain, pained. —व्यथा-रहित, अस्, आ, अम्, free from pain. —व्यथा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, full of pain.
व्यथि: व्यथि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. agitated, quivering, moving about, troubled, distressed, (Sāy. = व्यथित, Ṛg-veda V. 59, 2; = चलित, X. 86, 2); (इस्), m. a weapon, (Sāy. = शस्त्र, Ṛg-veda VI. 28, 3); a malevolent or evil-disposed person, (Sāy. = बाधक, राक्षस, Ṛg-veda IV. 4, 3; = हिंसक, VI. 62, 3.)
व्यथित: व्यथित, अस्, आ, अम्, agitated, disquieted, per-turbed, pained, tortured; distressed, afflicted; dis-turbed, troubled; alarmed, frightened.
व्यथितव्य: व्यथितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be pained or distressed.
व्यथिस्: व्यथिस्, इस्, n., Ved. perturbation, anger (accord-ing to Naigh. II. 13; perhaps referrible to व्यथि above).
व्यथ्य: व्यथ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be pained or distressed, &c.
व्यथ्यमान: व्यथ्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being disquieted or agitated, being pained or distressed.
व्यथ्ययस्: व्यथ्ययस्, in Naigh. 1. 14. a various reading for अ-व्यथयस्, (see अ-व्यथि।)
व्यद्: व्यद् व्य्-अद् (वि-अद्), cl. 2. P. -अत्ति, -अत्तुम्, to bite through or on all sides, gnaw, nibble, eat.
व्यध्: व्यध् व्यध्, cl. 4. P. विध्यति, विव्याध, व्यत्स्यति, अव्यात्सीत्, व्यद्धुम् (ep. वेद्धुम्), to pierce, perforate; to strike, beat, smite, stab; to pick; to tear, hurt, wound; to wave in triumph: Pass. विध्यते, to be pierced: Caus. व्या-धयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अविव्यधत्: Desid. विव्यत्-सति: Intens. वेविध्यते, वाव्यद्धि (?); [cf. per-haps Gr. ϝεθ in ἄεθλος.]
विद्धवा: विद्धवा, ind. having pierced, having struck.
विध्यमान: विध्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being pierced or struck or wounded.
व्यध: व्यध, अस्, m. piercing, perforating; striking, smiting; a stroke, wound; (आ), f. bleeding.
व्यधन: व्यधन, अम्, n. the act of piercing, perforating.
व्यध्य: व्यध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be pierced or wounded, (in this sense also व्याध्य); (अस्), m. an effigy or mark for archers to shoot at, a butt, target, (accord-ing to Śabda-k. = धनुर्-गुण ?)
व्याध: व्याध, अस्, m. ‘one who pierces or wounds,’ a hunter, one who lives by killing deer, &c., (if re-garded as a particular caste, supposed to be the son of a Kṣatriya by a Sarvasvin mother); a low man, wicked person. —व्याध-ता, f. the state or busi-ness of a hunter. —व्याध-भीत, अस्, m. ‘afraid of hunters,’ a deer.
व्याध व्याध। See under rt. व्यध्, p. 974, col. 1.
व्याधाय: व्याधाय, Nom. A. व्याधायते, &c., to become a hunter.
व्याधिन्: 1. व्याधिन्, ई, इनी, इ, possessing hunters, frequented by hunters.
2. व्याधिन्, ई, इनी, इ, piercing, wounding.
3. व्याधिन्, ई, इनी, इ, diseased, sick, ill.
व्यधिकरण: व्यधिकरण व्य्-अधिकरण, अम्, n. the sub-sisting or inhering in different receptacles or subjects or substrata (sometimes applied to a loose or am-biguous argument; probably opposed to समाना-धिकरण, see विशेष-व्याप्ति).
व्यधित: व्यधित व्यधित, अस्, आ, अम् (a doubtful word), made, done (?).
व्यध्व: व्यध्व व्य्-अध्व, अस्, m. a bad road, wrong road.
व्यध्वन्: व्य्-अध्वन्, आ, m., Ved. ‘having various paths,’ epithet of Agni, (Sāy. = विविध-ज्वाल, Ṛg-veda 1. 141, 7.)
व्यन्: व्यन् व्य्-अन् (वि-अन्), cl. 2. P. -अनिति, -अनितुम्, Ved. to breathe through, breathe.
व्यनुधा: व्यनुधा व्य्-अनु-धा (वि-अनु-), cl. 3. A. -धत्ते, -धातुम्, Ved. to unfold, display, (accord-ing to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda 1. 166, 10. वि-धिरे = विविधं धारयन्ति, apparently connecting धिरे with वि and not with व्य्-अनु।)
व्यनुनद्: व्यनुनद् व्य्-अनु-नद् (वि-अनु-), Caus. -ना-दयति, -यितुम्, to cause to resound or re-echo, fill with noise or cries, &c.
व्यनुनाद: व्य्-अनुनाद, अस्, m. reverberation, loud and ex-tending sound or noise.
व्यनुनादयत्: व्य्-अनुनादयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to resound or reverberate, filling with sound or noise.
व्यन्तर: व्यन्तर व्य्-अन्तर, अस्, m. a kind of super-natural being, (eight classes are enumerated, viz. Piśāca, Bhūta, Yakṣa, Rākṣasa, Kinnara, Kim-puruṣa, Mahoraga, and Gandharva.)
व्यन्वारभ्: व्यन्वारभ् व्य्-अन्व्-आ-रभ् (वि-अनु-आ-), cl. 1. A. -रभते, &c., Ved. to hold or touch on both sides.
व्यप्: व्यप् व्यप्, cl. 10. P. व्यापयति, -यितुम्, to throw (= rt. 1. विप्); to throw away, diminish, waste; [cf. rt. व्यय्।]
व्यपकृष्: व्यपकृष् व्य्-अप-कृष् (वि-अप-), cl. 1. P. -कर्षति, -कर्ष्टुम्, -क्रष्टुम्, to draw or drag away or off; to lead astray, seduce; to take off (as clothes), undress; to take away, remove, give up.
व्यपकर्षत्: व्य्-अपकर्षत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, drawing off or away.
व्यपकृष्ट: व्य्-अपकृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, drawn or dragged off, drawn aside, taken away, taken off, removed.
व्यपक्रम्: व्यपक्रम् व्य्-अप-क्रम् (वि-अप-), cl. 1. P. -क्रामति, -क्रमितुम्, to go away, move off, retire, depart.
व्यपगम्: व्यपगम् व्य्-अप-गम् (वि-अप-), cl. 1. P. -गच्छति, -गन्तुम्, to go away, retire, retreat, escape, disappear; to move away from, be entirely removed from.
व्यपगच्छत्: व्य्-अपगच्छत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, going away, leaving.
व्यपगत: व्य्-अपगत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone away or off, gone; departed from, fallen away from (with abl.); disap-peared. —व्यपगत-शुच्, क्, क्, क्, one whose sor-row has departed, free from grief.
व्यपगम: व्य्-अपगम, अस्, m. going away, departure.
व्यपत्रप्: व्यपत्रप् व्य्-अप-त्रप् (वि-अप-), cl. 1. A. -त्रपते (ep. also P. -ति), -त्रपितुम्, -त्रप्तुम्, to turn away through shame or embarrassment; to be-come shy, be ashamed.
व्यपत्रप: व्य्-अपत्रप, अस्, आ, अम्, shameless, (in this word वि is privative.)
व्यपत्रपमाण: व्य्-अपत्रपमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, turning away through shame, being ashamed; shy.
व्यपदिश्: व्यपदिश् व्य्-अप-दिश् (वि-अप-), cl. 3. 6. P. -दिदेष्टि, -दिशति, -देष्टुम्, to point out, indicate, represent, signify, mean, intend; to designate, name; to represent falsely, feign, pretend, hold forth as a pretext: Pass. -दिश्यते, to be represented or shown, (इति व्य्-अपदिश्यते, so it is represented, so it is said or intended or signified, such a form of expression is used): Caus. -देशयति, -यितुम्, to cause to be named after, call after.
व्यपदिशत्: व्य्-अपदिशत्, अन्, अती, or अन्ती, अत्, representing.
व्यपदिश्य: व्य्-अपदिश्य, ind. having represented or shown; having represented falsely, having feigned or pre-tended.
व्यपदिष्ट: व्य्-अपदिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, represented, signified, shown, informed, named; tricked; pleaded as a pretext or in excuse.
व्यपदेश: व्य्-अपदेश, अस्, m. representation, information, apprising, notice, hint; a particular form of speech; designation by name or appellation; a name, title, appellation; family, race; fame, renown; fraud, craft; stratagem, device, pretext, excuse.
व्यपदेष्टृ: व्य्-अपदेष्टृ, टा, ट्री, टृ, one who represents or shows, one who designates or names; one who represents falsely, one who pretends or makes pre-texts, deceiving, a cheat, impostor.
व्यपदृश्: व्यपदृश् व्य्-अप-दृश् (वि-अप-), Pass. -दृश्-यते, to be clearly seen, be distinctly visible.
व्यपनश्: व्यपनश् व्य्-अप-नश् (वि-अप-), Caus. -ना-शयति, -यितुम्, to cause to disappear entirely, cause to perish, drive away, remove.
व्यपनी: व्यपनी व्य्-अप-नी (वि-अप-), cl. 1. P. -न-यति, -नेतुम् (Ved. also -नयितुम्), to lead away, take away; to carry away, remove, drive away, banish; to take off, lay aside; to get rid of: Caus. -नाययति, -यितुम्, to cause to lead or carry away.
व्यपनयत्: व्य्-अपनयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, leading or taking away, driving away, removing.
व्यपनायित: व्य्-अपनायित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Caus.), caused to be led or taken away, &c.
व्यपनीत: व्य्-अपनीत, अस्, आ, अम्, led off, taken away, taken off, removed.
व्यपनीय: व्य्-अपनीय, ind. having led or taken away, hav-ing taken off or laid aside, having put away.
व्यपनुद्: व्यपनुद् व्य्-अप-नुद् (वि-अप-), cl. 6. P. A. -नुदति, -ते, -नोत्तुम्, to drive away, remove.
व्यपमुच्: व्यपमुच् व्य्-अप-मुच् (वि-अप-), cl. 6. P. A. -मुञ्चति, -ते, &c., to loosen, take off, remove, lay aside.
व्यपमुच्य: व्य्-अपमुच्य, ind. having loosed or taken off.
व्यपया: व्यपया व्य्-अप-या (वि-अप-), cl. 2. P. -याति (ep. also A. -ते), -यातुम्, to go away, retire from, withdraw; to pass away, disappear.
व्यपयात: व्य्-अपयात, अस्, आ, अम्, gone away, retired, with-drawn.
व्यपरुध्: व्यपरुध् व्य्-अप-रुध्, cl. 7. P. A. -रुणद्-धि, -रुन्द्धे, to exclude from sovereignty or power, dethrone, dismiss, dispossess, (in Rāmāyaṇa II. 58, 23. [Bombay ed.] the Intens. form व्यप-रोरुधः occurs.)
व्यपरुह्: व्यपरुह् व्य्-अप-रुह् (वि-अप-), Caus. -रोप-यति, -यितुम्, to root up, eradicate, extirpate; to lay aside, remove, take off; to deprive of, expel from (with inst. or abl.).
व्यपरोपण: व्य्-अपरोपण, अम्, n. the act of rooting up, extir-pating; expelling, removing; cutting up, cutting off.
व्यपरोपित: व्य्-अपरोपित, अस्, आ, अम्, rooted up, extirpated, eradicated; expelled.
व्यपवह्: व्यपवह् व्य्-अप-वह् (वि-अप-), cl. 1. P. A. -वहति, -ते, &c., to drive away, remove, expel; to manifest, display, exhibit.
व्यपोढ: व्य्-अपोढ, अस्, आ, अम्, driven or frightened away, expelled, removed; opposite, contrary, reverse; mani-fested, displayed, exhibited. —व्यपोढाभ्र (°ढ-अभ्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having the clouds driven away.
व्यपोढ व्य्-अपोढ, व्य्-अपोह्य। See under व्य्-अप-वह्।
व्यपोह्य: व्य्-अपोह्य, ind. having driven away, having re-moved or got rid of; having passed through a place, (व्य्-अपोह्य and व्य्-अपोढ may equally be referred to व्य्-अपोह्, see rt. 1. ऊह्।)
व्यपवृज्: व्यपवृज् व्य्-अप-वृज् (वि-अप-), Caus. -वर्-जयति, -यितुम्, to leave off entirely, relinquish, give up, abandon.
व्यपवर्जित: व्य्-अपवर्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, entirely relinquished or given up.
व्यपवृत्: व्यपवृत् व्य्-अप-वृत् (वि-अप-), cl. 1. A. -वर्-तते, &c. (see rt. 1. वृत्), to turn away from, leave; to desist from (with abl.).
व्यपव्यध्: व्यपव्यध् व्य्-अप-व्यध् (वि-अप-), cl. 4. P. -विध्यति, -व्यद्धुम्, to break to pieces, to throw or cast away.
व्यपविद्ध: व्य्-अपविद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, broken to pieces, thrown about in confusion, cast away, rejected, dis-carded. —व्यपविद्ध-वृषी-मठ, अस्, आ, अम्, whose (ascetic) seats and cells were discarded or abandoned.
व्यपसृज्: व्यपसृज् व्य्-अप-सृज् (वि-अप-), cl. 6. P. -सृजति, -स्रष्टुम्, to let go; to send away, dismiss, throw away, relinquish, abandon.
व्यपसृप्: व्यपसृप् व्य्-अप-सृप् (वि-अप-), cl. 1. P. -सर्पति, -सर्प्तुम्, -स्रप्तुम्, to go away, creep away, run away, escape.
व्यपहृ: व्यपहृ व्य्-अप-हृ (वि-अप-), cl. 1. P. A. -हरति, -ते, -हर्तुम्, to take away, carry away, remove; to cut off.
व्यपाकृति: व्यपाकृति व्य्-अपाकृति, इस्, f. driving away, repelling, denial.
व्यपाकृष्: व्यपाकृष् व्य्-अपा-कृष् (वि-अप-आ-), cl. 1. P. -कर्षति, -कर्ष्टुम्, -क्रष्टुम्, to drag or draw away, tear off, tear away from, take away, remove.
व्यपानुद्: व्यपानुद् व्य्-अपा-नुद् (वि-अप-आ-), cl. 6. P. A. -नुदति, -ते, -नोत्तुम्, to drive away, remove.
व्यपाश्रि: व्यपाश्रि व्य्-अपा-श्रि (वि-अप-आ-), cl. 1. P. A. -श्रयति, -ते, -श्रयितुम्, to go to for refuge, seek refuge with, have recourse to.
व्यपाश्रय: व्य्-अपाश्रय, अस्, m. going away, secession; hav-ing recourse to, taking refuge with, relying upon, reliance on, trusting to; expectation.
व्यपाश्रित: व्य्-अपाश्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has taken refuge with, relying upon, trusting to.
व्यपाश्रित्य: व्य्-अपाश्रित्य, ind. having gone to for refuge, having taken refuge with.
व्यपे: व्यपे व्य्-अपे (वि-अप-इ), cl. 2. P. -अपैति, &c., -अपैतुम्, to go apart, go asunder, be severed or separated, separate; to go away, leave, depart, leave off, cease, stop.
व्यपेत: व्य्-अपेत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone apart or asunder, severed, separated; gone off or away, passed away, departed, got rid of; opposed to, contrary. —व्य-पेत-कल्मष, अस्, आ, अम्, having taint or guilt removed. —व्यपेत-धैर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has abandoned firmness. —व्यपेत-भय, अस्, आ, अम्, or व्यपेत-भी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, one whose fears are gone, free from fear (= वीत-भी). —व्यपेत-हर्-ष, अस्, आ, अम्, devoid of joy.
व्यपेक्ष्: व्यपेक्ष् व्य्-अपेक्ष् (वि-अप-ईक्ष्), cl. 1. A. -अपेक्षते, -एक्षितुम्, to look about for, look for, expect; to regard, mind, pay regard or attention to; to look back.
व्यपेक्ष: व्य्-अपेक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, looking about for, ex-pecting; expectant, waiting, attentive; regarding, minding; (आ), f. looking for, expectation; regard, consideration; mutual expectation or regard; mutual connection or relation; application, use; (in gram-mar) the mutual application of two rules.
व्यपेक्षण: व्य्-अपेक्षण, अम्, n. the act of looking for, expecting, expectation.
व्यपेक्षणीय: व्य्-अपेक्षणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be looked for or expected.
व्यपेक्षमाण: व्य्-अपेक्षमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, looking about for, looking round, expecting.
व्यपेक्षित: व्य्-अपेक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, looked for, expected; mutually expected or looked to; mutually related; employed, applied.
व्यपेक्षितव्य: व्य्-अपेक्षितव्य or व्य्-अपेक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be looked for or expected.
व्यपोह्: व्यपोह् व्य्-अपोह् (वि-अप-ऊह्), cl. 1. P. -अपो-हति (ep. also A. -ते), -अपोहितुम्, to drive away from, keep off; to remove; to atone for, expiate, destroy; to heal, cure (sickness).
व्यपोह: व्य्-अपोह, अस्, m. driving away, keeping off, destroying. —व्यपोह-स्तव, अस्, m., N. of a chapter of the Liṅga-Purāṇa.
व्यपोहमान: व्य्-अपोहमान, अस्, आ, अम्, taking away, remov-ing; putting out, extinguishing.
व्यभिचर्: व्यभिचर् व्य्-अभि-चर्, cl. 1. P. (ep. also A.) -चरति (-ते), -चरितुम्, to act in an unfriendly way towards (with acc. or gen.), commit an offence against, offend, injure; to bewitch, practise sorcery; to go away, depart or deviate from; to go astray; to go wrong, fail, miscarry; to go beyond, trans-gress, exceed, surpass (with acc.).
व्यभिचार: व्य्-अभिचार, अस्, m. going or departing from, wandering away, going astray, deviation, leaving or abandoning (the right way), following improper courses, doing what is prohibited or wicked; erring, straying, error, trespass, transgression, crime, vice, sin, profligacy, adultery, infidelity of a wife, &c.; wandering from an argument, erroneous or fallacious reasoning, the presence of the हेतु without the साध्य; straying from a rule, exception to a rule, irregularity, anomaly. —व्यभिचार-तस्, ind. in con-sequence of straying or erring; (in phil.) from the Vya-bhicāra involved in the other supposition. —व्यभि-चार-ता, f. or व्यभिचार-त्व, अम्, n. error.
व्यभिचारिन्: व्य्-अभिचारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, going astray, erring, tres-passing, deviating from (virtue), following or doing what is improper; profligate, wanton; untrue, false; irregular, anomalous; (a word) having a non-primi-tive or secondary meaning, having several meanings; (इणी), f. a wanton woman, unchaste wife, adulteress; (इ), n. anything transitory, a transitory feeling or state, (opposed to स्थायि, ‘a lasting state,’ q. v., and forming a particular condition of the mind or body described in poetical compositions; these Vyabhicāri-bhāvas are said to be thirty-four in number, viz. 1. निर्वेद, disgust, despondency; 2. ग्लानि, ex-haustion, emaciation; 3. शङ्का, apprehension; 4. असूया, envy; 5. मद, intoxication; 6. श्रम, fatigue; 7. आलस्य, indolence, languor; 8. दैन्य, indigence, distress; 9. चिन्ता, anxious reflection or thought; 10. मोह, perplexity, distraction; 11. स्मृति, recollection, effort to remember; 12. धृति, calm enjoyment, satisfaction of mind; 13. व्रीडा, shame; 14. चपलता, unsteadiness, want of firm-ness; 15. हर्ष, joy, delight; 16. आवेग, flurry; 17. जडता, stupefaction, insensibility, apathy; 18. गर्व, pride, arrogance; 19. विषाद, depression, despair; 20. औत्सुक्य, regret, eager longing; 21. निद्रा, drowsiness; 22. अपस्मार, possession by an evil spirit, epilepsy; 23. सुप्त, sleep; 24. वि-बोध, waking; 25. अमर्ष, angry impatience; 26. अवहित्था, dissimulation; 27. उग्रता, cruelty, rage; 28. मति, mental perception or conclusion; 29. उपालम्भ, reviling, railing; 30. व्याधि, sick-ness; 31. उन्माद, madness, delirium; 32. मरण, death; 33. त्रास, fear; 34. वितर्क, doubt, delibera-tion.) —व्यभिचारि-ता, f. or व्यभिचारि-त्व, अम्, n. the state of going astray, error, doubt; (in gram-mar) the having a secondary meaning, the having several meanings. —व्यभिचारि-भाव, अस्, m. a transitory state (of mind or body; see above).
व्यभ्र: व्यभ्र व्य्-अभ्र, अस्, आ, अम्, unclouded, cloud-less.
व्यय्: व्यय् व्यय् (probably formed fr. rt. अय् for 5. इ with वि), cl. 1. P. A. व्ययति, -ते, वव्या-य, वव्यये, व्ययितुम्, and cl. 10. P. व्यययति, यितुम्, to go, move; to expend, disburse, spend; to waste, give away or squander money, &c., (in these senses probably a Nom. fr. व्यय below); cl. 10. P. व्याययति or व्यापयति, वेपयति (rather to be re-ferred to rts. व्यप्, 1. विप्), -यितुम्, to throw, cast.
व्यय: व्यय, अस्, आ, अम्, mutable, liable to change or decay [cf. अ-व्°]; (अस्), m. disappearance, loss; perish-ing, decaying, decay, destruction, change, downfall, decline, misfortune; spending, expenditure, expense, outlay, disbursement, (opposed to आय, income); squandering, extravagance, waste, prodigality; N. of Pradhāna; N. of the twentieth (or fifty-fourth) year of Jupiter's cycle; (अम्), n. (in astrology) the twelfth station or house from the Lagna (= लग्नाद् द्वा-दश-स्थानम्). —व्यय-पराङ्मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, averse from expenditure, parsimonious. —व्यय-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessing waste or decay, &c.; changeful, imperfect, incomplete. —व्यय-शील, अस्, आ, अम्, disposed to prodigality, wasteful, spendthrift. —व्ययी-करण, अम्, n. the act of expending or disbursing, wasting. —व्ययी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, ex-pended, spent, wasted, lavished. —व्ययी-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, spent, squandered, wasted.
व्ययन: व्ययन, अम्, n. the act of expending, spending, expenditure, wasting, destroying.
व्ययमान: व्ययमान, अस्, आ, अम्, expending, spending, wasting.
व्ययित: व्ययित, अस्, आ, अम्, expended, spent, disbursed, consumed, dissipated, dispersed; gone away, de-clined, fallen into decay.
व्ययिन्: व्ययिन्, ई, इनी, इ, expending, spending, expensive, prodigal, lavish, extravagant; declining, falling into calamity, wasting, changing, decaying, (उदय-व्ययिन्, rising and falling.) —व्ययि-ता, f. or व्ययि-त्व, अम्, n. prodigality, wastefulness.
व्यर्ण: व्यर्ण 1. व्य्-अर्ण, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. see below), without water, rainless, dry.
2. व्य्-अर्ण or व्य्-अर्ण्ण, अस्, आ, अम् (see Pāṇ. VII. 2, 24), gone away, gone; oppressed, pained, dis-tressed; asked.
व्यर्थ: व्यर्थ व्य्-अर्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, useless, unprofit-able, fruitless, ineffectual, vain; unmeaning. —व्यर्-थ-ता, f. or व्यर्थ-त्व, अम्, n. uselessness, un-profitableness, (व्यर्थ-तां या or गम्, to become useless); inoffensiveness; want of meaning, non-sense. —व्यर्थ-यत्न, अस्, आ, अम्, making useless efforts.
व्यर्थक: व्यर्थक, अस्, आ, अम्, useless, vain, &c., = व्य्-अर्थ. —व्यर्थक-ता, f. or व्यर्थक-त्व, अम्, n. unprofitableness, uselessness.
व्यर्द्: व्यर्द् व्य्-अर्द् (वि-अर्द्), cl. 1. P. -अर्दति, -अर्-दितुम्, Ved. to go or move away, to flow away; to oppress, harass, pain: Caus. -अर्दयति, -यितुम्, to cause to be scattered or dissolved, destroy, annihilate.
व्यलीक: व्यलीक व्य्-अलीक, अस्, आ, अम् [cf. अलीक], dis-agreeable, displeasing, painful, offensive, strange; improper or unfit to be done; false; (अम्), n. any-thing displeasing; any cause of pain or uneasiness or disagreeableness, pain, grief, torture; any improper act, fault, transgression (= कामजापराध); re-verse, contrariety, inversion; cheating, tricking; falsehood; (अस्), m. a libertine (= नागर, काम-केलि); a catamite. —व्यलीक-ता, f. or व्यलीक-त्व, अम्, n. disagreeableness, painfulness; impropriety, displeasure. —व्यलीक-निःश्वास, अस्, m. a sigh of pain or grief.
व्यल्कश: व्यल्कश व्य्-अल्कश, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having various branches, (Sāy. = विविध-शाख।)
व्यवकलन: व्यवकलन व्य्-अवकलन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. 3. कल् with अव and वि), separation, subtraction, deduction.
व्यवकलित: व्य्-अवकलित, अस्, आ, अम्, separated, subtracted, deducted; (अम्), n. subtraction.
व्यवकृष्: व्यवकृष् व्य्-अव-कृष् (वि-अव-), cl. 1. P. -कर्षति, -कर्ष्टुम्, -क्रष्टुम्, to draw or drag down or away from, tear away, alienate.
व्यवकॄ: व्यवकॄ व्य्-अव-कॄ (वि-अव-), cl. 6. P. -कि-रति, -करितुम्, -करीतुम्, to scatter or pour down, pour on, scatter about.
व्यवक्रोशन: व्यवक्रोशन व्य्-अवक्रोशन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. क्रुश् with अव and वि), mutual altercation, wrangling, mutual abuse; abuse, reviling (in general).
व्यवगम्: व्यवगम् व्य्-अव-गम्, cl. 1. A. -गच्छते, -गन्तुम्, Ved. to go apart, part, separate, divide.
व्यवगाह्: व्यवगाह् व्य्-अव-गाह्, cl. 1. A. -गाहते, -गा-हितुम्, -गाढुम्, to dive down into, plunge into; to enter into, penetrate; to set in.
व्यवगाढ: व्य्-अवगाढ, अस्, आ, अम्, dived or plunged into, immersed.
व्यवग्रह्: व्यवग्रह् व्य्-अव-ग्रह्, cl. 9. P. A. -गृह्णाति, गृह्णीते, &c., -ग्रहीतुम्, Ved. to bring down, to bend or incline down.
व्यवगृहीत: व्य्-अवगृहीत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. brought down, bent down.
व्यवच्छिद्: व्यवच्छिद् व्य्-अव-च्छिद् (वि-अव-छिद्), cl. 7. P. A. -च्छिनत्ति, -च्छिन्ते, -च्छेत्तुम्, to cut off or in pieces, separate, separate from; to tear asunder, open, sever; to interrupt; to decide or resolve on (with प्रति): Pass. -च्छिद्यते, to be cut off or separated.
व्यवच्छिद्य: व्य्-अवच्छिद्य, ind. having cut off or separated; having decided or resolved.
व्यवच्छिन्न: व्य्-अवच्छिन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, cut off; torn or rent asunder; separated, divided; distinguished; particu-larized, specified; distinct; interrupted, (अ-व्यवच्-छिन्न, uninterrupted.)
व्यवच्छेद: व्य्-अवच्छेद, अस्, m. cutting off or in pieces; anatomy; dividing, separating; discrimination; par-ticularizing, specification; distinction, contrast; deci-sion, determination; a division, section; letting fly an arrow, shooting, darting. —व्यवच्छेद-विद्या, f. the science of anatomy.
व्यवच्छेदक: व्य्-अवच्छेदक, अस्, इका, अम्, cutting off, divid-ing in two, discriminating, distinguishing, particular-izing.
व्यवतिष्ठमान: व्यवतिष्ठमान व्य्-अवतिष्ठमान। See under 1. व्य्-अव-स्था, col. 3.
व्य्-अवतिष्ठमान, अस्, आ, अम्, placed asunder, situated apart; adjusted, arranged, placed, &c.
व्यवदा: व्यवदा व्य्-अव-दा (see rt. 3. दा), cl. 2. 4. P. -दाति, -द्यति, -दातुम्, to cut off, cut in two, divide.
व्यवदाय: व्य्-अवदाय, having cut in two or divided.
व्यवदॄ: व्यवदॄ व्य्-अव-दॄ (वि-अव-), Pass. -दीर्यते, to be torn asunder; to burst asunder, split in two.
व्यवदीर्ण: व्य्-अवदीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, burst asunder, broken to pieces, distracted.
व्यवदे: व्यवदे व्य्-अव-दै (वि-अव-), Pass. -दायते, to be brightly diffused.
व्यवदात: व्य्-अवदात, अस्, आ, (Ved. ई), अम्, = अव-दात।
व्यवदायमान: व्य्-अवदायमान, अस्, आ, अम्, brightly diffused or spread about.
व्यवधा: व्यवधा 1. व्य्-अव-धा (वि-अव-), cl. 3. P. A. -दधाति, -धत्ते, -धातुम्, to place apart or asun-der; to put or place between, interpose; to separate, divide, interrupt, obstruct, cover, screen, conceal; to lay aside, leave out, omit, pass over; to put down here and there: Pass. -धीयते, to be separated or separated from.
2. व्य्-अवधा, f. anything which intervenes or conceals from sight; a screen, partition, covering, the state of being covered, concealment, disappear-ance.
व्यवधातृ: व्य्-अवधातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who separates or interposes or screens.
व्यवधान: व्य्-अवधान, अम्, n. the act of placing apart or between, intervening, intervention, interposition, separation, break, gap; anything which intervenes or screens; a screen, partition, intervening object; intervening space, interval, space (in general); (in grammar) the intervention of a syllable or letter; covering, a cover; obstruction, the being covered or concealed, concealment, disappearance.
व्यवधाय: व्य्-अवधाय, ind. having placed apart or be-tween, having interposed.
व्यवधायक: व्य्-अवधायक, अस्, इका, अम्, intervening, screen-ing, interposing, separating; covering, concealing, hiding, obstructing; intermediate.
व्यवधि: व्य्-अवधि, इस्, m. anything which intervenes or screens, a covering; intervention, covering, conceal-ing, &c., (see व्य्-अवधान।)
व्यवधेय: व्य्-अवधेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be put in between or interposed.
व्यवहित: व्य्-अवहित, अस्, आ, अम्, placed apart, placed be-tween; separated by anything intervening, separated, interrupted; obstructed, stopped, impeded; screened from view, concealed, covered; not contiguous, not immediately connected, only relating to; placed asunder, placed opposite, hostile, opposed; laid aside, omitted, passed over, surpassed, excelled, put to shame; done, acted, performed.
व्यवहित व्य्-अवहित। See under व्य्-अव-धा, col. 1.
व्यवधाव्: व्यवधाव् व्य्-अव-धाव् (वि-अव-), cl. 1. P. A. -धावति, -ते, -धावितुम्, to run away from one another, separate from; to run away from.
व्यवधू: व्यवधू व्य्-अव-धू (वि-अव-), cl. 5. P. A. -धूनोति, -धूनुते (in the later language also -धुनोति, -धुनुते), -धवितुम्, -धोतुम्, to shake off, ward off, remove; to shake about, treat roughly or rudely; to overthrow: Pass. -धूयते, to be shaken off, &c.
व्यवधूत: व्य्-अवधूत, अस्, आ, अम्, shaken off, one who has shaken off all worldly desires, indifferent in regard of life, resigned.
व्यवधूय: व्य्-अवधूय, ind. having shaken off, having removed or warded off.
व्यवधूयमान: व्य्-अवधूयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being shaken about, being roughly treated.
व्यवनी: व्यवनी व्य्-अव-नी (वि-अव-), cl. 1. P. A. -नयति, -ते, -नेतुम्, Ved. to pour in separately, pour in drop by drop.
व्यवनीय: व्य्-अवनीय, ind., Ved. having poured in sepa-rately.
व्यवपद्: व्यवपद् व्य्-अव-पद् (वि-अव-), cl. 4. A. -पद्यते, -पत्तुम्, to fall down, fall asunder.
व्यवभक्ष्: व्यवभक्ष् व्य्-अव-भक्ष् (वि-अव-), cl. 10. P. -भक्षयति, -यितुम्, Ved. to swallow down or eat (in the interval of certain religious rites).
व्यवभास्: व्यवभास् व्य्-अव-भास् (वि-अव-), Caus. -भा-सयति, -यितुम्, to cause to shine out brightly, to illuminate beautifully.
व्यवभासित: व्य्-अवभासित, अस्, आ, अम्, brightly illuminated.
व्यवमुच्: व्यवमुच् व्य्-अव-मुच् (वि-अव-), cl. 6. P. A. -मुञ्चति, -ते, -मोक्तुम्, to unloose, unfasten, take off.
व्यवमुच्य: व्य्-अवमुच्य, ind. having unloosed, having taken off.
व्यवरुह्: व्यवरुह् व्य्-अव-रुह् (वि-अव-), cl. 1. P. A. -रोहति, -ते, -रोढुम्, to ascend, mount, get upon: Caus. -रोपयति, -यितुम्, to displace, remove; to deprive of (with abl.): Pass. of Caus. -रोप्यते, to be expelled from or deprived of (with abl.).
व्यवरोपित: व्य्-अवरोपित, अस्, आ, अम्, displaced, removed, expelled; deprived of (with abl.).
व्यववद्: व्यववद् व्य्-अव-वद् (वि-अव-), cl. 1. P. A. -वदति, -ते, -वदितुम्, Ved. to speak ill of, decry; to begin to speak, break silence.
व्यवसद्: व्यवसद् व्य्-अव-सद् (वि-अव-), cl. 1. P. -सी-दति, -सत्तुम्, to sink or fall down, sit down; to pine or waste away, perish.
व्यवसाय: व्य्-अवसाय, अस्, m. settled determination, resolve, obstinacy; strenuous effort or exertion, activity, energy, industry, perseverance; action, performance; conduct, behaviour; following any business or pro-fession; a trade, business, livelihood; artifice, plan, device, stratagem, trick; boasting; N. of Viṣṇu; of Śiva; of a son of Dharma by Vapus (daughter of Dakṣa). —व्यवसायात्मिक (°य-आत्°), अस्, आ, अम्, full of resolve or energy, relating to exertion, ener-getic, laborious.
व्यवसृज्: व्यवसृज् व्य्-अव-सृज् (वि-अव-), cl. 6. P. -सृ-जति, -स्रष्टुम्, to throw, cast, hurl; to put down, lay down.
व्यवसो: व्यवसो व्य्-अव-सो (वि-अव-), cl. 4. P. -स्यति (ep. forms 1st sing. Pres. व्य्-अवसामि, Pot. व्य्-अवसेयम्, 2nd Fut. व्य्-अवसिष्यामि), -सातुम्, to settle, determine, resolve, decide, constitute, establish; to be convinced or persuaded; to make strenuous effort, strive, endeavour, act, be industrious; to strive for, labour after; to make an attempt upon (with acc.); to seek after, ask for, wish; to reflect: Caus. -साययति, -यितुम्, to cause to resolve, cause to make effort, excite, instigate, embolden, make vigorous or strong.
व्यवसायिन्: व्य्-अवसायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, one who acts resolutely or energetically, resolute, energetic, active, enterprising, persevering, painstaking, industrious, laborious, dili-gent; acting, performing, undertaking (anything), one who performs his duty; engaged in trade or busi-ness; a tradesman, handicraftsman.
व्यवसित: व्य्-अवसित, अस्, आ, अम्, settled, decided, resolved, determined, ascertained; endeavoured, undertaken, performed; energetic, taking pains, making effort or exertion, persevering, endeavouring; planned, de-signed, schemed; deceived, tricked, cheated; (अम्), n. certainty, ascertainment.
व्यवस्य: व्य्-अवस्य, ind. having settled or resolved, having decided; having made effort, having acted with resolution, having performed.
व्यवस्था: व्यवस्था 1. व्य्-अव-स्था, cl. 1. A. -तिष्ठते, -स्थातुम्, to be placed or situated asunder; to be arranged in due order, to be adjusted or settled; Caus. -स्थापयति, -यितुम्, to place or set asunder; to cause to be properly arranged or settled, decide, establish; to lay down a law; to perform.

2. व्य्-अवस्था, f. arrangement, settlement, placing apart, separating; placing in suitable order, adjusting, arranging, arrangement; relative position or state; placing or setting in or on, fixing on a firm basis, settlement, decision, decree, statute, rule, law, written declaration of the law, legal opinion (applied to the written extracts from the codes of law or proper adjustment of contradictory passages in different codes made by decisions of officers attached to the courts of justice), a decision (in general); engagement, agreement, contract; course, state, condition, system or order of things (in general). —व्यवस्थाति-क्रम (°था-अत्°), अस्, m. or व्यवस्थातिवर्तन (°था-अत्°), अम्, n. transgression or violation of the law, disregard of settled rule; breaking an agreement or contract. —व्यवस्थातिवर्तिन् (°था-अत्°), ई, इनी, इ, transgressing the law, breaking an engagement or contract, &c.
व्यवस्थान: व्य्-अवस्थान, अस्, m., N. of Viṣṇu; (अम्), n. regular arrangement or distribution; steadiness, set-tlement, &c. (= व्य्-अवस्थिति below).
व्यवस्थापक: व्य्-अवस्थापक, अस्, इका, अम्, settling, adjusting, arranging in an orderly manner, deciding, establish-ing, any one who settles or legislates or gives a legal opinion.
व्यवस्थापन: व्य्-अवस्थापन, अम्, n. the act of placing apart; placing in order, fixing, determining, appointing, declaring, deciding, laying down a law; fixing or placing (in general).
व्यवस्थापित: व्य्-अवस्थापित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to be placed or arranged in order; laid down (as a law, &c.), established, fixed, declared, determined.
व्यवस्थाप्य: 1. व्य्-अवस्थाप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be established or declared or settled, to be fixed, &c.; (अम्), n. the state of being established, &c.
2. व्य्-अवस्थाप्य, ind. having set or placed in proper order, having fixed or settled or determined.
व्यवस्थित: व्य्-अवस्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, standing or situated apart or at a distance, stood aside, separated; ex-cerpted, extracted; going away; placed in order, adjusted, harmoniously arranged; staying or standing or remaining in or on, (with वाक्ये, abiding in what is said, obeying); depending on, fixed in or on, resting on, based, fixed, settled; appointed, agreed, declared, decided, decreed, constant, restricted. —व्य-वस्थित-विकल्प, अस्, m. an option fixed or de-clared by law. —व्यवस्थित-विभाषा, f. (in gram-mar) a fixed option or one applicable throughout, (the prescribed operation being in one case carried out throughout and in the other omitted throughout.)
व्यवस्थिति: व्य्-अवस्थिति, इस्, f. the being situated or placed apart, separation; extracting; arrangement in due order, settlement, decision, determination, appoint-ment; rule, statute; remaining firm, constancy, perseverance; extracting.
व्यवहा: व्यवहा व्य्-अव-हा, cl. 3. P. -जहाति, -हातुम्, to abandon, give up, relinquish.
व्यवहाय: व्य्-अवहाय, ind. having abandoned or relin-quished.
व्यवहास: व्यवहास व्य्-अवहास, अस्, m. (fr. rt. हस् with अव and वि), mutual laughter.
व्यवहृ: व्यवहृ व्य्-अव-हृ, cl. 1. P. A. -हरति, -ते, -हर्तुम्, to act, behave; to manage, transact, deal with, traffic with, carry on a business or trade; to stake at play (with gen. of the thing staked, = rt. 2. पण्, q. v.); to carry on legal proceedings, litigate, contend; to recover, regain, obtain; to distinguish.
व्यवहरत्: व्य्-अवहरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, acting, behaving, con-ducting one's self.
व्यवहर्तव्य: व्य्-अवहर्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be transacted or done; to be litigated or decided judicially; to be dealt with.
व्यवहर्तृ: व्य्-अवहर्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who acts or trans-acts business, one engaged in any affair; observing or following established usages; (ता), m. the manager of any business, the conductor of any judicial pro-cedure, a judge, umpire; one engaged in litigation, a litigant, plaintiff, any one who institutes an action at law; an associate, partaker.
व्यवहार: व्य्-अवहार, अस्, m. doing, performing, conduct, behaviour, practice, action; affair; occupation, work, profession, business, any pecuniary transaction, usury; dealing, traffic, commerce, trade; a contest at law, legal dispute, lawsuit, litigation; legal prac-tice, judicial procedure, administration of justice (as the examination of evidence, &c.); a title of legal procedure, occasion of litigation, any act cognizable in a court of justice; usage, habit, custom, rule, law, adherence to law; steadiness, propriety; a con-tract; mathematical determination or ascertainment; a sort of tree. —व्यवहार-काल, अस्, m. the period of action, a mundane period. —व्यवहार-ज्ञ, अस्, m. a person who understands business, one acquainted with practice or legal procedure, a young man of age, one no longer a minor (i. e. one who has passed his sixteenth year, at which period he can assert his own rights in a court of law). —व्यवहार-तत्त्व, अम्, n., N. of a treatise on civil law by Raghu-nandana (being part of the Smṛti-tattva). —व्यवहार-तस्, ind. according to established practice. —व्यवहार-दर्शन, अम्, n. judicial investigation, trial. —व्य-वहार-निर्णय, अस्, m. ‘legal-decision,’ N. of a work by Śrī-pati. —व्यवहार-पद, अम्, n. a title or head of legal procedure, occasion of litiga-tion, (according to Śabda-k. = वादिना राज्ञि निवे-दनम्, see व्यवहार-विषय।) —व्यवहार-पाद, अस्, m. the fourth part or quarter of a legal process, one of the four stages or divisions necessary to conduct a regular suit, (these are, 1. पूर्व-पक्-ष, the plaint; व्यसन: व्य्-असन, अम्, n. the act of throwing in different directions, separating, separation; individuality; cast-ing away or dispelling (happiness &c.), violation, infraction; calamity, misfortune, ill-luck, evil destiny, fate, fated consequence, destruction, loss, defeat, fall-ing away, fall; setting (as of the sun or moon); sin, fault, vice, crime, bad practice, evil habit (said to arise either from love of pleasure or from anger; ten vices are enumerated in Manu VII. 47, 48, under the first head, viz. मृगया, hunting; द्यूत or अक्ष, gambling; दिवा-स्वप्न, sleeping in the day; परिवाद, calumny; स्त्रियः, addiction to women; मद, drinking spirits; तौर्य-त्रिक, dancing, singing, and instrumental music; वृथाट्या, idle roaming: and eight are said to proceed from anger, viz. पैशुन्य, tale-bearing; साहस, violence; द्रोह, insidious injury; ईर्ष्या, envy; असूया, detraction; अर्थ-दूषण, unjust seizure of pro-perty; वाक्-पारुष्य, violence in words or abuse; दण्ड-पारुष्य, violence by actual assault: the number and nature of these vices are variously given in other books); punishment, execution (of cri-minals); fruitless effort; incompetence, inability; throwing one's self into any pursuit, intent applica-tion or attachment to any object, inordinate addiction, diligence; air, wind. —व्यसन-प्रसारित-कर, अस्, आ, अम्, having the hand stretched forth for (inflicting) calamity. —व्यसन-प्रहारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, inflicting calamity, giving trouble or pain. —व्यसन-रक्-षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, preserving from calamity. —व्यस-नाक्रान्त-त्व (°न-आक्°), अम्, n. distressful condition, grievous distress. —व्यसनातिभार (°न-अत्°), अस्, आ, अम्, weighed down with misfortunes, overbur-dened with calamities. —व्यसनान्वित (°न-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, involved in calamity. —व्यसनाप्लुत (°न-आप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, overwhelmed with calamity. —व्यसनार्त (°न-आर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, afflicted by calamity or misfortune, suffering pain. —व्यसनो-दय (°न-उद्°), अस्, आ, अम्, followed by or resulting in calamities.

व्यसनीय: व्यसनीय, अस्, m. a vicious person, profligate, libertine.

व्यस्तार: व्यस्तार, अम्, n. (said to be fr. व्यस्त + आर fr. rt. 4. ऋ), the issue of the fluid from the temples of an elephant.
व्यस्य: व्य्-अस्य, ind. having thrown asunder, having thrown or tossed about, having dispersed or scattered; having arranged in order.
व्यास: व्य्-आस, अस्, m. distributing or disposing in dif-ferent directions, distribution or separation into parts, (in Atharva-veda Prātiśākhya III. 68. said to mean ‘the disjoined or Pada text’); severing; severalty, distinction, detail; diffusing, extending; diffusion, extension, width, breadth, the breadth or diameter of a circle; a particular measure; a fault in pronun-ciation, a kind of drawl [cf. पीडन, वि-हार]; dis-posing in order, arranging, an arranger, compiler; N. of a celebrated sage and author (often called Veda-vyāsa and regarded as the original arranger of the Vedas &c. and founder of the Vedānta philosophy [see वेदान्त]; he was the son of the sage Parāśara and Satyavatī, who afterwards, as the wife of Śāntanu, gave birth to Vicitra-vīrya and Bhīṣma; he was therefore half-brother of these latter; Parāśara met Satyavatī, when quite a girl, as he was crossing the river Jumnā; their child Vyāsa was called Kṛṣṇa from his dark complexion, and Dvaipāyana because he was brought forth by Satyavatī on a Dvīpa or island in the Jumnā; when grown up he retired to the wilderness to lead the life of a hermit, but at his mother's request returned to become the husband of Vicitra-vīrya's two childless widows, by whom he was the father of the blind Dhṛta-rāṣṭra and of Pāṇḍu; he was also the father of Vidura by a slave girl [see विदुर, p. 918] and of Śuka, the supposed narrator of the Bhāgavata-Purāṇa: the Viṣṇu-Pu-rāṇa III. 3. enumerates twenty-eight Vyāsas or arrangers of the Vedas in the twenty-eight Dvāpara ages of the Vaivasvata Manv-antara; the first Vyāsa is said to have been Svayam-bhū or Brahmā himself, and the twenty-eighth was Kṛṣṇa-dvaipāyana: the name Vyāsa seems to have been given to any great compiler or author, and this title is conferred not only on the arranger of the Vedas and the Purāṇas, but also on the compiler of the Mahā-bhārata, the Brahma-sūtra of the Vedānta philosophy, a Dharma-śāstra, the Yoga-sūtra-bhāṣya, the Vakra-tuṇḍa-stotra, the Vakra-tuṇḍāṣṭaka hymns, and the Śiva-dhanur-veda: the following are synonyms for Vyāsa, Vādarāyaṇa or Bādarāyaṇa, Dvaipāyana, Kṛṣṇa-dvaipāyana, Pārāśari, Māṭhara, Kānīna, Sātyavata, Satya-bhārata, Satya-rata); a Brāhman who recites or expounds the Purāṇas &c. in public (= पाठक-ब्राह्मण). —व्यास-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a place; (अस्), m., N. of a commentator. —व्यास-त्व, अम्, n. the state or title of a compiler. —व्यास-दास, अस्, m., N. of a chief of the Vaikhānasa sect. —व्यास-देव, अस्, m. the divine sage Vyāsa. —व्यास-पूजा, f. honour paid to an expounder of the Purāṇas. —व्यास-भाष्य-व्याख्या, f., N. of a commentary by Vācas-pati. —व्यास-मातृ, ता, f. ‘mother of Vyāsa,’ epithet of Satyavatī. —व्यास-वन, अम्, n., N. of a sacred forest. —व्यास-शुक-संवाद, अस्, m. ‘dialogue between Vyāsa and Śuka,’ N. of a philosophical discourse on the vanity of everything except religion (said to be extracted from the Mahā-bhārata). —व्यास-सूत्र, अम्, n., N. of a work. —व्यास-स्मृति, इस्, f., N. of a law-book. —व्या-साष्टक (°स-अष्°), N. of a hymn. —व्यासासन (°स-आस्°), अम्, n. the seat of an expounder of the Purāṇas. —व्यासेश्वर-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a chapter of the Śiva-Purāṇa.

व्याकुल: व्याकुल व्य्-आकुल, अस्, आ, अम्, confounded, confused, agitated, discomposed, bewildered, per-plexed, troubled, dimmed, overcome with fear; busily occupied about anything. —व्याकुल-चित्त, अस्, आ, अम्, or व्याकुल-चेतस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, or व्याकुल-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, or व्याकुलात्मन् (°ल-आत्°), आ, आ, अ, agitated or perplexed in mind, flurried, having a mind distracted with grief. —व्याकुल-ता, f. or व्याकुल-त्व, अम्, n. perturbation, agitation, per-plexity, bewilderment, alarm. —व्याकुली-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, -कर्तुम्, to bewilder, render confused or perplexed, trouble. —व्याकुली-भू, cl. 1. P. -भ-वति, &c., to become perplexed. —व्याकुलेन्द्रिय (°ल-इन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having the senses bewildered, one who has lost his senses, discomposed, ruffled.
व्याकुलय: व्याकुलय, Nom. P. व्याकुलयति, -यितुम्, to agitate, flurry, confuse, frighten.
व्याकुलित: व्याकुलित, अस्, आ, अम्, agitated, flurried, perplexed, confounded, alarmed.
व्याकूति: व्याकूति व्य्-आकूति, इस्, f. wrong or evil in-tention, fraud, deception, disguise (= भङ्गि).
व्याकृ: व्याकृ व्य्-आ-कृ (वि-आ-), cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to undo, decompose, analyse, separate, divide; to expound, explain, utter.
व्याकार: व्य्-आकार, अस्, m. transformation, change of form, distortion, deformity.
व्याकृत: व्य्-आकृत, अस्, आ, अम्, analysed, decomposed, sepa-rated, expounded, explained, made clear; transformed, disfigured, deformed, distorted, changed.
व्य्-आकृत, अस्, आ, अम्, developed, unfolded, ex-panded.
व्याकृति: व्य्-आकृति, इस्, f. analysing, explaining, making clear; grammar; change of form, development.
व्याकृष्: व्याकृष् व्य्-आ-कृष् (वि-आ-), cl. 1. P. -कर्-षति, -कर्ष्टुम्, -क्रष्टुम्, to draw or drag in different directions, draw apart, separate; to draw off or away, take off, put off, throw off; to remove.
व्याकृष्ट: व्य्-आकृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, drawn off, taken off, thrown off.
व्याकोश: व्याकोश व्य्-आकोश, अस्, आ, अम्, expanded, blossomed, blown (as a flower).
व्याकोष: व्य्-आकोष, अस्, आ, अम्, = व्य्-आकोश above.
व्याक्रुश्: व्याक्रुश् व्य्-आ-क्रुश् (वि-आ-), cl. 1. P. -क्रोशति, -क्रोष्टुम्, to cry out aloud, complain, lament.
व्याक्रोशत्: व्य्-आक्रोशत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, crying out aloud, mak-ing loud lamentations.
व्याक्षिप्: व्याक्षिप् व्य्-आ-क्षिप् (वि-आ-), cl. 6. P. A. -क्षिपति, -ते, -क्षेप्तुम्, to throw or toss about; to carry away; to stretch out or forth, open; to shoot off (as a bow).
व्याक्षिप्त: व्य्-आक्षिप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, tossed hither and thither, tossed about; torn asunder, carried away, distracted, stretched out, stretched forth. —व्याक्षिप्त-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, or व्याक्षिप्त-हृदय, अस्, आ, अम्, having the mind or heart tossed about, distracted in mind.
व्याक्षेप: व्य्-आक्षेप, अस्, m. throwing or tossing about; obstruction, hinderance, delay, (अ-व्याक्षेप, absence of delay.)
व्याक्षोभ: व्याक्षोभ व्य्-आ-क्षोभ, अस्, m. commotion, perturbation, agitation, disturbed state, disturbance.
व्याख्या: व्याख्या 1. व्य्-आ-ख्या (वि-आ-), cl. 2. P. -ख्याति, -ख्यातुम्, to explain in detail, expound, interpret, illustrate; to speak at length, tell in full; to relate, narrate, tell (a story); to communicate, inform; to name, call: Pass. -ख्यायते, to be ex-plained: Desid. -चिख्यासति, to intend or wish to explain, be about to expound.

2. व्य्-आख्या, f. explanation, exposition, interpreta-tion, gloss, comment, paraphrase. —व्याख्यागम्य (°या-आग्°), अम्, n. anything which can only be under-stood by explanation, a kind of उत्तराभास, q. v.; indistinct assertion or declaration (said to proceed from grammatical inaccuracy or faulty construction), any obscure statement or passage. —व्याख्या-सुधा, f. ‘nectar of exposition,’ N. of a commentary on the Amara-koṣa by Bhānujī-dīkṣita.
व्याख्यात: व्य्-आख्यात, अस्, आ, अम्, explained in detail, ex-pounded, interpreted, illustrated; spoken in full, related, narrated, told, spoken, said; conquered, over-come (?).
व्याख्यातव्य: व्य्-आख्यातव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, requiring to be ex-pounded or commented upon.
व्याख्यातृ: व्य्-आख्यातृ, ता, m. an explainer, commentator, expounder.
व्याख्यान: व्य्-आख्यान, अम्, n. explaining, expounding, commenting; explanation, exposition; gloss, com-ment, interpretation. —व्याख्यान-योग्य, अस्, आ, अम्, deserving exposition.
व्याख्येय: व्य्-आख्येय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be explained or ex-pounded, to be described.
व्याचिख्यासितग्रन्थ: व्याचिख्यासित-ग्रन्थ, अस्, m. one who is about to explain a book.
व्याघट्टन: व्याघट्टन व्य्-आघट्टन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. घट्ट् with आ and वि), rubbing together, friction; churning.
व्याघट्टित: व्य्-आघट्टित, अस्, आ, अम्, rubbed together, rubbed; churned, stirred.
व्याघात: व्याघात व्य्-आघात, अस्, m. (fr. व्य्-आ-हन्), striking against, beating, wounding, destroying, de-struction; a blow, stroke; obstacle, impediment, hin-derance; the thirteenth of the astronomical Yogas; the tree Cassia Fistula; a particular figure of rhetoric (described as the production of two different effects from a similar cause or by similar agency); contra-diction, inconsistency of statement.
व्याघातक: व्य्-आघातक, अस्, आ or इका, अम्, striking against, opposing, thwarting, hindering, impeding, resisting; one who opposes or resists, an obstructor.
व्याघातिन्: व्य्-आघातिन्, ई, इनी, इ, one who strikes against or opposes or resists, an opposer; obstructing, opposing, resisting.
व्याघुट्: व्याघुट् व्य्-आ-घुट् (वि-आ-), cl. 1. A. -घोटते, cl. 6. P. -घुटति, -घोटितुम्, to turn back, return.
व्याघुटित: व्य्-आघुटित, अस्, आ, अम्, turned back, returned.
व्याघुष्: व्याघुष् व्य्-आ-घुष् (वि-आ-), cl. 1. P. -घो-षति, -घोषितुम्, to sound aloud: Caus. -घोष-यति, -यितुम्, to call out aloud, shout or proclaim aloud.
व्याघुष्ट: व्य्-आघुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, sounded aloud, loud-sounding, resounding.
व्याघोषयत्: व्य्-आघोषयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, proclaiming aloud.
व्याघूर्ण्: व्याघूर्ण् व्य्-आ-घूर्ण् (वि-आ-), cl. 1. P. A. -घूर्णति, -ते, -घूर्णितुम्, to whirl or wave about, shake to and fro.
व्याघूर्णमान: व्य्-आघूर्णमान, अस्, आ, अम्, whirling or wav-ing about.
व्याघूर्णित: व्य्-आघूर्णित, अस्, आ, अम्, whirled about, tossed hither and thither, wheeled about, agitated, whirling round, tottering, shaking about, waving.
व्याघृ: व्याघृ व्य्-आ-घृ (वि-आ-), Caus. -घारयति, -यितुम्, Ved. to sprinkle round or over, besprinkle.
व्याघारण: व्य्-आघारण, अम्, n. the act of sprinkling.
व्याघारित: व्य्-आघारित, अस्, आ, अम्, besprinkled, sprinkled with oil or ghee.
व्याघ्र: व्याघ्र व्याघ्र, अस्, m. (fr. rt. घ्रा with आ and वि), a tiger, (चित्र-व्याघ्र, ‘spotted tiger,’ a hunting leopard; in the Vahni-Purāṇa tigers are said to be the offspring of Kaśyapa's wife, Daṃṣṭrā); any eminent person, best, pre-eminent (at the end of a comp., cf. पुरुष-व्° and see ऋषभ, सिंह, which are also used as the last member of com-pounds to express ‘eminence’); a red variety of the castor-oil plant (= रक्तैरण्ड); the tree Pon-gamia Glabra or Galedupa Arborea (= करञ्ज); N. of the author of a law-book; (ई), f. a female tiger, tigress; a sort of prickly nightshade, Solanum Jacquini (= कण्टकारी). —व्याघ्र-चर्मन्, अ, n. a tiger's skin. —व्याघ्रचर्म-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made of a tiger's skin. —व्याघ्र-ता, f. or व्याघ्र-त्व, अम्, n. the state or condition of a tiger. —व्या-घ्र-दल, अस्, m. the castor-oil tree or a red variety of it. —व्याघ्र-नख, अस्, m. a tiger's claw; a particular plant (= स्नुही); a kind of perfume; (अम्), n. a kind of medicinal herb with a fragrant root, (in Hindī called बघ्नहा); a sort of per-fume, (in this sense also ई, f.); a scratch, impres-sion of a finger-nail. —व्याघ्र-नखक, अम्, n. ‘tiger's claw,’ a scratch, the impression of a finger-nail. —व्याघ्र-नायक, अस्, m. ‘tiger-leader,’ a jackal. —व्याघ्र-पाद्, -पात्, -पदी, -पात्, tiger-footed; (पात्), m., N. of the author of Ṛg-veda IX. 97, 16-18 (having the patronymic Vāsiṣṭha); N. of a grammarian and author of a law-book. —व्या-घ्र-पाद, अस्, m. ‘tiger-footed,’ N. of a lawgiver; the plant Flacourtia Sapida (= वि-कङ्कत). —व्या-घ्र-पुच्छ, अस्, m. a tiger's tail; the castor-oil tree, Palma Christi or Ricinus Communis. —व्या-घ्र-पुर, अम्, n. ‘tiger's town,’ N. of a town. —व्याघ्र-भूति, इस्, m., N. of a grammarian. —व्याघ्र-वधू, ऊस्, f. the female of a tiger, a tigress. —व्याघ्र-श्वन्, आ, m. a tiger-like dog. —व्याघ्राट (°र-अट), अस्, m. a skylark (= भरद्-वाज). —व्याघ्रादनी (°र-अद्°), f. a particular plant (= त्रि-वृता). —व्याघ्रास्य (°र-आस्°), अम्, n. the mouth or face of a tiger; (अस्), m. ‘tiger-faced,’ a cat.
व्याघ्री: व्याघ्री, f. See under व्याघ्र above.
व्याङ्गि: व्याङ्गि व्याङ्गि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Vy-aṅga.
व्याचक्ष्: व्याचक्ष् व्य्-आ-चक्ष् (वि-आ-), cl. 2. A. -चष्टे, -चष्टुम्, to recite, rehearse (Ved.); to explain, comment upon.
व्याचक्षाण: व्य्-आचक्षाण, अस्, आ, अम्, reciting; explaining.
व्याज: व्याज व्य्-आज, अस्, m. (fr. व्य्-अज्), deceit, deception, fraud, craft, art, cunning; disguise (either of purpose or of person); semblance, appearance, pretext, pretence (sometimes at the end of comps., e. g. मृगया-व्याजेन, under the pretext of hunt-ing); contrivance, means; wickedness. —व्याज-निन्दा, f. ‘artful censure,’ a particular figure of rhetoric (praise veiled under apparent censure); ironical praise. —व्याज-भानु-जित्, त्, m. a proper N. —व्याज-स्तुति, इस्, f. ‘artful praise,’ indirect eulogy, praise or censure conveyed in language that expresses the contrary (as when from blame praise is expressed, and when from praise blame); ironical commendation. —व्याजी-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, &c., to hold out as a pretence or pretext. —व्याजी-कृत्य, ind. having held out as a pretext, having pretended (= अपदिश्य). —व्याजोक्ति (°ज-उक्°), इस्, f. covert allusion (intended to mislead), innuendo.
व्याड: व्याड व्याड, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. 1. अड् with वि), a snake; a carnivorous animal, beast of prey; N. of Indra; a villain, rogue; a proper N.; [cf. व्याल।] —व्याडायुध (°ड-आय्°), अम्, n. a sort of vegetable perfume (= व्याघ्र-नख).
व्याडि: व्याडि, इस्, m. (a patronymic fr. व्याड), N. of a celebrated grammarian and lexicographer (= विन्-ध्य-वासिन्, नन्दिनी-तनय, q. q. v. v.).
व्याडीय: व्याडीय, अस्, m. a follower of Vyāḍi.
व्यातन्: व्यातन् व्य्-आ-तन् (वि-आ-), cl. 8. P. A. -त-नोति, -तनुते, -तनितुम्, to stretch out, extend; to spread about or over, (व्यातेनिरे, they were spread about, Kirāt. XV. 42); to display; to produce, cause.
व्यात्युक्षी: व्यात्युक्षी व्य्-आत्य्-उक्षी, f. (probably fr. rt. 1. उक्ष् with अति, आ, and वि, cf. व्य्-आभ्य्-उक्षी), bathing together for amusement, mutual splashing and sporting in water (= रसिकानाम् अन्योन्यं जल-क्रीडनम्).
व्यादा: व्यादा व्य्-आ-दा (वि-आ-), cl. 3. P. A. -ददाति, -दत्ते, -दातुम्, to open wide, open, separate; to open the mouth, (also with मुखम् or similar words added); to make large or broad.
व्यात्त: व्य्-आत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, opened, open, wide open, spread, extended, expanded, vast; (अम्), n. the open mouth. —व्यात्तानन (°त-आन्°) or व्यात्तास्य (°त-आस्°), अस्, आ, अम्, open-mouthed.
व्याददान: व्य्-आददान, अस्, आ, अम्, opening (especially the mouth).
व्यादान: व्य्-आदान, अम्, n. opening, setting open or ajar.
व्यादाय: व्य्-आदाय, ind. having opened; having opened the mouth, having gaped (with wonder &c.); with the mouth open.
व्यादित: व्य्-आदित, अस्, आ, अम् (ep. for व्य्-आत्त), opened (applied especially to the mouth). —व्यादितास्य (°त-आस्°), अस्, आ, अम्, open-mouthed.
व्यादिश्: व्यादिश् व्य्-आ-दिश् (वि-आ-), cl. 3. 6. P. -दि-देष्टि, -दिशति, -देष्टुम्, to point out separately, divide among, distribute; to point out, show; to explain, inform, teach; to prescribe, order, charge, command (with acc. of the person); to assign, ap-point (to any duty); to give an order or command; to speak about any one (acc.); to declare, foretel.
व्यादिश: व्य्-आदिश, अस्, m., N. of Viṣṇu.
व्यादिश्य: व्य्-आदिश्य, ind. having pointed out, having pre-scribed or ordered, &c.
व्यादिष्ट: व्य्-आदिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, assigned or divided sepa-rately, distributed; pointed out, explained, instructed, taught; prescribed, ordered, charged, commanded; declared, indicated, foretold.
व्यादीर्घ: व्यादीर्घ व्य्-आदीर्घ, अस्, आ, अम्, very long or extended.
व्यादृश्: व्यादृश् व्य्-आ-दृश्, Pass. -दृश्यते, to be clearly seen or visible.
व्याधा: व्याधा व्य्-आ-धा (वि-आ-), cl. 3. P. A. -द-धाति, -धत्ते, -धातुम्, to separate, divide, dis-tract: Pass. -धीयते, Ved. to be separated or divided; to be out of health, feel unwell; [cf. व्याधि below.]
व्याहित: व्य्-आहित, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. diseased, unwell, ill, sick.
व्याधाम: व्याधाम व्य्-आधाम, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. ध्मा with आ and वि, but perhaps fr. व्य्-आ-धा, cf. also व्य्-आधाव below), Indra's thunderbolt (= वज्र).
व्याधाव: व्य्-आधाव, अस्, m. Indra's thunderbolt; [cf. व्य्-आधाम।]
व्याधि: व्याधि व्याधि, इस्, m. (probably to be con-nected with व्य्-आ-धा above, but also derived fr. rt. व्यध्, and perhaps connected with 2. आ-धि), pain, sickness, ailment, disease (in general); leprosy; N. of a son of Mṛtyu or Death. —व्याधि-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, causing sickness, unhealthy. —व्याधि-ग्रस्त or व्याधि-पीडित, अस्, आ, अम्, seized or afflicted with disease. —व्याधि-घात, अस्, m. ‘illness-destroyer,’ the tree Cassia Fistula (= आरग्-बध). —व्याधि-घ्न, अस्, ई, अम्, removing or destroying disease. —व्याधि-दुर्भिक्ष-पीडित, अस्, आ, अम्, afflicted with sickness and famine. —व्याधि-निग्रह, अस्, m. suppression of disease. —व्याधि-निर्जय, अस्, m. the subduing a disease. —व्याधि-बहुल, अस्, आ, अम्, frequently visited with disease (as a village). —व्या-धि-भय, अम्, n. fear of disease. —व्याधि-युक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, suffering from illness, diseased, sick. —व्याधि-रहित, अस्, आ, अम्, free from disease, convalescent. —व्याधि-हन्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, destroy-ing or removing disease; (ता), m. a kind of plant (= वाराही-कन्द). —व्याध्य्-आर्त, अस्, आ, अम्, pained with or suffering from disease. —व्याध्य्-उपशम, अस्, m. allaying or curing diseases.
व्याधित: व्याधित, अस्, आ, अम्, diseased, sick, ill, ailing.
व्याधू: व्याधू व्य्-आ-धू (वि-आ-), cl. 5. P. A. -धू-नोति, -धूनुते (later also -धुनोति, -धुनुते), -धवितुम्, -धोतुम्, to shake to and fro, move or toss about.
व्याधुत: व्य्-आधुत, अस्, आ, अम्, shaken about, tossed hither and thither, shaking, trembling, tremulous.
व्याधुन्वत्: व्य्-आधुन्वत्, अन्, अती, अत्, shaking or waving about.
व्याधूत: व्य्-आधूत, अस्, आ, अम्, shaken about, agitated.
व्याधूय: व्य्-आधूय, ind. having shaken or waved about.
व्याधूयमान: व्य्-आधूयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being shaken or tossed about, being moved hither and thither, being fanned; flickering.
व्यान: व्यान व्य्-आन, अस्, m. (fr. rt. अन् with आ and वि), one of the five vital airs (that which circulates or is diffused through the body, see प्राण).
व्यानम्: व्यानम् व्य्-आ-नम् (वि-आ-), cl. 1. P. A. -न-मति, -ते, &c., to bend or bow down.
व्यानत: व्य्-आनत, अस्, आ, अम्, bent down, having the face bent towards the ground; (अम्), n. a kind of coitus. —व्यानत-करण, अम्, n. the posture as-sumed in the preceding kind of coitus.
व्यानशि: व्यानशि व्य्-आनशि, इस्, इस्, इ (fr. व्य्-अश्), Ved. one who has pervaded, pervading, penetrating, (Sāy. व्य्-आनशिः = व्याप्नुवत्, Ṛg-veda III. 49, 3; in Naigh. III. 1. व्यानशिः is enumerated among the बहु-नामानि।)
व्य्-आनशि; add — according to B. R. fr. rt. 1. नश् with आ and वि।
व्यानशिन्: व्य्-आनशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. pervading, (Sāy. = व्यापन-शील।)
व्यानह्: व्यानह् व्य्-आ-नह्, cl. 4. P. A. -नह्यति, -ते, -नद्धुम्, to connect mutually, intersperse, inter-weave.
व्यानद्ध: व्य्-आनद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, connected mutually, interspersed.
व्यानी: व्यानी व्य्-आ-नी, cl. 1. P. A. -नयति, -ते, -नेतुम्, Ved. to pour in separately.
व्याप्: व्याप् व्य्-आप् (वि-आप्), cl. 5. P. -आप्नोति (some-times also A. -आप्नुते), -आप्तुम्, to reach through, spread through, go everywhere, overspread, pervade, permeate, fill up, occupy, cover, fill; to reach as far as, extend to: Pass. -आप्यते, &c.: Caus. -आपयति, &c.: Desid. वीप्सति; [cf. वीप्सा।]
व्यापक: व्य्-आपक, अस्, इका, अम्, pervading, diffusive, comprehensive, going everywhere, widely spreading, extending over the whole of anything, extensive, in-variably concomitant or inherent; (in law) compre-hending all the points of an argument, pervading the whole plea; (अस्), m. (in logic) ‘the pervader,’ a pervading attribute, one invariably concomitant (i. e. always found where some other is found); (इका), f. an impudent woman; (अम्), n. an invariably con-comitant or inherent property or characteristic. —व्या-पक-ता, f. or व्यापक-त्व, अम्, n. pervasion, diffusion, extensiveness, comprehensiveness; invari-able concomitance or inherence. —व्यापक-न्यास, अस्, m. (in the Tantra system) a particular disposition or arrangement of mystical texts over the whole per-son, (according to Śabda-k. = शिरस्तः पादान्तम् पादतः शिरो ऽन्तम् मूल-मन्त्र-विन्यासः।)
व्यापन: व्य्-आपन, अम्, n. the act of spreading through or throughout, pervading, penetrating, penetration, fill-ing up; covering.
व्यापनीय: व्य्-आपनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, fit to be pervaded or penetrated, permeable.
व्यापित: व्य्-आपित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Caus.), filled up, filled.
व्यापिन्: व्यापिन्, ई, इनी, इ, reaching through, pervading, extending over or to, covering; all-pervading, dif-fusive, comprehensive, co-extensive, invariably in-herent or concomitant; (ई), m. ‘the pervader,’ N. of Viṣṇu; a pervading property or characteristic. —व्यापि-त्व, अम्, n. the state of pervading, exten-siveness, extent, pervasion, diffusedness.
व्याप्त: व्य्-आप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, spread through, pervaded, pervading, extended, thoroughly occupied or pene-trated by (as the universe by spirit, &c.); encom-passed, surrounded; filled up, full; comprehended or included (under a general notion); having inhe-rent properties, invariably attended or accompanied (e. g. smoke is invariably attended by fire or neces-sarily includes or implies fire); obtained, possessed, possessed of; celebrated, famous; placed, fixed; open, outspread, expanded. —व्याप्त-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, most diffused. —व्याप्तान्तर (°त-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having intervals or holes or recesses filled up.
व्याप्ति: व्य्-आप्ति, इस्, f. the act or state of pervading, per-vasion, pervadedness, permeation, pervading inhe-rence, the inherent and inseparable presence of any one thing in another (as of oil in sesamum seed, heat in fire, &c.), universal pervasion, inseparable in-volvedness, invariable concomitance, invariable attend-ance on an ascertained sign, universal distribution (in logic), universal accompaniment of the middle term by the major (e. g. smoke is always pervaded by fire or fire is necessarily involved in smoke; it is this idea of pervasion that constitutes the peculiarity of the Hindū syllogism); universality, universal or general rule or law without an exception; omni-presence, ubiquity (as a divine attribute); fulness; obtaining, gaining, acquiring. —व्याप्ति-कर्मन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. whose function is diffusion. —व्याप्ति-ग्रह, अस्, m. apprehension of a general proposition or of universal concomitance, induction. —व्याप्ति-ज्ञान, अम्, n. knowledge of pervading inherence or of the presence of invariably concomitant properties. —व्य्-आप्ति-निश्चय, अस्, m. (in logic) the ascertainment of pervading inherence or universal concomitance. —व्य्-आप्ति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessing pervasion, univer-sally diffused, pervading; pervaded, attended by. —व्याप्ति-लक्षण, अम्, n. sign or proof of uni-versal pervasion or of the invariable attendance of an inherent property or characteristic.
व्याप्नुवान: व्य्-आप्नुवान, अस्, आ, अम्, pervading, permeating, penetrating.
व्याप्य: 1. व्य्-आप्य, ind. having pervaded, having pene-trated, &c.

2. व्य्-आप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, permeable, penetrable; capable of being attended by any inherent character-istic or constantly pervaded or accompanied by it; (अम्), n. that which may be the site or locality of universal pervasion or of an invariably concomitant cause or characteristic (e. g. smoke is invariably per-vaded by fire); the sign or middle term of an infer-ence, the proof, reason, cause (= साधन, हेतु); a particular medicinal plant, Costus Speciosus (= कुष्ठ). —व्याप्य-ता, f. or व्याप्य-त्व, अम्, n. permeableness, the state or capacity of being invari-ably pervaded or attended by; capacity of obtaining. —व्याप्यत्वासिद्धि (°व-अस्°), इस्, f. (in logic) im-perfect conclusion (i. e. where the alleged invariable-ness of concomitancy is not real).
व्याप्यमान: व्य्-आप्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being pervaded, being permeated or penetrated.
व्यापद्: व्यापद् 1. व्य्-आ-पद् (वि-आ-), cl. 4. A. -पद्-यते, -पत्तुम्, to fall away, fall down, fall into misfortune, perish; to disappear, be inaudible (as a sound): Caus. -पादयति, -यितुम्, to cause to perish, destroy, kill; to make worse, injure, hurt, spoil.
2. व्य्-आपद्, त्, f. death, decease; ruin, disease, calamity; derangement.
व्यापत्ति: व्य्-आपत्ति, इस्, f. falling into misfortune, ruin; change, substitution of one thing for another, (वर्-ण-व्°, substitution of one letter for another; as the change of Visarga into its corresponding sibilant.)
व्यापन्न: व्य्-आपन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen into misfortune, miscarried, failed; dead, deceased, expired, killed, perished; diseased; deranged, disordered; hurt, injured; changed, altered, substituted (as one letter or symbol for another, especially applied to the change of the Visarjanīya or Visarga to its corres-ponding sibilants; when this symbol remains un-changed it is called विक्रान्त).
व्यापाद: व्य्-आपाद, अस्, m. destroying, destruction, ruin, injury, evil design, the wish or project to injure another.
व्यापादक: व्यापादक, अस्, इका, अम्, destructive, murderous.
व्यापादन: व्य्-आपादन, अम्, n. the act of destroying, de-struction, killing, slaying; malice.
व्यापादनीय: व्य्-आपादनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be killed, liable to death, worthy of death or destruction. —व्यापाद-नीय-ता, f. the necessity of being killed.
व्यापादयितव्य: व्य्-आपादयितव्य or व्य्-आपाद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be killed, to be put to death.
व्यापादित: व्य्-आपादित, अस्, आ, अम्, destroyed, killed, slain; hurt, injured. —व्यापादित-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has killed or destroyed.
व्यापृ: व्यापृ व्य्-आ-पृ (वि-आ-), cl. 6. A. -प्रियते, -पर्तुम्, to be occupied or engaged in (with loc.); to be busy or occupied about anything (with अर्थम् or हेतोः at the end of a comp.), be employed or placed in any office: Caus. -पारयति, -यितुम्, to cause to be employed, set to work, set in motion or action; to occupy with, engage upon (with loc., rarely with inst.); to employ, use, apply to any use or purpose, entrust with, charge, commission, place (in any office); to place, set, fix (e. g. व्यापारया-मास करम्, he placed his hand; व्यापारयामास विलोचनानि, he fixed his eyes).
व्यापार: व्य्-आपार, अस्, m. occupation, employment, busi-ness, trade, profession; exercise, practice, exertion, activity; work, affair, operation, action, act, trans-action, doing, performance. —व्यापारावेश (°र-आव्°), अस्, m. the arising of a determination or resolve (in phil.).
व्यापारयत्: व्य्-आपारयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, setting to work, em-ploying; busying, exercising; placing; moving.
व्यापारित: व्य्-आपारित, अस्, आ, अम्, made to be busy, set to work, engaged, occupied, employed.
व्यापारिन्: व्यापारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, occupied, busy; transacting business; engaged in trade, a dealer, trader, agent; exercising, practising; causing action or motion, moving, motive.
व्यापृत: व्य्-आपृत, अस्, आ, अम्, occupied, engaged or occu-pied in (with loc.), engaged, employed, busy, ap-pointed to any office; (अस्), m. a minister, employé, chargé d'affaires (= कर्म-सचिव).
व्याप्रियमाण: व्य्-आप्रियमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being occupied or engaged in (with loc.).
व्याभञ्ज्: व्याभञ्ज् व्य्-आ-भञ्ज् (वि-आ-), cl. 7. P. -भ-नक्ति, -भङ्क्तुम्, to break to pieces, shatter.
व्याभग्न: व्य्-आभग्न, अस्, आ, अम्, broken to pieces, ṣat-tered.
व्याभाष्: व्याभाष् व्य्-आ-भाष् (वि-आ-), cl. 1. A. -भा-षते, -भाषितुम्, to speak to, address; to profess, declare.
व्याभाषमाण: व्य्-आभाषमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, speaking to, ad-dressing.
व्याभाषित: व्य्-आभाषित, अस्, आ, अम्, spoken to, addressed; spoken, pronounced [cf. दुःख-व्°]; (अम्), n. a speech.
व्याभुज्: व्याभुज् व्य्-आ-भुज् (वि-आ-), cl. 6. P. -भुजति, -भोक्तुम्, to bend.
व्याभ्युक्षी: व्याभ्युक्षी व्य्-आभ्य्-उक्षी, f. (probably fr. rt. 1. उक्ष् with अभि, आ, and वि, cf. व्य्-आत्य्-उक्षी), gamboling in water, bathing for pleasure.
व्याम: व्याम व्याम, अस्, m. (probably for व्य्-आयाम, q. v.), a fathom or the space between the tips of the fingers of either hand when the arms are extended; disregard, disrespect (?); smoke (?).
व्यामर्ष: व्यामर्ष 1. व्य्-आमर्ष, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. मृष् with आ and वि), impatience.
व्यामर्ष 2. व्य्-आमर्ष, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. मृश् with आ and वि), rubbing out, erasure.
व्यामृष्ट: 1. व्य्-आमृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, rubbed out, effaced, rubbed.
2. व्य्-आमृष्ट, rubbed off. —व्यामृष्ट-ति-लक, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has the Tilaka mark rubbed off.
व्यामिश्र: व्यामिश्र व्य्-आ-मिश्र, अस्, आ, अम्, intermixed, blended together, mingled, confused.
व्यामील्य: व्यामील्य व्य्-आ-मील्य, ind. (fr. rt. मील् with आ and वि), having closed and opened, having twinkled, &c.
व्यामुच्: व्यामुच् व्य्-आ-मुच् (वि-आ-), cl. 6. P. A. -मुञ्-चति, -ते, -मोक्तुम्, to emit, discharge.
व्यामोक: व्य्-आमोक, अस्, m. release or freeing from, getting rid of.
व्यामुह्: व्यामुह् व्य्-आ-मुह् (वि-आ-), cl. 4. P. -मुह्यति, &c., to become stupified or bewildered, to be infatu-ated: Caus. -मोहयति, -यितुम्, to stupify, bewilder, perplex, infatuate.
व्यामूढ: व्य्-आमूढ, अस्, आ, अम्, entirely stupified, thoroughly infatuated or bewildered, bewitched.
व्यामोह: व्य्-आमोह, अस्, m. bewilderment, embarrassment, error, foolishness.
व्यामोहित: व्य्-आमोहित, अस्, आ, अम्, bewildered, infatuated.
व्यामृज्: व्यामृज् व्य्-आ-मृज् (वि-आ-), cl. 2. P. -मार्ष्टि, &c., to rub off.
व्यायम्: व्यायम् व्य्-आ-यम् (वि-आ-), cl. 1. P. -यच्छति (Ved. and ep. also A. -ते), -यन्तुम्, -यमितुम्, to draw apart or asunder, stretch or draw out, extend; to drag or tear off (P.); to struggle or contend about (loc.), fight together (usually A.); to make efforts, strive, endeavour; to sport, dally: Caus. -यमयति or -यामयति, -यितुम्, to cause to stretch out or struggle, make great effort or exertion, take exercise.
व्यायच्छत्: व्य्-आयच्छत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, struggling or contend-ing about.
व्यायच्छमान: व्य्-आयच्छमान, अस्, आ, अम्, struggling or con-tending together; fighting, quarrelling.
व्यायत: व्य्-आयत, अस्, आ, अम्, drawn asunder, separated, drawn out, extended, long, tall; expanded, wide open; exercised, disciplined; busy, engaged, occupied; hard, firm; mighty, powerful, strong, intense, deep, much, excessive; (अम्), ind. excessively. —व्यायत-त्व, अम्, n. firmness. —व्यायत-पात, अस्, m. a strong or intense blow, a deep stroke (= अवगाढ).
व्यायाम: व्य्-आयाम, अस्, m. drawing or stretching out; a particular measure of length (= a fathom measured by the two extended arms, cf. व्याम); struggling, struggle, contention; fatigue, labour; exercise, exer-tion, manliness, manly effort, athletic or gymnastic exercise (e. g. playing with heavy clubs, drawing a bow with a chain in place of a string, alternate rising and falling at full length on the ground, &c.); busi-ness, occupation; a difficult passage or impassable defile, any difficulty. —व्यायाम-शील, अस्, आ, अम्, accustomed to exertion or exercise, fond of taking exercise, active, robust, athletic.
व्यायामिक: व्यायामिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to exercise or exertion, gymnastic, athletic.
व्यायामिन्: व्यायामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, taking exercise, undergoing fatigue, active, athletic.
व्यायाम्य: व्य्-आयाम्य, ind. having made exertion or effort, having taken exercise, having practised gymnastics, having made to undergo exercise or exertion.
व्यायुज्: व्यायुज् व्य्-आ-युज् (वि-आ-), cl. 7. P. A. -यु-नक्ति, -युङ्क्ते, -योक्तुम्, to disunite, separate, part, become disunited.
व्यायुज्य: व्य्-आयुज्य, ind. having disjoined or separated.
व्यायोग: व्य्-आयोग, अस्, m. a kind of dramatic representa-tion or composition in one act (belonging to the Prakaraṇa class, and describing some military or heroic exploit in which no part of the interest is derived from female participation, the sentiment of love being thereby excluded).
व्यारब्ध: व्यारब्ध व्य्-आ-रब्ध, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. रभ् with आ and वि), Ved. held on every side, upheld, maintained, properly carried into effect.
व्याल: व्याल व्याल, अस्, आ, अम् (connected with व्याड, q. v.), wicked, villainous, bad; cruel, fierce; vicious; (अस्), m. a villain, cheat, rogue; a snake; a beast of prey; a tiger; a hunting leopard; a vicious elephant; a king; N. of Viṣṇu; a species of the Daṇḍaka metre; (ई), f. a female snake; [cf. Old Germ. and Angl. Sax. al.] —व्याल-खड्ग, अस्, m. = व्याल-नख below. —व्याल-गन्धा, f. the ichneumon plant (= नाकुली). —व्याल-ग्राह, अस्, m. a snake-catcher. —व्याल-ग्राहिन्, ई, m. a snake-catcher, one who lives by catching and exhi-biting snakes. —व्याल-जिह्वा, f. a kind of plant (= महा-समङ्गा). —व्याल-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, very fierce or cruel. —व्याल-दंष्ट्र, अस्, m. a kind of plant (= गो-क्षुर). —व्याल-नख, अस्, m. a kind of medicinal herb with a fragrant root (in Hindī called बघ्नहा = व्याघ्र-नख). —व्याल-पत्त्रा, f. a kind of cucumber (= एर्वारु). —व्याल-पाणि-ज, अस्, m. = व्याल-नख. —व्याल-बल, अस्, m. = व्याल-नख. —व्याल-मृग, अस्, m. a fierce animal, wild stag; a hunting leopard. —व्याल-रूप, अस्, m. epithet of Śiva. —व्याल-वत्, ind. like a serpent; like a beast of prey. —व्यालायुध (°ल-आय्°), अस्, अम्, m. n. a sort of vegetable perfume (= व्याल-नख, नखी, व्याडायुध).
व्यालक: व्यालक, अस्, m. a vicious elephant.
व्यालम्ब्: व्यालम्ब् व्य्-आ-लम्ब्, cl. 1. A. -लम्बते, -लम्-बितुम्, to hang down; to stay behind, linger, delay.
व्यालम्ब: व्य्-आलम्ब, अस्, m. the red Ricinus or castor-oil plant.
व्यालिख्: व्यालिख् व्य्-आ-लिख् (वि-आ-), cl. 6. P. -लिखति, -लेखितुम्, to scratch or scrape against, rub against, touch, graze; to make an incision, scratch, draw lines, write.
व्यालिखत्: व्य्-आलिखत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, scratching, scrap-ing, piercing; touching, grazing, extending to; draw-ing lines, delineating.
व्यालीन: व्यालीन व्य्-आलीन, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. ली with आ and वि), clinging or sticking close together, cluster-ing, dense, thick.
व्यालुड्: व्यालुड् व्य्-आ-लुड्, Caus. -लोडयति, -यितुम्, to stir about, agitate.
व्यालोडित: व्य्-आलोडित, अस्, आ, अम्, = मथित, stirred about, agitated.
व्यालुप्: व्यालुप् व्य्-आ-लुप् (वि-आ-), cl. 6. P. -लुम्पति, -लोप्तुम्, to take away, carry off, remove: Pass. -लुप्यते, to be broken asunder or destroyed, be divided, be removed, to disappear.
व्यालू: व्यालू व्य्-आ-लू (वि-आ-), cl. 9. P. A. -लुनाति, -लुनीते, -लवितुम्, to cut off, cut away.
