व्यालून: व्य्-आलून, अस्, आ, अम्, cut off. —व्यालून-मूर्-धज, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has the hair cut off.
व्यालोल: व्यालोल व्य्-आलोल, अस्, आ, अम्, rolling about, quivering, tremulous, shaking, waving. —व्यालोल-कुन्तल-कलाप-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having dishevelled locks of hair.
व्यावकलन: व्यावकलन व्य्-आवकलन, अम्, n. = व्य्-अव-कलन, subtraction (in arithmetic).
व्यावक्रोशी: व्यावक्रोशी व्य्-आवक्रोशी, f. (fr. rt. क्रुश् with अव, आ, and वि), mutual abuse or imprecation.
व्यावप्: व्यावप् व्य्-आ-वप् (वि-आ-), cl. 1. P. A. -व-पति, -ते, -वप्तुम्, to sow, scatter, strew, (according to some the Ved. व्यावपाति, Pāṇ. III. 1, 34, is for व्यावयाति।)
व्यावभाषी: व्यावभाषी व्य्-आवभाषी, f. (fr. rt. भाष् with अव, आ, and वि), mutual abuse or imprecation; [cf. व्य्-आवक्रोशी above.]
व्यावर्ण्: व्यावर्ण् व्य्-आ-वर्ण् (वि-आ-), cl. 10. P. -वर्-णयति, -यितुम्, to enumerate, describe, narrate.
व्यावर्ण्य: व्य्-आवर्ण्य, ind. having narrated in detail.
व्यावर्त: व्य्-आवर्त, अस्, m. separating from, selecting, revo-lution, going round; encompassing, surrounding, en-closing; ruptured navel, umbilical hernia (= नाभि-कण्टक).
व्यावल्ग्: व्यावल्ग् व्य्-आ-वल्ग् (वि-आ-), cl. 1. P. -वल्-गति, &c., to jump, skip, leap; to gallop; to move quickly about, quiver, throb, be agitated.
व्यावल्गत्: व्य्-आवल्गत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, jumping, leaping, &c.; throbbing, being agitated.
व्यावल्गित: व्य्-आवल्गित, अस्, आ, अम्, jumped, moved, agitated.
व्यावहारिक: व्यावहारिक व्यावहारिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. व्य्-अवहार), relating to business or practice or action, practical, active; belonging to judicial procedure, judicial, legal; what has to be dealt with or is practised or intended for use, practicable, customary, usual, cur-rent; (अस्), m. a counsellor, minister; (अम्), n. use. —व्यावहारिक-त्व, अम्, n. practicalness; the state of belonging to the period of action.
व्यावहारी: व्यावहारी व्य्-आवहारी, f. (fr. rt. हृ with अव, आ, and वि), mutual seizing or taking (Vopa-deva XXVI. 177).
व्यावहासी: व्यावहासी व्य्-आवहासी, f. (fr. rt. हस् with अव, आ, and वि), mutual derision, reciprocal laughter.
व्याविध: व्याविध व्य्-आ-विध, अस्, आ, अम् (see 2. वि-ध), of various kinds, multifarious, omnigenous.
व्यावृ: व्यावृ व्य्-आ-वृ (वि-आ-), cl. 5. 9. 1. P. A. -वृणोति, -वृणुते, -वृणाति, -वृणीते, -वरति, -ते, -वरितुम्, -वरीतुम्, to cover over, conceal; to obstruct, stop; to choose, select; to open, (but forms like व्य्-आवर् in Ved. are referred to वि-वृ, q. v.)
व्यावृण्वान: व्य्-आवृण्वान, अस्, आ, अम्, concealing or hiding one's self.
व्यावृत: व्य्-आवृत, अस्, आ, अम्, covered over, screened; obstructed; excluded, excepted, (perhaps for व्य्-आवृत्त); uncovered, opened, (in this sense वि is rather privative.)
व्यावृति: व्य्-आवृति, इस्, f. covering, screening; exclusion; [cf. व्य्-आवृत्ति।]
व्यावृत्य: 1. व्य्-आवृत्य, ind. having covered over; having obstructed or stopped.
2. व्य्-आवृत्य, ind. having separated from, having parted with (with inst.), having turned or rolled away, having turned back.
व्यावृज्: व्यावृज् व्य्-आ-वृज् (वि-आ-), cl. 1. P. -वर्जति, &c., -वर्जितुम्, to exclude from; to divide or sepa-rate into parts.
व्यावृज्य: व्य्-आवृज्य, ind. having separated or divided.
व्यावृत्: व्यावृत् व्य्-आ-वृत् (वि-आ-), cl. 1. A. (in cer-tain tenses also P., see rt. 1. वृत्), -वर्तते, -वर्ति-तुम्, to become separated or singled out from (with inst.); to become separate or distinct, keep apart; to be split asunder or opened; to turn away from, become averted, go away, depart; to roll or turn back, return; to turn round, go round, revolve; to go down, set (said of the sun); to come to an end, cease, perish: Caus. -वर्तयति, -यितुम्, to separate from (with inst. or abl.); to turn away, turn out, set aside, exclude, put aside, lay down, remove, take away, destroy, overrule, annul; to throw down, throw about, strew; to turn about or round, cause to revolve; to retract; to exchange, substitute one for another, to contrive (?) : Pass. of Caus. -वर्त्यते, to be excluded, &c.: Desid. -वृत्सते, to wish to separate from, &c.
व्यावर्तक: व्य्-आवर्तक, अस्, इका, अम्, separating from, ex-cluding, excepting; turning away from; turning round; encircling, encompassing. —व्यावर्तक-ता, f. state of excluding, exclusion.
व्यावर्तन: व्य्-आवर्तन, अम्, n. the act of turning round or away, rolling round, revolving; a volute, fold, band; encompassing, surrounding.
व्यावर्तमान: व्य्-आवर्तमान, अस्, आ, अम्, becoming separated from, keeping apart from; turning away; desisting, ceasing; turning back.
व्यावर्तित: व्य्-आवर्तित, अस्, आ, अम्, made to turn away, made to desist, made to revolve; exchanged.
व्यावर्त्य: व्य्-आवर्त्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be excluded or excepted.
व्यावृत्त: व्य्-आवृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, separated or singled out from; excluded, excepted, free from (with inst.); opened, split asunder; turned away from, turned back, returned, desisted, desisting, ceased; turned round, re-volved; encompassed, surrounded; fenced, screened, (probably for व्य्-आवृत); praised, hymned (?). —व्या-वृत्त-गति, इस्, इस्, इ, turned back from a course, desisting from any course of action. —व्यावृत्त-त्व, अम्, n. the being separated or excluded from, &c.; the being non-extensive, (defined to be अल्प-देश-वृत्तित्वम्, the existing in few places, i. e. comprising but few individuals, said of a species in relation to its genus; opposed to अधिक-देश-वृत्तित्वम्, the characteristic of a genus viewed in relation to the species it contains.) —व्यावृत्त-देह, अस्, आ, अम्, having the body severed or split asunder. —व्यावृत्त-बुद्धि, इस्, f. ‘limited conception,’ the conception of a class denoting few individuals, i. e. of a class contained in a higher class. —व्यावृत्त-शिरस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, having the head turned round.
व्यावृत्ति: व्य्-आवृत्ति, इस्, f. separation from, selecting, selec-tion, choice, (perhaps for व्य्-आवृति); exception, ex-clusion, rejection; turning away; rolling back; roll-ing round, surrounding; screening, (perhaps for व्य्-आवृति); praise, eulogium.
व्याव्यध्: व्याव्यध् व्य्-आ-व्यध् (वि-आ-), cl. 4. P. -विध्-यति, -व्यद्धुम्, to throw about; to brandish, wave about.
व्याविद्ध: व्य्-आविद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, thrown or tossed about, dishevelled; glancing or darting in all directions; interlaced.
व्याविध्य: व्य्-आविध्य, ind. having brandished or waved about.
व्यासञ्ज्: व्यासञ्ज् व्य्-आ-सञ्ज् (वि-आ-), cl. 1. P. -सजति, -सङ्क्तुम्, to attach firmly to, fasten on; to adhere separately or severally.
व्यासक्त: व्य्-आसक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, firmly attached to or con-nected with, adhering closely to (any one or any-thing), devoted to, intent on, occupied with; inher-ing separately; detached, disjoined, (in this sense वि is privative); bewildered, confused.
व्यासङ्ग: व्य्-आसङ्ग, अस्, m. excessive attachment, close adherence, devotion or addiction to, resting or sitting on; close attachment (of the thoughts), attention, assiduous application, diligent study; addition; de-tachment, separation, (in this sense वि is privative); perplexity, confusion.
व्यासङ्गिन्: व्यासङ्गिन्, ई, इनी, इ, attaching one's self or apply-ing closely to (anything).
व्यासज्य: व्य्-आसज्य, ind. having firmly attached or fastened on, having adhered or inhered separately or severally. —व्यासज्य-वृत्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, inhering in more sub-jects than one (as a quality &c.).
व्यासिद्ध: व्यासिद्ध व्य्-आसिद्ध, अस्, आ, अम् (see 2. आ-सिद्-ध), prohibited, forbidden, restrained; contraband (i. e. not allowed to be sold except to particular persons or in certain places).
व्यासेध: व्य्-आसेध, अस्, m. prohibition, hindrance, restraint.
व्यासुकि: व्यासुकि व्यासुकि, इस्, m. a proper N.
व्याहन्: व्याहन् व्य्-आ-हन् (वि-आ-), cl. 2. P. -हन्ति, -हन्तुम्, to strike at excessively, strike back, repel, repulse; to foil, disappoint; to impede, obstruct, delay; to vex: Caus. -घातयति, -यितुम्, to repel, obstruct.
व्याहत: व्य्-आहत, अस्, आ, अम्, excessively struck at, struck or hit back; repelled, repulsed; obstructed, impeded; foiled, disappointed, expelled; confused, alarmed.
व्याहन्यमान: व्य्-आहन्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being excessively struck back or repelled, being obstructed.
व्याहृ: व्याहृ व्य्-आ-हृ (वि-आ-), cl. 1. P. A. -हरति, -ते, -हर्तुम्, to utter or pronounce a sound, speak, say, tell, declare, narrate, report; to explain; to answer; to cry, scream.
व्याहरण: व्य्-आहरण, अम्, n. the act of uttering or pro-nouncing, utterance, pronunciation; speech, narra-tion, explanation.
व्याहरत्: व्य्-आहरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, uttering, pronouncing, speaking; uttering a cry (as an animal).
व्याहर्तव्य: व्य्-आहर्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be told or declared or mentioned.
व्याहार: व्य्-आहार, अस्, m. utterance, speech, voice; a word, articulate sound, language; jest, joke, humorous speech, facetious allusion (a particular Alaṅkāra or figure in rhetoric).
व्याहारिन्: व्य्-आहारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, speaking, saying.
व्याहृत: व्य्-आहृत, अस्, आ, अम्, spoken, uttered, pronounced, said, declared. —व्याहृत-सन्देश, अस्, आ, अम्, one who tells news or communicates information.
व्याहृति: व्य्-आहृति, इस्, f. utterance, speech, voice; an utter-ance, articulate sound, word; a mystical word pro-nounced after ॐ by every Brāhman in commencing his daily prayers, (cf. Manu II. 76; भूर्, भुवः, स्वर् are the three great Vyāhṛtis, and महर्, q. v., is said to be a fourth mystical word, cf. महा-व्याहृति।) —व्याहृति-त्रय, अम्, n. the three Vyā-hṛtis or mystical words (described above). —व्याहृति-पूर्वक, अस्, इका, अम्, preceded by the three mystical words भूर्, भुवः, स्वर्।
व्याहृत्य: व्य्-आहृत्य, ind. having uttered, having spoken.
व्याह्वे: व्याह्वे व्य्-आ-ह्वे, cl. 1. P. A. -ह्वयति, -ते, &c., to call separately or distinctly.
व्याहाव: व्य्-आहाव, अस्, अम्, m. n. a separate or distinct call.
व्यु: व्यु व्य्-उ (वि-उ), cl. 5. P. -उनोति, Ved. to urge on, drive forward; to incite, animate, (Sāy. = प्रेरयति, Ṛg-veda V. 31, 1.)
व्युक्ष्: व्युक्ष् व्य्-उक्ष् (वि-उक्ष्, see rt. 1. उक्ष्), cl. 6. P. A. -उक्षति, -ते, -उक्षितुम्, Ved. to sprinkle or pour out; to drip or flow or trickle over (A.).
व्युच्चर्: व्युच्चर् व्य्-उच्-चर् (वि-उद्-चर्), cl. 1. P. A. -चरति, -ते, -चरितुम्, to go forth in different direc-tions; to go out of the right path; to transgress or offend against, be faithless or disloyal towards (with acc.); to commit adultery with (with inst.).
व्युच्चरत्: व्य्-उच्चरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, offending against, being faithless towards (with acc.); committing adultery.
व्युच्चरमाण: व्य्-उच्चरमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, offending against, being faithless towards (with acc.).
व्युच्छत्: व्य्-उच्छत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. shining forth, dawning, (according to Sāy. व्युच्छन्ती = तमो वर्जयन्ती, Ṛg-veda I. 49, 4.)
व्युच्छिद्: व्युच्छिद् व्य्-उच्-छिद् (वि-उद्-छिद्), cl. 7. P. A. -छिनत्ति, -छिन्त्ते, -छेत्तुम्, to cut entirely off, extirpate, cut up, destroy: Pass. -छिद्यते (ep. also P. -छिद्यति), to be entirely cut off, be extirpated; to be interrupted, come to an end, become extinct, cease, fail.
व्युच्छित्ति: व्य्-उच्छित्ति, इस्, f. cutting off, cutting away, cutting short, destruction, rooting up, extirpation.
व्युच्छिन्न: व्य्-उच्छिन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, cut off, extirpated, com-pletely destroyed, interrupted, come to an end, ceased.
व्युच्छेत्तृ: व्य्-उच्छेत्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, who or what cuts off or destroys, a destroyer.
व्युच्छेद: व्य्-उच्छेद, अस्, m. cutting off, cutting short, de-struction.
व्युत: व्युत व्य्-उत, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. वि-वे), inter-woven, woven, sewn; separated, (Sāy. = विविक्त); stretched out, expanded, (according to Sāy. in this sense fr. rt. व्ये।)
व्युति: व्य्-उति, इस्, f. interweaving, weaving, sewing.
व्युत्क्रम्: व्युत्क्रम् व्य्-उत्-क्रम् (वि-उद्-क्रम्), cl. 1. P. A. -क्रामति, -क्रमते, -क्रमितुम्, to go apart or in different directions, go in a wrong direction, go astray; to go or pass by, go beyond, overstep, deviate, go out of the right way, transgress; to dis-regard, neglect; to go away, depart, leave.
व्युत्क्रम: व्य्-उत्क्रम, अस्, m. going astray or out of the right course, going or passing beyond, transgression, inverted order, reverse or irregular arrangement, de-rangement, disorder, confusion, contrariety.
व्युत्क्रम्य: व्य्-उत्क्रम्य, ind. having gone forth, having left; having passed by or gone beyond.
व्युत्क्रान्त: व्य्-उत्क्रान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, gone asunder, gone forth, departed, left; passed by, gone beyond, over-stepped, transgressed, disregarded, neglected; (आ), f. a kind of riddle or enigma. —व्युत्क्रान्त-धर्म, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has overstepped his duty, neg-lectful of duty. —व्युत्क्रान्त-रजस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, one whose impurity has gone away, free from passion. —व्युत्क्रान्त-वर्त्मन्, आ, आ, अ, one who has gone beyond the right path.
व्युत्क्रामत्: व्य्-उत्क्रामत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, going asunder, going forth.
व्युत्था: व्युत्था व्य्-उत्-था (वि-उद्-स्था), Caus. -था-पयति, -यितुम्, to cause to rise up, stir up, excite greatly, rouse, instigate, incite, irritate.
व्युत्थान: व्य्-उत्थान, अम्, n. ‘excessive rising up,’ great activity; a kind of dancing or gesticulation; rising up against, opposition, contradiction, doing anything prohibited, obstruction, hindering; separate or indi-vidual exertion, independent action, following one's own inclination; the completion of a religious act or vow (as of contemplation or abstraction).
व्युत्थापित: व्य्-उत्थापित, अस्, आ, अम्, made to rise up, roused, brought up.
व्युत्पद्: व्युत्पद् व्य्-उत्-पद् (वि-उद्-पद्), cl. 4. A. -पद्यते, -पत्तुम्, to arise or originate clearly or in any well ascertained manner, to be produced from or out of; to originate; (in grammar) to be derived (from a root &c.); to have an etymology; to be an accomplished scholar, become perfectly proficient in or conversant with: Caus. -पादयति, -यितुम्, to cause to issue out of, produce, cause; (in gram-mar) to derive, trace back to a root &c.
व्युत्पत्ति: व्य्-उत्पत्ति, इस्, f. production, origin, derivation (especially of words from roots &c.), etymology; per-fection, completion, perfect conversancy with or pro-ficiency in (literature or science); scholarship, learn-ing. —व्युत्पत्ति-पक्षे, ind. on the side of deri-vation or etymology (an expression used by Vedic commentators when the accentuation is settled by the affixes and not according to the meaning of the words).
व्युत्पन्न: व्य्-उत्पन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, produced, generated, begotten; derived (from a root &c.; अ-व्युत्पन्-नम्, an underived or primitive word); formed (as a derivative word); completed, perfected, finished, ac-complished; quite conversant with or proficient in (literature &c.); learned.
व्युत्पादक: व्य्-उत्पादक, अस्, इका, अम्, giving rise to, pro-ducing, originating, productive; tracing or forming (words).
व्युत्पाद्य: व्य्-उत्पाद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, derivable, deducible, capable of being formed &c.
व्युत्पित्सु: व्य्-उत्पित्सु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. the Desid.), desirous of making proficiency (in any science).
व्युत्सद्: व्युत्सद् व्य्-उत्-सद् (वि-उद्-), cl. 1. P. -सीदति, -सत्तुम्, to be unsettled; to be upset or overthrown.
व्युद्: व्युद् व्य्-उद् or व्य्-उन्द् (वि-उद्, &c.), cl. 7. P. -उनत्ति, -उन्दितुम्, Ved. to spring or gush forth; to wet or sprinkle thoroughly, water, drench.
व्युत्त: व्य्-उत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, well sprinkled or wetted, drenched.
व्युन्दत्: व्य्-उन्दत्, अन्, अती, अत्, Ved. wetting thoroughly, sprinkling.
व्युन्दन: व्य्-उन्दन, अम्, n. the act of well moistening or wetting.
व्युदस्: व्युदस् व्य्-उद्-अस् (वि-उद्-), cl. 4. P. -अस्यति, -असितुम्, to throw or scatter about, cast in every direction; to throw off, cast off, reject, lay aside, give up, abandon, exclude.
व्युदस्त: व्य्-उदस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, thrown or scattered about, cast off, put off, thrown aside.
व्युदस्य: व्य्-उदस्य, ind. having thrown or scattered in all directions, having thrown off or put away, having thrown aside or abandoned.
व्युदास: व्य्-उदास, अस्, m. throwing or scattering in dif-ferent directions, throwing away or aside, rejection, exclusion (in grammar); prohibition; disregard for, indifference to.
व्युदित: व्युदित व्य्-उदित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. वद् with वि), disputed, debated, discussed, contested.
व्युदूह्: व्युदूह् व्य्-उद्-ऊह् (वि-उद्-), cl. 1. P. -ऊहति, -ऊहितुम्, Ved. to push apart or asunder, move away, move out, remove; to sweep out or away.
व्युदूह्य: व्य्-उदूह्य, ind. having moved or placed asunder, having removed.
व्युपदेश: व्युपदेश व्य्-उपदेश, अस्, m. pretext, pre-tence, plausible but false plea, deception.
व्युपनी: व्युपनी व्य्-उप-नी (वि-उप-), cl. 1. P. A. -नयति, -ते, -नेतुम्, Ved. to lead or bring sepa-rately or one by one.
व्युपयुज्: व्युपयुज् व्य्-उप-युज् (वि-उप-), cl. 7. A. -युङ्क्ते, -योक्तुम्, to become closely attached, be concerned about.
व्युपरम्: व्युपरम् व्य्-उप-रम् (वि-उप-), cl. 1. A. -र-मते (ep. also P. -ति), -रन्तुम्, to leave off or pause variously; to be at rest, be tranquil, have repose; to cease, desist from (with abl.).
व्युपरत: व्य्-उपरत, अस्, आ, अम्, paused, rested, stopped, interrupted, ceased, desisted; calmed, tranquillized, tranquil.
व्युपरम: व्य्-उपरम, अस्, m. pause, cessation, interruption.
व्युपरमम्: व्य्-उपरमम्, ind., Ved. leaving off or pausing variously.
व्युपरम्य: व्य्-उपरम्य, ind. having ceased or desisted from (with abl.), having stopped.
व्युपशम: व्युपशम व्य्-उपशम, अस्, m. non-cessation, not ceasing or desisting; inquietude.
व्युपारम्: व्युपारम् व्य्-उपा-रम् (वि-उप-आ-), cl. 1. A. -रमते (ep. P. -ति), -रन्तुम्, to desist from, leave off, cease.
व्युपास्: व्युपास् व्य्-उपास् (वि-उप-अस्), cl. 4. P. -उपास्-यति, -उपासितुम्, to throw about, distribute.
व्युब्ज्: व्युब्ज् व्य्-उब्ज् (वि-उब्ज्), cl. 6. P. -उब्जति, -उब्जितुम्, Ved. to uncover, open, display.
व्युष्: व्युष् 1. व्युष् (also read प्युष्), cl. 4. P. व्युष्यति, &c., to burn, (in this sense perhaps for rt. 1. उष् with वि); to divide, distribute, (in this sense also written प्युस्, पुष्, ब्युस्, बुस्); cl. 10. P. व्योषयति, -यितुम्, to reject, discharge, emit, (in this sense also written पुस्।)
व्युष् 2. व्य्-उष् (for 1. वि-वस्, q. v., cf. 2. उष्), cl. 6. P. -उच्छति, &c., Ved. to shine forth, shine, dawn, arise.
3. व्य्-उष्, f., Ved. shining forth, dawning, (ac-cording to Sāy. व्युषि = व्युच्छने सति, Ṛg-veda V. 45, 8, = विवासने or प्रकाशने सति, Ṛg-veda VII. 81, 2.)
व्युच्छन: व्य्-उच्छन, अम्, n. shining forth, opening, mani-festation.
व्युष्टि: व्य्-उष्टि, इस्, f., Ved. the rising or breaking of dawn, dawn; increase, prosperity, felicity; fruit, consequence; a hymn, praise.
व्युष्य: व्य्-उष्य, ind. having dwelt, having lodged, hav-ing passed or spent (e. g. रात्रिं व्य्-उष्य, having spent a night).
व्यूर्णु: व्यूर्णु व्य्-ऊर्णु (वि-ऊर्णु), cl. 2. P. A. -ऊर्णोति or -ऊर्णौति, -ऊर्णुते, -ऊर्णवितुम् or -ऊर्णुवितुम्, Ved. to uncover, open out, open; to display.
व्यूर्ण्वत्: व्य्-ऊर्ण्वत्, अन्, अती, अत्, Ved. uncovering, dis-playing, revealing.
व्यूह्: व्यूह् व्य्-ऊह् (वि-ऊह्, see rt. 1. ऊह्), cl. 1. P. -ऊहति, -ऊहितुम्, to push or move apart, place asunder, separate, divide, distribute; to separate, resolve (vowels, syllables, &c. in Vedic grammar); to dispose, arrange, place in order; to array, to place in battle-array, arrange in order of battle; to move from the proper place, change the position, trans-pose, alter, disarrange.
व्यूढि: व्य्-ऊढि, इस्, f. orderly arrangement or disposition, distribution in various positions, array.
व्यूह: व्य्-ऊह, अस्, m. placing apart, separation, distribu-tion; separation or resolution (of vowels, syllables, &c. in Vedic grammar); orderly arrangement, dis-position, array (e. g. चरण-व्यूह, array of Vedic schools), military array, (various forms of array are enumerated in Manu VII. 187 and elsewhere, e. g. दण्ड, that like ‘a staff;’ शकट, ‘a cart;’ व-राह, ‘a boar;’ मकर, ‘a sea-monster;’ सूचि, ‘a needle;’ गरुड, ‘the bird of Viṣṇu;’ वज्र, ‘a thunderbolt;’ भोग, ‘a snake,’ i. e. in column; मण्डल, ‘a circle;’ असंहत, ‘mixed order;’ पताक, ‘a flag,’ &c.); an army, host, squadron; a flock, multitude; (in phil.) arrangement or peculiar distribution (of the senses); formation, structure, manu-facture; the body; reasoning, logic, (in this sense rather to be derived fr. rt. 2. ऊह् with वि); breathing (according to the Nyāya-sūtras III. 31). —व्यूह-पार्ष्णि, इस्, m. the rear of an army (= प्रत्य्-आसार). —व्यूह-भङ्ग or व्यूह-भेद, अस्, m. breaking an array, throwing into disorder. —व्यूह-रचना, f. arrangement of troops. —व्यूह-राज, अस्, m. the chief or best form of military array. —व्यूहान्तर (°ह-अन्°), अस्, m. a different ar-rangement or position.
व्यूहत्: व्य्-ऊहत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, separating, dividing; dis-posing, arranging, putting in military array.
व्यूहन: व्य्-ऊहन, अम्, n. the act of disposing in order, arrangement, arraying, array (of an army); dispo-sition or structure of the members of the body.
व्यूह्य: व्य्-ऊह्य, ind. having disposed in order, having arranged or arrayed, having placed in battle-array.
व्यृ: व्यृ व्य्-ऋ (वि-ऋ), cl. 5. 3. P. -ऋणोति or -ऋण्-वति, -इयर्ति, &c. (see rt. 4. ऋ), Ved. to go apart or asunder, open out, be divided; to open, throw open, spread abroad, display.
व्यृछ्: व्यृछ् व्य्-ऋछ् (वि-ऋछ्), cl. 6. P. -ऋच्छति, -अर्च्छितुम्, Ved. to go apart or asunder.
व्यृध्: व्यृध् व्य्-ऋध् (वि-ऋध्), Pass. -ऋध्यते, Ved. to be unfortunate or unsuccessful; to be ex-cluded or deprived of (with inst.): Caus. -अर्ध-यति, -यितुम्, to exclude from, deprive of (with inst.): Pass. of Caus. -अर्ध्यते, to be excluded from or deprived of: Desid. वीर्त्सति (Part. वीर्त्सत्), to wish to nullify or render vain.
व्यृद्ध: व्य्-ऋद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, deprived of prosperity, deprived of, separated or excluded from; nullified; imperfect, defective, unfit.
व्यृद्धि: व्य्-ऋद्धि, इस्, f. (probably fr. वि privative + ऋद्-धि), non-prosperity, absence or loss of prosperity, misfortune, ill luck.
व्यृष्: व्यृष् 1. व्य्-ऋष् (वि-ऋष्), cl. 1. P. -अर्षति, -अर्षितुम्, Ved. to flow through.
व्यृष् 2. व्य्-ऋष् (वि-ऋष्), cl. 6. P. -ऋषति, -अर्षितुम्, to pierce, penetrate.
व्ये: व्ये व्ये (perhaps formed out of वि-इ, see 3. वी), cl. 1. P. A. व्ययति, -ते, विव्याय (2nd sing. विव्ययिथ, Pāṇ. VII. 2, 66), विव्ये, व्यास्यति, -ते, अव्यासीत्, अव्यास्त, व्यातुम्, to cover, conceal, clothe: Caus. व्याययति: Desid. विव्यासति, -ते: Intens. वे-वीयते, वाव्येति or वाव्याति; [cf. Gr. ἱ in ἱμάτιον.]
व्येत: व्येत व्य्-एत, अस्, -एनी, अम्, Ved. very bright, very white, (Sāy. व्येनी = विशेषेण श्वेता, Ṛg-veda V. 80, 4.)
व्येनस्: व्येनस् व्य्-एनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. exempt from sin, free from misfortune.
व्योकार: व्योकार व्यो-कार, अस्, m. (probably onoma-topoetic), ‘making the sound व्यो,’ a blacksmith.
व्योमन्: व्योमन् व्योमन्, अ, n. (according to Uṇā-di-s. IV. 150. fr. rt. व्ये above; according to others fr. ओ for अव् with वि, cf. ओमन्, or connected with rt. 2. दिव्), sky, heaven, atmosphere, ether; water; a temple sacred to the sun, a place where the sun is especially worshipped; talc, mica; (आ), m., N. of a king. —व्योम-केश, अस्, or व्योम-केशिन्, ई, m. ‘sky-haired,’ an epithet of Śiva. —व्यो-म-गङ्गा, f. the heavenly Ganges. —व्योम-चर, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘sky-going,’ passing through the air. —व्योम-चारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, sky-going; (ई), m. ‘air-goer,’ ‘sky-goer;’ a god; a bird; a saint; a Brāhman. —व्योमचारि-पुर, अम्, n. ‘sky-floating city,’ the city of Hari-ścandra (supposed to be sus-pended between heaven and earth). —व्योम-देव, अस्, m., N. of Śiva —व्योम-धूम, अस्, m. ‘sky-smoke,’ a cloud. —व्योम-नासिका, f. a sort of quail. —व्योम-पञ्चक, अम्, n. an aggregate of five Vyomans (?) . —व्योम-मञ्जर, अम्, n. ‘sky-cluster,’ a flag, banner. —व्योम-मण्डल, अम्, n. ‘sky-circle,’ a flag, banner. —व्योम-मध्ये, ind. in the middle of the sky, in mid-air. —व्योम-माय, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘sky-measuring,’ reaching to the sky, high as the heaven. —व्योम-मुद्गर, अस्, m. ‘sky-hammer,’ a gust of wind. —व्योम-यान, अम्, n. ‘sky-vehicle,’ a celestial car, chariot of the gods. —व्योम-वर्त्-मन्, अ, n. the path of the sky, (व्योम-वर्त्मना, inst. c. through the air or sky.) —व्योम-विस्तृत, अम्, n. the expanse of heaven, the sky, firmament. —व्योम-सद्, त्, m. ‘sky-dweller,’ a deity, divinity; a Gandharva; a spirit. —व्योम-स्थली, f. ‘ground or base of the sky,’ the earth. —व्योम-स्पृश्, क्, क्, क्, ‘sky-touching,’ ‘sky-reaching,’ lofty. —व्योमाभ (°म-आभ), अस्, m. ‘heaven-like,’ a Buddha or a Jaina deified saint. —व्योमोदक (°म-उद्°), अम्, n. ‘sky-water,’ rain-water, dew (= दिव्योदक).
व्योम्निक: व्योम्निक in परम-व्योम्निक, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to the highest ether.
व्योष: व्योष व्योष, अम्, n. (probably fr. rt. 1. व्युष् or fr. rt. 1. उष् with वि), the aggregate of three spices (black pepper, long pepper, and dry ginger).
व्रज्: व्रज् व्रज्, cl. 1. P. (ep. also A.) -व्र-जति (-ते), वव्राज, व्रजिष्यति, अव्राजीत्, व्रजितुम्, to go, proceed, travel; to go away, de-part, retire, withdraw; to pass away (as time); to go to, approach, visit, approach a woman (for adul-tery); to undergo; to go to any state or condition, attain to, become (with acc., especially with acc. of abstract noun, e. g. विनाशं व्रज्, to go to destruc-tion, become destroyed; छात्त्रतां व्रज्, to be-come a pupil; निर्वृतिं व्रज्, to grow happy; cf. rt. 1. या); to obtain, gain, (व्यापारं व्रज्, to obtain possession of anything, loc.): Caus. or cl. 10. P. व्राजयति, -यितुम्, to cause to go, send; to go; to prepare, decorate: Desid. विव्रजिषति: Intens. वाव्रज्यते, वाव्रक्ति, to go crookedly; [cf. Gr. ϝέργον; Goth. vrikan, vrakja, waurkjau; Angl. Sax. wrecan; Old Germ. rehhan, wreh.]
व्रज: व्रज, अस्, m. a road; a flock, herd, multitude, collection of anything; a station of cowherds, cow-pen, cattle-shed, stall, stable; a resting-place, abode; a cloud (= मेघ according to Naigh. I. 10); N. of the district surrounding Agra and Mathurā (the scene of Kṛṣṇa's juvenile adventures; it is com-monly called Braj, cf. वृजि); N. of a son of Havir-dhāna; (अम्), n. going, wandering, roaming; [cf. perhaps Lat. vulgus.] —व्रज-किशोर, अस्, m. ‘youth of Vraja,’ epithet of Kṛṣṇa. —व्रज-नाथ, अस्, m. ‘lord of Vraja,’ epithet of Kṛṣṇa. —व्रज-भू, ऊस्, ऊस्, उ, being or produced in Vraja; (ऊस्), m. the tree Nauclea Cordifolia, = केलि-कदम्ब; (ऊस्), f. the district of Vraja. —व्रज-मण्डल, अम्, n. the district of Vraja. —व्रज-मोहन, अस्, m. ‘the fascinator of Vraja,’ epithet of Kṛṣṇa. —व्र-ज-लाल, अस्, m., N. of a king. —व्रज-वर, अस्, m. ‘best in Vraja,’ epithet of Kṛṣṇa. —व्रज-वल्-लभ, अस्, m. ‘beloved in Vraja,’ epithet of Kṛṣṇa. —व्रजाङ्गना (°ज-अङ्°), f. ‘woman of Vraja,’ a Gopī, cowherdess, shepherdess. —व्रजाजिर (°ज-अज्°), अम्, n. a cow-yard, cattle-fold, cow-pen.
व्रजक: व्रजक, अस्, m. a religious ascetic who wanders about (in quest of alms &c.).
व्रजत्: व्रजत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, going, proceeding, travel-ling; roaming.
व्रजन: व्रजन, अम्, n. the act of going or proceeding, travelling, roaming; exile; a road, way, street (Ved.); (अस्), m., N. of a brother of Jahnu (considered as one of the ancestors of the Kuśikas).
व्रजित: व्रजित, अस्, आ, अम्, gone, proceeded; (अम्), n. going, roaming.
व्रजिन्: व्रजिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. herded or grouped together, collected into a mass, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda V. 45, 1. व्रजिनीः = तमः-पुञ्जवतीः, clustered gloom, i. e. nights.)
व्रज्या: व्रज्या, f. travelling or wandering about (either as a religious act or in quest of alms); march, attack, invasion; a flock, tribe, class; a theatre (= रङ्ग). —व्रज्या-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, wandering, roaming; going gracefully.
व्रण्: व्रण् 1. व्रण् (also written ब्रण्), cl. 1. P. व्रणति, वव्राण, व्रणितुम्, to sound.
व्रण् 2. व्रण् (perhaps rather to be re-garded as a Nom. fr. व्रण below), cl. 10. P. व्रणयति, -यितुम्, to wound.
व्रण: व्रण, अस्, अम्, m. n. a wound, sore, ulcer, boil, bruise, tumor; a fracture, scar, rent (see अ-व्°, cf. Manu II. 47); [cf. Gr. οὐλή (i. e. ϝολνη), ἄπ-ελος; Lat. vulnus.] —व्रण-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, making a sore, wounding, ulcerating; corroding; (त्), m. the mark-ing-nut plant, Semecarpus Anacardium. —व्रण-केतु-घ्नी, f. a kind of small shrub (= दुग्ध-फेनी). —व्रण-द्विष्, ट्, ट्, ट्, ‘hostile to sores,’ healing sores; (ट्), m. the plant Siphonanthus Indica (= ब्राह्मण-यष्टिका). —व्रण-धूपन, अम्, n. fumigating a sore. —व्रण-वस्तु, n. a part liable to ulcerate (as skin, flesh, &c.). —व्रण-वेदना, f. the pain of a wound or sore. —व्रण-शोधन, अम्, n. the cleansing or cicatrising of a sore. —व्र-ण-ह, अस्, m. ‘destroying sores,’ the castor-oil tree; (आ), f. a sort of creeper or shrub (= गुडूची). —व्र-ण-हृत्, त्, m. ‘sore-removing,’ a particular plant (= कलि-कारी). —व्रणारि (°ण-अरि), इस्, m. ‘enemy of sores,’ the plant Sesbana Grandiflora (= अगस्त्य-वृक्ष); gum-myrrh (= वोल).
व्रणित: व्रणित, अस्, आ, अम्, wounded, ulcerated, bruised, scarred. —व्रणित-हृदय, अस्, आ, अम्, heart-stricken, bruised or wounded at heart.
व्रणिन्: व्रणिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having a sore or wound, afflicted with boils or ulcers.
व्रत: व्रत व्रत, अस्, अम्, m. n. (probably an old past pass. participle fr. rt. वृ), anything enclosed, an enclosed place, enclosure, realm, sphere, sway (Ved.); anything fenced off or settled, a law, ordinance, com-mand, rule, (अनु-व्रतम्, according to law or ordi-nance); rite, observance, practice [cf. अर्क-व्°, यम-व्°]; any religious act or obligation enjoined by the gods; a sacrifice; a self-chosen or voluntary act, any meritorious act of devotion or austerity, fasting, continence, vowed observance, solemn pur-pose, vow, (असि-धारा-व्रत or आसिधारं व्र-तम्, a vow to stand on the edge of a sword or a vow as difficult as standing on the edge of a sword); action, agency, doing, work, deed; a design, plan; eating, in पयो-व्रत, q. v.; [cf. probably Gr. ἑορτή.] —व्रत-कल्पद्रुम, अम्, n., N. of a work by Ratnākara. —व्रत-चर्या, f. the practice of religious vows; (अस्), m. a religious student. —व्रत-चारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, Ved. vow-performing, fulfilling or performing vows. —व्रत-तत्त्व, अम्, n., N. of a part of the Smṛti-tattva. —व्रत-निमित्त, अस्, आ, अम्, caused by a vow. —व्रत-पति, इस्, m., Ved. ‘lord of vows,’ epithet of Agni. —व्रत-पा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. upholding ordinances, protecting sacred rites. —व्रत-पारण, अम्, आ, n. f. conclusion of a fast, eating or drinking after a fast. —व्रत-प्र-काश, अस्, m. ‘illustration of vows,’ N. of a work by Viśva-nātha on the subject of vows (compiled from the Purāṇas and other more ancient sources). —व्र-त-प्रतिष्ठा, f. the performance of a religious act voluntarily undertaken. —व्रत-भङ्ग, अस्, m. the interruption of an act of devotion, breach of a vow. —व्रत-भिक्षा, f. soliciting alms (as one of the ceremonies accompanying investiture). —व्रत-भृत्, त्, m., Ved. ‘bearer of sacrifices,’ epithet of Agni. —व्रत-राज, अस्, m. = व्रत-प्रकाश above. —व्रत-लुप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has broken a vow (of fasting &c.). —व्रत-लोपन, अम्, n. the breaking of a vow (of fasting, chastity, &c.), violat-ing any religious vow or obligation. —व्रत-वै-कल्य, अम्, n. imperfection or incompletion of a vow or religious observance. —व्रत-शेष, अस्, m. the remainder of a religious vow. —व्रत-संर-क्षण, अम्, n. the keeping of a vow, observing penance. —व्रत-सङ्ग्रह, अस्, m. undertaking any act of devotion, taking on one's self any voluntary religious obligation (= दीक्षा). —व्रत-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, engaged in religious austerities or in a vow of any kind, performing penance. —व्रत-स्नातक, अस्, m. a Brāhman who has completed his term of studentship, (see स्नातक।) —व्रताचरण (°त-आच्°), अम्, n. the act of observing a vow or religious obligation (especially that of continence, as the duty of a religious student; cf. ब्रह्म-चर्य). —व्र-तादान (°त-आद्°), अम्, n. undertaking the obliga-tions of a devotee. —व्रतादेश (°त-आद्°), अस्, m. investiture of a youth of one of the first three classes with the sacred cord. —व्रतोपवास (°त-उप्°), अस्, m. fasting as a religious obligation, a fast. —व्रतोपा-यन (°त-उप्°), अम्, n. = वायन, presents of cakes &c. which may be eaten during a religious feast.
व्रतय: व्रतय, Nom. P. व्रतयति, -यितुम्, to observe a vow; to fast or practise any abstinence in conse-quence of a vow; to eat together.
व्रतिक: व्रतिक in वक-व्रतिक, वैडाल-व्°, &c., q. q. v. v.
व्रतिन्: व्रतिन्, ई, इनी, इ, observing a vow (of continence, fasting, &c.), relating to a vow, practising any penance or religious observance, engaged in a sacrifice, devout, pious; (ई), m. an ascetic, devotee; a religious student; one who institutes a sacrifice and employs priests (= यजमान); N. of a Muni.
व्रतेयु: व्रतेयु, उस्, m., N. of a king.
व्रत्य: व्रत्य, अस्, आ, अम्, = व्रतिन् (Ṛg-v. VIII. 48, 8).
व्रतति: व्रतति व्रतति, इस्, f. (said to be fr. rt. 1. वृत्, according to Yāska fr. rts. वृ and 3. तन्), expansion, extension, spreading; a creeper. —व्रतति-वलय, अस्, अम्, m. n. a creeper winding round like a bracelet.
व्रध्न: व्रध्न व्रध्न, अस्, m. (also written ब्रध्न, q. v.), the sun; the root of a tree.
व्रन्द्: व्रन्द् व्रन्द् or व्रद् (a Vedic root said to be allied to rts. म्रद् and 1. मृड्, ‘to rub, press, crush,’ &c.), cl. 1. P. A. व्रन्दति, -ते, &c., (probably) to soften; to become soft, (अव्र-दन्त वीलितेत्य् अपि निगमो भवति, Nirukta V. 16); [cf. Gr. βραδύ.]
व्रन्दिन्: व्रन्दिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. reduced to a state of softness or mildness; tamed, subdued, (or according to Sāy. connected with वृन्द, ‘a multitude;’ व्रन्-दिनः = मृदु-भावं प्राप्तान् or समूह-व-तः, Ṛg-veda I. 54, 4; see Nirukta V. 15.)
व्रयस्: व्रयस् व्रयस्। See under rt. व्री, col. 3.
व्रयस्, Ved. abandoning, abandonment, (accord-ing to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda II. 23, 16. वि व्रयस् = विशेषेण वर्जनम्।)
व्रश्च्: व्रश्च् व्रश्च्, cl. 6. P. वृश्चति (Ved. वृ-णक्ति, Naigh. II. 19), वव्रश्च, व्र-श्चिष्यति or व्रक्ष्यति, अव्रश्चीत् or अव्राक्षीत्, व्रश्चितुम् or व्रष्टुम्, to cut, cut up, cut asunder, tear, lacerate, divide with an edged tool; to wound: Caus. व्रश्चयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अविव्रश्चत्: Desid. विव्रश्चिषति and विव्रक्षति: Intens. वरीवृ-श्च्यते, वरीवृश्चीति; [cf. Gr. ἔλκος, ῥάκος, λακίς, λακερός; Lat. lacerare, ulcus.]
व्रश्च्, व्रट्, ट्, ट्, cutting, cutting off.
व्रश्चन: व्रश्चन, अस्, ई, अम्, who or what cuts, cutting; (अस्), m. a small saw or chisel; a fine file or saw used by goldsmiths, &c.; the juice flowing from an incision in a tree; (अम्), n. cutting, wounding; a cut, incision. —व्रश्चन-प्रभव, अस्, आ, अम्, flowing from an incision (in a tree, as juices &c.).
व्रह्मन्: व्रह्मन् व्रह्मन्, अ, n. = ब्रह्मन्, q. v.
व्रा: व्रा व्रा, f. (fr. rt. वृ), Ved. night; dawn, (Sāy. on Ṛg-veda I. 121, 2 = तमसा सर्वम् आच्छादयतीति व्रा रात्रिः or प्रकाशेन वृणोतीति व्रा उषाः); a multitude, troop, (see Nirukta V. 3.)
व्राचड: व्राचड व्राचड, अस्, m. a kind of corrupt dialect.
व्राज: व्राज व्राज, अस्, m. (fr. rt. व्रज्), going, movement, motion; a troop, multitude (Ved.). —व्राज-बाहू, m. du., Ved. the spreading or out-stretched arms of death.
व्राजि: व्राजि, इस्, f. a gale of wind, whirlwind, wind.
व्रात: व्रात व्रात, अस्, m. (fr. व्रत or connected with rt. वृ), a multitude, flock, assemblage, troop, (व्रातं-व्रातम्, in companies, in troops, Ṛg-veda V. 53, 11); = मनुष्य (according to Naigh. II. 3); the descendant of an outcast Brāhman, &c., (see व्रात्य); the company or attendants at a marriage feast; (अम्), n. manual or bodily labour; day labour, casual employment. —व्रात-जीवन, अम्, n. living by manual or bodily labour.
व्रातीन: व्रातीन, अस्, m. one living by the profession of a Vrāta, a hired labourer, porter, cooly; one having no fixed employment; one living by violence.
व्रात्य: व्रात्य, अस्, m. a Brāhman or man of one of the first three classes who has lost caste through non-observance of the ten principal Saṃskāras (especially investiture with the thread; in the Atharva-veda XV. 8, 1, XV. 9, 1. the Rājanyas and even the Brāhmans are said to have sprung from the Vrātya who is even identified with the Supreme Being); an out-cast; a man of a particular inferior class (regarded as the descendant of a Śūdra father and Kṣatriya mother; cf. वैद्य); a low or vile person; (आ), f. the daughter of an outcast, a female of a fallen Brāhman, &c. —व्रात्य-ता, f. or व्रात्य-त्व, अम्, n. the condition of one who has lost caste by neglect of the Saṃskāras or sacred observances (such as investi-ture with the thread, &c.). —व्रात्य-ब्रुव, अस्, m. one who calls himself a Vrātya; [cf. ब्राह्मण-ब्रुव।] —व्रात्य-भाव, अस्, m. = व्रात्य-ता. —व्रा-त्य-याजक, अस्, m. one who sacrifices for a Vrātya. —व्रात्य-स्तोम, अस्, m. a particular sacrifice per-formed to recover the rights forfeited by a delay of the Saṃskāras (especially of investiture).
व्राधत्: व्राधत् व्राधत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत् (probably a kind of pres. part. connected with rt. 1. वृध्), Ved. great, mighty, (Sāy. = महत्, Ṛg-veda IV. 32, 3; cf. Gr. βλωθ-ρός.) —व्राधन्-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, greatest, most eminent, (Sāy. = प्रवृद्ध-तम, Ṛg-veda I. 150, 3.)
व्राधत्; according to B. R. fr. a rt. व्राध्, to excite, incite, provoke.
व्रिश्: व्रिश् व्रिश्, शस्, f. pl., Ved. the fingers (according to Naigh. II. 5; according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda I. 144, 5. व्रिशः = विशः = परस्पर-विश्लिष्टाः, mutually separated).
व्री: व्री व्री (connected with rts. वृ, व्ली), cl. 9. P. व्रीणाति or व्रिणाति, विव्राय, व्रेष्यति, अव्रैषीत्, व्रेतुम्, to choose, elect; cl. 4. A. व्रीयते, विव्रिये, व्रेष्यते, अव्रेष्ट, व्रे-तुम्, to choose (?); to be chosen or elected; to cover, screen: Caus. व्राययति (or according to others व्रेपयति), -यितुम्: Desid. विव्रीषति, -ते: Intens. वेव्रीयते, वेव्रयीति, वेव्रेति।
व्रीण: व्रीण, अस्, आ, अम्, chosen, elected.
व्रीड्: व्रीड् व्रीड्, cl. 4. P. व्रीड्यति (ep. cl. 1. A. व्रीडते, see below), विव्रीड, व्रीडिष्-यति, अव्रीडीत्, व्रीडितुम्, to be ashamed, feel shame, to be modest or bashful; to throw, hurl, send; (ac-cording to Nirukta V. 16. व्रीडयति = वीडयति।)
व्रीड: व्रीड, अस्, आ, m. f. shame, modesty, bashfulness. —व्रीडानत (°डा-आन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, bowed down with shame, hanging down the head with shame, ashamed. —व्रीडान्वित (°डा-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, ashamed, bashful, modest. —व्रीडा-युज्, क्, क्, क्, possessing shame, ashamed.
व्रीडन: व्रीडन, अम्, n. shame, bashfulness, modesty; lowering, depression (= नीचैर्-भाव).
व्रीडमान: व्रीडमान, अस्, आ, अम् (an epic form), being ashamed, blushing.
व्रीडित: व्रीडित, अस्, आ, अम्, ashamed, abashed, modest; (अम्), n. shame.
व्रीस्: व्रीस् व्रीस् (= rt. व्रूस्), cl. 1. 10. P. व्री-सति, व्रीसयति, to hurt, injure; to kill, wound.
व्रीहि: व्रीहि व्रीहि, इस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. व्री), rice, (eight principal sorts are enumerated by native authorities; rice is not mentioned in the Ṛg-veda, but is named in the Atharva-veda together with यव, माष, and तिल); a grain of rice, (व्रीहीन् प्रोक्षति, he sprinkles or scatters grains of rice); rice ripening in the rainy season; (अयस्), m. pl. grains of rice. —व्रीहि-काञ्चन, अस्, m. a sort of pulse, Ervum Lens or Hirsutum (= मशूर). —व्री-हि-पर्णी, f. a particular shrub (= शाल-पर्णी)। —व्रीहि-भेद, अस्, m. a species of rice; a sort of grain, Panicum Miliaceum (= अणु). —व्रीहि-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made or consisting of rice; (अस्), m. a rice-cake made with ghee (offered as an oblation). —व्रीहि-राजिक, अस्, m. panic seed, Panicum Itali-cum (= कङ्गु); another species, Panicum Milia-ceum. —व्रीहि-श्रेष्ठ, अस्, m. a kind of rice (= शालि-धान्य). —व्रीह्य्-अगार, अम्, n. ‘rice-house,’ a shed where rice or other grain is stored, granary.
व्रीहिक: व्रीहिक, अस्, आ, अम्, having rice, bearing rice, &c.
व्रीहिन्: व्रीहिन्, ई, इणी, इ, having or bearing rice (a field &c.).
व्रैह: व्रैह, अस्, ई, अम्, made of rice, composed of rice.
व्रैहेय: व्रैहेय, अस्, ई, अम्, fit for rice, sown with rice (as a field &c.), made or consisting of rice; (अम्), n. a field of rice.
व्रुड्: व्रुड् व्रुड्, cl. 6. P. व्रुडति, to cover; to heap; to sink.
व्रूस्: व्रूस् व्रूस् (also written व्रूष् or ब्रूष्; cf. rts. व्रीस्, कष्), cl. 1. 10. P. व्रूसति, व्रूसयति, &c., to hurt, injure, wound, kill.
व्ली: व्ली व्ली (also written ब्ली; according to some fr. वि-ली, but cf. rt. व्री), cl. 9. P. व्लि-नाति (Ved. व्लीनाति), विव्लाय, व्लेष्यति, अव्लैषीत्, व्लेतुम्, to go, move; to choose, select, (in this sense for rts. वृ, व्री); to hold, maintain, support: Caus. व्लेपयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अविव्लिपत्: Desid. विव्ली-षति: Intens. वेव्लीयते, वेव्लयीति or वेव्लेति।
व्लीन: व्लीन, अस्, आ, अम्, gone; held, supported.
व्लेक्ष्: व्लेक्ष् व्लेक्ष् (also written वेक्ष्, q. v.), cl. 10. P. व्लेक्षयति, व्लेक्षापयति, यितुम्, to see.
वर्षधर: वर्ष-धर or वर्ष-प, अस्, or वर्ष-पति, इस्, or वर्ष-भुज्, क्, m. the ruler of a Varṣa.
वर्षाहू: वर्षा-हू, ऊस्, f., Ved. ‘calling out or croaking in the rains,’ a frog (= वर्षा-भू).
वर्षु: वर्षु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. sprouting in the rains.
वर्ष्टृ: वर्ष्टृ, टा, ट्री, टृ, Ved. one who rains, pouring down.
वलक: वलक, अस्, m. a covering, cover; (अम्), n. a procession, B. R.
वलभिका: वलभिका, f. a particular poisonous insect.
वल्गुली: वल्गुली, f. a kind of bat.
वशितृ: वशितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who has a strong will, independent.
वशिमन्: वशिमन्, आ, m. the supernatural power of bringing everything under one's own will.
वष्टि: वष्टि, इस्, इस्, इ (fr. rt. वश्), Ved. wishing for, loving.
वसतिद्रुम: वसति-द्रुम, अस्, m. a tree suitable for lodging under.
वसन्ततिलक: वसन्त-तिलक; for ‘अस्, अम्, m. n.’ read अम्, आ, n. f.
वसवान: वसवान, अस्, m. (fr. वसु), Ved. an owner or holder of property.
वसाति: वसाति, अयस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
वसातीय: वसातीय, belonging to the Vasātis; (अस्), m. a king of the Vasātis.
वस्नय: वस्नय, Nom. P. वस्नयति, &c., Ved. to expose for sale (B. R.); to desire wealth.
वस्नयत्: वस्नयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. desiring riches, (Sāy. = धनम् इच्छत्, Ṛg-veda VI. 47, 21.)
वह्यशीवन्: वह्य-शीवन्, आ, अरी, अ, or वह्ये-शय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. lying in a palanquin; reclining on a couch; [cf. तल्प-शीवन्।]
वाणीवाद: वाणी-वाद, अस्, आ, अम्, uttering words, talking, talkative; (अस्), m. a kind of bird.
वातरेचक: वात-रेचक, अस्, m. a gust of wind.
वातस्कन्ध: वात-स्कन्ध, अस्, m. one of the regions of the wind (of which there are seven); N. of a Ṛṣi.
वाताय: वाताय, Nom. A. वातायते, -यितुम्, to resemble the wind.
वातायमान: वातायमान, अस्, आ, अम्, resembling the wind, quick as the wind.
वाध्र्यश्व: वाध्र्यश्व, अस्, m. (fr. वध्र्य्-अश्व), a patro-nymic.
वामनक: वामनक, अस्, आ, अम्, = वामन, dwarfish, a dwarf; (अस्), m. epithet of a man born under a par-ticular constellation; N. of a mountain; (इका), f., N. of one of the Mātṛs attending on Skanda; (अम्), n. the form of a dwarf; N. of a place of pilgrimage (called after Viṣṇu in his dwarf-incarnation).
वायुस्कन्ध: वायु-स्कन्ध, अस्, m. one of the regions of the wind.
वारणशाला: वारण-शाला, f. a place for keeping elephants.
वारीय: वारीय, Nom. A. वारीयते, &c., to be like water.
वार्योकस्: वार्य्-ओकस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, living in the water pro-bably (आस्), f. a leech [cf. जलौकस्].
वार्षल: वार्षल, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. वृषल), proper for a Śūdra; (अम्), n. the occupation of a Śūdra.
वार्षिक्य: वार्षिक्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. वार्षिक), yearly, annual; (अम्), n. the rainy season.
वासवि: वासवि, इस्, m. (fr. वासव), ‘son of Indra,’ Ar-juna; the ape Bālin.
वासवेय: वासवेय, अस्, m. (fr. वासवी), a metronymic of Vyāsa.
वाह्न: वाह्न, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. वह्नि), relating to fire.
विक्रीड: वि-क्रीड, अस्, m. a play-ground; (आ), f. play, sport, jest.
विक्लवित: वि-क्लवित, अम्, n. a desponding speech.
विक्षर: वि-क्षर, अस्, आ, अम्, flowing away, pouring out; (अस्), m. the flowing away; N. of Viṣṇu; of an Asura.
विचर: वि-चर, अस्, आ, अम्, moving away from.
विचालन: वि-चालन, अस्, ई, अम्, causing to go away, ruining, destroying.
विचिकित्सित: वि-चिकित्सित, अस्, आ, अम्, doubted about, questioned.
विचिन्तन: वि-चिन्तन, अम्, n. thinking about; discernment.
विचिन्ता: वि-चिन्ता, f. thought, regard, care, anxiety.
विचूलिन्: वि-चूलिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having no top-knot.
विच्चिक: विच्चिक, अस्, m. a particular bird.
विजेष: वि-जेष, अस्, m., Ved. victory, conquest.
विजेषकृत्: विजेष-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. causing victory.
विज्य: वि-ज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, unstrung; [cf. स-ज्य।]
विडम्ब्य: वि-डम्ब्य, अम्, n. an object of derision.
विण्मूत्र: विण्-मूत्र, अम्, n. (i. e. 3. विष् + मूत्र), feces and urine, (sometimes also ए, neut. du.)
वित्रिष्णा: वि-त्रिष्णा, f. freedom from desire, absence of longing; excessive desire, violent longing for.
विदीपक: वि-दीपक, अस्, m. a light, lamp, lantern.
विद्याव्रत: विद्या-व्रत, अम्, n. divine knowledge and reli-gious vows; a particular religious observance.
विद्याव्रतस्नात: विद्या-व्रत-स्नात, अस्, m. (a Brāhman) who has completed his course of Vedic study and his religious observances.
विद्योत: वि-द्योत, अस्, आ, अम्, glittering, gleaming, spark-ling; (अस्), m. glitter, gleam; a proper N.; (आ), f., N. of an Apsaras.
विद्वल: विद्वल, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. clever, cunning, artful.
विधूम्र: वि-धूम्र, अस्, आ, अम्, quite grey.
विनिनीषु: वि-निनीषु, उस्, उस्, उ, desirous of ruling or governing.
विनिन्द: वि-निन्द, अस्, आ, अम्, censuring; (आ), f. abuse, slander.
विनिबर्हण: वि-निबर्हण, अस्, ई, अम्, or वि-निबर्हिन्, ई, इणी, इ, throwing down, dashing to pieces.
विनिर्बाहु: वि-निर्बाहु, उस्, m. a particular kind of fighting.
विनिर्मुक्ति: वि-निर्मुक्ति, इस्, f. freedom from, deliverance from.
विनिर्मोक्ष: वि-निर्मोक्ष, अस्, m. freedom from; exclusion from.
विनिवर्तन: वि-निवर्तन, अम्, n. the act of turning back, returning, return home; the coming to an end, cessation.
विनेत्र: वि-नेत्र, अस्, m. an instructor, preceptor, teacher.
विपरिभ्रंश: वि-परिभ्रंश, अस्, m. complete failure, mis-carriage; loss, ruin.
विपुलय: विपुलय, Nom. P. विपुलयति, to extend, enlarge.
विप्रणाश: वि-प्रणाश, अस्, m. complete loss, total disap-pearance.
विप्रतीप: वि-प्रतीप, अस्, आ, अम्, quite contrary or opposite, obstinate, wilful, stubborn, hostile, unfriendly.
विप्रत्यय: वि-प्रत्यय, अस्, m. want of confidence.
विप्रमाथिन्: वि-प्रमाथिन्, ई, इनी, इ, crushing or trampling to pieces, destroying.
विप्रमोक्ष: वि-प्रमोक्ष, अस्, m. the being free from, free-dom or release from.
विप्रमोक्षण: वि-प्रमोक्षण, अम्, n. the act of liberating one's self from, liberation from.
विप्रवाद: वि-प्रवाद, अस्, m. varying statement, disagree-ment.
विप्रहाण: वि-प्रहाण, अम्, n. entire disappearance, total loss.
विप्रेक्षण: वि-प्रेक्षण, अम्, n. the act of looking round.
विबुभूषा: वि-बुभूषा, f. wish to manifest one's self.
विबुभूषु: वि-बुभूषु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to appear or manifest one's self.
विभञ्जनु: वि-भञ्जनु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. breaking to pieces, crushing, destroying, (Sāy. = विशेषेण भञ्जक, Ṛg-veda IV. 17, 13.)
विभानु: वि-भानु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. shining forth, shining.
विभास: वि-भास, अस्, m., N. of one of the seven suns; of a deity.
विभीषा: वि-भीषा, f. desire of frightening, wish to alarm.
विभूमन्: वि-भूमन्, आ, m. (perhaps) ‘appearing in many forms,’ epithet of Kṛṣṇa.
विभूरसि: विभूर्-असि, इस्, m. ‘thou art mighty,’ a form of fire, B. R.
विमलय: विमलय, Nom. P. विमलयति, &c., to make pure or clean, purify, cleanse.
विमृध्: वि-मृध्, त्, m., Ved. an enemy, (according to Sāy. वि-मृधः = सङ्ग्राम-कारी, Ṛg-veda X. 152, 2.)
विमृश: वि-मृश, अस्, m. consideration, reflection, exa-mination.
विमोक: वि-मोक, अस्, m., Ved. unloosing, releasing, libe-ration, ending, completion; freedom from, release from.
विरात्र: वि-रात्र, the passing away of night.
विरावण: वि-रावण, अस्, ई, अम्, raising a cry or clamour.
विरूक्ष: वि-रूक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, rough, harsh.
विरेचक: वि-रेचक, अस्, इका, अम्, purgative, cathartic.
विलापन: 1. वि-लापन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. the Caus. of वि-लप्), causing to bewail; (अम्), n. the act of causing to lament; lamentation; (अस्), m. a proper N.
2. वि-लापन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. the Caus. of वि-ली), causing to be dissolved, melting, &c.; causing to dis-appear, destroying; (अम्), n. dissolution, death.
विवर्षिषु: विवर्षिषु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. the Desid. of rt. वृष्), inclined or disposed to rain, about to rain.
विवारयिषु: विवारयिषु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. Desid. of Caus. of rt. वृ), wishing to keep back, desirous of restraining.
विवित्सा: विवित्सा, f. (fr. the Desid. of rt. 1. विद्), the wish to know or understand, desire of knowledge.
विवित्सु: विवित्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to know, desiring knowledge.
विशकल: वि-शकल, अस्, आ, अम्, broken to pieces, reduced to shreds and fragments.
विशकलीकृ: विशकली-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, &c., to reduce to fragments, break to pieces, shatter.
विशङ्क्य: वि-शङ्क्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be suspected, suspicious.
विशन: विशन, अम्, n. the act of entering, entrance; penetration.
विशोषिन्: वि-शोषिन्, ई, इणी, इ, drying up, becoming dry; drying, making dry.
विश्रमण: वि-श्रमण, अम्, n. the act of reposing or taking rest after fatigue.
विषयवासिन्: विषय-वासिन्; add — one who dwells in any region or country, an inhabitant of a province.
विषूचीन: विषूचीन, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. विष्व्-अञ्च्), going on all sides, all-pervading, extending everywhere, going asunder, (opposed to समीचीन, q. v.)
विसंसर्पिन्: वि-संसर्पिन्, ई, इणी, इ, moving about, becoming spread about or diffused.
विसञ्चारिन्: वि-सञ्चारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, wandering about in all directions, straying.
विसदृश्: वि-सदृश्, क्, क्, क्, or वि-सदृश, अस्, ई, अम्, unlike, dissimilar.
विसर्गिन्: वि-सर्गिन्, ई, इणी, इ, creating, producing; distri-buting, bestowing, giving.
विसर्मन्: वि-सर्मन्, आ, आ, अ (fr. वि-सृ), Ved. flowing away, transitory.
विस्फोटन: वि-स्फोटन, अम्, n. a loud noise or crash.
विस्मारक: वि-स्मारक, अस्, इका, अम्, causing to forget.
विस्मारण: वि-स्मारण, अस्, ई, अम्, causing to forget.
विस्रव: वि-स्रव, अस्, m. a stream, flood, flow.
विहिंसन: वि-हिंसन, अम्, n. the act of injuring, injury.
विहिंस्र: वि-हिंस्र, अस्, आ, अम्, injurious, noxious, hurtful.
वीरिण: वीरिण, अस्, अम्, m. n. the grass Andropogon Muricatus.
वृत्तवत्: वृत्त-वत्; add — round; having suitable occu-pation.
वृधीक: वृधीक, अस्, m., Ved. an increaser, prosperer.
वेणविन्: वेणविन्, ई, इनी, इ (fr. वेणु), having a flute or pipe (said of Śiva).
वेणीसंहार: वेणी-संहार; add — ‘hair-binding,’ (the name of the Drama, though connected by some with the seizing and unloosing of Draupadī's hair by Duḥśā-sana, rather refers to its being bound together again after the punishment of Duḥśāsana.)
वेदना: वेदना, f. pain, &c., (this may also be अम्, n.)
वेप: वेप, अस्, ई, अम्, swinging, moving, oscillating (Ved.); (अस्), m. trembling, quivering.
वैतस्तिक: वैतस्तिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. वि-तस्ति), measuring a span.
वैत्तपाल्य: वैत्तपाल्य (fr. वित्त-पाल), relating to Vitta-pāla or Kuvera.
वैद्रुम: वैद्रुम, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. वि-द्रुम), made of coral.
वैनत्य: वैनत्य, अम्, n. (fr. वि-नत), submissiveness, modesty.
वैनायक: वैनायक, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to Gaṇeśa.
व्यालम्बिन्: व्य्-आलम्बिन्, ई, इनी, इ, hanging down.
व्यावृत्सु: व्य्-आवृत्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to separate one's self from.
व्याशा: व्य्-आशा, f. an intermediate quarter of the compass.
व्युद: व्य्-उद or व्य्-उदक, अस्, आ, अम्, devoid of water.
व्युद्ग्रन्थन: व्य्-उद्ग्रन्थन, अम्, n. the act of winding or intertwining in various ways.
व्युन्मिश्र: व्य्-उन्मिश्र, अस्, आ, अम्, intermixed, commingled.
व्युपकार: व्य्-उपकार, अस्, m. making good, fulfilling, per-formance.
व्यूक: व्यूक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
व्योदन: व्य्-ओदन, Ved. having various kinds of grain or food.
व्र: व्र; in Ṛg-veda I. 124, 8. व्राः is referred by B. R. to a form व्र fr. rt. वृ, meaning ‘a collec-tion, multitude;’ see व्रा, p. 984, col. 2.
व्रजभाषा: व्रज-भाषा, f. the Braj dialect (spoken around Agra and Mathurā).
व्रण्य: व्रण्य, अस्, आ, अम्, good or suitable for wounds.
व्रतस्नान: व्रत-स्नान, अम्, n. the due performance of vowed observances.
व्रतादेश: व्रतादेश; add — enjoining a religious observance.
व्रस्क: व्रस्क, अस्, आ, अम् (at the end of comps.), cutting.
व्लग्: व्लग् or व्लङ्ग्, a Vedic rt., according to Sāy. meaning ‘to go,’ &c.; used with prep. अभि, (in Ṛg-veda I. 133, 1, 2. अभि-व्लग्य = अभितो गत्वा or अभितः प्राप्य, having approached or come near, having laid hold of; according to B. R. per-haps ‘having strangled.’)
